Title: Must have every day routine
ReviewText:
I’m genuinely OBSESSED with this glazing milk 🤍 The texture is just everything—so lightweight, silky, and it melts into my skin instantly. It feels like a drink of water for my face every single time I use it.

I keep it in my skincare fridge (yes, it’s that serious 😭) and using it cold makes the experience even better. It leaves my skin feeling SO smooth, like actual silk, and gives me that healthy, glowy finish without feeling heavy or greasy.

I use it every single day and I’m not even kidding when I say I can’t go without it anymore. My skin just looks and feels so hydrated, calm, and fresh.

10/10. I’m in love 💫

나는 매일 그것을 사용하고 더 이상 그것 없이는 갈 수 없다고 말해도 농담이 아닙니다. 내 피부는 수분이 풍부하고 차분하며 신선해 보이고 느껴집니다.

Title: NO GO IF YOU HAVE ACNE PRONE SKIN

I tried two more times with different preparation methods and foundations, but every time I had issues with separation and left me looking super oily. Author: OpalPearl
ReviewText: I have mixed feelings about this glazing milk essence. I didn’t care for the scent of it, and I also didn’t love the bottle design, finding that product often ended up accumulating on the flat top after I had dispenser some onto my hands. On initial application, I did not care for how it felt on my skin. It felt too greasy, but once it absorbed, it was much better. My skin felt soft and hydrated and glowy. I did still feel there was a slight oiliness left behind, which makes me feel it may be better suited to dryer skin types. I did also feel some slight sensation after using it, not even a tingling really. I do wonder how it will affect my skin with long-term use due to the oilier texture; however, it does provide nice results for now.

Author: Lembesixoxo
Title: No
ReviewText:
I want to be very clear that I did not struggle with acne prior to using these products. I am extremely upset that I spent over $60 on this combination, only for it to cause severe and widespread breakouts. I purchased the two-product set with genuine excitement and optimism. Although I had seen multiple reports on social media about these products causing significant breakouts, I believed that might not be my experience.

I followed the instructions precisely, and every area where the products were applied developed large, painful, under-the-skin pimples and persistent bumps. The reaction was so intense that I have had to continuously wear pimple patches, and I even experienced breakouts on my neck and jaw—areas where I have never had acne before.

This experience has been incredibly distressing and frustrating. I am deeply disappointed that something I invested so much money and trust in has resulted in such a serious skin issue. I genuinely wish I had never purchased these products, as the emotional and physical impact has been far greater than expected.

Author: babyymonser
ReviewText: Rhode Glazing Milk Ceramide Facial Essence delivers a featherweight, cushiony texture that feels almost whipped as it glides across the skin, dissolving into a refreshing veil of hydration. The milky, slightly opalescent formula layers effortlessly under serums and moisturizers, lending a soft radiance without any tacky or sticky residue. Its ceramide complex works quietly in the background, strengthening the barrier while keeping the complexion serene and comforted after cleansing. I appreciate the delicate, spa-like scent that fades quickly, making it an easy addition to both morning and evening routines without clashing with other fragrances. The pump mechanism dispenses a measured beading of product, which helps with consistent application and minimal waste. On my skin, it feels neither heavy nor greasy, striking a truly balanced viscosity that suits a variety of climates and seasons. Author: Miccheelle
ReviewText: Rhode Glazing Milk Ceramide Facial Essence is a lightweight, hydrating serum that glides smoothly onto the skin, delivering a refreshing, dewy finish. The milky texture feels luxe yet breathable, absorbing quickly without leaving a sticky afterfeel. Its ceramide complex helps reinforce the skin barrier, which is particularly comforting for drought-prone or sensitive complexions. I notice a gentle, comforting scent that fades quickly, making it suitable for daily use without overpowering other products. The essence layers nicely under moisturizer, enhancing overall softness and radiance rather than competing with other actives in my routine. Visually, it imparts a healthy glow that seems to come from within, rather than sitting on the surface like some high-shine serums. A subtle note of sweetness from the milky base makes the experience pleasant without being gourmand or cloying. In terms of texture, it’s neither too runny nor too thick, striking a balanced viscosity that feels indulgent but practical for morning and night routines. I’ve used it for several weeks and my skin looks smoother, with a refined texture and fewer dry patches along the cheeks and nose. It plays well with acids and vitamins, showing no signs of irritation or pilling when layered with other products. The packaging is clean and minimal, and the pump delivers a controlled amount, reducing waste and making it easy to portion out your daily dose. The ingredient list feels thoughtful, prioritizing barrier-supportive components over fragrance-heavy formulas, which is reassuring for long-term use. While it’s not a miracle product, it contributes noticeably to a healthy, hydrated baseline that enhances makeup wearability and luminosity. One potential con is that if you prefer a more matte or matte-dewy finish, you might not notice dramatic shine because the glow is softly natural. ReviewText: I’ve been using rhode Glazing Milk Ceramide Facial Essence for a few weeks now, and I absolutely love it. The texture is lightweight, milky, and instantly comforting — it absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or heavy. My skin feels noticeably more hydrated, calm, and smooth right after application, and it gives that healthy, glazed glow without looking oily. I especially appreciate how well it layers with the rest of my skincare and makeup — no pilling at all. This essence has been amazing for strengthening my skin barrier and reducing dryness and sensitivity. It feels soothing and nourishing, making it perfect for both morning and evening routines. Definitely a staple if you’re looking for hydration, glow, and skin comfort in one step.

Author: Annlovesmakeup
ReviewText: Rhode Glazing Milk has quickly become a staple in my daily routine. The texture is lightweight and silky, almost like a milky essence, and it absorbs beautifully without feeling greasy or heavy. I use it right after cleansing, morning and night, and it instantly preps my skin for the rest of my skincare and makeup. The hydration is noticeable right away—my skin feels calm, plump, and comfortable, with that healthy glazed look without any shine. Over time, I’ve noticed my skin stays hydrated longer throughout the day and looks smoother overall. It layers well under serums, moisturizer, and SPF, and also works perfectly under makeup for a fresh, dewy finish. If you’re looking for an easy step that adds lasting hydration and a healthy glow, this is definitely worth adding to your routine.

Author: yruri
Title: Causes Foundation Separation Over Time
ReviewText:
Unfortunately, this did not meet my expectations.

The first issue for me was the scent. It has a distinctly chalky smell that makes the application experience unpleasant. For a product positioned as a refined skincare step, the fragrance feels distracting rather than soothing.

The texture is also extremely slippery, almost serum-like. While this may work well under skin tints or very lightweight bases, it does not perform well under long-wear foundations. I typically use Estée Lauder Double Wear, and although the base looks nice immediately after application, the performance does not last.

After a few hours of wear, the foundation begins to separate and break down, settling unevenly rather than wearing gracefully. Instead of extending wear time, this product seemed to compromise the longevity of my makeup.

Overall, this may suit those who prefer minimal makeup or tints, but for anyone relying on long-lasting, full-coverage foundations, this was disappointing and not something I would repurchase.

불행히도 이것은 내 기대에 미치지 못했습니다.

나에게 첫 번째 문제는 향기였습니다. 그것은 응용 프로그램 경험을 불쾌하게 만드는 뚜렷한 백악 냄새가 있습니다. 정제된 스킨케어 단계로 포지셔닝된 제품의 경우 향은 진정되기보다는 산만한 느낌을 줍니다.

질감도 매우 미끄럽고 거의 세럼과 비슷합니다. 이 제품은 스킨 틴트나 매우 가벼운 베이스에는 효과가 좋을 수 있지만, 오래 지속되는 파운데이션에는 효과가 좋지 않습니다. 평소 에스티로더 더블웨어를 주로 사용하는데 바르는 즉시 베이스는 좋아보이지만 성능이 지속되지는 않더라구요.

몇 시간 착용하고 나면 파운데이션이 분리되고 부서지기 시작하여 우아하게 발려지기보다는 고르지 않게 자리잡게 됩니다. 이 제품은 착용 시간을 연장하기는커녕 메이크업의 지속력을 손상시키는 것 같았습니다.

전반적으로 미니멀한 메이크업이나 틴트를 선호하는 분들에게는 적합할 수 있지만, 지속력이 좋고 커버력이 좋은 파운데이션을 주로 사용하는 분들에게는 실망스럽고 재구매하고 싶지 않은 제품입니다.
text_for_model: Unfortunately, this did not meet my expectations. The first issue for me was the scent. It has a distinctly chalky smell that makes the application experience unpleasant. For a product positioned as a refined skincare step, the fragrance feels distracting rather than soothing. The texture is also extremely slippery, almost serum-like. While this may work well under skin tints or very lightweight bases, it does not perform well under long-wear foundations. I typically use Estée Lauder Double Wear, and although the base looks nice immediately after application, the performance does not last. After a few hours of wear, the foundation begins to separate and break down, settling unevenly rather than wearing gracefully. Instead of extending wear time, this product seemed to compromise the longevity of my makeup. Overall, this may suit those who prefer minimal makeup or tints, but for anyone relying on long-lasting, full-coverage foundations, this was disappointing and not something I would repurchase.

Overall, it’s an easy, everyday product if you’re looking to boost hydration and get a natural-looking glow.

Author: AshKittenCoutu
Title: Obsesssed
ReviewText: Okay, I did not expect to love this as much as I do…but Rhode’s Glazing Milk has officially entered my “will cry if it gets discontinued” list. The texture is unreal — it’s lightweight, silky, and somehow manages to feel hydrating without being greasy at all. My skin drinks it up in like two seconds. The glow? Chef’s kiss. It’s not glittery or oily… it’s that clean, healthy, “I actually slept last night” kind of glow. Makeup goes on smoother, and on no-makeup days my skin just looks better. Even my dry patches calm down, and it doesn’t break me out — which feels like a small miracle. The packaging is cute (very Rhode, very bathroom-shelf aesthetic) and one bottle lasts surprisingly long because you don’t need much. If you want soft, bouncy, glazed-donut skin without feeling like you dipped your face in oil, this is it. 10/10 — obsessed, will repurchase forever.

Author: Ciciesq
ReviewText: I have been using this product for 24 days and while it will leave your skin glowy and hydrated as it claims, it does not compare well to other toners that I've used. I bought this because the thicker texture appealed to me and I thought that would equate to more hydration. This product takes a long time to absorb compared to my Paula's Choice milky toner. Also, it leaves my skin with an almost silicone feel. It's difficult to explain the feeling, but it feels like there is a mix of silicone pore primer and toner on your skin. My ideal toner would make my skin tacky and help the other products absorb faster. I feel that this toner makes the absorption of products I put on top of it take even longer. I think there are more functional and hydrating products on the market, so I would not recommend this one.

Author: rareblueberry
Title: Expected to like this more
ReviewText: I like to use good skincare products before my makeup as a skin prep step to make my foundation look more natural, flawless, and radiant. I thought this would be the perfect product for this purpose based on what I’d seen online but for me this was just not the case. My foundation completely broke up and looked pretty bad when applied overtop of this glazing milk. I also didn’t really find that my skin looked any more hydrated than when I use this foundation alone. Another factor of milky toners is that typically they feel cooling on the skin. I didn’t really notice a cooling effect from this one either. Also it really felt like it was making a layer on my skin rather than sinking in - that’s probably why my foundation didn’t sit well on it. With all of those factors this just isn’t something for me.
ReviewText_ko: 저는 메이크업 전 좋은 스킨케어 제품을 사용하여 피부 준비 단계에서 파운데이션을 더욱 자연스럽고, 결점 없이, 윤기나게 표현하는 것을 좋아합니다. 나는 온라인에서 본 내용을 바탕으로 이것이 이 목적에 가장 적합한 제품이라고 생각했지만 나에게는 그렇지 않았습니다. 이 글레이징 밀크 위에 바르면 파운데이션이 완전히 부서져 꽤 나빠 보였습니다. 그리고 이 파운데이션만 단독으로 사용했을 때보다 피부가 더 촉촉해 보인다는 느낌도 못 받았어요. 밀키 토너의 또 다른 요인은 일반적으로 피부에 시원한 느낌이 든다는 것입니다. 나는 이것에서도 냉각 효과를 실제로 느끼지 못했습니다. 그리고 피부에 스며들기보다는 피부에 한 겹을 씌워주는 듯한 느낌이 들었습니다. 아마 파운데이션이 피부에 잘 안착했던 것 같습니다. 이러한 모든 요소로 인해 이것은 나에게 도움이 되지 않습니다.

Author: danibeauty101
Title: Must have
ReviewText: I’ve been using the Rhode Glazing Milk for a few weeks now, and I can honestly say it’s become one of my favorite steps in my routine. From the first use, my skin just drank it up. It feels so calming and cooling on the skin — almost like a reset button after cleansing. What really impressed me is how hydrated and plump my face looks afterward. It gives that fresh, healthy “glazed” look without feeling heavy or sticky. The ceramides have definitely helped calm down my sensitivity, and my skin barrier just feels stronger and more balanced overall. I also love how well it layers under the rest of my skincare and makeup. My moisturizer goes on smoother, and my makeup looks way more seamless on days I use it. I didn’t expect an essence to make such a difference, but this one genuinely does. If you love a soft glow, hydrated skin, and anything that makes your routine feel a little more luxurious, this is 100% worth trying. I’ll definitely be repurchasing!

Author: Sylviacongcong
Title: makes the rest of my routine work better
ReviewText:
I’ve been testing the Rhode Glazing Milk Ceramide Facial Essence for the past couple of weeks, and I’m genuinely surprised by how quickly it worked its way into my daily routine. I tend to be pretty picky with essences because many of them feel either too watery to make a difference or too sticky to layer under makeup. This one actually sits right in the middle — the texture is milky and fluid, but it doesn’t leave any film or tackiness behind. It absorbs almost immediately, which makes it an easy first step after cleansing.

The biggest change I’ve noticed is the way it softens my skin right after application. My face tends to get a little flushed after washing, especially in the mornings, and this tones that down within a minute or two. It doesn’t “erase” redness overnight, but it definitely helps the skin settle faster. On days when my moisture barrier feels a bit compromised or I’ve over-exfoliated, this has been the one product that doesn’t sting at all — instead, it feels cooling in a subtle, comforting way.

Hydration-wise, it doesn’t give a heavy glow on its own, but it creates a nice, plump base for anything that comes after. When I layer moisturizer or sunscreen on top, they seem to sit more evenly, and my foundation blends noticeably smoother. ReviewText_ko:

제가 느낀 가장 큰 변화는 바르자마자 피부가 부드러워진다는 점이에요. 특히 아침에 세안 후 얼굴이 약간 붉어지는 경향이 있는데, 이 현상은 1~2분 내에 가라앉습니다. 밤새 붉어짐이 "지워지지"는 않지만 확실히 피부가 더 빨리 안정되는 데 도움이 됩니다. 수분 장벽이 조금 약해졌거나 각질을 과도하게 제거한 날에는 이 제품이 전혀 따끔거리지 않는 유일한 제품이었습니다. 대신 미묘하고 편안한 방식으로 시원한 느낌을 줍니다.

text_for_model: I’ve been testing the Rhode Glazing Milk Ceramide Facial Essence for the past couple of weeks, and I’m genuinely surprised by how quickly it worked its way into my daily routine. I tend to be pretty picky with essences because many of them feel either too watery to make a difference or too sticky to layer under makeup. This one actually sits right in the middle — the texture is milky and fluid, but it doesn’t leave any film or tackiness behind. It absorbs almost immediately, which makes it an easy first step after cleansing. The biggest change I’ve noticed is the way it softens my skin right after application. My face tends to get a little flushed after washing, especially in the mornings, and this tones that down within a minute or two. It doesn’t “erase” redness overnight, but it definitely helps the skin settle faster. On days when my moisture barrier feels a bit compromised or I’ve over-exfoliated, this has been the one product that doesn’t sting at all — instead, it feels cooling in a subtle, comforting way. Hydration-wise, it doesn’t give a heavy glow on its own, but it creates a nice, plump base for anything that comes after. When I layer moisturizer or sunscreen on top, they seem to sit more evenly, and my foundation blends noticeably smoother. ReviewText: I haven’t tried a lot from Rhode, so I’m excited to get glazing milk since I’ve heard so much about it. The good feedback was right it’s such a nice milky essence. I love that. I usually do more hydration for my skin, but once in a while, I like very light hydration and this works perfectly for that.It also is amazing during the day under my sunscreen. It is lightweight yet hydrating and gives my skin a beautiful natural glow.

Author: NOLAJAY
Title: Hopeful but Unfortunately Very Disappointed!
ReviewText: I was excited to try this product given its hype and popularity. When it was finally in stock, I grabbed a mini size to test it out. I've had good experience with other milky toners/essences such as Laneige. However this product not only has an odd chemical must like odor, it also did not absorb at all. It left a tacky sticky layer on my skin and disrupted my ability to apply my other products such as moisturizer and sunscreen (I used it immediately after cleansing and did not use a large amount at all).
ReviewText_ko: 나는 이 제품의 과대광고와 인기를 보고 매우 기뻤습니다. 드디어 재고가 생겼을 때 미니 사이즈를 들고 테스트해 봤습니다. 나는 라네즈와 같은 다른 밀키 토너/에센스에 대해 좋은 경험을 했습니다. 하지만 이 제품은 냄새를 좋아하는 이상한 화학물질이 있을 뿐만 아니라 전혀 흡수하지도 않았습니다. 피부에 끈적끈적한 층이 남아서 모이스처라이저, 자외선 차단제 등 다른 제품을 바르는 데 방해가 되었습니다. (저는 세안 후 바로 사용했고 많은 양을 전혀 사용하지 않았습니다.)

Author: Ulana
Title: Eager to see results
ReviewText: I was so eager to finally try the Rhode Glazing Milk — this essence has been everywhere, and I wanted to see what the hype is about. I’ve been using it for about a week now, and so far… I really like it. It’s winter and the weather is cold, so my skin definitely needs extra love and ceramides to keep my barrier happy. This feels soothing, hydrating, and just gives that nice, cushioned feel right after application. I still have high hopes for long-term results, so I’m going to keep using it and see how my skin feels after a few more weeks — but first impressions are definitely promising.
ReviewText_ko: 나는 Rhode Glazing Milk를 마침내 시험해 보고 싶었습니다. 이 에센스는 어디에서나 볼 수 있었고, 어떤 과대광고가 있는지 알고 싶었습니다. 지금 일주일 정도 사용해 봤는데, 지금까지… 정말 마음에 듭니다. 겨울이고 날씨도 춥기 때문에 피부 장벽을 행복하게 유지하려면 여분의 사랑과 세라마이드가 꼭 필요합니다. 진정 효과와 수분 공급 효과가 있으며 바르고 난 직후에 쿠션감이 좋은 느낌을 줍니다. 나는 장기적인 결과에 대해 여전히 큰 희망을 갖고 있기 때문에 계속 사용하고 몇 주 후에 내 피부가 어떤 느낌인지 지켜볼 것입니다. 하지만 첫인상은 확실히 긍정적입니다.

Author: juby16
Title: It feels like my skin is hydrated.
ReviewText:
Rhode Glazing Milk Ceramide Facial Essence has a light and liquid milky texture (not as watery as water) and absorbs very quickly into the skin. It leaves me feeling moisturized and smooth immediately upon application. I use it as a primer under my daily moisturizer, sunscreen or makeup without it getting cakey.
It is suitable for those who tend to have a dewy, radiant makeup look or a dewy look.
After 1 week of use, I am quite satisfied with Rhode Glazing Milk Ceramide Facial Essence. No redness or irritation and it suits my dry skin.
ReviewText_ko:
로드 글레이징 밀크 세라마이드 페이셜 에센스는 가볍고 리퀴드한 밀키 텍스처(물처럼 묽지 않음)로 피부에 매우 빠르게 흡수됩니다. 바르는 즉시 촉촉하고 매끈한 느낌이 들어요. 뭉치지 않고 매일 모이스처라이저, 자외선 차단제 또는 메이크업 아래 프라이머로 사용합니다.
촉촉하고 윤기나는 메이크업을 좋아하는 분들이나 촉촉한 느낌을 좋아하시는 분들에게 적합합니다.
1주일 사용 후 로드 글레이징 밀크 세라마이드 페이셜 에센스는 상당히 만족스럽습니다. 붉어짐이나 자극도 없고 건조한 제 피부에 잘 맞아요.

Author: ekaterina7
Title: Helps with dry skin!
ReviewText: This Glazing Milk by Rhode has been one of the only things that has helped my severely dry skin especially during this weather. My skin type is dry and I usually have to layer products on top of products and my skin still feels dry a few hours later but this rhode glazing milk keeps my skin hydrated all day. I usually use this before I do my makeup and my skin looks shiny and hydrated and helps my makeup stay put as well. I also like that it not scented and the bottle design makes it easy to use.

Author: oksanaga
ReviewText:

I use it as my second step after cleansing, and it gives my skin a comfortable layer of hydration. My skin looks smoother and more refreshed, and it layers well under the rest of my routine. It keeps my skin calm, hydrated, and ready for moisturizer.

Author: FragJunkie
Title: Great hydration!
ReviewText:

Typically, I used this milk as the first step in my skincare routine and sealed it with my usual face cream. My makeup looked great and lasted the whole day without any issues!
I really liked it a lot!

저는 이 제품을 며칠 동안(낮과 밤 모두) 사용해 왔습니다. (추운 날씨, 바람이 많이 부는 날씨에도) 뛰어난 수분 공급을 제공하고 피부를 정말 윤기나게 만들어줍니다! 여드름이 없었다면 반드시 단독으로 사용했을 것입니다.
일반적으로 저는 이 우유를 스킨케어 루틴의 첫 번째 단계로 사용하고 평소 페이스 크림과 함께 밀봉했습니다. 메이크업이 너무 예뻐서 하루종일 문제없이 지속됐어요!
정말 마음에 들었어요!

Author: missmissajade
Title: Oh..
ReviewText: Super hydrating but sadly it burned my skin. I felt a tingling/warming/burning sensation that didn’t subside and made my skin rashy. I patch tested in isolation from all other products so I know for a fact it’s the Rhode. I have acne popping up everywhere along with red rashes and my skin feels irritated which is so weird for a barrier support marketed product. For reference I’m not using any actives. It also caused some purple pigmentation on my lips which isn’t cute. I hope it goes away..
ReviewText_ko: 수분 공급이 뛰어나지만 슬프게도 피부가 화상을 입었습니다. 따끔거림/따뜻함/화끈거림이 가라앉지 않고 피부가 발진이 생겼습니다. 다른 모든 제품과 별도로 패치 테스트를 진행했기 때문에 그것이 Rhode라는 사실을 확실히 알 수 있었습니다. 붉은 발진과 함께 여드름이 여기저기서 생기고 피부가 자극을 받아 시중에서 판매되는 장벽 지원 제품에 비해 너무 이상합니다. 참고로 저는 액티브를 사용하지 않습니다. 그것은 또한 내 입술에 귀엽지 않은 보라색 색소 침착을 일으켰습니다. 가버렸으면 좋겠다..

Author: dimpleepatel
Title: Can’t live without it anymore
ReviewText: The glazing milk is one of my holy grail products and I make sure I always have my travel size when I’m traveling. Honestly would not care if I forgot any of my other skincare products. I use it both morning and night. I have super dry but combo skin and this definitely makes a difference in hydration and makes my skin feel so soft. I also will use it during the day before I apply makeup because it really does prep the skin. I do want to say that I did a lot of research before buying this product because I purchased it before it was available at Sephora. Two things stood out - people said it would break them out if they had combo skin and some didn’t like the scent. I have never broken out and I’m honestly obsessed with the scent. To me - it’s a subtle but clean scent and I get averted to scents very easily! I’m on my second big bottle now.

Author: GlammyNest
Title: Loving this
ReviewText: I’ve heard so many great things about the rhode Glazing Milk Ceramide so I couldn’t wait to try it. My skin, especially in the winter months, tends to be on the drier side. I have used this essence a few different ways. I’ve applied it immediately after cleansing to sink into my dry skin and then follow up with a moisturizing cream afterwards. I saw Hiley’s tip to mix it with foundation, but that totally failed for me — it made my base look patchy and too slick. Cute packaging though, and my skin did feel soft after, just not the best match for my skin type.

Title: My dry skin loves this
ReviewText: Rhode’s Glazing Milk has been a game-changer for my dry skin. The texture is a silky, weightless milk that sinks in fast but immediately takes away that tight, dehydrated feeling. Title: LOVE
ReviewText: The formula of this milk is thin, but still very nourishing at the same time. It leaves a beautiful dewy glaze on the skin, which is perfect as a makeup base. I've seen other reviews say this product smells, but please remember that unscented products will not always smell the best - sometimes they have natural odors and that's ok. Unscented products are SO much better for your skin over scented products with parfum. The smells dissipates quickly, so it's no bother for me (I'm sensitive to smells too). I love that this brand is earth-conscious and responsible with its packaging - something I'll gladly support. Lastly (and most importantly), I always look up the ingredients of all my skincare through "ingredient checker" tools, and this glazing milk came up with SO many ingredients that are actually good for your skin. Also worth mentioning that this brand is cruelty free, and that's another cause I can get behind. I use this both day and night and I'll continue to keep this in my routine no matter what season it is.

Author: michat
Title: My go-to skincare brand
ReviewText:
I’ve been using Rhode since the moment it launched, and I honestly love everything about it. I know skincare is super personal and everyone’s skin reacts differently, but for me, Rhode has been a game changer. After trying so many different products and brands over the years, Rhode has become my absolute favorite.

The formulas feel lightweight but still super hydrating, and my skin always looks healthy and glowy. I also really appreciate the minimalist packaging and how simple the routine is — it’s effective without being complicated.

If you’ve been thinking about trying Rhode, I definitely recommend giving it a shot. It’s one of those rare brands that actually lives up to the hype!
ReviewText_ko:
저는 Rhode가 출시된 순간부터 Rhode를 사용해 왔고 솔직히 Rhode의 모든 것이 마음에 듭니다. 스킨케어는 매우 개인적이고 모든 사람의 피부가 다르게 반응한다는 것을 알고 있지만, 저에게 Rhode는 게임 체인저였습니다. 수년에 걸쳐 수많은 다양한 제품과 브랜드를 사용해 본 후, Rhode는 제가 가장 좋아하는 제품이 되었습니다.

포뮬러는 가벼우면서도 수분 공급이 뛰어나 피부가 항상 건강하고 윤기있어 보입니다. 또한 미니멀한 포장과 루틴이 얼마나 단순한지 정말 높이 평가합니다. 복잡하지 않으면서도 효과적입니다.

로드(Rhode)를 시험해 볼 생각을 하고 계시다면 꼭 한번 시도해 보시기를 권합니다. 실제로 과대광고에 부응하는 희귀 브랜드 중 하나입니다!

Title: Broke me out/ bad customer service:(

Lastly when I was looking back at my order (I bought the $117 dollar kit) rhode forgot to put in one of the products, when I reached out to have them send me the last one or at the very least get reimbursed. Author: beautyluvr
Title: subtle glow
ReviewText:
I've been using this for 3 weeks now. My combination skin loves this milky essence. It is an extra boost of hydration my skin needs. It absorbs pretty quickly, leaving a subtle glow on my skin. I did need to put on a moisturizer right afterwards, since this alone is not sufficient moisture for my skin type, only an added boost. My skin felt comfortable all day. No negative reactions, no breakouts or anything. 

This formula is "fragrance free", but it does have a slightly off putting scent to it. The scent quickly diminishes, and isn't enough for me to deduct a star.

Author: idontusuallywea
Title: Only causes acne if you don't have proper routine!
ReviewText: I have read a lot of reviews here about people who says this breaks them out or clogs their pores. I will say that my friends who have been using this that makes them break out do NOT double cleanse and do NOT use a proper amount of sunscreen for their face. I had them switch to double cleansing and wearing a proper amount of sunscreen. Suddenly, no more breakouts! I'm a huge fan of double cleansing and using at least two fingers worth of SPF for your face (as you should be per the American Academy of Dermatology). Using this product made my skin much healthier and glowy. I say this as someone with PCOS, rosacea, and sensitive skin who uses both retinoids and salicylic acid daily. So if you're finding it's breaking you out, please try double cleansing and proper SPF on your face.

Author: shellbeee
Title: Pretty packaging, harsh results.
ReviewText:
I really wanted to love this product because of all the hype and the gorgeous branding, but honestly, my skin had the worst reaction to it. Within just a couple of days of using it, I broke out so badly all over my cheeks and chin—it was like my skin was angry at me. I kept hoping it was just “purging” and tried to push through for another week, but the breakouts just got worse, painful, and left marks behind that I’m still dealing with.

I don’t normally have super sensitive skin, and I’ve used plenty of other hydrating products before without issues. But something in this formula just did not agree with me at all. It felt nice going on, I’ll give it that—it’s lightweight and gives that dewy look at first. But the aftermath was definitely not worth it.

For the price point and hype, I expected something gentle, effective, and worth adding to my routine. Instead, it set my skin back weeks. I’ve now had to strip back my skincare routine to heal from the breakouts this caused.

I know it works for some people, but if you’re acne-prone or even slightly sensitive, I would be very cautious. Definitely not worth the hype in my experience, and I wouldn’t repurchase.

온갖 과대광고와 화려한 브랜딩 때문에 이 제품을 정말 좋아하고 싶었는데, 솔직히 피부 반응이 가장 안 좋았습니다. 사용하고 이틀만에 볼과 턱 전체에 피부가 화난 것 같은 트러블이 너무 심해졌습니다. 나는 그것이 단지 "퍼징"이길 바라며 일주일을 더 견디려고 노력했지만 발진은 더욱 심해지고 고통스러워졌으며 여전히 겪고 있는 흔적을 남겼습니다.

평소에 피부가 엄청 예민한 편은 아닌데, 이전에도 다른 수분 공급 제품을 사용해도 문제 없이 잘 사용했어요. 하지만 이 공식의 어떤 부분은 나와 전혀 일치하지 않았습니다. 계속해서 기분이 좋았습니다. 그렇게 하겠습니다. 가볍고 처음에는 촉촉한 느낌을 줍니다. 그러나 여파는 확실히 그만한 가치가 없었습니다.

Title: You get what you pay for
ReviewText: I was curious about the hype. Right away, the smell caught me off guard and it had a chemical/plastic like scent, which was surprising since most fragrance free products don’t usually smell unpleasant. On application, it felt sticky, and I thought maybe that texture would help my foundation stay on better?? lol After finishing my makeup, my cheeks started to burn. I should’ve washed it off, but I had to head out and ended up wearing it for about six hours. Luckily, I didn’t break out (and I do have sensitive skin), but the burning sensation was enough to make me uneasy. I really wanted to like this product because the formula sounded promising, but unfortunately, it just didn’t work for me.

Title: My new favorite

Author: slamminbananas
Title: real review in midst of fake reviews/perioral derm
ReviewText:
I was very confused to see what seems to be hundreds of negative reviews that are not verified, or provide no photo or proof that they even own the product, and most seem to be accounts that have just been created on Sephora's website. 

As background, I am in my mid-30s and I have a skin condition called perioral dermatitis. It's like a combination of eczema, rosacea and acne. I have to be extremely careful with what skincare I put on my face because my skin is extremely reactive. I have gone through four bottles of this product. I am always sketpical to try something new but combing through the ingredients (having a skincare condition will make you very vigilant and knowledgable on skincare ingredients) - ceramides, beta-clucan, copper, magnesium, zinc, cholesterol are all great for my inflammatory skin condition. Rhode's cosmetic chemist Ron Robinson is a genius and every product he's made in his career is a slam dunk for sensitive skin. He's worked at Estee Lauder, Clinique, La Mer and has his own fantastic line of products.

The smell isn't great, but it feels like my skin had a big drink of water when I apply. It's so moisturizing. It is thicker than essences you may be used to. It quite literally is closer to the texture and feel of milk. It has helped my perioral dermatitis so much and this is now a permanent staple in my skincare routine. Be aware that if you are sensitive to coconut alkanes, this product may not be good for you. I have attached a photo of me holding the product and my skin after applying with not a stitch of makeup.
ReviewText_ko:
확인되지 않은 수백 개의 부정적인 리뷰나 제품을 소유하고 있다는 사진이나 증거를 제공하지 않는 부정적인 리뷰를 보고 매우 혼란스러웠습니다. 대부분은 세포라 웹사이트에서 방금 생성된 계정인 것 같습니다. 

배경으로 저는 30대 중반이고 구강주위 피부염이라는 피부 질환을 앓고 있습니다. 이는 습진, 장미증, 여드름의 조합과 같습니다. 내 피부는 반응성이 매우 높기 때문에 얼굴에 바르는 스킨케어에 매우 주의해야 합니다. 나는 이 제품을 네 병이나 마셨다. 나는 항상 새로운 것을 시도하는 데 회의적이지만 성분을 면밀히 살펴봅니다. (스킨케어 상태가 있으면 스킨케어 성분에 대해 매우 주의를 기울이고 지식을 갖게 됩니다.) - 세라마이드, 베타-클루칸, 구리, 마그네슘, 아연, 콜레스테롤은 모두 내 염증성 피부 상태에 좋습니다. 로드의 화장품 화학자인 론 로빈슨(Ron Robinson)은 천재이며 그가 경력을 쌓으면서 만든 모든 제품은 민감한 피부를 위한 슬램덩크입니다. 그는 Estee Lauder, Clinique, La Mer에서 근무했으며 자신만의 환상적인 제품 라인을 보유하고 있습니다.

향은 별로 안 좋은데 바르고 나면 피부가 물을 많이 마신 것 같은 느낌이에요. 너무 촉촉해요. 기존에 사용하던 에센스보다 더 두꺼워요. 말 그대로 우유의 질감과 느낌에 더 가깝습니다. 그것은 내 구강 주위 피부염에 큰 도움이 되었으며 이제 이것은 내 스킨케어 루틴의 영구적인 필수 요소입니다. 코코넛 알칸에 민감한 분이라면 이 제품이 좋지 않을 수도 있습니다. 메이크업을 전혀 하지 않은 상태에서 제품을 바른 후 피부와 제품을 들고 있는 사진을 첨부했습니다.

Title: Just not for me unfortunately
ReviewText: I bought into the hype for this product. I’m all in on the milky toner trend. Before I bought this one though, I read some of the (non-incentivized) reviews on here. So many repeat 1 star reviews in a row mentioning that the product broke them out. The verbiage seemed so similar amongst the reviews that I thought the product was being review bombed. ReviewText_ko:
나는 샘플 패킷을 통해 이것을 몇 번 사용했고 판매 당일 즉시 주문했으며 방금 전체 병을 받았고 모든 것이 여전히 정상인지 확인했습니다.  나는 이 제품에 집착하고 있어서 병이 도착할 때까지 거의 기다릴 수가 없었습니다.  나는 그것과 함께 다른 많은 제품을 사용할 수 없을까 봐 두려웠고, 그날의 보습을 제한했습니다(저는 건성 소녀입니다). 하지만 좋은 점은 ***다른 세럼/모이스처라이저 아래에*** 바르는 것입니다.  그것은 일을합니다 !!!  그럼요!  끈적이지 않고, 냄새가 나지 않고, 부드럽고 탱글탱글합니다.  그리고 여러분 중 일부가 언급하는 '향기'에 관해 저는 이 제품에 향이 첨가된 것이 없다고 생각합니다. 그래서 여러분은 단지 냄새를 맡고 있는 것입니다...제품입니다.  나에게는 꽤 정상적인 냄새가 나지만, 장미 냄새나 그런 냄새는 나지 않습니다(좋은 점입니다).

나는 Rhode에서 다른 제품을 구매한 적이 없지만 이제는 공식적으로 신자이기 때문에 주위를 둘러보고 있습니다(신자와 혼동하지 마십시오).  그냥 당장 큰 병을 주문했으면 좋았을 텐데!  나는 더 작은 것을 빨리 처리할 것이라고 확신하므로 주저하지 않고 크기를 늘릴 것입니다.
text_for_model: i've used this a handful of times via the sample packets and instantly ordered the day it went up for sale, just received my full bottle and ensured everything was still on the up-and-up. i'm OBSESSED with this product, i couldn't hardly wait for the bottle to arrive. i was fearful i wouldn't be able to use many other products with it, limiting my moisturization for the day (i am a dry girlie), but what's nice is that you apply it ***underneath*** other serums/moisturizers. it DOES THE JOB!!! so well! not sticky, not stinky, so smooth and bouncy. and in reference to the 'scent' some of you are mentioning, i don't believe this product has a fragrance added, so you're just smelling...product. pretty normal smelling to me, though NO, it doesn't smell like roses or anything (and that's a good thing). i've never purchased any other products from Rhode, but now i'm looking around because i'm officially a believer (not to be confused with a belieber). i just wish i had ordered the big bottle right off the bat! i'm sure i'll go through the smaller one quickly, so i won't hesitate to size up.

Author: Hnubhli
Title: BREAKS YOU OUT!
ReviewText: I have used this product for a total of 3 days, day and night, and it has broken me out terribly. I will unfortunately be bringing this product back.

Author: itsfi
Title: Glowy hydration, just not the best fit for my skin
ReviewText:
I have the full size & mini versions of this product, both of which I purchased directly from the brand.

TL;DR: The product itself is very nice & I can see why it has a cult following. The skin on my face can only handle it in small doses. The skin on my body, however, soaks this up & appreciates how hydrating it is. Just as this can be used to thin down fuller coverage foundations, it can help to thin overly thick hand/foot/body creams, making it easier to spread.

WHAT I LIKE:
* Light, thin-ish, milky consistency
* Softly hydrating
* Hailey Bieber's tip to mix this with fuller coverage foundations to make a more skin-tint-like base is excellent

AREA(S) FOR IMPROVEMENT:
* Would love to be able to see how much product has been used/remains

FYI:
* Contains some fabulous skincare ingredients for dry/very dry skin in need of barrier repair
* Product itself is very nice. I can see why it has a cult following. On paper, my skin should love this, but, for some reason (that I suspect may be the coconut alkanes in it), my skin can become irritated if I'm using it too often, but once every so often in the cooler seasons, it's fine. 
* BEAUTY HACK: Usually, the skin on the body is less sensitive than the skin on the face & can tolerate products/ingredients that the skin on the face cannot. If that's true for you & this passes a patch test, you can (a) use it in lieu of body lotion/cream or (b) mix a little of this with a thick/too thick hand/foot/body cream to thin down the thicker cream, making it easier to spread. 
* Highly recommend getting a sample to try first, if you can, either in store or as a promo gwp.

BUY 🛍️ or BYE 👋🏼?:
* This really is a wonderfully hydrating formula; if you're not sensitive/allergic to coconut alkanes, it's worth looking into. BUY 🛍️
* I’ll use the beauty hack to use up what I have of the product but won’t repurchase BYE 👋🏼 

Sent from my iPhone
ReviewText_ko:
저는 이 제품의 풀 사이즈 버전과 미니 버전을 가지고 있는데 둘 다 브랜드에서 직접 구매했습니다.

요약: 제품 자체는 매우 훌륭하며 왜 이 제품이 많은 팬을 보유하고 있는지 알 수 있습니다. 내 얼굴의 피부는 소량으로만 처리할 수 있습니다. 그러나 내 몸의 피부는 이것을 흡수하고 그것이 얼마나 수분을 공급하는지 평가합니다. 커버력이 풍부한 파운데이션을 얇게 펴는 데 사용할 수 있는 것처럼, 지나치게 두꺼운 핸드/풋/바디 크림을 얇게 펴 바르는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다.

내가 좋아하는 것:
* 가볍고 묽은 우유빛 농도
* 부드럽게 수분 공급
* 풀커버 파운데이션과 섞어서 좀 더 피부 틴트같은 베이스를 만들어주는 헤일리 비버의 팁이 탁월해요

개선 분야:
* 제품의 사용/남은 정도를 확인하고 싶습니다.

참고:
* 장벽 회복이 필요한 건성/극건성 피부를 위한 놀라운 스킨케어 성분 함유
*제품 자체는 매우 좋습니다. 왜 컬트 추종자가 있는지 알 수 있습니다. 서류상으로는 내 피부가 이것을 좋아해야 하지만 어떤 이유에서인지(내 생각에는 코코넛 알칸 때문일 수 있음) 너무 자주 사용하면 피부가 자극을 받을 수 있지만 서늘한 계절에 자주 사용하면 괜찮습니다. 
* 뷰티 꿀팁: 일반적으로 신체 피부는 얼굴 피부보다 덜 민감하며 얼굴 피부는 견딜 수 없는 제품/성분을 견딜 수 있습니다. 그것이 사실이고 패치 테스트를 통과한 경우, (a) 바디 로션/크림 대신 사용하거나 (b) 이것을 약간 걸쭉하거나 너무 두꺼운 핸드/풋/바디 크림과 섞어 두꺼운 크림을 묽게 만들어 더 쉽게 펴 바를 수 있습니다. 
* 가능하다면 매장이나 프로모션 GWP에서 샘플을 먼저 받아보는 것이 좋습니다.

구매 🛍️ 또는 작별 👋🏼?:
* 이것은 정말 놀랍도록 수분을 공급하는 포뮬러입니다. 코코넛 알칸에 민감하거나 알레르기가 없다면 살펴볼 가치가 있습니다. 구매하세요 🛍️
* 뷰티 꿀팁을 활용해 제품을 다 써볼 예정이지만 재구매는 하지 않겠습니다 BYE 👋🏼

Author: conniethehbk
Title: Horrendous
ReviewText: This product is so over hyped. Or maybe it isn’t, IF you are a 20 something with already perfect, pore-less, texture free, baby skin. I was excited to try this, and worked it into my normal morning routine applying just before my serum, followed by my moisturizer. As SOON as I applied this to my face I HATED how my skin looks. I’m an esthetician and take pride in having great skin. This product made any imperfection glaringly obvious and awful. Every pore I barely noticed on a regular skin care day became massive and my makeup sank into the craters, every little wrinkle, line or bump in my forehead (not acne, just bone anatomy lol) stuck out like a sore thumb. I was so embarrassed going to work with my skin looking like this but it was too late to start over. Sure it hydrates and adds a gleam to the skin but if you have any skin concerns do yourself a favor and stay away. I can’t even imagine how terrible this looks over acne.

Author: Colette0692
Title: A Heavy Greasy Mess!
ReviewText: I received a sample of this product in one of my orders.  I was very excited to try it because there has been a lot of hype surrounding it for a long time.  A while back I was wanting a product like this, but after doing some research I chose Ilia's version of this product.  I'm so glad I made that choice, I didn't like this Rhode product at all.  it was extremely thick and heavy, even though I used a small amount.  it was very greasy, and it smelled weird.  It seemed to lay on the surface of my skin.  I wasn't able to use my other beneficial skin care products, I didn't even feel like my face could handle sunscreen at that point.  Also, my complexion leans dry; so I've never had an issue with any other moisturizing products.  My face has always been happy with any moisture I'm willing to give it. ReviewText: Got a sample with an online order and decided to give it a try since I see a lot of people use it online. Author: smert
Title: Buyer Beware
ReviewText:
I was so excited to try this when it first came out that I ordered two bottles from the States. This product gave me milia all over my forehead and under my eyes, which I had to get extracted. Through the process of elimination, I figured out that this product was to blame. I threw both bottles out. 

I do not have sensitive or dry skin. I did not find this to be hydrating. The hype of this brand is purely due to marketing - the products themselves are nothing to write home about and no better than their drugstore counterparts.
ReviewText_ko:
처음 나왔을 때 이 제품을 먹어보고 너무 좋아서 미국에서 두 병을 주문했습니다. 이 제품은 이마 전체와 눈 밑에 비립종을 줘서 뽑아야 했어요. 제거 과정을 거치면서 이 제품이 원인이라는 것을 알게 되었습니다. 두 병 다 버렸어요. 

저는 피부가 민감하거나 건조한 편은 아닙니다. 나는 이것이 수분을 공급하는 것을 찾지 못했습니다. 이 브랜드의 과대 광고는 순전히 마케팅 때문입니다. 제품 자체는 집에서 쓸 만한 것이 아니며 약국의 제품보다 나을 것도 없습니다.

Title: Worth the hype
ReviewText: Im a licensed esthetician so I have access to everything from medical grade skincare to niche brands. Author: emmmmmy18
Title: Never again
ReviewText:
Received a sample of this in my recent Sephora order and was super excited to try it. I wish I would’ve read the recent reviews before I did…  
I was laying in bed about an hour or two after washing my face and doing my skincare  (gentle cleanser, rhode glazing milk, and innis free green tea hyaluronic moisturizer) and noticed my cheeks were feeling tingly and hot. I got up and looked in the mirror and I had a major rosacea flare up and mu skin was really bumpy and irritated. I washed my face to get the product off. I’m super sad because my skins been in really good shape lately and I haven’t had a flare up in months. Hopefully it goes away soon

Author: SparklingTail
Title: Sticky but super hydrating
ReviewText:
The scent in the tube is a bit plasticky and sweet, but it’s barely noticeable once applied. It has a mild sugary taste, almost like you just took a sip of sweetened tea. The texture is quite fluid and definitely on the sticky side. A word of warning: if you have fine hair and like wearing it down, even the slightest breeze will have your hair glued to your lips.

I ordered this in the shade Espresso ☕️, and the color itself is stunning 😍 However, the applicator isn't the most user-friendly. Applying it straight from the tube is a bit tricky, and it takes some practice to get a neat, even finish. On my pale lips, a single layer is also a bit too sheer. While the color is buildable, applying a second layer to get that beautiful pigment makes it even stickier than before. For that reason, I’m knocking off one star.

As a makeup product, it’s not my favorite due to the tackiness, but as a treatment, it’s excellent. I apply it as the very first step of my makeup routine, and by the time I’m done with my brows and eyes, my lips look completely nourished and smooth.
ReviewText_ko:
튜브의 향은 약간 플라스틱 같고 달콤하지만 일단 바르면 거의 눈에 띄지 않습니다. 마치 달콤한 차를 한 모금 마신 것처럼 부드러운 설탕 맛이 납니다. 질감은 매우 유동적이며 확실히 끈적한 편입니다. 경고 한마디: 머리카락이 가늘고 머리를 내려쓰고 싶다면 약간의 바람에도 머리카락이 입술에 달라붙을 것입니다.

에스프레소 찻잔 색상으로 주문했는데 색상 자체가 너무 예뻐요 😍 다만 어플리케이터가 사용하기 편한 편은 아니네요. 튜브에서 바로 바르는 것은 약간 까다로우며 깔끔하고 균일한 마무리를 얻으려면 약간의 연습이 필요합니다. 내 창백한 입술에서는 한 겹도 너무 투명하다. 색상이 형성 가능하지만 두 번째 레이어를 적용하여 아름다운 색소를 얻으면 이전보다 더욱 끈적해집니다. 그런 이유로 별 하나 뺍니다.

메이크업 제품으로는 끈적임 때문에 별로 선호하지 않지만, 트리트먼트로는 아주 좋습니다. 메이크업 첫 단계에 바르고, 눈썹과 눈매를 마무리할 즈음에는 입술이 완전 영양감 있고 매끈해 보여요.

Author: uhrelee
Title: Not worth the price!
ReviewText: I bought this on a whim while on holiday since I saw so many influencers posting about rhode for ages!!! The smell was initially overwhelming and headache inducing. The product has a taste that you cannot escape. While it stays on forever, the glaze loves to settle in the corners of your mouth and is quite heavy on the lips. I noticed very early on that my corners began cracking and causing a slight case of cheilitis on my lips, so I doubt there's any truth to rhode's peptides being nourishing. I normally apply between meals so about 2-3 times a day, and I'm about halfway through the product for over two months of use. The color is sheer which makes sense as a tint, but definitely buildable depending on application.
ReviewText_ko: 휴가 중에 로드에 대한 인플루언서들이 오랫동안 포스팅하는 것을 보고 충동적으로 구입했습니다!!! 처음에는 냄새가 압도적이었고 두통을 유발했습니다. 이 제품은 도저히 벗어날 수 없는 맛을 가지고 있습니다. 영원히 지속되는 동안 글레이즈는 입가에 정착하는 것을 좋아하며 입술에 상당히 무겁습니다. 나는 내 모서리가 갈라지기 시작하고 입술에 경미한 구순염이 발생한다는 것을 아주 일찍 알아차렸습니다. 따라서 로드 펩타이드가 영양을 공급한다는 사실이 의심스럽습니다. 보통 식간에 바르기 때문에 하루에 2~3회 정도 사용하고, 절반 정도 사용하면 두 달 넘게 사용하게 됩니다. 색상은 틴트처럼 투명하지만 용도에 따라 확실히 바를 수 있습니다.

Author: ajkrpa
Title: Tingly and numb lips/tongue. Check ingredients.
ReviewText: I was so excited when Rhode was introduced to Sephora  and had high hopes for the product. I tested the product on my hand in the store and it seemed great. Unfortunately, as soon as I put it on my lips and tongue started to go numb and tingly. This happened with both the lip liner and the gloss. And not in the way that some plumping products cause your lips to tingle. I tried again a few days later because I thought it might’ve been a one off situation and the same thing happened. Be careful of the ingredients and allergies.

Title: Surprisingly Fantastic
ReviewText: I have pretty sensitive lips and I cannot use most brands and products on the market with the exception of two. The raspberry isn't too far on the purple hue, unlike some, which is great, its a more flushed true berry. The product itself is effective at keeping my lips hydrated without making them reliant on constant application and it lasts for hours. Definitely recommend!

That was in January of 2026 and that replacement has began to have that same foul smell again just over a month later. I love the feel of the formula but I can never purchase another one of these lip tints again. Twice in a row is mad.

Author: EmmylouTee
Title: Great until it began to smell
ReviewText: I purchased the peptide lip tint in raspberry jelly on January 17, 2026. I absolutely loved the product formulation and it originally had a nice scent...until it suddenly didn't. I can't recall exactly when it began to have a noticeably rotten smell, but it was within a couple of weeks of using it. I have only had this lip product for a month and I so wanted to love it, but the price point that it is at and the fact that the scent has turned rotten so quickly are unacceptable to me. I have a lot of product left in this tube and hate wasting my hard-earned money. I had hoped to become a repeat customer for this product because I do love the way it feels on my lips, but I am bummed that it already smells bad just a few weeks into using it. Rhode needs to know that the formula needs some work. I do hope they fix this issue because this is one of the better lip tints in terms of color and feel, but the smell is just gross.
ReviewText_ko: 2026년 1월 17일 라즈베리 젤리에 들어있는 펩타이드 립틴트를 구입했습니다. 제품 제형이 정말 마음에 들었고 원래 향도 좋았는데...갑자기 향이 안 나기 전까지는요. 언제부터 눈에 띄게 썩은 냄새가 나기 시작했는지 정확히 기억나지 않지만, 사용한 지 2주 정도 됐어요. 이 립제품을 산지 한달밖에 안됐는데 너무 맘에 들었는데 가격도 그렇고 향도 너무 빨리 상하는 게 도저히 받아들일 수 없더라구요. 나는 이 튜브에 제품이 많이 남아 있고 힘들게 번 돈을 낭비하는 것을 싫어합니다. 나는 입술에 닿는 느낌을 정말 좋아하기 때문에 이 제품의 단골 고객이 되기를 바랐지만, 사용하고 몇 주만 지나도 이미 나쁜 냄새가 난다는 사실이 안타깝습니다. Rhode는 공식에 약간의 작업이 필요하다는 것을 알아야 합니다. 나는 이것이 색상과 느낌 측면에서 더 나은 립틴트 중 하나이기 때문에 그들이 이 문제를 해결하기를 바랍니다. 그러나 냄새는 역겹습니다.

Author: Casey90s
Title: Smelly formula. They need to reformulate this asap

Author: CocoCalifornia
Title: Allergic reaction to Peptides
ReviewText: I am a lip gloss connoisseur and I really wanted to love these coveted Rhode Lip Tints but beware they can cause an allergic reaction.  A few weeks after using them my lips became very swollen then dry and irritated.  It's been months now and they are still recovering. After reading other experiences online found the source of the issue with the peptides.  If you have sensitive skin or prone to allergies be mindful when using this product.
ReviewText_ko: 저는 립글로스 감정가이고 탐나는 로드 립 틴트를 정말 좋아하고 싶었지만 알레르기 반응을 일으킬 수 있다는 점을 조심하세요.  사용 후 몇 주 후에 입술이 매우 부어오르고 건조해지고 자극을 받았습니다.  몇 달이 지났지만 여전히 회복 중입니다. 온라인에서 다른 경험을 읽은 후 펩타이드 문제의 원인을 찾았습니다.  피부가 민감하거나 알레르기가 있는 분은 제품 사용 시 주의하시기 바랍니다.

ReviewText: I didn't want to love this product because of the hype, BUT I went looking for a lip treatment/balm product that colormatched the summer fridays soft mauve lip oil (too thin), and this fit the bill. Unfortunately (because of the price) I love it. Superior to ole for moisture and staying power. It honestly is a lovely product. Not too scented or flavored either.
ReviewText_ko: 과대 광고 때문에 이 제품을 좋아하고 싶지 않았지만 여름 금요일의 소프트 모브 립 오일(너무 묽음)과 색상이 일치하는 립 트리트먼트/밤 제품을 찾으러 갔는데 이것이 딱 맞았습니다. 불행히도 (가격 때문에) 나는 그것을 좋아합니다. 올레보다 보습력과 지속력이 뛰어납니다. 솔직히 사랑스러운 제품입니다. 너무 향이 나지도 향이 강하지도 않아요.

Author: ValerieCanary
Title: Overhyped
ReviewText: Oh man. I wish I didn’t buy into the hype. All the reviews I read stated how nourishing this lip tint and that it left a beautiful tint. I personally didn’t find either to be true. When you first apply it, it looks great, but it has no staying power. I also wouldn’t say it’s super nourishing or moisturizing for my lips… Using my blistex has worked way better for me. lol. I also agree with the other reviews that say it smells awful after a few months. I bought this back in September and after 4 months, it smells like straight plastic. Wouldn’t buy again.
ReviewText_ko: 아 이런. 나는 과대 광고를 믿지 않았 으면 좋겠다. 내가 읽은 모든 리뷰에는 이 립 틴트가 얼마나 영양을 공급하고 아름다운 틴트를 남겼는지 명시되어 있었습니다. 나는 개인적으로 어느 쪽도 사실이 아니라고 생각했습니다. 처음 바르면 보기엔 좋은데 지속력은 없어요. 또한 입술에 영양이 풍부하거나 보습 효과가 뛰어나다고는 말할 수 없습니다. 블리스텍스를 ​​사용하는 것이 저에게 훨씬 더 효과적이었습니다. ㅋㅋㅋ. 나는 또한 몇 달 후에 냄새가 지독하다는 다른 리뷰에 동의합니다. 9월에 구입했는데 4개월 지나니 플라스틱 냄새가 나네요. 다시는 구매하지 않을 것입니다.

Author: JaffaZori
Title: All Rhodes Lead to Cracked Lips
ReviewText: After using this peptide treatment for a week, I can confidently say that it is not for me. At first, I enjoyed the buttery smooth application and the natural tint it gave me. Unfortunately, applying it daily as instructed caused me to have chapped lips. The polybutene and synthetic wax are most likely what caused the irritation. I would recommend choosing another lip treatment, such as, Laneige lip glowy balm

Author: yazirayolanda
ReviewText: This Peptide Lip Tint Nourishing Glaze is exactly what I want in an everyday lip product. The formula feels incredibly comfortable and instantly locks in moisture, leaving my lips soft and pillowy without any stickiness. The color is sheer but buildable, so one swipe gives a natural tint and a few layers add more dimension while still looking glossy and fresh. I love that it smooths out fine lines and makes my lips look visibly plumper over time. The blend of peptides, shea butter, and vitamin E really shows—my lips stay hydrated for hours, even in dry weather. It works beautifully on its own or layered with other lip products. Perfect for day or night, and a must if you want hydrated, glossy lips with a hint of color. 💄✨
ReviewText_ko: 이 펩타이드 립 틴트 너리싱 글레이즈는 제가 매일 사용하는 립 제품에 꼭 필요한 것입니다. 포뮬러의 사용감은 놀라울 정도로 편안하고 즉각적으로 수분을 잡아주어 끈적임 없이 부드럽고 푹신한 입술을 유지해줍니다. 컬러는 투명하지만 지속력이 좋기 때문에 한 번만 스쳐도 자연스러운 틴트가 되고 몇 겹을 덧바르면 윤기 있고 산뜻한 느낌을 주면서도 입체감을 더할 수 있습니다. 나는 그것이 잔주름을 부드럽게하고 시간이 지남에 따라 입술을 눈에 띄게 통통하게 보이게 만드는 것을 좋아합니다. 펩타이드, 시어 버터, 비타민 E의 혼합이 실제로 보여줍니다. 건조한 날씨에도 입술이 몇 시간 동안 수분을 유지합니다. 단독으로 사용해도, 다른 립 제품과 레이어드해도 아름답게 작동합니다. 낮이나 밤이나 사용하기 적합하며, 약간의 컬러감과 함께 촉촉하고 윤기 나는 입술을 원한다면 필수품입니다. 💄✨

Author: ByNadiaH
ReviewText:
The rhode Peptide Lip Tint in Ribbon is one of those products you just keep reaching for. The shade is a soft, natural pink that makes lips look healthier without looking like makeup. The texture feels smooth and comfortable, not sticky, and the glossiness looks really nice in person.

What I like most is how hydrating it feels — my lips stay comfortable for hours, even after the shine fades a bit. It works great on its own or over a lip liner and fits easily into an everyday routine.
ReviewText_ko:
리본의 로드 펩타이드 립 틴트는 계속해서 손이 가는 제품 중 하나입니다. 은은한 내추럴 핑크 컬러로 메이크업을 하지 않아도 입술을 더욱 건강하게 연출해줍니다. 질감은 끈적임 없이 매끄럽고 편안한 느낌이고, 광택감도 직접 보면 정말 좋을 것 같아요.

제가 가장 좋아하는 점은 수분 공급 느낌입니다. 광택이 약간 사라진 후에도 입술이 몇 시간 동안 편안하게 유지됩니다. 단독으로 사용하거나 립 라이너 위에 바르면 효과가 뛰어나며 일상 생활에 쉽게 어울립니다.

Author: ZachH3
Title: Really wanted to love this
ReviewText:
I’ve tried Rhode’s lip tints a few times before they arrived at Sephora. While I enjoyed the product itself, they would alway develop a really bad scent after about a month of use. I’ve seen others compare it to wet laundry that’s been left in the machine, and that’s a pretty bail on the head comparuson. 

Unfortunately, the issue remains. I have purchased two since the launch in stores, and the scent issue is still present. Really disappointed.
ReviewText_ko:
나는 Rhode의 립틴트가 Sephora에 도착하기 전에 몇 번 시험해 보았습니다. 제품 자체는 마음에 들었지만, 한 달 정도 사용하면 항상 아주 나쁜 냄새가 나더군요. 나는 다른 사람들이 그것을 기계에 남겨진 젖은 세탁물과 비교하는 것을 본 적이 있는데, 그것은 머리 비교에 있어서 꽤 보석입니다. 

불행히도 문제는 남아 있습니다. 매장 출시 이후 두 개를 구입했는데 냄새 문제가 여전히 존재합니다. 정말 실망했어요.

It’s super hydrating and makes my lips look way fuller. If you have dry lips but still want a high-shine finish, get this. 10/10.

Author: dayana021
ReviewText: This lip tint is that girl. The formula feels incredibly nourishing the second it hits your lips—no stickiness, just a smooth, cushiony glaze that makes lips look instantly healthier. The peptide-infused texture gives a subtle plumping effect while keeping lips hydrated for hours, even after the shine wears down. The color payoff is sheer but buildable, perfect for everyday wear when you want something effortless but polished. It gives that “your lips but better” vibe with a glossy finish that looks luxe without feeling heavy. I love how it blurs fine lines and makes lips look fuller and soft—definitely a staple in my bag and one I keep reaching for daily.
ReviewText_ko: 이 립틴트가 바로 그 여자예요. 입술에 닿는 순간 믿을 수 없을 정도로 영양이 풍부한 포뮬러가 느껴집니다. 끈적임 없이 부드럽고 쿠션감 있는 글레이즈가 입술을 즉각적으로 건강해 보이게 만들어줍니다. 펩타이드가 함유된 텍스처가 은은한 플럼핑 효과를 선사하며 윤기가 사라진 후에도 입술을 몇 시간 동안 촉촉하게 유지해줍니다. 색상은 투명하지만 제작이 가능하며, 수월하면서도 세련된 것을 원할 때 일상적인 착용에 적합합니다. 무겁지 않으면서도 고급스러운 글로시한 마무리감으로 '당신의 입술이 더 나은' 느낌을 선사합니다. 저는 잔주름을 흐리게 하고 입술을 더욱 도톰하고 부드럽게 보이게 하는 방식을 좋아합니다. 확실히 제 가방에 꼭 들어가는 필수품이자 매일 손이 자주 가는 제품입니다.

Author: elenov
ReviewText: Toast is one of those shades that looks different depending on how much you put on. One swipe gives my lips a soft brown-pink tone, almost like a tinted balm. Two swipes makes it look more like a lip color, but still very casual. I use it a lot when my lips are dry and I don’t want lipstick. It feels slick at first, then settles in and stays comfortable. It fades slowly instead of disappearing all at once, and I like how my lips still feel moisturized after it’s mostly gone. It’s not glossy in a shiny way. More like a natural sheen. Easy to throw on, easy to reapply, and Toast works with almost everything I wear.
ReviewText_ko: 토스트는 바르는 정도에 따라 느낌이 달라지는 컬러 중 하나예요. 한 번만 스치면 입술이 틴티드 밤처럼 부드러운 브라운-핑크 톤으로 변합니다. 두 번 스와이프하면 립 컬러처럼 보이지만 여전히 매우 캐주얼합니다. 입술이 건조해서 립스틱이 싫을 때 많이 사용해요. 처음에는 매끈한 느낌이 들더니 자리를 잡아 편안하게 유지됩니다. 한꺼번에 사라지지 않고 천천히 사라지고, 다 없어진 뒤에도 입술이 촉촉한 느낌이 남아있는 게 마음에 들어요. 반짝반짝 윤기가 나지 않아요. 좀 더 자연스러운 광택에 가깝습니다. 바르기도 쉽고, 다시 바르기도 쉬우며, Toast는 제가 입는 거의 모든 옷에 잘 어울립니다.

Title: smelly & drying

Title: Love
ReviewText: I’ve been loving the Rhode Peptide Lip Tint in Toast. It gives my lips the perfect warm tint while still feeling buttery, hydrating, and smooth. Author: Nadia2000
ReviewText: Was super excited to try this in espresso. Espresso is a really pretty brown shade. It’s actually pretty pigmented but you can sheer it out too. I find that it has really impressive shine to it. It has a bit of weight to it but seems to add hydration. I find it feels smooth and not grainy. Really impressive tint : pigmentation for a gloss!
ReviewText_ko: 이것을 에스프레소에 넣어서 먹어보게 되어 매우 기뻤습니다. 에스프레소는 정말 예쁜 브라운 색상이에요. 실제로는 꽤 착색되어 있지만 투명하게 만들 수도 있습니다. 나는 그것이 정말 인상적인 빛을 발한다는 것을 알았습니다. 무게감이 좀 있지만 수분감이 더해진 것 같아요. 퍽퍽하지 않고 부드러운 느낌이 나는 것 같아요. 정말 인상적인 틴트 : 착색을 위한 윤기!

Author: emptydeer
Title: Not bad
ReviewText: I tried the lip tint in the shade Espresso, and I really liked how rich and smooth the color looks on the lips. The formula feels hydrating and comfortable, almost like a balm with a tint. The scent is pleasant and adds a nice touch without being too strong. I’ve been using it throughout the day, and it easily fits into my usual routine. It gives my lips a natural glossy finish with a warm, everyday-friendly tone.

Author: haddismartha
ReviewText: The Rhode Lip Tint in Toast is my go-to lip product and always in my purse. The sheer nude tint is the perfect everyday shade—smooth, blendable, and hydrating. Author: atyuna
ReviewText: I’ve been using the Rhode Peptide Lip Tint Nourishing Glaze every day, and I finally get the hype. The hydration is honestly the standout. My lips stay soft even after the shine wears off — it feels more like a balm that happens to be glossy. The tint is the perfect amount of color: sheer, natural, and buildable, so it enhances your lips without overpowering your makeup. And the glossiness? Chef’s kiss. It’s that effortless, glassy shine that instantly makes you look put together.

ReviewText: I tried Rhode’s Peptide Tint in Toast and honestly, I just wasn’t blown away. It has a slight tint of color, is fragrance free but has a strange plastic, artificial taste to it. It does hydrate lips and looks glossy but at this price point, there are much better options. It’s a miss for me.
ReviewText_ko: 저는 Rhode's Peptide Tint in Toast를 사용해 보았는데 솔직히 별로 놀라지 않았습니다. 약간의 색상이 있고 무향이지만 이상한 플라스틱, 인공적인 맛이 있습니다. 입술에 수분을 공급하고 윤기나게 보이지만 이 가격대에서는 훨씬 더 나은 옵션이 있습니다. 나에게는 그리워요.

Author: Springn89
Title: Nice lip tint!
ReviewText: Love this lip tint from Rhode! It has a pretty pink tint that is subtle and is a great everyday shade. The lip tint is super hydrating and has a shiny gloss finish. It doesn't feel sticky or tacky in my lips at all. It stays put for a long time without having to reapply multiple times throughout the day. I've been wearing it a lot and it's definitely helped keep my lips soft and moisturized during this cold weather. Its small and compact, easy to take on the go, and I love the soft tip applicator. Very happy with this product.

I've been wearing it a lot and it's definitely helped keep my lips soft and moisturized during this cold weather. Its small and compact, easy to take on the go, and I love the soft tip applicator. Very happy with this product.

Author: shayrealbeauty
Title: Super hydrating
ReviewText: Everyone and their mama has been hyping these up, so I had to see what the talk was about. And honestly? They’re actually really good. The formula is chef’s kiss super hydrating, keeps my lips moisturized for a long time, and doesn’t feel heavy or sticky at all. I picked up the Toast shade and i love both alone and paired with a lip liner. Only thing… the packaging was a little underwhelming for me. Not bad, just not as cute as I expected with all the hype. But the balm itself? She’s that girl. If you love a comfy, hydrating lip with a touch of color, you’ll definitely vibe with this one.
ReviewText_ko: 모두들과 그들의 엄마가 이 내용을 과대평가하고 있어서 무슨 내용인지 알아보고 싶었습니다. 그리고 솔직히? 그들은 실제로 정말 좋습니다. 셰프의 키스 초보습 포뮬러로 오랜 시간 입술을 촉촉하게 유지시켜주며, 무겁거나 끈적이는 느낌이 전혀 없습니다. 나는 토스트 쉐이드를 골랐고 단독으로 사용하거나 립 라이너와 함께 사용하는 것을 좋아합니다. 다만… 포장이 조금 실망스러웠습니다. 나쁘지는 않습니다. 모든 과대 광고로 예상했던 것만 큼 귀엽지는 않습니다. 하지만 밤 자체는요? 그 사람이 바로 그 여자야. 편안하고 촉촉한 컬러감의 립을 좋아한다면 이 립이 마음에 쏙 들 것입니다.

This lip tint gives my lips an effortless, cool-girl sheen with a rich warm brown tint that takes any makeup look from average to fabulous in seconds. The texture of this tint is incredible; it feels buttery soft and velvety plush with absolutely no stickiness.

이 립 틴트는 어떤 메이크업 룩도 단 몇 초 만에 평범한 룩에서 멋진 룩으로 바꿔주는 풍부하고 따뜻한 브라운 틴트로 내 입술에 자연스럽고 쿨한 광채를 선사합니다. 이 틴트의 질감은 정말 놀랍습니다. 끈적임 없이 버터처럼 부드럽고 벨벳처럼 부드러운 느낌을 줍니다.

Author: grlbhndthemsc
Title: Do not purchase this
ReviewText: I bought this the day Rhode launched in Sephora, and not even three months later, the lip tint has changed smell completely and smells rancid. The label says it should last 12 months. I loved it while it was still safe to use, but after seeing many other reviews on Sephora and Reddit of people's lip tints going bad and smelling horrible quickly, I recommend saving your money for a slightly more expensive product that will actually last the length its label says. Do not purchase this, lest you experience what I did and have both Sephora and Rhode customer service tell you "too bad."

Author: Anya97
Title: ​Not Worth The Price: The Rhode Lip Tint Went Bad
ReviewText:
​This lip tint is thick, smooth, and lasts a long time, offering great hydration. That is the only positive.
​However, the color payoff is minimal, and most critically, the product spoiled quickly. Purchased in September, it now has a foul, unpleasant odor and taste.
​For the high price and lack of stability, I do not recommend this product and would not repurchase it.
ReviewText_ko:
​두껍고 매끄러우며 지속력이 뛰어나 보습력이 뛰어난 립 틴트입니다. 그것이 유일한 긍정적인 점이다.
​그러나 색상 효과는 미미하며, 가장 중요한 것은 제품이 빨리 상한다는 것입니다. 9월에 구입했는데 지금은 역겹고 불쾌한 냄새와 맛이 납니다.
​가격이 비싸고 안정성이 부족하여 이 제품을 추천하지 않으며 재구매하지도 않습니다.

Purchased in September, it now has a foul, unpleasant odor and taste. ​For the high price and lack of stability, I do not recommend this product and would not repurchase it.

Title: Such a pretty tint it is.
ReviewText:
I’m big on lip tints, and I can never have enough of it. I need one in every bag so I’m never without it. The Rhode lip tint is perfectly sized for that. The cute, compact packaging makes it easy to carry and super handy.
The formula is hydrating and moisturizing, and since it’s enriched with shea butter, peptides, and vitamin E, it not only adds a tint but also nourishes the lips. I tried the shade Ribbon, a beautiful sheer pink that looks great on its own or layered over lipstick. I love the color, though my naturally pigmented lips make it blend softly with my natural tone.
I absolutely love the shine, hydration, and comfort it provides, and I can’t wait to try more shades. I’m all set to face the winter woes with these new lippies from Rhode.

저는 립틴트를 워낙 좋아하는데, 그걸로 충분할 수가 없어요. 가방마다 하나씩 꼭 필요해서 절대 없으면 안 되거든요. 로드 립 틴트는 이에 딱 맞는 크기입니다. 귀엽고 컴팩트한 포장으로 휴대가 간편하고 매우 편리합니다.
촉촉하고 촉촉한 포뮬러로 시어버터, 펩타이드, 비타민E가 풍부해 틴트를 더해줄 뿐만 아니라 입술에 영양도 공급해줍니다. 저는 단독으로 사용해도 좋고 립스틱 위에 레이어드해도 멋진 아름다운 쉬어 핑크색 리본 쉐이드를 사용해 보았습니다. 색상이 마음에 들지만, 자연스럽게 착색된 입술로 인해 자연스러운 톤과 부드럽게 조화를 이룹니다.
나는 그것이 제공하는 광택, 수분 공급 및 편안함을 정말 좋아하며 더 많은 색상을 시도하고 싶습니다. 나는 Rhode의 새로운 lippies로 겨울의 불행에 직면 할 준비가되었습니다.

It’s become one of my go-to everyday shades when I want something simple, fresh, and really pretty.

Author: Leshaeveon
Title: Love the formula of this lip tint!!!
ReviewText: This was my first time trying anything from Rhode, and I have to say this lip tint made a great first impression! I got their Peptide Lip Tint Nourishing Glaze in the shade Toast, and I’ve been reaching for it since I got it. This is the perfect nude lip for me, and I love how well it works for creating really pretty lip combos. It’s also pretty buildable and really pretty to wear on its own. The formula is incredibly moisturizing and I love how hydrated my lips feel after use. The shine on this lip tint is also perfect, and I love that it’s not sticky, but has the perfect consistency long wear. The Rhode Peptide Lip Tint Nourishing Glaze is an absolute keeper and I MUST have the other shades!

Author: klaudiazj
ReviewText: The Rhode Peptide Lip Treatment is honestly one of the only balms that feels like it actually does something instead of just sitting on your lips. The texture is thick but glossy, never sticky, and it gives that clean-girl, hydrated look instantly. What I love most is how long it lasts — you don’t have to constantly reapply — and the peptide formula really does make your lips look smoother and a little plumper over time. Every flavor feels luxe, but still simple and wearable. It’s the kind of balm you throw in your bag and end up reaching for all day because it makes your lips look healthy, juicy, and glowy with literally zero effort. Honestly… it’s worth the hype.

아름답게 착용되고(적어도 내 피부 톤에는 립 라이너가 필요함에도 불구하고) 번지지 않고 촉촉한 느낌을 주며 입술을 촉촉하게 유지해줍니다.
이 밤을 사용하면 간편하면서도 스타일리쉬한 메이크업을 연출할 수 있어요!
text_for_model: Such a pretty, slightly gothic shade! I love how easily it applies, and it even looks great on dry lips. It wears beautifully (even though this shade requires a lip liner, at least on my skin tone), doesn’t smudge, gives a juicy look, and keeps my lips hydrated. I love using this balm to create effortless yet stylish makeup!

Title: So good
ReviewText: I’m loving this lip tint so much. It has the perfect hint of color that gets my lips so juice and soft. The application of it also feels amazing on my lips, it is smooth and thick without being super sticky. I found the formula to be very hydrating. The design is also very sleek enough to fit in my purse or even my pocket.
ReviewText_ko: 저는 이 립틴트를 너무 좋아해요. 그것은 내 입술을 너무 촉촉하고 부드럽게 만들어주는 완벽한 색상 힌트를 가지고 있습니다. 입술에 바르는 느낌도 놀랍고, 끈적임 없이 부드럽고 두껍습니다. 나는 공식이 매우 수분을 공급한다는 것을 알았습니다. 디자인도 너무 깔끔해서 지갑이나 주머니에도 쏙 들어갑니다.

ReviewText: This is my first Rhode lip product to try. It has a light texture, not sticky. It gives my lips a nice sheer shine. It has no flavor or scent. My lips feel nourished and it’s long lasting compared to others lip treatments.

Author: meganhowdy
Title: Overhyped in so many ways.
ReviewText: Why are these so hyped? This formula in my experience was thick, sticky, and settled into my outer lips lines. Not to mention it dried my lips out lol. I was so excited to try this but it's not living up to the praise it gets, imo the formula sucks, there are much better out there. The only thing I liked was the applicator, I liked that it was smaller so you had more control with a pigmented formula. That's why I'm giving it 2 stars instead of 1.
ReviewText_ko: 이게 왜 그렇게 과장된 걸까요? 내 경험상 이 포뮬러는 걸쭉하고 끈적거리며 입술 바깥 라인에 자리잡는 느낌이었다. 말할 것도없이 입술이 건조 해졌습니다 ㅋㅋㅋ. 나는 이것을 시도하게되어 매우 기뻤지 만 그것이 얻는 칭찬에 부응하지 못했습니다. 공식이 형편없고 훨씬 더 나은 것이 있습니다. 유일하게 마음에 들었던 점은 어플리케이터였는데, 크기가 작아서 색소를 더 잘 표현할 수 있다는 점이 마음에 들었습니다. 그래서 별 1개가 아닌 별 2개를 주고 싶습니다.

Title: Good lip tint
ReviewText: I’ve been using this lip tint lately, and I really like how it looks on my lips. It adds a soft color without feeling like I’m wearing makeup. The texture is more like a smooth balm, so I end up reapplying it during the day just because it feels nice. It’s the kind of tint I keep in my small bag, it’s easy to put on, adds a bit of color, and doesn’t get sticky. That’s pretty much all I wanted from it, and it does exactly that.
ReviewText_ko: 요즘 이 립틴트를 사용하고 있는데 입술에 발색되는 느낌이 너무 좋아요. 화장을 한 듯한 느낌 없이 은은한 컬러를 더해줍니다. 질감은 오히려 부드러운 밤에 가까운 느낌이라 사용감이 좋아서 낮에 다시 바르고 있어요. 작은 가방에 넣어다니는 틴트인데 바르기도 편하고 발색도 살짝 해주고 끈적임도 없어요. 그것이 제가 원했던 전부였고, 정확히 그 일을 해냈습니다.

Author: TammyLH
Title: Coconut Free!??
ReviewText: This became an instant favorite for me. I'm not sure why I hadn't tried it before, but with it containing Babassu Oil, it is the perfect substitute for those like me who are avoiding coconut based components. It has a lovely thickness to it like a gloss, while keeping my lips hydrated and slightly plumped. I have noticed that after a while it gets tacky though. 1 star less due to that. Still highly recommend trying.

Author: mar11sv
Title: Very pretty color
ReviewText: This Lip Tint is very beautiful, the application is super smooth, it glides on so well over my lips. Instantly, you feel the hydration, which is exactly what my lips needed, as I usually struggle with chapped and dry lips. But this Lip Tint has really made them much softer and more nourished. The color in Ribbon is subtle but pretty. It has that light touch of color that brings life to the lips without being too intense and the texture is lightweight, not sticky, but gives a gorgeous shine like a gloss finish without the sticky feeling that some balms leave behind, not only hydrates but also makes my lips look fuller and smoother, almost like they’re more plump. At the same time, it gives me a sense of comfort that lasts all day. And with ingredients like peptides, shea butter, and vitamin E, it really helps a lot. I’ve incorporated it into my daily routine, both day and night.

Title: Good moisturizer
ReviewText:
The strongest rhode Peptide Lip Tint is moisturizing, I can confirm that. The lipstick has a perfect moisturizing layer, glossy and non-sticky. It has become my daily companion in my bag and before going to bed.
The squeeze head design and screw cap are very hygienic and easy to use. The lipstick has a gel texture that creates a plumping effect when used with very good adhesion.
In short, Rhode Peptide Lip Tint is the ideal choice for those who:
Prioritize the ability to moisturize and restore lips.
Like the effect of plump lips, natural light shine.
Want a light color layer, easy to use every day without elaborate makeup.
You can find it at beauty stores such as Sephora.

Author: jessicaxxxoo
Title: Love the color
ReviewText: This lip tint is such a perfect blend of skincare and color. The formula feels instantly hydrating, thanks to the mix of peptides, shea butter, and vitamin E, and it really does melt into the lips with a sheer, glossy wash of color. I love how buildable it is—one swipe gives you a soft, natural tint, but you can easily layer it for more impact without ever feeling sticky or heavy. What stands out most is how nourishing it is. It locks in moisture right away and keeps lips feeling smooth and pillowy long after it fades. Over time, the formula even helps soften the look of fine lines and gives the lips a subtle plumping effect, which makes it feel more like a treatment than just a tint. It’s easy to wear day or night, works beautifully on its own or layered over other lip products, and the glossy finish makes lips look healthy and fresh. Plus, it’s vegan and cruelty-free, which is always a bonus. Overall, a great pick if you want color, shine, and actual lip care all in one.

Author: CaitYates
Title: Smells funny

I know this is advertised as fragrance-free, so I'm guessing what I am smelling is the raw ingredients. It's not pleasant to me and I do wish there was some kind of subtle fragrance added to mask that more.

Author: Jarami20
Title: MUST HAVE
ReviewText: I am a lip gloss, balm, oil, etc. SNOB. I haven’t tried this product for years waiting to make the move, and with the Sephora sale I finally snagged two. Title: That's That Me Espresso

Author: hshshsjsjsjsjkr
Title: Moisture and high shine
ReviewText: I have so many lip balms and I am very picky. This one is moisturizing and makes my lips look very kissable with the high shine. Ribbon is a subtle pink that compliments my lips very well and is a barely there nude pink for my medium skin tone. The packaging does not get messy or leak near the cap, which is very important for me. The size is very convenient to put in your pocket if needed. I will be using this daily!
