Author: GlammyNest
Title: Love this glaze
ReviewText: I’m loving the Rhode Peptide Lip Tint! The espresso tube is a deep burgundy shade, and while I expected a stronger tint, the color is actually quite subtle. This was my first time trying a lip product from the brand, so I was really excited to test it out. I’m impressed with how well the glaze keeps my lips hydrated for hours. They feel softer, smoother, and there’s even a slight plumping effect that gives my lips a nice confidence boost. Overall, I definitely recommend it!
ReviewText_ko: 저는 로드 펩타이드 립 틴트를 좋아해요! 에스프레소 튜브는 짙은 버건디 컬러인데, 좀 더 강한 틴트를 기대했지만, 실제로는 색상이 꽤 은은합니다. 처음으로 해당 브랜드의 립 제품을 사용해 보았는데, 테스트해보고 싶어서 정말 기뻤습니다. 글레이즈가 몇 시간 동안 입술에 수분을 얼마나 잘 유지하는지에 깊은 인상을 받았습니다. 더 부드럽고 매끄러운 느낌이 들며 약간의 플럼핑 효과도 있어서 입술에 자신감이 더해집니다. 전반적으로, 나는 그것을 추천합니다!
text_for_model: I’m loving the Rhode Peptide Lip Tint! The espresso tube is a deep burgundy shade, and while I expected a stronger tint, the color is actually quite subtle. This was my first time trying a lip product from the brand, so I was really excited to test it out. I’m impressed with how well the glaze keeps my lips hydrated for hours. They feel softer, smoother, and there’s even a slight plumping effect that gives my lips a nice confidence boost. Overall, I definitely recommend it!

Author: Itsfrankayy
ReviewText: The Rhode Peptide Lip Tint in Toast is nourishing with a gorgeous high-shine formula that glides on so smoothly. The sheer but buildable color is stunning, and the aesthetic packaging makes it even better. It’s the perfect tint for day or night. All Rhode lip products are a hit, they never miss!!
ReviewText_ko: 로드 펩타이드 립 틴트 인 토스트는 매끄럽게 미끄러지는 고광택 포뮬러로 영양을 공급합니다. 투명하지만 제작 가능한 색상이 놀랍고 심미적인 포장이 더욱 좋습니다. 낮이나 밤이나 딱 맞는 틴트에요. 로드 립 제품은 모두 히트상품이에요, 절대 놓치지 마세요!!
text_for_model: The Rhode Peptide Lip Tint in Toast is nourishing with a gorgeous high-shine formula that glides on so smoothly. The sheer but buildable color is stunning, and the aesthetic packaging makes it even better. It’s the perfect tint for day or night. All Rhode lip products are a hit, they never miss!!

Author: nancyb1224
Title: worth the hype
ReviewText: This was my first tinted peptide by rhode! Espressos slight tint is gorgeous and you can build on it , its the perfect fall lippie paired with my lip liner. Its not only moisturizing when first putting it on but that moisturize actually lasts
ReviewText_ko: 이것은 로드의 첫 번째 틴티드 펩타이드였습니다! 에스프레소의 은은한 틴트가 화려하고 그 위에 얹을 수 있습니다. 내 립 라이너와 짝을 이루는 완벽한 가을 립피입니다. 처음 발랐을 때 촉촉함은 물론, 촉촉함이 지속되는 느낌이에요
text_for_model: This was my first tinted peptide by rhode! Espressos slight tint is gorgeous and you can build on it , its the perfect fall lippie paired with my lip liner. Its not only moisturizing when first putting it on but that moisturize actually lasts

Author: AlinaYklymova
Title: Must have
ReviewText: The Peptide Lip Treatment in Espresso is stunning. The tint is rich but still wearable, giving my lips a warm, chocolatey gloss without feeling heavy. It’s super hydrating, smooth, and makes my lips look fuller. Such a perfect cozy everyday shade.
ReviewText_ko: 에스프레소의 펩타이드 립 트리트먼트는 정말 놀랍습니다. 틴트가 풍부하면서도 지속력이 좋아서 무거운 느낌 없이 입술에 따뜻한 초콜렛 광택을 선사합니다. 보습력이 뛰어나고 매끄러우며 입술이 더 통통해 보입니다. 완벽하고 아늑한 일상의 그늘.
text_for_model: The Peptide Lip Treatment in Espresso is stunning. The tint is rich but still wearable, giving my lips a warm, chocolatey gloss without feeling heavy. It’s super hydrating, smooth, and makes my lips look fuller. Such a perfect cozy everyday shade.

Author: ReviewsByHolly
ReviewText: It’s Rhode, it’s their signature product, you know it’s going to be good. I loved the color of ribbon and how this elevates even an otherwise no make-up day. It’s not too sticky but long lasting enough to keep from reapplying too often.
ReviewText_ko: 로드(Rhode)입니다. 그들의 시그니처 제품입니다. 분명 좋을 것입니다. 나는 리본의 색상을 좋아했고 이것이 메이크업을 하지 않은 날에도 어떻게 향상되는지를 좋아했습니다. 너무 끈적이지는 않지만, 자주 덧바르지 않아도 될 정도로 지속력이 좋습니다.
text_for_model: It’s Rhode, it’s their signature product, you know it’s going to be good. I loved the color of ribbon and how this elevates even an otherwise no make-up day. It’s not too sticky but long lasting enough to keep from reapplying too often.

Author: missamandayunnn
Title: Must have lippie!
ReviewText: Ever since they reformulated, I have to say I’m pretty impressed! It feels very hydrating and there is no more graininess to it. The shade is also super beautiful. I love using it on top of the Rhode liners.
ReviewText_ko: 그들이 재구성된 이후로, 나는 꽤 감동받았다고 말하고 싶습니다! 굉장히 수분감이 느껴지고 더 이상 끈적임이 없습니다. 그늘도 매우 아름답습니다. 나는 Rhode 라이너 위에 사용하는 것을 좋아합니다.
text_for_model: Ever since they reformulated, I have to say I’m pretty impressed! It feels very hydrating and there is no more graininess to it. The shade is also super beautiful. I love using it on top of the Rhode liners.

Author: jackies305
Title: Perfect glossy color!
ReviewText: The Espresso shade is my new obsession!!!! It gives the lips this sheer, glossy coffee tint that looks so effortless and pretty. The peptide formula makes them feel soft and hydrated all day, and the hint of sweetness in the scent is so good. It’s the perfect “my lips but better” shade with a cozy vibe. It’s fall girl vibe approved! I bought an extra one to keep in my office!
ReviewText_ko: 에스프레소 쉐이드는 나의 새로운 강박관념입니다!!!! 입술에 투명하고 글로시한 커피 틴트를 주어 자연스러우면서도 예쁘게 보입니다. 펩타이드 포뮬러가 하루종일 부드럽고 촉촉한 느낌을 주며, 은은한 달콤함이 느껴지는 향이 너무 좋아요. 아늑한 분위기를 지닌 완벽한 "내 입술이지만 더 나은"색상입니다. 가을 소녀 분위기가 승인되었습니다! 사무실에 보관하려고 하나 더 구매했어요!
text_for_model: The Espresso shade is my new obsession!!!! It gives the lips this sheer, glossy coffee tint that looks so effortless and pretty. The peptide formula makes them feel soft and hydrated all day, and the hint of sweetness in the scent is so good. It’s the perfect “my lips but better” shade with a cozy vibe. It’s fall girl vibe approved! I bought an extra one to keep in my office!

Author: Baileyanne10
ReviewText: This lip tint was really hydrating and pretty. It wasn’t as tinted as I expected but it was very shimmery which I loved. The applicator was smaller than any other brand I’ve tried but I liked how I could be a bit more precise with it
ReviewText_ko: 이 립틴트는 정말 촉촉하고 예뻤어요. 생각보다 발색은 안됐지만 은은하게 반짝이는 발색이 너무 맘에 들었어요. 어플리케이터는 제가 사용해본 어떤 브랜드보다 작았지만 좀 더 정밀하게 사용할 수 있다는 점이 마음에 들었습니다.
text_for_model: This lip tint was really hydrating and pretty. It wasn’t as tinted as I expected but it was very shimmery which I loved. The applicator was smaller than any other brand I’ve tried but I liked how I could be a bit more precise with it

Author: Funebone
ReviewText: My first Rhode product and it did not disappoint! I love the formula and how it leaves my lips looking glossed and hydrated without being overly shiny and sticky. Espresso’s slight brown tint is perfect over lip liner or on its own. Love how easy it is to get product out of the tube, not too quick and not too watery. My only wish is that it be scented, but otherwise I love it and look forward to trying more shades!
ReviewText_ko: 나의 첫 Rhode 제품은 실망스럽지 않았습니다! 나는 포뮬러를 좋아하고 입술이 지나치게 윤기 나 끈적 거리지 않고 윤기 있고 촉촉해 보이게 만드는 방법을 좋아합니다. 에스프레소의 은은한 브라운 틴트는 립라이너 위에 바르거나 단독으로 사용하기에도 완벽합니다. 너무 빠르지도 너무 물같지도 않은 방식으로 튜브에서 제품을 꺼내는 것이 얼마나 쉬운지 정말 마음에 듭니다. 내 유일한 희망은 향이 나는 것인데, 그렇지 않으면 나는 그것을 좋아하고 더 많은 색상을 시도하기를 기대합니다!
text_for_model: My first Rhode product and it did not disappoint! I love the formula and how it leaves my lips looking glossed and hydrated without being overly shiny and sticky. Espresso’s slight brown tint is perfect over lip liner or on its own. Love how easy it is to get product out of the tube, not too quick and not too watery. My only wish is that it be scented, but otherwise I love it and look forward to trying more shades!

Author: Ulana
Title: Espresso love
ReviewText: I get the hype now. This is only my second product from the Rhode and I’m hooked. Espresso is a gorgeous rich brown—sheer but deep—and feels hydrating without the stickiness I expected. No scent, but the color and packaging are stunning. 5/5.
ReviewText_ko: 이제 과대광고를 듣게 되었습니다. 이것은 Rhode의 두 번째 제품이고 저는 매료되었습니다. 에스프레소는 맑지만 깊고 화려한 브라운 색상으로 예상했던 끈적임 없이 수분을 공급하는 느낌을 줍니다. 향은 없지만 색상이나 포장이 너무 예뻐요. 5/5.
text_for_model: I get the hype now. This is only my second product from the Rhode and I’m hooked. Espresso is a gorgeous rich brown—sheer but deep—and feels hydrating without the stickiness I expected. No scent, but the color and packaging are stunning. 5/5.

Author: cookie614
ReviewText: This feels so moisturizing on the lips and the shade is so pretty. I love the packaging of it as well as it’s easy to apply and squeeze out so it doesn’t get stuck or anything. Now I really want to try all the shades
ReviewText_ko: 입술에 촉촉한 느낌이 들고 색상도 너무 예뻐요. 포장도 마음에 들고, 붙이고 짜내기도 쉽기 때문에 막히는 일도 없고요. 이제 정말 모든 색상을 시험해보고 싶습니다
text_for_model: This feels so moisturizing on the lips and the shade is so pretty. I love the packaging of it as well as it’s easy to apply and squeeze out so it doesn’t get stuck or anything. Now I really want to try all the shades

Author: LizPrecious
Title: Such a disappointment
ReviewText: So disappointed after waiting years for Rhode to be available in Canada. After receiving my lipgloss there is nothing significantly special about it, and ￼the flavour has a high chemical taste. There are many amazing glosses out there for half the price.
ReviewText_ko: Rhode가 캐나다에서 출시될 때까지 몇 년을 기다린 끝에 너무 실망했습니다. 내 립글로스를 받은 후에는 크게 특별한 것이 없으며 맛은 화학적 맛이 높습니다. 절반 가격에 놀라운 글로스가 많이 있습니다.
text_for_model: So disappointed after waiting years for Rhode to be available in Canada. After receiving my lipgloss there is nothing significantly special about it, and ￼the flavour has a high chemical taste. There are many amazing glosses out there for half the price.

Author: Bmichelle16
Title: So pink so pretty!!
ReviewText: I absolutely love how it hydrates my lips and gives me a natural pinky tone! I love how it’s not sticky at all and the new formula is amazing. Will be ordering other shades to keep my lips glossy and scrumptious looking.
ReviewText_ko: 입술에 수분을 공급하고 자연스러운 핑크색 톤을 선사하는 방식이 정말 마음에 듭니다! 끈적임이 전혀 없고 새로운 포뮬러가 정말 놀랍습니다. 내 입술을 윤기 있고 맛있게 보이게 유지하기 위해 다른 색상을 주문할 것입니다.
text_for_model: I absolutely love how it hydrates my lips and gives me a natural pinky tone! I love how it’s not sticky at all and the new formula is amazing. Will be ordering other shades to keep my lips glossy and scrumptious looking.

Author: Sford75
ReviewText: Rhode’s Peptide Lip Tint in Toast is a perfect everyday nude with just enough warmth to look polished without trying. It feels buttery, smooth, and hydrating, more like a lip treatment than a tint. It’s lightweight, non-sticky, and wears comfortably for hours. If you want a natural, plush finish with a hint of tint, this is an easy go-to.
ReviewText_ko: 로드의 펩타이드 립 틴트 인 토스트(Rhode's Peptide Lip Tint in Toast)는 노력하지 않고도 세련되게 보일 만큼 충분한 따뜻함을 지닌 완벽한 데일리 누드입니다. 버터처럼 부드럽고 촉촉한 느낌이 들어 틴트라기보다는 립 트리트먼트에 가까운 느낌이에요. 가볍고 끈적이지 않으며 몇 시간 동안 편안하게 착용할 수 있습니다. 은은한 틴트가 가미된 ​​자연스럽고 고급스러운 마무리를 원한다면 이 제품을 선택하세요.
text_for_model: Rhode’s Peptide Lip Tint in Toast is a perfect everyday nude with just enough warmth to look polished without trying. It feels buttery, smooth, and hydrating, more like a lip treatment than a tint. It’s lightweight, non-sticky, and wears comfortably for hours. If you want a natural, plush finish with a hint of tint, this is an easy go-to.

Author: Hannahberhow
Title: Glossy
ReviewText: This is my first time trying rhode and the peptide actually feels nice on the lips. At first feels very moisturizing with more of a gloss like texture, but wears off fast. You do have to reapply every couple hours.
ReviewText_ko: 로드를 처음 사용해봤는데 펩타이드가 실제로 입술에 좋은 느낌을 줍니다. 처음에는 수분감이 많고 글로시한 질감이 느껴지지만 금방 지워집니다. 몇 시간마다 다시 신청해야 합니다.
text_for_model: This is my first time trying rhode and the peptide actually feels nice on the lips. At first feels very moisturizing with more of a gloss like texture, but wears off fast. You do have to reapply every couple hours.

Author: o12443998
Title: Light tint and glossy finish
ReviewText: Ribbon is the perfect everyday pink. Super hydrating and it melts into the lips fast, stays glowy for hours. The shine is glowy but natural and the tint gives a soft flush that stays even after the gloss fades. Makes my lips look healthy.
ReviewText_ko: 리본은 데일리로 딱 좋은 핑크색이에요. 수분 공급이 뛰어나 입술에 빠르게 녹아 몇 시간 동안 윤기를 유지합니다. 광채가 나지만 자연스러우며, 광택이 사라진 후에도 은은한 홍조가 유지되는 틴트입니다. 입술이 건강해 보이더라구요.
text_for_model: Ribbon is the perfect everyday pink. Super hydrating and it melts into the lips fast, stays glowy for hours. The shine is glowy but natural and the tint gives a soft flush that stays even after the gloss fades. Makes my lips look healthy.

Author: ivyhindman
ReviewText: This made my lips feel so nice and hydrated. I love that it had peptides in it and I loved the color pay off. It made my lips feel soft after a long day and it was nice and glossy! Huge fan of the brand and o glad to add it to my collection.
ReviewText_ko: 입술이 너무 좋고 촉촉한 느낌이 들었습니다. 펩타이드가 함유되어 있어서 마음에 들었고 색상도 마음에 들었습니다. 긴 하루를 보낸 후 입술이 보송보송해지고, 윤기가 나고 좋았어요! 브랜드의 열렬한 팬이며 내 컬렉션에 추가하게 되어 기쁩니다.
text_for_model: This made my lips feel so nice and hydrated. I love that it had peptides in it and I loved the color pay off. It made my lips feel soft after a long day and it was nice and glossy! Huge fan of the brand and o glad to add it to my collection.

Author: Viluya
Title: comfortable, non-sticky, glossy
ReviewText: The formula is lightweight, hydrating, and gives a soft glossy finish. The shade Espresso adds a natural but noticeable tint that fits perfectly into my daily routine. Super easy to reapply and keeps my lips looking smooth and moisturized.
ReviewText_ko: 포뮬러는 가볍고 촉촉하며 부드러운 광택 마무리를 제공합니다. 에스프레소 셰이드는 내 일상에 완벽하게 어울리는 자연스러우면서도 눈에 띄는 틴트를 더해줍니다. 다시 바르기가 매우 쉽고 입술을 부드럽고 촉촉하게 유지합니다.
text_for_model: The formula is lightweight, hydrating, and gives a soft glossy finish. The shade Espresso adds a natural but noticeable tint that fits perfectly into my daily routine. Super easy to reapply and keeps my lips looking smooth and moisturized.

Author: Liiizaa
Title: My daily lippie
ReviewText: The glossiness is there, the hydration is there, the pigment is there!! Girl this peptide treatment is just that girl! Not only is the color so cute but it’s lasting and hydrating on the lips, makes them look 10xs better!
ReviewText_ko: 윤기도 있고, 수분도 있고, 색소도 있어요!! 얘야 이 펩타이드 트리트먼트가 바로 그 여자야! 컬러가 너무 귀여울 뿐만 아니라 지속력과 입술 보습력이 10배 더 좋아보여요!
text_for_model: The glossiness is there, the hydration is there, the pigment is there!! Girl this peptide treatment is just that girl! Not only is the color so cute but it’s lasting and hydrating on the lips, makes them look 10xs better!

Author: vintageoctober1
Title: Healthy and beautiful lips
ReviewText: This was my first time trying the rhode peptide lip tint nourishing glaze, and I instantly fell in love. Ingredients like Shea, butter and vitamin E are always really great for adding hydration to my lips and I love that it has peptides too because it also helps smoothing and hydrating my lips. Sometimes I forget that taking care of my lips is important and I love how fun this lip product is because it makes it more approachable and really stands out as a lip product. Overall, my lips looked good and felt really healthy, which I really loved.
ReviewText_ko: 로드 펩타이드 립 틴트 너리싱 글레이즈를 처음 써보는데 바로 반해버렸어요. 시어, 버터, 비타민 E와 같은 성분은 항상 입술에 수분을 공급하는 데 정말 좋습니다. 또한 입술을 매끄럽게 하고 수분을 공급하는 데 도움이 되기 때문에 펩타이드도 포함되어 있다는 점이 마음에 듭니다. 가끔 입술 관리가 중요하다는 사실을 잊어버릴 때가 있는데, 이 립 제품이 더 친근하고 립 제품으로서 돋보이기 때문에 이 립 제품이 얼마나 재미있는지 정말 좋아합니다. 전체적으로 입술이 좋아보이고 건강해지는 느낌이 들어서 정말 마음에 들었어요.
text_for_model: This was my first time trying the rhode peptide lip tint nourishing glaze, and I instantly fell in love. Ingredients like Shea, butter and vitamin E are always really great for adding hydration to my lips and I love that it has peptides too because it also helps smoothing and hydrating my lips. Sometimes I forget that taking care of my lips is important and I love how fun this lip product is because it makes it more approachable and really stands out as a lip product. Overall, my lips looked good and felt really healthy, which I really loved.

Author: Iheartlattes
Title: Beautiful look and formula!
ReviewText: This has such a great nourishing formula but still gives the lips some nice color! It’s super glossy and buildable so you can take it from a hint of color to a little more bold. It replenishes moisture AND makes lips look even better!

Author: snatali
Title: Everyday hydration and gloss
ReviewText: I’ve been using the Rhode Peptide Lip Tint Nourishing Glaze in Espresso daily, and I honestly love how it fits seamlessly into my routine. After my morning skincare, I apply this tint as the final touch, and it instantly makes my lips look healthy and cared for. The texture is lightweight but nourishing, so my lips feel soft all day without any stickiness. I also love the Espresso shade — it’s rich, flattering, and enhances my natural lip color without being too bold. The subtle gloss adds a nice shine that catches the light beautifully, making my lips look fuller and hydrated. Even after sipping coffee or water, the color stays natural and doesn’t dry out my lips. Overall, it’s become a small everyday indulgence that makes me feel polished and confident without extra effort. I appreciate that it combines care and color in one product, so my lips stay smooth, moisturized, and just the right amount of glossy from morning to night.
ReviewText_ko: 저는 매일 에스프레소에 로드 펩타이드 립 틴트 너리싱 글레이즈를 사용하고 있는데, 그것이 제 일상에 완벽하게 들어맞는 방식이 솔직히 마음에 듭니다. 아침 스킨케어 후 마지막 터치로 이 틴트를 바르면 즉각적으로 입술이 건강해지고 케어되는 느낌이 듭니다. 텍스쳐가 가벼우면서도 영양감이 있어서 끈적임 없이 하루종일 입술이 보송보송해요. 나는 또한 에스프레소 색상을 좋아합니다. 풍부하고 돋보이며 너무 대담하지 않으면서 자연스러운 입술 색상을 향상시킵니다. 은은한 광택이 빛을 아름답게 받아 좋은 윤기를 더해 입술을 더욱 도톰하고 촉촉하게 만들어준다. 커피나 물을 마신 후에도 컬러가 자연스럽고 입술이 건조해지지 않아요. 전체적으로 별 노력 없이도 세련되고 자신감을 느끼게 해주는 소소한 일상의 방종이 되었습니다. 케어와 컬러를 하나의 제품에 담아 아침부터 저녁까지 입술이 매끄럽고 촉촉하며 딱 적당한 윤기를 유지해주는 점에 감사드립니다.

Title: Such a great lip treatment!
ReviewText: The Rhode Peptide Lip Tint in Toast is the perfect balance between nourishment and effortless color. The formula has that same cushiony, hydrating feel as the original Peptide Lip Treatment, but with a warm, cozy tint that instantly enhances your lips. Toast is a flattering caramel rose shade — it gives a natural “my lips but warmer” look that works beautifully for everyday wear or layered for a deeper tone. The texture is silky and never sticky, gliding on smoothly and leaving a glossy, plumped finish that lasts for hours. It also wears down evenly, leaving a soft stain so your lips still look polished even after the shine fades. The subtle vanilla scent adds a hint of sweetness without being overpowering.

Author: dindin96
Title: Wanted to love...a return for me. Odd texture.
ReviewText:
I have seen these everywhere and was super excited when rhode was announced to be sold in Sephora. I had been eyeing this Raspberry Jelly lip tint and ended up trying it on in the store. The color was gorgeous so it was an immediate buy. When I went to put on my purchased gloss, it came out clear. the rest of the day it remained clear, but after spending the night in my purse, the color began to show. 

Pretty odd, but it wasn't a big deal. Then I began to put it on and after maybe 30 minutes, it felt like I had crumbs on my lips. I ended up switching to a normal chapstick and I had no issues with having the crumb like feeling on my lips. When I went back to rhode, the same issue happened again. 

I'm pretty disappointed. Will not be buying again.
ReviewText_ko:
나는 이것을 어디에서나 보았고 로드가 세포라에서 판매된다는 발표를 받았을 때 매우 기뻤습니다. 저는 이 라즈베리 젤리 립 틴트를 눈여겨보고 있었는데 결국 매장에서 직접 사용해 봤습니다. 색상이 너무 예뻐서 바로 구매했습니다. 구매한 글로스를 바르려고 했더니 투명하게 나왔어요. 나머지 하루 동안은 맑았지만 지갑에서 밤을 보낸 후 색이 나타나기 시작했습니다. 

꽤 이상했지만 큰 문제는 아니었습니다. 그리고 바르기 시작했는데 30분 정도 지나니 입술에 부스러기가 생긴 것 같았어요. 나는 결국 일반 챕스틱으로 바꿨고 입술에 부스러기가 느껴지는 데 아무런 문제가 없었습니다. 로드로 돌아갔을 때도 같은 문제가 다시 발생했습니다. 

나는 꽤 실망했다. 다시 구매하지 않을 것입니다.

Author: izzeye
Title: STINKY BLUE CHEESE SMELL - DONT BUY
ReviewText:
After having this lipgloss for a month it started to smell like blue cheese. I originally bought it the day they dropped Rhode in Sephora. At first everything was well but then it quickly turned south. Everytime I would apply on my lips I would get a sour waft of stinky blue cheese that would linger while wearing it.

What I’m most disappointed is the fact that when I went into store a few days past the 30 days from when I purchased, I was aware I couldn’t officially return, and the associate kept telling me how tons of people with this product were having the same issue. When I asked if it was from a bad batch she told me “no it’s just the product”. 

My question is if all of these $20 lip glosses are going to reek of pungent blue cheese after a few weeks of opening, then why are they still selling them?? Honestly ridiculous if you ask me. 

And if they did know this was going to be the case, this should have been forewarned prior to purchasing. With that being said I feel like I deserve some sort of refund for Sephora being deceiving about the peptides longevity. 

I am very disappointed and will not be repurchasing and STRONGLY do not recommend. (I do still love the pocket blushes)
ReviewText_ko:
이 립글로스를 한 달 동안 사용하고 나니 블루치즈 냄새가 나기 시작했어요. 나는 원래 세포라에 로드(Rhode)를 떨어뜨린 날 구입했습니다. 처음에는 모든 것이 순조로웠지만 곧 남쪽으로 향했습니다. 입술에 바를 때마다 입는 동안 계속 남아 있는 냄새나는 블루 치즈의 신맛이 납니다.

가장 실망스러운 점은 구매한지 30일이 지나고 며칠이 지나서 매장에 갔을 때 공식적으로 반품이 불가능하다는 것을 알았고, 그 직원은 이 제품을 사용하는 많은 사람들이 같은 문제를 겪고 있다고 계속해서 말했습니다. 내가 그것이 불량한 배치에서 나온 것인지 물었을 때 그녀는 "아니요, 그것은 단지 제품일 뿐입니다"라고 말했습니다. 

내 질문은 이 20달러짜리 립글로즈를 개봉한 지 몇 주 후에 모두 매운 블루 치즈 냄새가 날 것인데, 왜 아직도 판매하고 있습니까?? 물어보면 솔직히 웃긴다. 

그리고 만약 그들이 이런 일이 일어날 것이라는 것을 알았다면, 구매하기 전에 미리 경고했어야 했습니다. 그렇게 말하면 세포라가 펩타이드 수명에 대해 속이고 있는 것에 대해 일종의 환불을 받을 자격이 있다고 생각합니다. 

나는 매우 실망했고 재구매하지 않을 것이며 강력히 권장하지 않습니다. (나는 아직도 포켓 블러셔를 좋아한다)

Author: AKantarjian
Title: Not for everyone, definitely a yes for some.
ReviewText: I believe you’re buying the name more than the product when it comes to the Rhode Peptide Lip Tint. I was very excited to use this PB&J Lip Tint, upon opening I put it on without a lip liner to see it and try it. It’s not as pigmented as it is advertised. The next morning I put on lip liner, smudged it in then put the PB&J Lip Tint and it still didn’t come out the way I was expecting…you could still see the smudging of the lip liner barely covered and blended together. I also would like to add that I understand it is a lip “tint” meaning it isn’t supposed to be super noticeable and dark however in the pictures they use to promote the product it looks so much better and darker than in real life. I think this is a great product if you have lip blushing (tattooed lip color base) and want to enhance that or if you’re not big on pigment and visibility but otherwise if you want color and pigment and shine I would go with Fenty Beauty lip products. I gave 3 stars because the packaging is still cute, not bulky and I will try it again someday if they reformulated it to have some more pigment but rn it’s not a rebuy for me.
ReviewText_ko: 로드 펩타이드 립 틴트에 관해서는 제품보다 이름을 더 많이 구매하신다고 생각합니다. Author: ajamal43
Title: My must have
ReviewText:
I’ve tried a lot of lip glosses, but Rhode honestly gets it right every single time. The texture is buttery, not sticky, and it leaves my lips feeling plumped, hydrated, and glossy for hours. It’s like skincare and shine in one.

I love how it gives that “clean girl” glassy finish — perfect on its own or layered over lipstick. Plus, the flavors are subtle but delicious (especially Salted Caramel and Watermelon Slice). My lips have never felt softer.
ReviewText_ko:
나는 많은 립글로스를 사용해 보았지만 Rhode는 매번 솔직하게 옳았습니다. 질감은 끈적이지 않고 버터처럼 느껴지며 입술이 몇 시간 동안 통통하고 촉촉하며 윤기 나는 느낌을 줍니다. 스킨케어와 윤기가 하나로 합쳐진 것 같아요.

나는 그것이 "깨끗한 소녀"의 유리 같은 마무리를 제공하는 방법을 좋아합니다. 그 자체로 완벽하거나 립스틱 위에 겹쳐서 완벽합니다. Plus, the flavors are subtle but delicious (especially Salted Caramel and Watermelon Slice). 내 입술이 더 부드러워진 적이 없습니다.

Author: Sydni00
Title: Fishy and moldy smell
ReviewText: Initially, I was eager to try this product because of the rave reviews on TikTok and my friends’ love for it. I headed to Sephora as soon as it arrived in stores and immediately fell in love with the raspberry tint. I’ve only worn it three times—once just to test it out and twice during a girls’ trip. I had plans to wear it again before going out, but when I opened the cap, I was hit with a strong, fishy, moldy odor. I thought I might be imagining it, so I asked my mom to smell it too, and she instantly told me I should return it. When I went to Sephora to exchange it, I shared my disappointment with the associate and even asked her to smell the lip gloss. To my dismay, her reaction was even worse than mine—confirming that the product was definitely spoiled.

Author: Piffyhai
Title: Save your money! It went bad in 30 days
ReviewText:
I don’t like doing this, but it was a terrible experience no one needs to go through. I have used the rhode Peptide Lip Treatment Nourishing Glaze previously and got excited they were going to sell it at Sephora.

 I purchased the lip tint on 9/8/25. I enjoyed it at first, the color is great and it lasted so I wasn’t constantly reapplying it. However, less than a month after purchasing, I noticed a VERY foul smelling odor. I thought maybe something got into the cap area so I cleaned it with alcohol. I tried again and realized it was the lip glaze producing the odor! I looked online and read that this is a common occurrence with this product, but all of the reviews I saw were after using the product for 6 months. I had it 29 days! I submitted a return online to drop off in store and explained the reason in the return. I received the return email with the barcode to provide to the in-store beauty advisor. 

 Today was the first day I was available to do the return, when the advisor scanned the barcode she said it was over 30 days so she couldn’t continue with the return. I was shocked, I said if she wasn’t going to accept the return then to just throw it away because that’s what I plan to do. She told me she couldn’t accept it at all. I am so disappointed, I am sticking to LANEIGE, because I’ve never had this type of issue with their product.

나는 이런 일을 하는 것을 좋아하지 않지만, 누구도 겪을 필요가 없는 끔찍한 경험이었습니다. 나는 이전에 로드 펩타이드 립 트리트먼트 너리싱 글레이즈를 사용했는데 세포라에서 판매할 예정이어서 매우 기뻤습니다.

 9/8/25에 립틴트를 구매했습니다. 처음엔 맘에 들었고 발색도 좋고 지속력도 좋아서 계속 덧바르지 않아도 되더라구요. 그런데 구입한 지 한 달도 채 되지 않아 아주 지독한 냄새가 났습니다. 캡 부분에 뭔가 들어간 것 같아 알코올로 닦아냈습니다. 나는 다시 시도했고 냄새를 일으키는 것이 립글레이즈라는 것을 깨달았습니다! 온라인에서 찾아보니 이 제품에서 흔히 발생하는 현상이라고 읽었는데, 제가 본 리뷰는 모두 제품을 6개월간 사용한 후의 내용이었습니다. 저는 29일 했어요! 매장 방문을 위해 온라인으로 반품 신청을 하고 반품 사유를 설명했습니다. 매장 내 뷰티 어드바이저에게 제공할 바코드가 포함된 반송 이메일을 받았습니다.

I live in Colorado where it's really dry so my lips NEED moisture and this provides that. It is a little on the thicker side but I personally enjoy that - if I'm not using this, I'm using Aquaphor on my lips, if that gives you any idea of the kinds of products I like lol. My only issues with this product are that the tube is a lot smaller than I thought it was going to be (so you don't get a ton of product for $20) and the lack of scent/flavor means that it smells and tastes kind of like plastic in my opinion. I totally get the reasoning behind not using a scent or flavor, but I wish there was one because it's something that you have to taste when you lick your lips and it's right under your nose so a pleasant scent would be nice lol.

Author: rissym33
Title: Went bad too soon…
ReviewText:
I got this product towards the end of last year and loved it! But after owning this, I know now that I prefer for there to be a scent in my lip products, even if it’s not intentional or strong. It’s not a big deal though, and I still liked it because of the color and moisture it gave! 
I hadn’t touched it for a while with the seasons changing, and decided to get it out the other day. It smelled so bad. Like moldy clothes that have been sitting for months.
Important note: the expiration date on these says 12 months, and it hasn’t been 12 months since I got it. I can’t ever remember having to throw out makeup because it went bad. I should have tried just cleaning the exterior applicator and the cap, but I was so repulsed and concerned I just had to throw it away. I think that there are a lot of similar/better options than this that will not go bad and smell great.

계절이 바뀌면서 한동안 손을 대지 않다가, 요전에 꺼내보기로 했어요. 냄새가 너무 심했어요. 몇 달 동안 방치된 곰팡이 핀 옷처럼.
중요 참고 사항: 이 제품의 만료 날짜는 12개월로 되어 있으며, 구입한 지 12개월이 지나지 않았습니다. 화장품이 상해서 버려야 했던 기억이 없습니다. 겉 어플리케이터와 캡만 청소해 볼까 했는데, 너무 역겹고 불안해서 그냥 버렸습니다. 나는 이것보다 상하지 않고 냄새가 좋은 유사하거나 더 나은 옵션이 많이 있다고 생각합니다.

Author: tomattom
Title: Most disappointing purchase
ReviewText:
In my 30 something years, I never knew it is even possible for me to have breakouts on my lips. There has never been a single product that would irritate my lips in any possible way, yet this product successfully managed to do this. 

Such a disappointment, I wanted to like it and I actually ended up liking the colour and how it felt on my lips. But aside from causing breakouts on my lips, the smell is horrible. It’s so chemical/ burnt plastic like. Taste is equally unpleasant.
ReviewText_ko:
30대 동안 입술에 트러블이 생길 수 있다는 사실조차 전혀 몰랐습니다. 어떤 방식으로든 내 입술을 자극하는 단일 제품이 없었는데 이 제품은 성공적으로 이를 해결했습니다. 

너무 실망스러워서 맘에 드나 싶었는데 실제로 발색도, 입술에 닿는 느낌도 마음에 들었습니다. 하지만 입술에 트러블이 생기는 것 외에도 냄새가 끔찍합니다. 너무 화학적이거나 탄 플라스틱과 같습니다. 맛도 마찬가지로 불쾌합니다.

Author: LivKoven
Title: Lives Up To The Hype
ReviewText: The hype is real! I had been waiting for Rhode to come to Sephora Canada for what felt like forever so that I could get my hands on the coveted Peptide Lip Tints and it did not disappoint. The formula is cushiony and feels nourishing without being slick nor oily and it isn't sticky at all. The tint is actually better than I expected; I would compare the amount of colour to that of a lip gloss but it has the added skincare benefits. PB&J reads as a warm berry brown, just as described and it was exactly what I expected it to look like from the pictures. I know there had previously been an issue with the formula being grainy (before launching at Sephora) but it seems that has been corrected!
ReviewText_ko: 과대광고는 진짜입니다! 나는 로드가 세포라 캐나다에 와서 탐나는 펩타이드 립 틴트를 손에 넣을 수 있도록 영원처럼 느껴지는 것을 기다리고 있었는데 실망하지 않았습니다. 끈적임이나 끈적임 없이 쿠션감 있고 영양감이 넘치는 제형입니다. 실제로 틴트가 생각했던 것보다 더 좋습니다. 나는 색상의 양을 립글로스와 비교하고 싶지만 스킨 케어 이점이 추가되었습니다. PB&J는 설명대로 따뜻한 베리 브라운으로 읽혀지며 사진에서 기대했던 바로 그 모습입니다. 이전에 (Sephora에서 출시하기 전) 공식이 거칠어지는 문제가 있었다는 것을 알고 있지만 수정된 것 같습니다!

I will say, the color didn't show up much but I am okay with that. Whenever my lips feel dry, sometimes I like to put a lot of gloss on and if it's got too much tint, that's not a great look. Author: permegan
ReviewText: I already owned ribbon from Rhode directly, I bought in January before they reformulated, and so far no quality issues for me and it’s getting low. So I bought another ribbon but I also wanted to try this berry color for fall. The richer shade is gorgeous, though I do have to be more precise with the application, due to the punchy color, compared to ribbon which is quite sheer on me. Raspberry jelly faded to a lighter, more pinkish tone on my lips in a couple hours, but the balmy feel itself didn’t disappear completely. It really felt like my lips just drank in all the hydration, and they felt soft all day. At the time I was not eating anything, but drinking water through a straw. Bear in mind I am not a person who expects lip balm to last all day, why would you, when the application is so fun?! But these have impressed me. I can’t wait to try salty tan and jelly bean.

Author: DarkSkinBeyonce
Title: SHES NOT ALL THAT 🙂‍↕️
ReviewText:
I wanted to give this product some time before reviewing, and honestly, I think it’s a bit overhyped. I picked up the shades Raspberry Jelly and Espresso. The pigments are nice—rich and somewhat buildable—but the applicator really misses the mark. It’s small, stiff, and just doesn’t work well, especially if you have fuller lips. Compared to applicators from brands like Summer Fridays, Fenty, or even ELF, this one feels cheap and awkward.
Another drawback is the wear time. I find myself needing to reapply more often than expected. For around $30 for such a tiny tube, I thought it would be more in line with the size of Summer Fridays or even ELF’s dupe—but it’s much smaller.
Overall, it’s not terrible, but for me, the poor applicator and lack of longevity make it not worth the price.
ReviewText_ko:
이 제품은 리뷰하기 전에 시간을 좀 갖고 싶었는데, 솔직히 좀 과대평가된 제품인 것 같아요. 저는 라즈베리 젤리와 에스프레소 색상을 골랐습니다. 안료는 풍부하고 어느 정도 형성 가능하지만 어플리케이터는 실제로 표시를 놓칩니다. 작고 뻣뻣하며 잘 작동하지 않습니다. 특히 입술이 더 도톰한 경우에는 더욱 그렇습니다. Summer Fridays, Fenty, 심지어 ELF와 같은 브랜드의 어플리케이터와 비교하면 이 제품은 저렴하고 어색한 느낌이 듭니다.
또 다른 단점은 착용 시간입니다. 예상보다 더 자주 다시 신청해야 하는 상황이 발생했습니다. 이렇게 작은 튜브에 약 30달러면 Summer Fridays나 심지어 ELF의 dupe 크기와 더 비슷할 것이라고 생각했지만 훨씬 작습니다.
전반적으로 나쁘지는 않지만, 나에게는 어플리케이터가 좋지 않고 지속력이 부족하여 가격 대비 가치가 없습니다.

Author: itsfi
Title: Strikes the right balance for color and shine
ReviewText:
TL;DR: These hydrating lip tints strike the right balance for color (sheer but buildable) & shine - glassy & glossy without looking heavy, goopy or overly lacquered.

WHAT I LIKE:
* Glides on smoothly, easily - directly from the tube or with fingers
* Buildable tint - has a hint of sheer color but is buildable
* Feels comfortable on lips even when I've layered on 3 coats (for the lighter shades)
* Glassy, glossy finish - more than a soft sheen but not overly shiny - it doesn't give a lacquered, vinyl effect (it doesn't claim to)
* Good wear time even with sipping gently on liquids & light and careful snacking throughout the day - I can get 3, sometimes 4 hours, which is pretty good for a balm
* Contains peptides, which can promote cell turnover, reduce signs of aging around the lips, stimulate collagen production which can plump up lips

AREA(S) FOR IMPROVEMENT:
* Would love to see the color range expand. The formula lends nicely to deeper shades in that it makes vibrant, bold shades easily wearable with its initial sheer tint & buildability (especially for those of us who might be more timid when it comes to a bolder lip color)
* Design of the cap makes it challenging, if not impossible, to stand it upright without propping it against something. Not a dealbreaker.

FYI:
* Tint fades first, then the shine but the hydration from the lip treatment remains
* Color of the packaging meant to reflect the shade the particular tint can get to - I can build up to the color with about 2-3 coats - 3 for the lightest shades as my lips naturally have more pigment to them. Color on lips will have a less opacity just given the nature of it being a balm.
* The tints are typically unscented except for those that are / were part of a limited edition release
* Fits easily into the pocket of jeans, pants, dress, skirt, or purse
* Makes a great gift or stocking stuffer

BUY, BUY, BUY or BYE-BYE?:
* The formulation, level of shine & buildable color work for me. BUY
ReviewText_ko:
요약: 이 수분 공급 립 틴트는 색상(투명하지만 지속력 있음)과 윤기의 적절한 균형을 유지합니다. 무겁거나 끈적거리거나 지나치게 래커가 묻어나지 않으면서 유리 같고 광택이 있습니다.

내가 좋아하는 것:
* 튜브에서 직접 또는 손가락으로 부드럽고 쉽게 미끄러지듯 움직입니다.
* 빌더블 틴트 - 투명한 색상의 힌트가 있지만 빌더블 가능
* 3회 덧발라도 입술이 편안해요. (밝은 색상의 경우)
* 유리알같은 윤기있는 마감 - 부드러운 광택보다는 과하지 않은 광택 - 래커칠한 비닐효과를 주지 않음(그렇다고 주장하지 않음)
* 하루 종일 가볍게 액체를 마시고 가볍게 간식을 먹더라도 좋은 착용 시간 - 3, 때로는 4 시간이 걸릴 수 있는데, 이는 밤용으로 꽤 좋습니다.
* 세포 턴오버를 촉진하고 입술 주변의 노화 징후를 감소시키며 콜라겐 생성을 촉진하여 입술을 통통하게 만드는 펩타이드 함유

개선 분야:
* 색상 범위가 확장되기를 바랍니다. 이 포뮬러는 처음의 투명한 틴트와 지속력으로 생동감 있고 대담한 색상을 쉽게 착용할 수 있다는 점에서 더 깊은 색상에 잘 어울립니다. (특히 더 대담한 립 컬러에 대해 더 소심한 사람들에게)
* 캡 디자인은 불가능하지는 않지만 무언가에 기대지 않고 똑바로 세우는 것이 어렵습니다. 거래 중단자가 아닙니다.

참고:
* 틴트가 먼저 사라지고 윤기가 나지만 립 트리트먼트의 수분감은 그대로 남아있습니다
* 포장의 색상은 특정 틴트가 얻을 수 있는 색상을 반영하기 위한 것입니다. 약 2~3회 코팅하여 색상을 만들 수 있습니다. 가장 밝은 색상은 3회입니다. 내 입술은 자연적으로 더 많은 색소를 가지고 있기 때문입니다. 입술의 색상은 밤의 특성상 불투명도가 덜합니다.
* 틴트는 한정판 출시의 일부였던 틴트를 제외하고 일반적으로 무향입니다.
* 청바지, 바지, 드레스, 스커트 또는 지갑 주머니에 쉽게 맞습니다.
* Makes a great gift or stocking stuffer

구매, 구매, 구매 또는 작별?:
* 포뮬러, 광택 수준 및 빌드 가능한 색상이 저에게 효과적입니다. 구매
text_for_model: TL;DR: These hydrating lip tints strike the right balance for color (sheer but buildable) & shine - glassy & glossy without looking heavy, goopy or overly lacquered. WHAT I LIKE: * Glides on smoothly, easily - directly from the tube or with fingers * Buildable tint - has a hint of sheer color but is buildable * Feels comfortable on lips even when I've layered on 3 coats (for the lighter shades) * Glassy, glossy finish - more than a soft sheen but not overly shiny - it doesn't give a lacquered, vinyl effect (it doesn't claim to) * Good wear time even with sipping gently on liquids & light and careful snacking throughout the day - I can get 3, sometimes 4 hours, which is pretty good for a balm * Contains peptides, which can promote cell turnover, reduce signs of aging around the lips, stimulate collagen production which can plump up lips AREA(S) FOR IMPROVEMENT: * Would love to see the color range expand. The formula lends nicely to deeper shades in that it makes vibrant, bold shades easily wearable with its initial sheer tint & buildability (especially for those of us who might be more timid when it comes to a bolder lip color) * Design of the cap makes it challenging, if not impossible, to stand it upright without propping it against something. Not a dealbreaker. FYI: * Tint fades first, then the shine but the hydration from the lip treatment remains * Color of the packaging meant to reflect the shade the particular tint can get to - I can build up to the color with about 2-3 coats - 3 for the lightest shades as my lips naturally have more pigment to them. Color on lips will have a less opacity just given the nature of it being a balm. * The tints are typically unscented except for those that are / were part of a limited edition release * Fits easily into the pocket of jeans, pants, dress, skirt, or purse * Makes a great gift or stocking stuffer BUY, BUY, BUY or BYE-BYE?: * The formulation, level of shine & buildable color work for me. BUY

Author: hiptotheship
ReviewText: Gritty can mean it’s expired. Lip balm also becomes gritty from a process called "fat blooming" or crystallization, where fats with different melting points in natural butters, like cocoa butter or shea butter, melt and re-solidify at different rates due to temperature fluctuations. This slow cooling creates larger, grainy crystals within the balm, making it feel sandy. You can fix it by gently melting the balm and cooling it quickly, or by storing it at consistent room temperature.
ReviewText_ko: Gritty는 만료되었음을 의미할 수 있습니다. 또한 립밤은 코코아 버터나 시어 버터와 같은 천연 버터에서 녹는점이 서로 다른 지방이 온도 변동으로 인해 서로 다른 속도로 녹고 다시 응고되는 "지방 개화" 또는 결정화라는 과정으로 인해 거칠어집니다. 천천히 냉각되면서 밤 내에 더 크고 거친 결정이 생성되어 모래 같은 느낌을 줍니다. 밤을 살짝 녹였다가 빠르게 식혀주거나, 일정한 실온에 보관하면 고칠 수 있습니다.
text_for_model: Gritty can mean it’s expired. Lip balm also becomes gritty from a process called "fat blooming" or crystallization, where fats with different melting points in natural butters, like cocoa butter or shea butter, melt and re-solidify at different rates due to temperature fluctuations. This slow cooling creates larger, grainy crystals within the balm, making it feel sandy. You can fix it by gently melting the balm and cooling it quickly, or by storing it at consistent room temperature.

Title: My Holy Grail Lip Tints
ReviewText: I’ve been using the Rhode lip tints for almost a year now, and they are hands-down my absolute favorite lip tints! On top of that, they’re incredibly hydrating and feel more like a nourishing balm than a typical tint, so my lips never feel dry. Painfully grainy, and the formula separates so it looks patchy on your lips and feels gross. I have every color and each one has the same problem. 

Rhode is also a terrible brand with nonexistent customer service. Bringing a problem to them will be swiftly ignored.
ReviewText_ko:
고통스러울 만큼 거칠고 포뮬러가 분리되어 입술에 바르면 뭉툭해 보이고 지저분해 보입니다. 나는 모든 색상을 가지고 있으며 각 색상에는 동일한 문제가 있습니다. 

Rhode는 또한 존재하지 않는 고객 서비스를 제공하는 끔찍한 브랜드입니다. 그들에게 문제를 가져오는 것은 신속히 무시될 것입니다.

Author: sonora1122
Title: Sephora Sucks -Their Credit Card Discount's a Scam
ReviewText: Sephora is awful and their claim to get 25% off your first purchase after being approved for their credit card is a scam. They take weeks to approve you if at all and then they start the 30 days that you have to use the coupon without telling whether you are approved. In my case they started that 30 days to get the discount on the first purchase more than 10 days before I received the card and knew that I was approved. But I didn't know the date until much later, so I thought I had 30 days to make my first purchase and they really only gave me 20. Then when I complained about not having gotten the discount, they did nothing. They have horrible customer service and every time I called with a question about if I was approved for the card or when I would get the card, I was given a different (and usually incorrect answer). I had the same experience calling about the details of getting the 25% off. When I called them, I was told it would just show up on my credit card statement (and the purchase invoice would not show it). Well of course that was wrong as well and after waiting weeks for the first credit card statement, the discount was not there. By then it was almost too late to return any items and of course the customer service when I complained bout all of this was terrible. Sephora does not care about its customers at all. Their store credit card is a scam. I have a credit score of 850 and should have just been approved in the store. Instead, it took over three 3 weeks for me to be approved and of course during that three weeks they could not give me any information about if and when I would know and actually receive the card. I am cancelling my store credit card and going to buy all these products at other retailers in the future because of my terrible experience. I hate Sephora now and can’t believe how much they screw over their customers

Author: honeyi
ReviewText:
I’ve been using The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Serum for a few months now, and it’s become a regular part of my skincare routine. I have combination skin with some oiliness in the T-zone and occasional breakouts. This serum really helps in keeping excess oil under control and visibly reduces the appearance of pores.

What I really like is that it’s lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave any sticky residue. It layers well under moisturizer and makeup, which is a big plus. After consistent use, I’ve noticed my skin looks more even-toned and feels smoother.

One thing to note is that it can cause some initial purging or slight irritation, especially if you’re new to actives or have sensitive skin. I recommend starting with a patch test and using it every other day at first.

Overall, this is a great affordable option if you’re looking to add niacinamide into your skincare routine. Just be patient and consistent with it!

저는 몇 달 동안 The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Serum을 사용해왔고 이것이 제 스킨케어 루틴의 정기적인 부분이 되었습니다. 저는 T존에 약간의 유분이 있고 가끔 트러블이 발생하는 복합성 피부입니다. 이 세럼은 과잉 유분을 조절하는 데 도움이 되며 모공의 모양을 눈에 띄게 줄여줍니다.

무엇보다 가볍고 흡수가 빠르고 끈적임이 남지 않는다는 점이 정말 마음에 듭니다. 보습제와 메이크업 아래에 잘 겹쳐서 큰 장점입니다. 꾸준히 사용한 후에는 피부톤이 더욱 균일해지고 매끄러워지는 것을 느꼈습니다.

Author: hthoman
Title: Triggered an allergic reaction
ReviewText: Vitamin C is usually a little harsh on my super sensitive skin, so I’ve been looking for alternatives and had high hopes for this serum after having used The Ordinary’s hyaluronic acid serum for the past few years. Unfortunately, within a few short hours after first use of their niacinamide serum, my skin broke out in an allergic reaction, lots of small red bumps and tiny comedones all over my face, giving my skin the texture and appearance of a football. That coupled with overall redness, minor swelling, and a burning itchiness means it was definitely an allergic reaction to this formulation and not the purging that can be expected when introducing new active ingredients with my skincare routine. Bummed because I wanted to love this serum. Womp womp :/
ReviewText_ko: 비타민C는 보통 초민감성 피부에 좀 자극적이어서 대체제를 찾다가 지난 몇 년간 더 오디너리 히알루론산 세럼을 사용해오면서 이 세럼에 대한 기대가 컸습니다. 불행하게도, 나이아신아미드 세럼을 처음 사용한 지 몇 시간 만에 내 피부에 알레르기 반응이 나타났습니다. 작은 붉은 돌기와 작은 여드름이 얼굴 전체에 생겨 피부가 축구공 같은 질감과 모양을 갖게 되었습니다. 전체적인 발적, 경미한 붓기, 작열감과 함께 이는 확실히 이 제제에 대한 알레르기 반응이지 내 스킨케어 루틴에 새로운 활성 성분을 도입할 때 기대할 수 있는 퍼징이 아니라는 것을 의미합니다. 이 세럼을 좋아하고 싶어서 당황했어요. 웜 웜 :/

Author: ensemky
Title: Not for everyone
ReviewText:
Honestly I think this product varies for people with different skin textures and sensitivities. I have very sensitive skin and I noticed that my skin was really inflamed after using this product. My pores were enlarged (which is strange because it’s supposed to do the opposite of that). I noticed a lot of weird breakouts as well. I think I had a little allergic reaction to the product which wasn’t what I expected. 

However on the positive note, my mom loves this product and she says it did a lot for her skin and really helped her minimize her pores and the oiliness of her skin. 


I think you should definitely patch test this product. I don’t know if it’s the best for people with sensitive skin like me.
ReviewText_ko:
솔직히 이 제품은 피부 질감이나 민감도가 다른 사람마다 다를 수 있다고 생각합니다. 저는 매우 민감한 피부를 가지고 있는데, 이 제품을 사용한 후 피부에 정말 염증이 생겼다는 것을 느꼈습니다. 모공이 넓어졌습니다. (그 반대의 일을 해야 하기 때문에 이상합니다.) 이상한 현상도 많이 발견했습니다. 제가 기대했던 것과는 다르게 제품에 약간의 알레르기 반응이 있었던 것 같아요. 

하지만 긍정적인 점은 저희 엄마가 이 제품을 좋아하시고 피부에 많은 도움이 되었고 모공과 피부의 유분을 최소화하는 데 정말 도움이 되었다고 말씀하셨습니다. 


이 제품은 반드시 패치 테스트를 해봐야 할 것 같습니다. 저처럼 예민한 피부를 가진 분들에게는 좋을지 모르겠네요.
text_for_model: Honestly I think this product varies for people with different skin textures and sensitivities. I have very sensitive skin and I noticed that my skin was really inflamed after using this product. My pores were enlarged (which is strange because it’s supposed to do the opposite of that). I noticed a lot of weird breakouts as well. I think I had a little allergic reaction to the product which wasn’t what I expected. However on the positive note, my mom loves this product and she says it did a lot for her skin and really helped her minimize her pores and the oiliness of her skin. I think you should definitely patch test this product. I don’t know if it’s the best for people with sensitive skin like me.

Author: emwhydee
Title: I use this in combo with lactic acid
ReviewText: I know I have very sensitive skin, so I used this in combination with the Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% Exfoliating Serum, left it on for less than 10 minutes, then rinsed it off before putting on my usual face cream. Yes, it was itchy and stung, but I always expect acid serums to sting my skin. It wasn't unbearable, but I also knew I had to rinse it off to keep my face from reacting too badly. But after using it in the evening, I wake up the next morning with the most absolutely smooth skin. This includes the really rough, dry patches I had on my forehead and next to the corner of my mouth. Considering how expensive these kinds of products can be, I love that these are often less than $10, and have no extra scents or ingredients. Literally, just the pure, working products.

Author: Freyasm
Title: Disappointing Results Despite the Hype
ReviewText:
I had high hopes for The Ordinary Niacinamide after seeing so many rave reviews, but unfortunately, it didn’t live up to my expectations. While I appreciate the affordable price and simple ingredients, I didn’t notice any significant improvement in my skin after consistent use.

The serum has a somewhat sticky texture that didn’t absorb well into my skin, leaving a tacky feeling even after it dried. 

While I know this product works well for others, it just didn’t deliver the results I was hoping for. It may be better suited for certain skin types, but for me, it was underwhelming and not as effective as I expected.

많은 호평을 보고 The Ordinary Niacinamide에 대한 기대가 컸지만 안타깝게도 기대에 미치지 못했습니다. 저렴한 가격과 심플한 성분에 감사하지만 꾸준히 사용해도 피부가 크게 좋아지는 느낌은 없었습니다.

세럼은 다소 끈적한 질감이 있어서 피부에 흡수가 잘 안되고, 건조 후에도 끈적한 느낌이 남아요. 

이 제품이 다른 사람들에게는 효과가 있다는 것을 알고 있지만, 제가 기대했던 결과를 제공하지는 못했습니다. 특정 피부 타입에는 더 적합할 수도 있지만, 저에게는 기대했던 것만큼 실망스럽고 효과적이지 않았습니다.

Title: Must for oily skin
ReviewText: Offered by the ordinary Niacinamide is a versatile skincare ingredient that has become a staple in my routine. It effectively reduces redness and inflammation, improves skin texture, hydrates and strengthens the skin barrier, minimizes fine lines, and regulates oil production. Initially, I experienced some breakouts, but they subsided after a couple of weeks. Author: semosyrp
Title: Beware - Caused Major Skin Reaction
ReviewText: I wish I could give this product 0 stars.  I do not have particularly sensitive skin, and I have been using 5% niacinamide from another brand for about a year with no issues.  I decided to try this because of all of the great reviews, but I should have paid more attention to the over 700 1 star reviews warning people about the damage that this product can do.  After a week of using 2 drops of this product mixed with my usual moisturizer every other day, I developed the worst rash of my life all over my face and neck, and my face was red, raw, and swollen.  My allergist had to put me on a 14 day course of prednisone to resolve it.  After looking at pictures and reading the stories of the 1 star reviews, I realized that what happened to me has happened to many other people who have used this product.  Please be mindful of the fact that even if you patch test (which I did) it could be a few days before your skin reacts badly to this product as this is what happened to me and seems to be a trend in some of the other reviews that I read.  This is truly the worst experience that I have ever had with a skincare product.  Please beware.

Author: davaynacamalot
ReviewText: Incorporating Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% by The Ordinary into my skincare routine has been a game-changer. Over the past few weeks, I've observed a significant reduction in redness and blemishes, leading to a more even and clearer complexion. The serum's lightweight, non-sticky formula is easy to apply and absorbs quickly, making it ideal for layering with other skincare products. My combination skin benefits greatly from the zinc, which helps control excess oil without causing dryness or irritation. Although consistent use is necessary to achieve the best results, the product's effectiveness and affordability make it a valuable addition to my daily regimen. Overall, it provides a potent yet gentle solution for maintaining balanced and healthy-looking skin.

Title: Excellent for brightening
ReviewText: As a big fan of this brand and a frequent user of their products, I can confidently say this serum stands out. It effectively blocks melanin transport and includes 1% zinc to regulate oil and water balance, making it perfect for yellowish skin, oily skin, and red, acne-prone skin. The brightening and oil-control effects are visibly noticeable, and it also excels at repairing damaged keratin and whitening pores. I used to have a face full of acne marks, but my skin condition has improved significantly!

Author: ssaloni26
Title: wonderful
ReviewText:
I’ve been using the Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% serum for a few weeks, and it has become a game-changer for my skincare routine.

This serum is amazing for reducing blemishes and controlling oil. The niacinamide helps to even out my skin tone and minimize pores, while the zinc calms any redness and inflammation. My skin looks clearer and smoother since I started using it.
It has a lightweight, non-greasy texture that absorbs quickly into the skin. It doesn’t feel sticky or heavy, and it layers well under my moisturizer and sunscreen.
The 30 ml bottle is compact and comes with a dropper for easy application. The dropper makes it simple to control the amount of product I use, ensuring no waste.
The price is very reasonable for such an effective product. It offers high-quality results at an affordable cost, making it a great addition to any skincare routine.

이 세럼은 잡티를 줄이고 유분을 조절하는 데 탁월합니다. 나이아신아미드는 피부톤을 균일하게 하고 모공을 최소화하는 데 도움이 되며, 아연은 발적과 염증을 진정시킵니다. 사용하기 시작한 이후로 피부가 더 깨끗하고 매끄러워진 것 같아요.
가볍고 끈적이지 않는 질감으로 피부에 빠르게 흡수됩니다. 끈적이거나 무거운 느낌이 들지 않으며 모이스처라이저와 자외선 차단제 아래에 잘 겹쳐집니다.
30ml 용량으로 스포이드가 포함되어 있어 사용하기 편리합니다. 드로퍼를 사용하면 사용하는 제품의 양을 쉽게 조절할 수 있어 낭비가 발생하지 않습니다.

Author: Brunette43
Title: A staple from now on
ReviewText:
I’m 43, and I spent years doing little but wiping my face with a baby wipe at bedtime, and moisturizing maybe once a week.   

Fed up with how terrible my skin looked, in March I started using The Ordinary’s niacinamide in rotation with their mandelic acid + HA, washing at bedtime with their glycolic acid foaming cleanser, and using a Korean ceramide moisturizer nightly (Good Cera off Amazon), and Burt’s Bees calming moisturizer every morning. 

After one month of use I can hardly believe the difference in overall skin tone and texture. I won’t need to explain which is the Before and which is After in the two pics. They were taken at the same time of day in the same lighting conditions with the same phone, exactly 1 month and two days apart. A lot of the improvement is due to regular moisturizing, I know, but the niacinamide and mandelic acid absolutely evened out my skin tone enormously.
ReviewText_ko:
저는 43세이고 취침 시간에 아기용 물티슈로 얼굴을 닦고 일주일에 한 번 정도 보습을 하는 것 외에는 거의 아무것도 하지 않고 몇 년을 보냈습니다.   

내 피부가 얼마나 끔찍한지에 지쳐서 3월에 나는 만델산 + HA와 함께 The Ordinary의 나이아신아미드를 번갈아 사용하기 시작했고, 취침 시간에는 글리콜산 포밍 클렌저로 세안하고, 밤에는 한국 세라마이드 모이스처라이저(아마존에서 판매 중인 Good Cera), 그리고 매일 아침 Burt's Bees 진정 모이스처라이저를 사용하기 시작했습니다. 

한 달 사용 후 전체적인 피부 톤과 질감의 차이가 거의 믿기지 않습니다. 두 사진에서 어느 것이 이전이고 어느 것이 이후인지 설명할 필요는 없습니다. 정확히 1개월 2일 간격으로 같은 시간, 같은 조명 조건, 같은 전화기로 촬영되었습니다. 대부분의 개선은 정기적인 보습 덕분이라는 것을 알지만, 나이아신아미드와 만델산은 내 피부톤을 엄청나게 균일하게 만들어주었습니다.

Author: Nicrohr
Title: Amazinggg for Seb Derm on scalp!
ReviewText:
I read on reddit that folks were using this to treat seb derm on face and scalp - my face is clear but my scalp suffers. Using this once or twice a day with dropped to easily apply to my scalp and massage in - every time I use it I can see lasting improvement. I especially like to apply before bed and wake up to less irritated, less scaly, less itchy and scalp build up in these areas. Woohoo! Amazing. I alternate with salicylic acid (or sometimes layer them, not sure if that's recommended but didn't irritate me to do it at least).

My stubborn years of scalp SD is almost cleared completely in about ten days of use. For me this is like a miracle, and unexpected. I would not have thought to try niacinamide. I've been taking niacinamide oral dietary supplements for about 9 mos, that didn't really do anything, but this topical application sure did.
ReviewText_ko:
사람들이 얼굴과 두피의 피지를 치료하기 위해 이것을 사용하고 있다는 것을 Reddit에서 읽었습니다. 제 얼굴은 깨끗하지만 두피는 고통받고 있습니다. 하루에 한두 번씩 떨어뜨려 사용하면 두피에 쉽게 바르고 마사지할 수 있습니다. 사용할 때마다 지속적인 개선을 볼 수 있습니다. 나는 특히 잠자리에 들기 전에 바르고 일어나면 자극이 덜하고, 비듬이 덜하고, 가려움증이 덜하고, 이 부위에 두피가 쌓이는 것을 좋아합니다. 우후! 놀라운. 나는 살리실산을 번갈아 사용합니다(또는 때때로 겹쳐서 사용하는 것이 권장되는지 확실하지 않지만 적어도 그렇게 하는 데 짜증이 나지는 않았습니다).

나의 고집스러운 두피 SD는 열흘 정도 사용하면 거의 완전히 지워집니다. 나에게 이것은 기적과 같고 예상치 못한 일이다. 나는 나이아신아미드를 시도할 생각을 하지 않았을 것입니다. 저는 약 9개월 동안 나이아신아마이드 경구용 건강보조식품을 복용했는데 실제로는 아무런 효과가 없었지만 이 국소 적용은 확실히 효과가 있었습니다.

Author: juliaguulia17
Title: Life Changing & Affordable
ReviewText: This stuff really did change my life. I went from being someone who really struggled with my skin throughout my teens and most of my 20s to someone who often gets stopped and asked about my skincare routine now in my late 20s. I typically use a basic fragrant-free cleanser, followed by The Ordinary's Hydraulic acid, Niacinamide, and the rosehip oil (which is also the best-priced rosehip on the market by about half the price). A few times a week I will add a couple drops of the retinol in with the rosehip. Once a week I will use a face mask (sometimes I use the one by The Ordinary, or I will use clay-based one). I can get by with these products for about 6 months. some last longer even, and some I buy more frequently like the rosehip oil. I spend less than 100 dollars a year on my skincare routine and my skin has never been better. I will forever be an Ordinary gal.

Author: kjean93
Title: Be Cautious If You Have Product Sensitivities!
ReviewText:
I wanted to love this sooo badly. It’s worked amazing for others I’ve spoken to, but if you’re sensitive to a lot of things like I am then I don’t recommend unfortunately. 

I react to pretty much everything I put on my face. This caused extreme tightness, bad reddening and burning around the cheek areas and forehead, and made my skin very sensitive. On top of that, what I thought was skin purging turned out to be a skin reaction, with thousands of what looked like whiteheads but were very watery.

After looking into it, it seems like someone like myself can’t handle the high formula of 10%. If you’re like me and you want to try a product like this START SLOW! Look for a product with a much lower percentage and don’t jump straight into the deep end like I did haha.

I hope this helps other skin product allergic people!

나는 내 얼굴에 바르는 거의 모든 것에 반응합니다. 이로 인해 뺨 부위와 이마 주변에 극도의 당김, 심한 붉어짐 및 작열감이 발생하여 피부가 매우 민감해졌습니다. 게다가 피부 퍼징이라고 생각했던 것도 피부 반응으로 밝혀졌는데, 화이트헤드처럼 보였지만 수분이 많은 수천 개가 있었습니다.

Author: magicclaire
Title: Holy Grail
ReviewText: If I had to limit myself to one extra skincare step (other than cleanser and moisturizer) this would be it. I have KP and it totally cleared up the bumps/redness on my face and brightens my complexion. Makes my skin GLOW. I saw some reviews saying that it burns skin so if you experience any burning I would recommend starting every other day or twice a week because my skin now has absolutely no reaction to it even though it was a little tingly when I first started. Pairs great with the Ordinary’s hyaluronic acid, especially in the dry winter, if you have combination skin like me and want to fix any dry patches (I never experienced any extra dryness with this serum like I saw in the reviews, I just follow up with a light moisturizer and my skin still glows).
ReviewText_ko: 만약 제가 스킨케어 단계를 한 단계만 더 추가해야 한다면(클렌저와 모이스처라이저 제외) 이 단계일 것입니다. 나는 KP를 가지고 있는데 얼굴의 돌기와 붉은기를 완전히 없애고 안색을 밝게 해줍니다. 내 피부를 빛나게 만들어줍니다. 피부가 화상을 입었다는 리뷰를 봤습니다. 화상을 입었다면 이틀에 한 번 또는 일주일에 두 번 시작하는 것이 좋습니다. 처음 시작했을 때 약간 따끔거렸음에도 불구하고 이제는 피부가 전혀 반응하지 않기 때문입니다. 특히 건조한 겨울에 저처럼 복합성 피부를 갖고 있고 건조한 부위를 고치고 싶다면 Ordinary의 히알루론산과 잘 어울립니다. (리뷰에서 본 것처럼 이 세럼을 사용하면 추가 건조함을 경험한 적이 없으며 가벼운 모이스처라이저만 바르면 피부가 여전히 빛납니다.)

ReviewText: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sunscreen works great! It is 50 spf, is non-comedogenic, and water resistant. Lastly, the packaging is lightweight and easy to hold, distribute product, and securely close - the aesthetic, dusky gradient pink to cream is a nice added touch. I have purchased and used several other products from this brand and am happy to add this one to my collection - I plan to (re)purchase when this tube runs out.

Author: hjirenekim
Title: Absolute love
ReviewText:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this sunscreen. I’m a huge fan of Korean skincare, and this has quickly become my new favorite K-beauty sunscreen. It has SPF 50, which gives me great sun protection, but the texture is very light and comfortable on the skin. It absorbs quickly and doesn’t feel greasy, sticky, or heavy at all.

After applying it to my face, I can easily put makeup on top without any peeling or pilling, which is very important to me. My foundation goes on smoothly and looks natural throughout the day. Another big plus is that it doesn’t sting my eyes, even when I apply it around the eye area. I usually have sensitive eyes with sunscreens, so this is a huge advantage for me.

I also like that I can reapply it in the middle of the day without my skin feeling overloaded. Because the texture is so lightweight, my face still feels fresh and comfortable after multiple applications. It doesn’t clog my pores or make my skin feel suffocated.

Overall, this sunscreen is perfect for daily use. It works well under makeup, feels gentle on the skin, and provides strong sun protection without irritation. I would definitely recommend this to anyone who loves Korean skincare or is looking for a lightweight, non-irritating sunscreen for everyday wear. I will definitely repurchase this product.
ReviewText_ko:
[본 상품은 솔직한 리뷰의 대가로 제공되었습니다.] 이 자외선 차단제는 정말 마음에 듭니다. 저는 한국 스킨케어의 열렬한 팬이고, 이 제품은 제가 가장 좋아하는 K-뷰티 선크림이 되었습니다. SPF 50으로 자외선 차단 효과가 뛰어나지만 질감이 매우 가볍고 피부가 편안합니다. 흡수가 빠르고 끈적임이나 끈적임이나 무거운 느낌이 전혀 없습니다.

얼굴에 바르고 나면, 필링이나 필링 없이 쉽게 메이크업을 얹을 수 있다는 점이 저에게는 매우 중요합니다. 파운데이션이 매끄럽게 발리고 하루종일 자연스러워 보여요. 눈가에 발라도 눈이 따갑지 않다는 점도 큰 장점이에요. 저는 평소에 자외선 차단제를 사용하는 민감한 눈을 가지고 있기 때문에 이것이 제게는 큰 장점입니다.

피부에 부담감 없이 낮에도 덧발라줄 수 있다는 점도 마음에 듭니다. 질감이 너무 가벼워서 여러 번 바른 후에도 얼굴이 여전히 산뜻하고 편안한 느낌을 줍니다. 모공을 막거나 피부가 질식하는 느낌을 주지 않습니다.

전반적으로 이 자외선 차단제는 매일 사용하기에 적합합니다. 메이크업 아래에도 잘 작용하고, 피부에 부드러운 사용감을 주며, 자극 없이 강력한 자외선 차단 기능을 제공합니다. 한국식 스킨케어를 좋아하시는 분이나 가볍고 자극 없는 데일리 선크림을 찾으시는 분들께 꼭 추천드리고 싶습니다. 나는 확실히 이 제품을 재구매할 것이다.

Title: Good with US ingredients
ReviewText:

This sunscreen has USA ingredients which work alright. The texture is a little lighter than creamy which I enjoy. It spreads nicely, doesn’t leave a white cast and is good to wash off as well. Thank you for the complimentary product to try!

이 자외선 차단제는 효과가 좋은 미국 성분을 함유하고 있습니다. 질감은 제가 좋아하는 크림보다 약간 가볍습니다. 퍼짐도 좋고, 백탁도 안 남고, 씻어내기도 좋아요. 방수 기능이 없습니다. 내 눈 주위에는 괜찮습니다. 여기 약국에서 구입하는 브랜드보다 여전히 훨씬 낫습니다!
나는 이미 사용하고 있는 아이 크림과 같은 브랜드의 다른 품목을 재구매할 예정이지만 주로 아시아 버전의 선스크린을 사용합니다. 그들은 단지 더 좋습니다! BoJ는 거기에 강력한 팬층을 보유하고 있습니다. 
무료 제품을 사용해 주셔서 감사합니다!
text_for_model: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am going to preface by saying that this is not the Korean version of the sunscreen and has America approved ingredients, like any other sunscreen in USA. I am a fan of Asian sunscreen for their superior and innovative sunblocking ingredients with a great feel on the skin and I really prefer Asian and European sun care products when I have access to them. This sunscreen has USA ingredients which work alright. The texture is a little lighter than creamy which I enjoy. It spreads nicely, doesn’t leave a white cast and is good to wash off as well. It isn’t water resistant. This is fine around my eyes. It is still way better than the brands we get at drugstore here! I will repurchase other items from the brand like the eye cream, that I already use, but mostly the Asian version of the sunscreens. They just are better! BoJ has a strong fan base there. Thank you for the complimentary product to try!

Author: sngray11
Title: A lovely sunscreen for fair to light-medium skin
ReviewText: (I received this product in exchange for my honest review). I have sensitive combination skin and a medium olive complexion. While the texture of this sunscreen is lovely, I do wish that there was tint to it because the white color makes my face appear a lot more pale than it actually is. If you have a fair to light-medium skintone, this product would be perfect for you,  but if you have a medium or darker skin tone, I would steer clear of this product. The texture is light and lovely and it feels wonderful on my face. There is a faint sunscreen smell to this product, but it isn’t overwhelming and it dissipates quickly. It keeps my skin hydrated and comfortable throughout the day and I didn’t get burned spending the afternoon in the sun wearing this product. The packaging makes this sunscreen easy to use, it absorbs quickly and leaves a smooth, matte finish. While it is a lovely sunscreen, I do wish that they offered a tinted version for darker skin tones.

Title: Great Sunscreen, Bad smell
ReviewText: I think that this could be a great sunscreen option for a lot of people. It’s fairly lightweight for dry-normal (even combination) skin types, it doesn’t have a white cast, it’s decently priced, and it works really great underneath makeup. HOWEVER, this spf has a scent that I cannot stand. It’s not normal spf scent, it almost resembles the scent of human spit? Not only does it smell when you first apply it, but the smell unfortunately never goes away, I get whiffs of it hoursss after i’ve applied it and it’s too bothersome to me to continue using. So unfortunate because I like literally everything else about it, so if smells don’t bother you then you might really enjoy this spf.

Title: Dewy finish
ReviewText: I received my Day Dew Sunscreen from Beauty of Joseon as a free gift in exchange for my honest review. I'm a big fan of Korean sunscreen. I've purchased quite a few including the BoJ Relief Sun Aqua-fresh sunscreen, which is great for summer. This one is different because it has U.S.-approved filters, so I have to manage my expectations. The active ingredients in this one (avobenzone, homosalate, octisalate, and octocrylene) do irritate my sensitive skin a bit, so I can only use this on my hands and neck. This has a dewy finish as the name implies, so another reason I can't use this on my face as it is very oily as it is, but has a lovely finish on my hands. I also notice the smell is different. All of my authentic Korean sunscreens have a yogurt smell that I'm assuming is from the fermented rice that's in most of them. This smells more synthetic and no yogurt smell. I love that it's spf 50 and comes in a cute pinkish tube. I don't mind it can't use this on my face because I can use it on the back of my hands and they feel moisturized. Overall, very happy with this product.

Title: Great for dry skin!
ReviewText:

Day dew sunscreen:
-has typical sunscreen smell 
-a little thick in consistency compared to the OG sun relief
-great for dry skin and didn’t cause irritation
-didn’t cause any noticeable white cast on my skin
-layered well under makeup 

OG relief sun
-has no noticeable smell
-much lighter consistency that seems to absorb faster into the skin 
- doesn’t feel heavy on the skin
-hydrates well and lays well under makeup

I really enjoy the day dew sunscreen for winter but not sure I’d use it for the hot summer weather.

Title: Lightweight heaven sent sunscreen
ReviewText:

It absorbs quickly and leaves a soft, dewy finish that makes my skin look healthy rather than shiny.

The scent is very mild and clean—almost unnoticeable—which I really appreciate since it doesn’t linger or feel overwhelming. In terms of effectiveness, it provides great sun protection and layers well under makeup without pilling or causing irritation. My skin feels comfortable and hydrated throughout the day while wearing it.

Overall, this sunscreen feels gentle, elegant, and reliable. I genuinely like it and would definitely continue using it again as part of my daily routine

The same happens with the smell.  That being said, as a sunscreen this works and gives protection from the sun.

Author: Bronkany
Title: The holy grail chemical sunscreen
ReviewText:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First off, it's important to note that this is a chemical sunscreen. It blocks harmful UV rays through a different mechanism than mineral sunscreens, and feels different to apply than mineral alternatives.

Beauty of Joseon is one of the most comfortable sunscreens I've ever used. I keep a tube in my kid's stroller to slap on when the toddler demands a walk. I always know I'm covered when I apply it, and I never have any streaks or white cast after application. Yes, sunscreen application without a mirror - it does exist!!

It's so comfy to wear that I often fall asleep with it on post-walk.

It absorbs within minutes, making it easy to follow with makeup. I like wearing it alone so I can top off my coverage later in the day.

I'm obsessed. And in love. I keep trying to switch to mineral sunscreens, but every other product pales in comparison to this.
ReviewText_ko:
[본 제품은 솔직한 리뷰를 위해 제공받았습니다.] 우선, 주의할 점은 이 제품은 화학적 자외선 차단제라는 점입니다. 미네랄 자외선 차단제와는 다른 메커니즘을 통해 유해한 자외선을 차단하고, 미네랄 대체제와는 사용감도 다릅니다.

뷰티 오브 조선은 제가 사용해 본 자외선 차단제 중 가장 편안한 제품 중 하나입니다. 나는 아이가 산책을 요구할 때 때리기 위해 아이의 유모차에 튜브를 보관합니다. 나는 그것을 적용할 때 항상 커버된다는 것을 알고 있으며 적용 후 줄무늬나 백탁이 전혀 없습니다. 네, 거울이 없는 자외선 차단제 - 존재해요!!

착용 후 너무 편안해서 산책 후 잠이 드는 경우가 많습니다.

몇 분 안에 흡수되어 메이크업을 따라하기 쉽습니다. 나는 단독으로 착용하는 것을 좋아하므로 나중에 커버력을 높일 수 있습니다.

나는 집착하고 있습니다. 그리고 사랑에 빠졌습니다. 나는 계속 미네랄 자외선 차단제로 바꾸려고 노력하지만 다른 모든 제품은 이것에 비하면 아무것도 아닙니다.

Title: Light and no white residues
ReviewText:

It leaves a beautiful glow on the skin. There are some active ingredients I don't entirely like, but they haven't caused any irritation either.
So, in terms of ingredients, I prefer the one from the same brand that contains probiotics.

Author: jackypalumbo
Title: I Cannot Recommend This Product Enough!!!
ReviewText: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I can not even begin to describe how excited I was when I was chosen to review this product! Let’s start with the brand and why I think you should try out Beauty of Joseon. For starters, this brand focusing on creating skincare and beauty products that are gentle on the skin, enriching, and most importantly, effective. The cruelty free brand develops all of their products without animal testing which is always important to me. The products they sell are all inspired by traditional Hanbang- the Korean medicine based on natural ingredients with therapeutic benefits. If that isn’t enough to convince you that this brand is seriously amazing- let’s take a look at their individual products. The Day Dew Sunscreen I have recently been using is unreal! To begin, the packaging arrived with measures in place to ensure proper sanitation, which is always important to me when it comes to skin care. The box had a tape securement and a tinfoil cover on the tip of the bottle itself. Next, the 50mL bottle is the perfect size to bring with you anywhere, it fits in any bag and comes with me wherever I leave the house so I can reapply on the go. The sunscreen itself has a light scent that is quite refreshing, not overbearing at all like other sunscreens I have tried. Additionally, the sunscreen leaves absolutely zero white cast, so it works perfectly in my day to day life, whether I’m wearing makeup or not. When using this product, I feel clean and not like I am being weighed down by an oily face. It is SPF 50 which is wonderful for preventing any sun damage or future wrinkles. The ingredients are clean and clearly stated on the box and bottle. All in all, I cannot recommend this product enough. The brand and the product speak for themselves- it is the best of the best! Thank you Beauty of Joseon!

Author: Angelfroggy
Title: A new holy grail sunscreen for a radiant glow
ReviewText: The Day Dew provides a beautiful, dewy finish, making the skin look fresh and radiant without any greasiness. It absorbs quickly and leaves no white cast on the skin. It also contains skincare ingredients like hyaluronic acid for hydration and niacinamide to calm and brighten the skin. It works perfectly as a makeup primer, creating a smooth, glowy base that prevents foundation from pilling. The formula is fragrance-free and gentle, making it a good choice for sensitive skin."

Author: MsReporter
Title: An interesting take on the US sunscreen
ReviewText:
Don't let the 4-star rating intimidate you. Here is my honest take about this product:
- The texture is milky, blends in seamlessly and most importantly, does NOT leave a white cast. Huge W. Thus, if you like milky sunscreen, this is for you.
- However, one thing I don't like about this product which also explains the lack of one star is that this product used the outdated filters from the FDA, so when you apply the sunscreen, there will be this funky smell from the filters used, although they do fade away quickly compared to mainstream US sunscreens.

Conclusion:
Would I say that this is BoJ's best take on American sunscreen? Yes.
Would I say that this is comparable to Relief Sun and Aqua Fresh aka the originals? lol no
But yeah, it is indeed a decent sunscreen and performs better than your average sunscreen, even under FDA's silly restrictions. It is worth a try - but would I repurchase it? Meh.

별 4개 등급이 당신을 위협하도록 두지 마십시오. 이 제품에 대한 저의 솔직한 의견은 다음과 같습니다.
- 질감이 우윳빛이고, 매끄럽게 혼합되며, 가장 중요한 점은 흰색 캐스트가 남지 않는다는 것입니다. 거대한 W. 따라서 우유빛 자외선 차단제를 좋아한다면 이것은 당신을 위한 것입니다.
- 하지만 별 하나가 부족한 이 제품에 대해 제가 마음에 들지 않는 한 가지는 이 제품이 FDA의 오래된 필터를 사용했기 때문에 자외선 차단제를 바르면 사용된 필터에서 이상한 냄새가 날 것입니다. 하지만 주류 미국 자외선 차단제에 비해 빨리 사라집니다.

이것이 원작인 릴리프썬이나 아쿠아프레시와 비슷하다고 할까요? ㅋㅋㅋ 아니

Author: elaxx
Title: Glowy Sunscreen
ReviewText:
I’ve been using the Beauty of Joseon Day Dew Sunscreen and honestly, it feels more like a lightweight moisturizer than sunscreen. It sinks in super quickly, leaves my skin with the prettiest natural glow, and there’s zero white cast. It layers perfectly under makeup — no pilling, no greasiness — and actually makes my foundation sit better.

What I love most is that it feels hydrating throughout the day. My skin leans dry, and this makes it look plump and fresh instead of tight or chalky like a lot of sunscreens do. Plus, since it’s fragrance-free, it hasn’t irritated my skin at all.

This is hands down one of the best sunscreens I’ve tried — it protects, hydrates, and gives me that “glass skin” finish without even trying. Definitely a new staple in my routine.

Author: baroquejaneite
Title: Not the same as Relief Sun Rice + Probiotic SPF 50
ReviewText: I was a huge fan of the Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun Rice + Probiotic SPF 50 sunscreen. Unfortunately, due to the FDA's glacial processes for approval of sunscreens, the sale of that original formula was discontinued in the USA in January 2025 and BoJ came up with a "US only" formula that adheres to the older US approved UV filters. You can no longer purchase the original formula (at least from the official site) which has more up to date and more effective sun protection (including UVA rays) along with a much lighter, comfortable formula. It's a real shame that we don't have access to these more advanced sunscreens in the US. This Day Dew Sunscreen is still nice, although it has that distinct "sunscreen" smell that conventional sunscreens have and also has that mineral-oil quality I dislike about them. It's still better than most though and I would use it on my body: for daily facial sunscreen though I'm afraid the US is still in the dark ages.

This Day Dew Sunscreen은 기존의 자외선 차단제에서 나는 독특한 "자외선 차단제" 냄새와 제가 싫어하는 미네랄 오일 품질을 가지고 있기는 하지만 여전히 좋습니다. 그래도 대부분의 것보다 훨씬 낫고 몸에 바르고 싶습니다. 매일 얼굴에 바르는 자외선 차단제지만 미국은 아직 암흑기입니다.

Author: Winthrop44
Title: A must try
ReviewText: I have rosacea and ridiculously sensitive skin with a long list of rosacea triggers. I was shocked to find my skin loves this sunscreen more than any other I’ve ever tried, mineral or chemical. Yes, I would prefer the newer SPF filters used in Europe and South Korea, but with very rare exception those sunscreens include high levels of propanediol, alcohol, and other ingredients my skin doesn’t tolerate. This new BOJ sunscreen dries down to a dewy but not greasy finish and works beautifully under makeup. I absolutely love it and hope it’s a big success for BOJ. The price is also quite reasonable. Highly recommend giving it a try.

Author: SkintherapistZi
Title: Worth Every Bit of the Hype
ReviewText:
First, let me start by saying this is absolutely worth the hype. I’m a lip girl through and through — I love a great lip balm, gloss, anything — and this one delivers.

It makes my lips feel lush, luscious, and deeply hydrated. The texture is smooth, cushiony, and comfortable without feeling sticky. It gives the perfect glossy, healthy shine while actually moisturizing at the same time.

What really impressed me is that the hydration lasts. My lips still feel soft even after the shine fades a bit, which tells me it’s actually nourishing and not just sitting on top of the lips. The gloss factor is beautiful — juicy but not over-the-top — and it wears comfortably for hours.

10/10 — this is a must-buy. I literally just ordered the new shade that dropped and can’t wait to review that one too.

If you’re on the fence about purchasing, go ahead and jump over it and grab one. You will not be disappointed.

Author: sydhan
ReviewText:
This is the "grown-up" sparkle you’ve been looking for. Unlike the milky Sakura, Chateau Rose is a sophisticated, dusty vintage rose infused with ultra-fine, non-gritty gold shimmer.
• The Look: A luminous, multidimensional glow that suits all skin tones.
• The Scent: A refreshing Lemon Meringue tartness.
• The Feel: Cooling metal applicator with a plush, non-sticky water-balm texture.
Perfect if you want hydration with a hint of festive "glam."
ReviewText_ko:
이것이 당신이 찾던 "어른스러운" 반짝임입니다. 밀키한 사쿠라와 달리 샤토 로즈는 매우 미세하고 모래가 없는 골드 쉬머가 주입된 세련되고 더스티한 빈티지 로즈입니다.
• 더 룩: 모든 피부 톤에 어울리는 빛나는 다차원 광채.
• 향: 상큼한 레몬 머랭의 신맛.
• 느낌: 푹신하고 끈적이지 않는 워터밤 질감의 냉각 금속 어플리케이터입니다.
축제 분위기의 "글램"을 가미한 수분 공급을 원할 경우 적합합니다.

Author: Tiffpodzy
Title: The only lippie in my rotation
ReviewText:
Sakura Shaved Ice is the prettiest milky pink I’ve ever put on my lips. It gives that soft, blurred, your lips but better glow and pairs with everything. And the vanilla latte scent? Warm, cozy, addictive. I want to reapply just for the experience.

The exfoliating + softening peptide formula keeps my lips baby smooth — no flakes, no dryness, just plush hydration and shine. It’s nourishing but still gives that juicy finish I love.

Officially the only lippie in my rotation. Nothing else compares.
ReviewText_ko:
사쿠라 빙수는 제가 지금까지 입술에 발랐던 밀키 핑크색 중 가장 예쁜 것 같아요. 부드럽고 흐릿한 입술을 선사하지만 더 나은 빛을 발하고 모든 것과 짝을 이룹니다. 그리고 바닐라라떼 향? 따뜻하고 아늑하며 중독성이 있습니다. 경험을 위해 다시 신청하고 싶습니다.

각질 제거 + 연화 펩타이드 포뮬러가 입술을 매끄럽게 유지해줍니다. 각질이 생기거나 건조함도 없이 촉촉하고 윤기 있게 가꿔줍니다. 영양이 풍부하지만 여전히 내가 좋아하는 육즙이 가득한 마무리를 제공합니다.

공식적으로 내 로테이션에서 유일한 lippie입니다. 다른 어떤 것도 비교할 수 없습니다.

Author: Tiffpodzy
Title: Perfection in a tube!
ReviewText:
I don’t say this lightly but EADEM Le Chouchou in Château Rose is perfection in a tube. The soft shimmer is elevated, not glittery, it gives that juicy, lit-from-within glow that makes your lips look expensive. And the lemon meringue scent? Dreamy, fresh, subtly sweet… I’m obsessed.

The formula is where it really wins though. It gently exfoliates while softening with peptides, so my lips stay smooth all day without that heavy, sticky feeling. It’s glossy, cushiony, and healing at the same time. Absolute heaven. I genuinely don’t reach for anything else anymore.
ReviewText_ko:
가볍게 말하지는 않지만 샤토 로즈의 EADEM Le Chouchou는 튜브에 담아도 완벽합니다. 글리터가 아닌 부드러운 쉬머가 입술을 고급스럽게 보이게 하는 촉촉하고 내부에서 빛나는 광채를 선사합니다. 그리고 레몬 머랭 향? 몽환적이고, 상큼하고, 은은하게 달콤하고... 푹 빠졌어요.

공식은 실제로 승리하는 곳입니다. 펩타이드 함유로 부드럽게 각질을 제거해주며, 끈적임 없이 하루종일 보송보송한 입술을 유지해줍니다. 윤기와 쿠션감, 힐링을 동시에 선사합니다. 절대 천국. 나는 정말로 더 이상 다른 어떤 것도 추구하지 않습니다.

The formula is where it really wins though. It gently exfoliates while softening with peptides, so my lips stay smooth all day without that heavy, sticky feeling.
