Author: Tygerlillian
Title: Finally kissable after 30 years!
ReviewText:
Having dry, flaky lips for most of my adult life (I'm 51), I've tried many balms and treatments and was resting with Ilia and Laneige for exfoliating treatment, and Olehenricksen for hydration. Enter Le Chouchou – this product is truly superior in its exfoliating action and lasts longer than any other for hydration and protection. After the very first application I immediately felt a difference and saw my dry skin sloughing off in the most gentle way. Absolutely no irritation and the formula feels rich and comfortable and melts right into my lips. They're truly soft and kissable now after only two days of use and will continue to improve with regular wear (pic 1 without product but after two days treatment, pic 2 with medium application to show color).

Boba Bounce has the scent of dark Bing cherries with a subtly dark fruity nuance, relatively flavorless. I have darkish SE Asian lips with a naturally darker toned outline and I can wear this color as sheer or as heavy as I need for a naturally enhanced look to high color payoff. The color is about equivalent to Olehenriksen's Cocoa Crème.

Author: meeggymoo
Title: HOLY GRAIL!!!
ReviewText: I genuinely think anyone leaving less than a 5-star review may not fully understand how this product is meant to be used. This is a treatment; it’s designed to heal your lips, not act as a regular, constantly reapplied lip balm. You only need to use it a few times a day at most. I typically apply it in the morning and mid-day, and sometimes at night if my lips are especially dry (like in the winter). I reach for it when my lips are close to peeling or feel super dehydrated. This is not something you should be reapplying every hour. Your lips may start peeling; that’s because it exfoliates. It’s doing its job. You use it when you’re dry, let it work, and that’s it. One application literally heals my husband’s lips (and mine). In between treatments, you’ll want a traditional moisturizing balm to keep your lips comfortable and hydrated. This is where other brands come in. Jack Black (their SPF balm), Cocokind, and Summer Fridays are great for maintaining moisture throughout the day. They won’t heal your lips the way EADEM does, but they’re perfect between treatments. Ole Henriksen is another option that both heals and can be reapplied more frequently, but for me it feels more like a lip gloss; a bit stickier. I don’t usually reach for it on no-makeup days, but I always use it when I’m wearing makeup. For me, EADEM is truly superior. Ole Henriksen is my second favorite, and I love Cocokind and Jack Black for in-between hydration.
ReviewText_ko: 별 5개 미만의 리뷰를 남기는 사람은 이 제품이 어떻게 사용되어야 하는지 완전히 이해하지 못할 수도 있다고 진심으로 생각합니다. 이것은 치료법입니다. 이 제품은 정기적으로 계속 바르는 립밤이 아닌 입술을 치유하도록 설계되었습니다. 하루에 최대 몇 번만 사용하면 됩니다. 저는 주로 아침과 낮에 바르고, 겨울처럼 입술이 특히 건조한 경우 밤에 바르기도 합니다. 입술이 벗겨지기 직전이거나 수분이 너무 부족할 때 손을 뻗습니다. 이것은 매 시간마다 다시 적용해야 하는 것이 아닙니다. 입술이 벗겨지기 시작할 수 있습니다. 그것은 각질을 제거하기 때문입니다. 그것은 그 일을하고 있습니다. 건조할 때 사용하고 작동하도록 놔두기만 하면 됩니다. 한 번의 적용으로 말 그대로 남편(그리고 내 입술)의 입술이 치유됩니다. 트리트먼트 사이에는 입술을 편안하고 촉촉하게 유지해 주는 전통적인 보습 밤이 필요할 것입니다. 여기에 다른 브랜드가 등장합니다. Jack Black(SPF 밤), Cocokind 및 Summer Fridays는 하루 종일 수분을 유지하는 데 좋습니다. EADEM처럼 입술을 치료하지는 않지만 치료 사이에 완벽합니다. Author: grc1110
Title: Nice colors, not my favorite scents
ReviewText: I ordered both chateau rose and sakura shaved ice. I like the formula of Le Chouchou but the scents are just fine, not my favorite. I'd describe chateau rose as a lightly scented lemon cleaning product scent as opposed to a lemon baked good (like Rhode lemontini), not my favorite but bearable. The Sakura shaved ice is a lightly scented warm vanilla sugar by bath and bodyworks, also not my favorite but fine. Both shades are great which is why I'm keeping both. If Guava fresca was way too pink/pigmented you will like Sakura shaved ice. Chateau Rose reminds me of the Croissant au beurre just with a hint of translucent pink.

Author: 1jazzychick
Title: Honest Review, I REALLY Wanted to Love These
ReviewText:
I purchased four Eadem lip glosses because the colors and brand message completely sold me. I was excited to add them to my routine, but unfortunately they did not work for my lips at all.

There is definitely an exfoliating ingredient in the formula, and for me it was way too strong. After a short time my lips became extremely dry and started peeling badly. I stopped using them for a few days and switched back to my Topicals lip products, and my lips returned to normal almost immediately. I tried Eadem again just to be sure, and the peeling came right back.

The shades are beautiful and the packaging is gorgeous, so this review honestly makes me sad to write. If your lips are sensitive or easily irritated, just be cautious. I really wanted these to be a staple, but sadly they are not for me

text_for_model: I purchased four Eadem lip glosses because the colors and brand message completely sold me. I tried Eadem again just to be sure, and the peeling came right back. The shades are beautiful and the packaging is gorgeous, so this review honestly makes me sad to write. Author: ClaireL232
Title: Holy grail!

I do NOT get soy sauce, to me it smells exactly like butter mochi which is really good. 

I will say, my sister tried this and it didn't work that well for her, so I think lip products are just super individual. She prefers the Dr Idriss lip set (which I also love, I think works just as well as this), and didn't get great results from this. But for me it's wonderful! 

I like the clear one, and have tried three colors. 

Fig Sauce: Too orange for me. I am VERY fair skinned (usually lightest shade one or two in any foundation range) and cool toned, and this just was too warm and shows up too orange on my skin tone. 

Bissap Glaze: Pretty, but it's super pigmented. That's not really a flaw, but for me it still was a touch too warm toned (though better than the others), and looked off on my skin tone.

Guava Fresca: Was hoping this one would be a perfect pink, but sadly didn't work for my skin tone. Too warm and showed up more peach/orange, which isn't what I was looking for. 

However I think they are coming out with a cool toned pink so I shall keep my fingers crossed for that one!
ReviewText_ko:

내 여동생이 이것을 시도했지만 그녀에게는 그다지 효과가 없었기 때문에 립 제품은 매우 개별적이라고 생각합니다. 그녀는 Dr Idriss 립 세트를 선호하지만(나도 좋아하는 이 세트는 이것만큼 효과가 있다고 생각합니다), 이것으로 좋은 결과를 얻지 못했습니다. 하지만 나에게는 정말 멋진 일이다! 

저는 투명한 걸 좋아해서 3가지 색상을 사용해 봤어요.

구아바 프레스카(Guava Fresca): 이 제품이 완벽한 핑크색이기를 바랐지만 안타깝게도 내 피부색에는 맞지 않았습니다. 너무 따뜻하고 복숭아/오렌지가 더 많이 나타났는데, 이는 제가 찾던 것이 아닙니다. 

하지만 아무래도 쿨톤 핑크가 나올 것 같아서 그것도 꼭 사야겠어요!

It’s thick enough that it stays on for a long time but not so thick that it’s bothersome. Author: seuuum
Title: Holy grail, favorite and worth every penny
ReviewText:
I am a full-on lip balm snob. I’ve tried everything. Until this, my ride-or-die was Ole Henriksen, but I never loved the scents and they can feel a little sticky on my lips.

The Eadem Butter Mochi Lip Balm is that same high-quality, actually-works level of hydration — but smoother, less tacky, and somehow just more comfortable to wear. It lasts just as long, too. I only need to reapply every few hours, which is saying a lot coming from someone with chronically dry, chapped lips. I mean ripping dead skin, bleeding, the whole thing 😬 Most people will not need something as intensive as I do or have to reapply as often.

I also love the metal applicator. It feels cool and soothing on the lips, especially when they’re irritated, and honestly just makes the whole experience feel more luxurious and intentional.

I originally bought this because Abbey Young recommended it on Instagram, and she was absolutely right. I ended up buying three — one lives in my car, one is clipped to my badge at work, and one stays in my purse at
ReviewText_ko:
나는 완전한 립밤 속물입니다. 나는 모든 것을 시도했습니다. 지금까지 나의 승부욕은 올레 헨릭센(Ole Henriksen)이었지만 나는 그 향기를 결코 좋아하지 않았고 입술에 약간 끈적한 느낌을 줄 수 있었습니다.

Eadem 버터 모찌 립밤은 동일한 고품질의 실제 수분 공급 수준이지만 더 부드럽고 끈적임이 적으며 착용하기가 더 편안합니다. 그만큼 오래 지속됩니다. 몇 시간에 한 번씩만 다시 바르면 되는데, 이는 만성적으로 건조하고 갈라진 입술을 가진 사람에게서 많이 발생한다는 것을 의미합니다. 죽은 피부를 찢고, 피를 흘리는 등 모든 것을 의미합니다. 😬 대부분의 사람들은 나만큼 집중적인 제품이 필요하지 않거나 자주 다시 발라야 할 필요가 없습니다.

메탈 어플리케이터도 마음에 듭니다. 특히 짜증이 났을 때 입술에 시원하고 진정되는 느낌이 들며 솔직히 전체 경험이 더욱 고급스럽고 의도적인 느낌을 줍니다.

원래는 Abbey Young이 인스타그램에서 추천해서 이걸 샀는데 그녀의 말이 딱 맞았습니다. 결국 3개를 구입했습니다. 하나는 내 차에, 하나는 직장에서 배지에 고정하고, 하나는 직장에서 지갑에 보관합니다.

I only need to reapply every few hours, which is saying a lot coming from someone with chronically dry, chapped lips. I mean ripping dead skin, bleeding, the whole thing 😬 Most people will not need something as intensive as I do or have to reapply as often. I also love the metal applicator. It feels cool and soothing on the lips, especially when they’re irritated, and honestly just makes the whole experience feel more luxurious and intentional. I originally bought this because Abbey Young recommended it on Instagram, and she was absolutely right. Author: themamacheetah
Title: Not all colors are as fabulous
ReviewText:
So…docking a star because of inconsistency, color selection, and representation. I first bought bissap glaze. Color appeared to be a great choice for me, but once ON, it looked muddy and vampy. I had also tried the butter mochi in-store and it lasted through the rest of my shopping trip. But the bissap seemed to parch my lips a bit and didn’t last long. I decided to return that try again anyway, having had a better experience from my previous shopping trip. I grabbed both limited edition shades once restocked and then came back and grabbed a second croissant to keep in my bathroom drawer. Both these colors are really nice. Applying the chocolate too thick does look like you have melted chocolate on your lips but that blots out to a nice sheer shimmer, and it legit smells like I just put a chocolate in my mouth. However, there is ZERO taste, which I greatly appreciate. The croissant one is more subtle so I only noticed a scent the first couple of times I used it, but again no taste. 

It stays glossy a really decent amount of time, and then dries down to more of a seal on your lips rather than wearing off. So it’s been really nice for sealing moisture IN plus works beautifully on top of my lip stain to seal and preserve the color longer. (Also a better option for kissing since it’s sort of a film former that doesn’t slip around.) It does seem to have a very mild exfoliating effect and I have smooth, soft lips that take my stain nicely and evenly. (And it’s winter as I write this!) I will still alternate this with my Alpyn lip balm and a more traditional cocoa butter based stick because they perform in different ways and nourish differently, but this balm has become a purse staple now. Really great product if you find a color that works for you. I need more light/bright shades though because the only color (not just shimmer) that really works for my coloring is the guava, but I cannot tolerate the smell. It hits like BO to me.
ReviewText_ko:
그래서… 불일치, 색상 선택 및 표현 때문에 별을 도킹하는 것입니다. 처음으로 비삽 글레이즈를 구매했어요. 색상은 나에게 훌륭한 선택인 것처럼 보였지만 일단 색상을 사용하면 탁하고 뱀파이어처럼 보였습니다. 나는 또한 매장에서 버터 모찌를 시험해 보았고 나머지 쇼핑 여행 내내 지속되었습니다. 그러나 비삽은 내 입술을 약간 바싹 마른 것 같았고 오래 가지 못했습니다. 나는 이전 쇼핑 여행에서 더 나은 경험을 했기 때문에 어쨌든 다시 시도하기로 결정했습니다. 나는 재입고된 한정판 쉐이드 두 개를 모두 집은 다음 돌아와서 욕실 서랍에 보관할 두 번째 크루아상을 집었습니다. 이 두 색상 모두 정말 예뻐요. 초콜렛을 너무 두껍게 바르면 입술에 초콜렛이 녹은 것 같은 느낌이 들지만, 오히려 은은한 반짝임이 묻어나고 입에 초콜렛을 넣은 것 같은 향이 나기도 합니다. 하지만 ZERO 맛이 있어서 정말 감사하게 생각합니다. 크루아상은 좀 더 미묘해서 처음 몇 번 사용했을 때만 향이 느껴졌지만 다시는 맛이 나지 않았습니다. 

그것은 정말 적당한 시간 동안 광택을 유지하고, 닳지 않고 입술에 더 많은 밀봉이 될 때까지 건조됩니다. 그래서 수분 IN을 밀봉하는 데 정말 좋았고 입술 얼룩 위에 아름답게 작용하여 색상을 더 오래 밀봉하고 보존합니다. (미끄러지지 않는 일종의 필름 포머이기 때문에 키스를 위한 더 나은 옵션이기도 합니다.) 매우 온화한 각질 제거 효과가 있는 것 같고 얼룩을 고르게 고르게 잡아주는 부드럽고 부드러운 입술을 가지고 있습니다. (그리고 이 글을 쓰는 지금은 겨울입니다!) 저는 이것을 알핀 립밤과 좀 더 전통적인 코코아 버터 기반 스틱으로 대체할 것입니다. 왜냐하면 그것들은 다른 방식으로 작용하고 다르게 영양을 공급하기 때문입니다. 하지만 이 밤은 이제 지갑의 필수품이 되었습니다. 자신에게 어울리는 색상을 찾으면 정말 좋은 제품입니다. 내 착색에 실제로 효과가 있는 유일한 색상(쉬머뿐만 아니라)은 구아바이기 때문에 더 밝고 밝은 색조가 필요하지만 냄새를 견딜 수 없습니다. 그것은 나에게 BO처럼 맞았습니다.

Author: CherokeeGypsy
Title: Perfect for the Winter!
ReviewText: So I needed a new lip treatment for the super cold winters here in Tennessee. I’ve heard nothing but amazing things about this brand and lip balm, so I chose the shade Butter Mochi, and I’m super glad I did. I didn’t want any color, as i just needed a good lip treatment to keep my lips soft and moisturized in this winter. The applicator is my favorite part as it’s cooling and feels amazing on the lips. The formula also feels very hydrating on my lips, so I’m sure this is going to do exactly what I need it to do this winter. These are viral for a reason yall, and they’re also reasonably priced.

Author: 808mimi
Title: love pain au chocolat
ReviewText: I already have and love guava fresca, so I decided to branch out and try a shimmery shade. I got pain au chocolat and it smells soo good, it's like a familiar chocolate pastry smell but I can't put my finger on exactly what it reminds me of. I have light to medium skin and medium lips, and I prefer a lighter application in this shade so I get a sheer wash of brown. The pink shimmers are so pretty. They're fine and not gritty, I can't feel them at all. The product itself is a balmy consistency, slightly glossy but definitely more of a balm than a gloss or oil. Love the metal tip applicator, it just applies the product so seamlessly to my lips.

Title: Great value! Does what it says!
ReviewText: Color is great, I love the texture- luxurious but not gloopy or oily. My lips still feel good when it wears down, not dry like so many products. I’d say the formula is a bit thicker than most, but it’s not difficult to get out of the tube at all. In fact, I prefer this bc other formulas.  Okay I can’t see where I stopped using this mobile version on a tablet— anyway, some thinner formulas come out much too easily so I end up with a lot of product waste. I do live in LA so that may contribute as well anyway I think it’s well worth the money.

Author: versacevonna
Title: Disappointing 'scent'/shade, terrific product.
ReviewText:
I'm super confused. I've never purchased this product, or from this brand before. I bought shade "Croissant au Beurre". 
When I tell you it has no smell, whatsoever, I don't mean 'oh, it could be stronger' or 'it's too bad the scent is so light and doesn't punch you in the face like Summer Fridays or Rhode', I mean it doesn't have ANY scent. If you were even sensitive to scents(I'm not), this would be fragrance-free to you. Not being dramatic.
All the reviews about the product itself are accurate. Even though there's glitter in it, you can't feel even the slightest grittiness; it's completely smooth and very hydrating and long lasting. I thought even the "metal tip" was going to be gimmicky, because why would how it applies really matter? But it actually is super nice and noticeably different from all the other lippies I own, it's just completely fragrance free though. 
That's disappointing to me because even though the product itself is one of the best lip products I've now used, I was expecting some delicious(I didn't even care if it would've been super light) fragrance. It's just an expensive, clear(only you can see the glitter), fragrance free gloss with a nice applicator. 
I genuinely bought the product for the scent. I mean, seriously, how many lippies do you have that smell like a "buttery pastry"? That would've been cool!
For me, I still have none. 
Don't let this review deter you from purchasing this lip product, but definitely don't expect much if you're buying shade "Croissant au Beurre".
ReviewText_ko:
정말 혼란스럽습니다. 나는 이 제품을 구매한 적이 없으며, 이 브랜드에서도 구매한 적이 없습니다. 나는 그늘 "Croissant au Beurre"를 구입했습니다. 
내가 냄새가 없다고 말할 때, '아, 좀 더 강할 수도 있다'거나 '너무 안타깝지만 향이 너무 가벼워 서머 프라이데이나 로드처럼 얼굴에 펀치를 날리지 않는다'는 뜻은 아닙니다. 아무 향도 없다는 뜻입니다. 당신이 냄새에 민감하다면(저는 그렇지 않습니다), 이것은 당신에게 무향일 것입니다. 드라마틱하지 않습니다.
제품 자체에 대한 모든 리뷰는 정확합니다. 반짝임이 있어도 약간의 거친 느낌도 느낄 수 없습니다. 완전 부드럽고 촉촉하고 지속력도 좋아요. 나는 "금속 팁"조차도 변칙적일 것이라고 생각했습니다. 왜 그것이 실제로 적용되는 방식이 중요할까요? 하지만 실제로는 매우 훌륭하고 제가 소유한 다른 모든 립과는 눈에 띄게 다릅니다. 하지만 완전히 무향입니다. 
제품 자체는 제가 지금까지 사용해본 최고의 립 제품 중 하나임에도 불구하고 맛있는(매우 가벼울지라도 상관없었던) 향기를 기대하고 있었기 때문에 실망스럽습니다. 그것은 단지 값비싸고 투명한(당신만이 반짝이는 것을 볼 수 있습니다), 멋진 어플리케이터를 사용한 무향의 글로스입니다. 
정말 향 때문에 구매한 제품이에요. 내 말은, 진지하게, "버터 페이스트리" 같은 냄새가 나는 입술이 몇 개나 있습니까? 그랬더라면 좋았을 텐데!
나에게는 아직 아무것도 없습니다. 
이 리뷰로 인해 이 립 제품 구매를 단념하지 마십시오. 하지만 "Croissant au Beurre" 색상을 구매하는 경우에는 큰 기대를 하지 마십시오.
text_for_model: I'm super confused. I've never purchased this product, or from this brand before. I bought shade "Croissant au Beurre". When I tell you it has no smell, whatsoever, I don't mean 'oh, it could be stronger' or 'it's too bad the scent is so light and doesn't punch you in the face like Summer Fridays or Rhode', I mean it doesn't have ANY scent. If you were even sensitive to scents(I'm not), this would be fragrance-free to you. Not being dramatic. All the reviews about the product itself are accurate. Even though there's glitter in it, you can't feel even the slightest grittiness; it's completely smooth and very hydrating and long lasting. I thought even the "metal tip" was going to be gimmicky, because why would how it applies really matter? But it actually is super nice and noticeably different from all the other lippies I own, it's just completely fragrance free though. That's disappointing to me because even though the product itself is one of the best lip products I've now used, I was expecting some delicious(I didn't even care if it would've been super light) fragrance. It's just an expensive, clear(only you can see the glitter), fragrance free gloss with a nice applicator. I genuinely bought the product for the scent. I mean, seriously, how many lippies do you have that smell like a "buttery pastry"? That would've been cool! For me, I still have none. Don't let this review deter you from purchasing this lip product, but definitely don't expect much if you're buying shade "Croissant au Beurre".

Title: Best tinted lip balm for WOC
ReviewText:

The Bissap Glaze shade in particular is the perfect pinkish color for me. 
The sheen is excellent, and the metal tip, plus the thicker product consistency, make the product application feel so luxe. Great job EADEM, please do not change a single thing about this product! Also, I bought this product with my own money and was not incentivized to write this review; I just really love this balm!

Author: delightfullypre
Title: Great Lip balm for Fall
ReviewText: I frequently use Fenty Gloss and Summer Fridays Balm so I was hoping this would have a delicious scent. Unfortunately there is no scent and no taste but the color is perfect for everyday. The product itself is thick at first but it “coats” your lips after applying, and thins out without feeling heavy or watery. It almost feels more like a lip mask than a lip balm. In the picture I wore it over Rare Beauty lip oil in the shade happy. I was pleasantly surprised with the wear test, it stayed on for about 8 hours with no touch ups. Had to give it four stars because even when capped tightly sometimes the product leaks out through the hole, leaving the applicator messy. But I love this balm, it will be great in my fall rotation. I’ve already purchased burnt malai and boba bounce after smelling the testers in store, I can’t wait until they arrive!
ReviewText_ko: 펜티글로스와 썸머프라이데이밤을 자주 사용하는데, 향이 너무 맛있으면 좋겠다고 생각했어요. 향도 맛도 없는게 아쉽지만 색상이 데일리로 딱이네요. 제품 자체는 처음에는 걸쭉하지만 바르고 나면 입술에 '코팅'되고, 무겁거나 묽은 느낌 없이 얇아집니다. 립밤이라기보다는 립 마스크에 가까운 느낌이에요. 사진에서는 행복한 그늘에서 레어뷰티 립오일 위에 발랐어요. 나는 마모 테스트에 놀랐고, 아무런 손질도 없이 약 8시간 동안 지속되었습니다. 별 4개를 주어야 합니다. 캡을 단단히 닫아도 가끔 제품이 구멍을 통해 새어 나와 어플리케이터가 지저분해지기 때문입니다. 하지만 저는 이 밤을 좋아합니다. 가을에 바르면 아주 좋을 것 같아요. 이미 매장에서 테스터 냄새를 맡아본 후 번트 말라이와 보바 바운스를 구매했는데, 도착할 때까지 너무 기대됩니다!

Author: LipLipHooray
Title: No buttery croissant smell
ReviewText: While I love the formula and the packaging, the Croissant Au Beurre is a huge disappointment. A buttery croissant flavor is my dream but this has barely ANY smell at all and what I can smell, smells like cheap orange cleaning supplies. For $24 I need a lip product to be PERFECT and deliver exactly what it says it is, that includes smell. In a post COVID world, brands also need to make smells stronger.
ReviewText_ko: 공식과 포장은 마음에 들지만 Croissant Au Beurre는 큰 실망입니다. 버터향이 나는 크루아상 맛이 내 꿈이지만 이건 냄새가 거의 없고 내가 맡을 수 있는 냄새는 값싼 오렌지 청소 용품 냄새다. 24달러에 나는 완벽하고 냄새를 포함하여 말하는 그대로 전달하는 립 제품이 필요합니다. 코로나 이후의 세계에서 브랜드는 또한 냄새를 더 강하게 만들어야 합니다.

Author: bootifulbean
Title: A necessity!!!
ReviewText:
I love love love this Eadem lip balm. It really does leave my lips super soft & hydrating - unlike other brands that rely on the slippery feel to trick you into thinking your lips are hydrated.

I love the metal applicator - it is so soothing and feels so luxe!

I purchased both Croissant and Guava. The Croissant is a beautiful good shimmer, it doesn’t smell like a croissant but regardless, I hope it’s here to stay!

The Guava scent is SOOO yummy and smells like an actual guava! the Summer Fridays Guava just smells like fruity candy so this Eadem Guava feels like it’s sophisticated older sister. Additionally, the Eadem Guava lip balm is actually tinted and leave my lips looking fantastic!

Overall, I highly recommend the Eadem lip balm, it’s absolutely worth the price & lives up to the hype!
ReviewText_ko:
나는이 Eadem 립밤을 정말 좋아합니다. 미끄러운 느낌에 의존하여 입술이 촉촉하다고 생각하도록 속이는 다른 브랜드와는 달리 정말 내 입술이 매우 부드럽고 촉촉해집니다.

저는 메탈 어플리케이터를 좋아해요. 정말 편안하고 고급스러운 느낌이거든요!

크루아상과 구아바를 모두 구매했습니다. 크루아상은 아름답고 좋은 반짝임입니다. 크루아상 냄새는 아니지만 어쨌든 여기에 있기를 바랍니다!

구아바 향은 정말 맛있고 실제 구아바 냄새가 나요! 썸머 프라이데이 구아바는 그냥 과일사탕 향이 나는데 이 에뎀 구아바는 세련된 누나 같은 느낌이에요. 또한 Eadem Guava 립밤은 실제로 착색되어 입술이 환상적으로 보입니다!

전반적으로 저는 Eadem 립밤을 적극 추천합니다. 가격 대비 가치가 있고 과대 광고에 부응합니다!

Title: I love it!
ReviewText: Let me start off by saying, this is a great product! I did a ton of research on these before I finally bought it, and here are my thoughts. Longevity wise, it will literally stay all day as long as you don’t eat or drink anything! It’s super tick, and very long lasting. It is SUPER hydrating but it also does work as an exfoliant so remember your lips will shed a little bit. I’m not giving it 5 stars only because I do prefer a slightly thinner texture. Other than that, I love!!

Author: SunniDeeMe
Title: Proceed with Caution
ReviewText: I originally loved this product so much that I bought 3 shades. Very moisturizing (not just sitting on top of the lips) and I did not need to re-apply even after eating, drinking, "gyming", etc. Everything was fine and dandy until I wore this stuff in the summer time...my lips got sunburned! Sadly, I have been struggling for the past 2 months to get my lips back to normal from a pretty severe reaction. Initially, my top lip was swollen and puffy and the corners of my mouth kept splitting. Then the hyperpigmentation and peeling came. I never knew that lips could get sunburned until I used this product! If I am not mistaken, it has 3 exfoliating ingredients in it, including LACTIC ACID. For the life of me, I truly don't understand why any amount of lactic acid would be in a product with any sort of warning/suggestion to avoid sun exposure, wear sunscreen, etc. This is extremely negligent on the company's behalf, despite how much I initially loved the product. I plan to try it again in the colder months once my lips have healed and sunny weather is long gone. I however would be very leery of purchasing this product. Just be aware and careful should you choose to still try it.

Author: deedee7423
Title: BEST LIP BALM EVER
ReviewText:

The problem some people may be having with the applicator is that they are squeezing way too hard near the top or just in general. It is not delicate whatsoever, but if you are worried about it make sure you're not squeezing the life out of your tube lol! 

This is definitely the best lip balm I've ever tried and 10/10 would recommend to anyone and everyone!!

Also for those complaining that it's always sold out, go to your local Sephora, they should have it there! I had my eye on this product for a while and it was always sold out so on my next trip to Sephora I asked a worker to help me and they had a bunch in stock!!

A must have for anyone!! Amazing formula, long-lasting, hydrating, pigmented, and non-sticky!!

Author: artDecomp
ReviewText: of all the Twenty-Something Dollar Fancy Squeezy Tube Lip Balms that i've suckered myself into buying in the past couple years, this one is a standout. it's rich, thick, glossy, nourishing, luxuriant - everything you hope for with the pricepoint and packaging. it's like if vaseline was exceedingly sexy. it's like soaking in a bubblebath in a 4-star hotel, complete with complementary champagne. it's like footing the bill in a softly-lit restaurant without bothering to check the total, simply because you don't have to. it's the delight of an utterly unnecessary and over-the-top indulgence.
ReviewText_ko: 제가 지난 몇 년 동안 푹 빠져서 구입한 20달러짜리 팬시 스퀴지 튜브 립밤 중 이 제품이 단연 눈에 띕니다. 풍부하고, 두껍고, 광택이 나고, 영양이 풍부하고, 풍성합니다. 가격대와 포장으로 여러분이 바라는 모든 것을 갖추고 있습니다. 마치 바세린이 엄청나게 섹시한 것 같군요. 마치 4성급 호텔의 거품 목욕에 무료 샴페인이 함께 제공되는 것과 같습니다. 그것은 단지 총액을 확인할 필요가 없기 때문에 은은한 조명이 켜진 레스토랑에서 총액을 확인하지 않고 계산서를 작성하는 것과 같습니다. 그것은 완전히 불필요하고 지나친 방종의 즐거움입니다.

Author: Robyn116
Title: Favorite Lip Balm - But Skip Guava
ReviewText: I LOVE this lip balm. I wear it basically every day and am glad it's back in stock. It heals my lips all year long. SO GOOD! I buy it as a gift for all of my friends and family and they report it works with all skin tones. I have Burnt Malai, Fig Sauce, Clear and B Glaze and all are perfect - soft, not sticky, a little bit transparent, doesn't break down or bunch up. I can wear it alone or dab it over lipstick or stain. I was excited about the new color Guava since it's more pink, but just got it and it's not the same as the others. Guava is thicker, opaque, has a flavor that fades quickly (of guava, go figure), and did that thick stringy sticking my lips together thing on me. I can wear a transparent light pink, but opaque it looks weird with my skin. So I will stick to the others I have. I would recommend Burnt Malai for a warm tone and Fig Sauce for cool and skip Guava unless you're looking for lipstick-like balm.
ReviewText_ko: 저는 이 립밤을 정말 좋아합니다. 기본적으로 매일 입고 있는데 재입고되어서 기쁘네요. 그것은 일년 내내 내 입술을 치유합니다. 정말 좋아요! 나는 그것을 내 친구와 가족 모두를 위한 선물로 구입했는데 그들은 모든 피부 색조에 효과가 있다고 보고했습니다. 나는 Burnt Malai, Fig Sauce, Clear 및 B Glaze를 가지고 있는데 모두 완벽합니다. 부드럽고 끈적 거리지 않으며 약간 투명하며 부서지거나 뭉치지 않습니다. 단독으로 바르거나 립스틱이나 얼룩 위에 톡톡 두드려도 됩니다. 새로운 컬러인 구아바는 핑크빛이 더 강해서 기대됐는데 방금 받았는데 다른 컬러와 똑같지 않아요. 구아바는 더 두껍고 불투명하며 빨리 사라지는 맛이 있고(구아바의 경우), 두껍고 끈끈하게 입술을 서로 붙이는 일을 했습니다. 투명한 라이트 핑크색을 입으면 되는데, 불투명하면 피부에 이상하게 보이더라구요. 그래서 나는 내가 가진 다른 사람들을 고수할 것입니다. 따뜻한 톤에는 번트 말라이를, 시원한 톤에는 무화과 소스를 추천하고, 립스틱 같은 밤을 찾는 것이 아니라면 구아바는 생략하겠습니다.
text_for_model: I LOVE this lip balm. I wear it basically every day and am glad it's back in stock. It heals my lips all year long. SO GOOD! I buy it as a gift for all of my friends and family and they report it works with all skin tones. I have Burnt Malai, Fig Sauce, Clear and B Glaze and all are perfect - soft, not sticky, a little bit transparent, doesn't break down or bunch up. I can wear it alone or dab it over lipstick or stain. I was excited about the new color Guava since it's more pink, but just got it and it's not the same as the others. Guava is thicker, opaque, has a flavor that fades quickly (of guava, go figure), and did that thick stringy sticking my lips together thing on me. I can wear a transparent light pink, but opaque it looks weird with my skin. So I will stick to the others I have. I would recommend Burnt Malai for a warm tone and Fig Sauce for cool and skip Guava unless you're looking for lipstick-like balm.

That said, I adore the color and finish. It leaves a beautiful stain, the gloss lasts impressively well—even through meals—and it gives my lips a plump, juicy look I’m obsessed with.

ReviewText_ko: 나 이거 너무 좋아하는데. 나는 너무 많은 립글로스와 밤을 소유하고 사용해 왔으며 이것이 내가 가장 좋아하는 것입니다. 끈적임도 없고 지속력도 좋고 컬러도 너무 예뻐요! 내 입술이 얼마나 윤기 있고 기분이 좋은지 좋아합니다! 다른 사람들이 언급한 것처럼 팁이 파손되는 데 아무런 문제가 없었습니다.

Author: swirlsncurls
Title: Love this!
ReviewText:
First off: I LOVE the smell of the guava! Was so excited when I saw that it was *finally* available again, and I grabbed it instantly.

I've been eyeing this brand for months, and I'm so, so glad I tried it. My lips looked and felt instantly juicy, plump and moisturized. My husband even said that my lips looked "delicious".

As others have mentioned, I also enjoy the feel and shape of the metal applicator.

If you're on the fence, give it a try!
ReviewText_ko:
우선 구아바 냄새가 너무 좋아요! *드디어* 다시 사용할 수 있게 되었다는 소식을 듣고 너무 기뻐서 즉시 구매했습니다.

나는 몇 달 동안 이 브랜드를 눈여겨봤고, 사용해 보게 되어 정말 기뻤습니다. 내 입술은 즉시 육즙이 많고 통통하며 촉촉해 보였습니다. 남편은 내 입술이 "맛있다"고 말하기도 했다.

다른 사람들이 언급했듯이 저는 금속 어플리케이터의 느낌과 모양도 마음에 듭니다.

울타리에 있다면 시도해보십시오!
text_for_model: First off: I LOVE the smell of the guava! Was so excited when I saw that it was *finally* available again, and I grabbed it instantly. I've been eyeing this brand for months, and I'm so, so glad I tried it. My lips looked and felt instantly juicy, plump and moisturized. My husband even said that my lips looked "delicious". As others have mentioned, I also enjoy the feel and shape of the metal applicator. If you're on the fence, give it a try!

Title: It smells.

Had I known it would smell like this I probably wouldn’t have purchased because it makes me not want to reach for it

Author: Shanae157
Title: Amazing product with metal smell
ReviewText: Absolutely lovely formula. It’s really nice and hydrating. It’s not grainy or anything which is what I thought it would be since it says exfoliating. But it’s incredible. The only reason it gets a 4/5 is because the smell isn’t the best. They say it’s meant to have no smell but it smells just like metal and a hint of vanilla. It may be the packaging messing with it. I’m assuming it only metal inside and out which is why it smells that way.

Author: vivacomokasey
Title: The best Sephora has to offer
ReviewText: I have this product in the shades Guava Fresca and also in Fig Sauce. This lip balm is the best formula. Best applicator. Really unique scent(s). To be clear, the Guava Fresca shade smells like photorealistic orange and passion. Fruit juice cocktail. The other shades smell like an herbal tonic that is kind of hard to describe. I love it, but could understand if it weren’t for everyone. I definitely recommend trying this!

Author: samisaywhat
Title: Works on my Accutane Lips
ReviewText: I’ve been on Accutane twice now and anyone that’s been on it knows how badly it dries out your lips. After my first time it took a couple of months for my lips to bounce back. Second time? Girl. My lips are still dry! It’s been months! I’ve tried maybe a hundred products to keep my lips hydrated. I’ve tried lip basting. Vaseline. And Vaseline was the only product that kind of worked but I’m not trying to stick my finger in a jar while I’m on the run, and their lip formula isn’t just pure Vaseline either. So I tried Eadem. I didn’t want to like it. $24!? But I’m desperate so I purchased it. I got Boba Bounce first and was… shocked. I didn’t have to reapply 20 times a day. My lips didn’t peel from the color. I got Butter Mochi after that (it’s never in stock so was a huge win) and the it’s even better. Author: EmMEm0
Title: Beautiful Product
ReviewText: I’m normally not one to spend over $20 on a lip balm, but I was drawn in after hearing how nourishing they are for the lips, while also giving pigment, in colors that show up on brown skin. My first shade was Boba Bounce because I don’t have a brown gloss, and I was so impressed. It smells like brown sugar boba, yet the fragrance doesn’t irritate my lips, and it looks good. I think it would flatter many skin tones. As a gloss, it’s not transfer-proof, but I don’t really expect that. It does go on a bit patchy because it’s so pigmented, so it may not be for you, if you prefer to reapply without a mirror. Massaging it in with the applicator works just fine. This does the work of both a lip balm and a gloss, and it’s a treatment too. I no longer have to worry about dry or flaky lips with this. I also have Bissap Glaze, which is like a berry on my lips, and Guava, which is a bright berry pink. They show up and I’m light-medium to medium skin tone.

Author: Bunnysdeals
Title: Worth the hype, def try it!
ReviewText:
I rarely leave reviews, but I felt like I had to with this one since I’ve seen so many mixed opinions. 
This is my honest take on the Le Chouchou lip balm in Guava.

First off, the color is beautiful. The metal applicator feels super luxe, and the formula keeps my lips hydrated for several hours, depending on how much I use.

Now for the part I was most nervous about: the scent. I’ve seen a lot of people say theirs smelled weird, but mine was amazing. It smells like tropical fruit with a hint of caramel, and the scent fades pretty quickly after applying.

All in all, I’m really impressed. Totally worth the hype, and I’m already planning to try more shades.

리뷰를 거의 남기지 않는데, 호불호가 많이 갈리는 걸 보니 이건 꼭 남겨야겠다는 생각이 들더군요. 
이것은 구아바의 Le Chouchou 립밤에 대한 솔직한 의견입니다.

우선 색상이 아름답습니다. 메탈 어플리케이터는 매우 고급스러운 느낌을 주며, 포뮬러는 사용량에 따라 몇 시간 동안 입술에 수분을 공급해 줍니다.

이제 제가 가장 긴장했던 부분은 바로 향기입니다. 많은 사람들이 자신의 냄새가 이상하다고 말하는 것을 보았지만 내 냄새는 정말 훌륭했습니다. 카라멜 향이 살짝 나는 열대 과일 향이 나고 바르고 나면 향이 꽤 빨리 사라집니다.

전체적으로 정말 감동받았습니다. 과대 광고할만한 가치가 있으며 이미 더 많은 색상을 시도할 계획입니다.

Author: adash98
Title: Fantastic product, terrible tubes
ReviewText: I actually want to give this 5 full stars for the product itself. I deal with incredibly dry and flaky lips and skin due to medical conditions and medications. So I’ve spent years trying to find the perfect products. I was looking for a lip product that did the same for me as Mamondes aqua peel lip mask (which was discontinued). And this was it. Absolute perfection. My lips weren’t flaky, the lines were barely existent. My lips looked full and hydrated with minimal effort. The only reason I gave less stars is because of the packaging. As I’ve seen in other reviews, the metal applicator tip broke off from the tube. Luckily, I kept an old pot from previous lip treatments so I was able to save the product. But one of the biggest selling points for me was that I wouldn’t need to dip my finger into a pot to use it. That’s really the only thing holding me up from wanting to repurchase. Maybe if they fix the applicator, this could be my staple. Because it’s a sucky feeling to have spent this much for a lip mask/balm and suddenly it bursts open at a seam in the office, spilling gunk all over the desk and papers.

Author: iimaan
Title: Sickening fruited juice concentrate. GROSS smell
ReviewText: First discovered this product on Sephora but it sold out in seconds so I bought it from the retailer instead in the shade guava Fresca and fig sauce. Let’s get straight into it… the smell is atrocious and unbearable. I couldn’t keep it on for more than a few minutes. Fig sauce smells like regular hair store lip gloss, the roller ball kind from the 2000’s. nothing special. The color and texture are nice but it’s overhyped. Guava Fresca is actually THE WORST it smells of SUPER sour tropical fruit juice concentrate from a can. It’s overscented. It literally reminds me of a juice box or like fruit juice concentrate. GROSS. Not the smell of a luxurious perfume I thought I was getting. Will be returning Guava Fresca.
ReviewText_ko: 처음 세포라에서 이 제품을 발견했지만 몇 초 만에 품절되어 구아바 프레스카와 무화과 소스 대신 소매점에서 구입했습니다. 곧바로 들어가 보자… 냄새는 지독하고 참을 수 없을 만큼 지독하다. 몇 분 이상 계속할 수 없었습니다. 무화과 소스는 2000년대 롤러볼 종류인 일반 헤어샵 립글로스 냄새와 비슷해요. 특별한 것은 없습니다. 색상이나 질감은 좋은데 너무 과대평가된 것 같아요. 구아바 프레스카(Guava Fresca)는 실제로 캔에서 나오는 매우 신맛이 나는 열대 과일 주스 농축액 냄새가 나는 최악의 제품입니다. 향이 과해요. 말 그대로 주스 상자나 과일 주스 농축액을 생각나게 합니다. 역겨운. 내가 생각했던 고급스러운 향수 냄새가 아니었어요. 구아바 프레스카(Guava Fresca)가 돌아올 예정입니다.

Author: Viczzx22
Title: Irritation alert: lips developed weird bumps
ReviewText: I really enjoyed the thick cushiony texture of this product so I imediately bought this clear shade with two other shades. However, after consistently wearing the lip balm for a few days, I developed a strange bump (I'm guessing a pimple or irritation from this product), which I had never experienced on my lip before (and I have drawers full of various lip products). I thought maybe it's just a weird, misplaced breakout and continued to wear this balm, however, in a few days, my lips got two more of those weird bumps and were concerning. I stopped using this lip balm and after a while, the bumps disappeared... I need to return these unfortunately

(그리고 서랍 안에는 다양한 립 제품이 가득해요) 나는 그것이 단지 이상하고 잘못된 발진일지도 모른다고 생각하고 이 밤을 계속 바르고 있었습니다. 그러나 며칠 후에 내 입술에 이상한 돌기가 두 번 더 생기고 걱정되었습니다. 이 립밤 사용을 중단하고 시간이 지나자 돌기가 사라졌어요... 아쉽게도 반납해야겠어요

Author: albuquerque
Title: Try it.
ReviewText:
I knew I wanted to try the Eadem Lip Balm.  I was hesitant to try this color (Boba Bounce), but the other colors I wanted to try were sold out.
I am VERY fair with blue eyes and I thought it may be too brown on me.  I couldn't have been more wrong.  
Boba Bounce looks lovely on me.  Similar to a "your lips but better" look.  Incredibly flattering.
Texture - amazing.
Smell/taste - in all honesty, I couldn't detect either and I am sensitive to smells.  I just couldn't find one.
I KNEW this color would look spectacular on darker complexions (as the pictures of other reviewers show), but I wanted to reassure someone who may be hesitant due to the color being more of a brown. 🤎🤎🤎
ReviewText_ko:
나는 Eadem 립밤을 사용해보고 싶다는 것을 알았습니다.  이 색상(보바바운스)을 해볼까 망설였는데, 해보고 싶었던 다른 색상도 품절이더라구요.
나는 파란 눈을 가진 매우 공정한 사람이고 그것이 나에게 너무 갈색일지도 모른다고 생각했습니다.  나는 더 이상 틀릴 수 없었다.  
보바 바운스가 정말 사랑스러워 보이네요.  "입술이 더 나은" 모습과 유사합니다.  믿을 수 없을만큼 아첨합니다.
질감 - 놀랍습니다.
냄새/맛 - 솔직히 말해서 둘 다 감지할 수 없었고 냄새에 민감합니다.  나는 하나를 찾을 수 없었습니다.
나는 이 색상이 더 어두운 피부색에서 멋져 보일 것이라는 것을 알고 있었지만(다른 리뷰어의 사진에서 볼 수 있듯이) 색상이 더 갈색에 가깝기 때문에 주저할 수 있는 누군가를 안심시키고 싶었습니다. 🤎🤎🤎

Author: Deejers
Title: My new summer go to!
ReviewText:
I love lip balms (my favorites of all time are are the clear Summer Fridays and Ole Henriksen balms and I don't like the Rhode lipbalm since it was too thin for me for a reference) and bought this myself. This one has skyrocketed to one of my most used. The scent is like a real guava and it's so nice! I can really see it being not sweet enough for people, but I love natural fruit scents like this that don't go into candy or perfume territory. I think the other Eadem scents might be too strong for me personally and I recommend smelling them in store first (I have the same problem with the Ole Henriksen balms outside of the citrus and strawberry ones but I like most of the Summer Fridays scents).

The color is a really beautiful medium pink on my light-medium olive skin tone and is already going to be my pink summer lip of choice. The balm itself is thicker with a really pretty gloss that reminds me the most of the Ole Henriksen balms (the Summer Fridays are a little more liquidy and spread more), but with a lot more pigment. It lasts a long time on my lips, I've worn it before bed and woken up feeling it on my lips still. I also really like the metal applicator, even though I do find the tube hard to squeeze sometimes.
ReviewText_ko:
나는 립밤을 좋아합니다(제가 가장 좋아하는 것은 맑은 Summer Fridays와 Ole Henriksen 밤입니다. 참고로 Rhode 립밤은 너무 얇기 때문에 좋아하지 않습니다). 이것을 직접 구입했습니다. 이것은 내가 가장 많이 사용하는 것 중 하나로 급등했습니다. 향이 진짜 구아바같고 너무 좋아요! 사람들이 먹기에는 충분히 달지 않다는 걸 알 수 있지만, 사탕이나 향수의 영역에 속하지 않는 이런 천연 과일 향을 좋아합니다. 개인적으로 다른 Eadem 향은 나에게 너무 강할 수 있다고 생각하므로 먼저 매장에서 향을 맡는 것이 좋습니다. (저는 감귤류와 딸기 향을 제외한 Ole Henriksen 밤에도 동일한 문제가 있지만 대부분의 Summer Fridays 향을 좋아합니다.)

색상은 내 밝은 중간 올리브 피부 톤에 정말 아름다운 미디엄 핑크이며 이미 내가 선택한 핑크 여름 입술이 될 것입니다. 밤 자체는 Ole Henriksen 밤을 연상시키는 정말 예쁜 광택으로 더 두껍지만(여름 금요일은 조금 더 유동적이고 더 많이 퍼집니다) 색소가 훨씬 더 많습니다. 입술에 지속력이 오래가서 자기 전에 바르고 자고 일어났더니 아직도 입술에 남아있는 느낌이 들었어요. 때로는 튜브를 짜내기가 힘들지만 금속 어플리케이터도 정말 좋아합니다.

Author: Tiffanyanders
Title: The best lip balm I’ve ever! A new purse staple.
ReviewText:
I recently tried the EADEM Le Chouchou Lip Softening Balm, and I can confidently say it’s earned a permanent spot in my bag. From the first application, I was hooked the formula is incredibly hydrating, yet lightweight enough to feel comfortable throughout the day.  

One of the standout features is how long it lasts. Unlike other balms that need constant reapplication, this one keeps my lips soft and nourished for hours. The texture is rich but not overly thick, providing the perfect balance of moisture and a natural gloss without feeling sticky.  

I also love the cooling metal applicator, which makes each application feel soothing and luxurious. The subtle tint in Boba Bounce adds just the right amount of color, enhancing my natural lip tone effortlessly.  

Overall, this balm is a game-changer for anyone looking for long-lasting hydration, a touch of shine, and a truly enjoyable experience. EADEM has delivered a formula that feels amazing, works beautifully, and is now a staple in my daily routine.

눈에 띄는 특징 중 하나는 지속 시간입니다. 지속적으로 다시 발라야 하는 다른 밤들과 달리, 이 제품은 입술을 몇 시간 동안 부드럽고 영양분을 공급해 줍니다. 리치하면서도 과하지 않은 텍스처로 끈적임 없이 수분감과 자연스러운 광택의 완벽한 밸런스를 선사합니다.  

나는 또한 각각의 적용이 차분하고 고급스러운 느낌을 주는 냉각 금속 어플리케이터를 좋아합니다. 보바 바운스의 은은한 틴트가 딱 알맞은 양의 컬러를 더해주어 자연스러운 입술 톤을 자연스럽게 살려줍니다.  

전반적으로 이 밤은 오래 지속되는 수분 공급, 윤기 있는 터치, 진정으로 즐거운 경험을 원하는 모든 사람에게 획기적인 제품입니다. EADEM은 놀라운 느낌을 주고 아름답게 작용하며 이제 내 일상의 필수품이 된 포뮬러를 제공했습니다.

Title: eadem’s biggest spokesperson without them knowing
ReviewText: i am EXTREMELY picky when it comes to lip products (instilled in me from accutane). texture, thickness, and length of wear i take a bit too seriously. this lip balm i’ll recommend to anyone that’ll listen. there’s no gritty texture, it has the thickness of a vaseline, but TRULY moisturizes the lips more than vaseline could. it also continues to have shine and keep my lips hydrated through long periods at work. the tinted shades are super cute i just love that butter mochi can be used as a glossy topper to any look or just a treatment without makeup. it has a lightly syrupy smell too that i think is nice and not overwhelming. i just wish it was able to stay in stock for more people to try it out!!

Author: JWillardMUL
Title: Lovely formula and colors
ReviewText:
So I've purchased a few of the shades of this formula and recently got the new Guava one. I do love all of them, the formula is moisturizing and doesn't do like some other balms and cause my lips to peel but actually makes them feel moisturized, but I agree with other reviews that the scent is a little off putting. I believe it is actually guava that I'm smelling but it's potent in the tube but wears away once applied. I can get past the smell as it doesn't reflect as a taste in your mouth but don't be surprised that the scents in these seem like true natural smells of their name and not everyone likes the true scents of these flavors. That's why a lot of brands use sweet fruit flavors/scents or pastry sweet scents/flavors. 

Bottom line though is that this is an excellent product and you get a lot of it for a reasonable price. They have a good formula to apply the color evenly without being overpowering or too translucent. There's a reason why this sold out almost all the time in every flavor but I am deducting a star due to the scent. I think it would be best to have no scent just to cater to more people.
ReviewText_ko:
그래서 저는 이 포뮬라의 쉐이드 몇 개를 구입했고 최근에는 새로운 구아바 제품을 구입했습니다. 나는 그들 모두를 좋아합니다. 포뮬러는 보습력이 있고 다른 발삼과는 달리 입술이 벗겨지지만 실제로는 촉촉한 느낌을 주지만 향이 약간 나쁘다는 다른 리뷰에 동의합니다. 나는 냄새가 실제로 구아바라고 생각하지만 튜브에서는 강력하지만 바르고 나면 닳아 없어집니다. 입안의 맛으로 반영되지 않기 때문에 냄새를 지나칠 수 있지만 이 냄새가 이름의 진정한 자연 냄새처럼 보이고 모든 사람이 이러한 맛의 진정한 향기를 좋아하지는 않는다는 사실에 놀라지 마십시오. 이것이 바로 많은 브랜드가 달콤한 과일 향/향 또는 페이스트리 달콤한 향/향을 사용하는 이유입니다. 

하지만 결론은 이것이 훌륭한 제품이고 합리적인 가격으로 많은 것을 얻을 수 있다는 것입니다. 과하지도, 너무 투명하지도 않게 컬러를 고르게 발색할 수 있는 좋은 포뮬러를 가지고 있습니다. 거의 모든 맛이 매진되는 데에는 이유가 있지만 향 때문에 별 하나 뺍니다. 더 많은 사람들이 먹을 수 있도록 향이 없는 것이 가장 좋을 것 같아요.

Author: bswitz
Title: Game changer
ReviewText:
I’m 35F, live in the Midwest, and sometimes have low vitamin D. I’m constantly looking for a lip product to hydrate my lips - bonus if it has pigment. 

Usually lip products are grainy, dry my lips out, or wear off fast (or all 3.) 

I purchased this and have been using it for a month. The applicator feels very smooth and the silver look to the tube is visually appealing, so much so my toddler steals it constantly when he sees it out. 

The formula is unlike any I’ve ever used — it’s hydrating, smooth, smells good, has great pigment AND MOST OF ALL, I can apply it before I go to sleep, and when I wake up in the morning, I still feel it on my lips! I have tried nearly every lip product on the market, and this is the first to do that for me — lasted throughout the night (I’m undoubtedly a bit of an open mouth sleeper,) and my lips were hydrated come morning.

Author: CLGR3
Title: Eadem Chouchou Lip Balm – Honest Review
ReviewText:
I really wanted to love this lip balm. The metal tip applicator feels luxe and cooling on the lips, and the formula itself is beautifully cushiony and hydrating—everything I usually look for in a balm. I went with the clear shade because the colored versions, while gorgeous, seemed a bit more pigmented than I typically prefer.

That said, I have to return it. The biggest issue for me is the taste. Since it’s unflavored, you really taste the raw formula, and unfortunately, I find it extremely unpleasant. It’s not a subtle aftertaste—it lingers, and I just couldn't get used to it, even after a full day of wear. It completely ruined the experience of an otherwise great formula.

It’s such a shame because the texture is spot-on, and I had high hopes. Maybe the flavored or tinted versions mask the taste better when sheered out, but for now, this one just isn’t for me.
ReviewText_ko:
이 립밤이 너무 갖고 싶었어요. 금속 팁 애플리케이터는 입술에 고급스럽고 시원한 느낌을 주며, 포뮬러 자체는 제가 일반적으로 밤에서 찾는 모든 것인 쿠션감과 수분 공급 자체가 아름답습니다. 저는 컬러 버전이 화려하기는 하지만 제가 일반적으로 선호하는 것보다 조금 더 착색된 것처럼 보였기 때문에 투명한 색상을 선택했습니다.

즉, 반품해야 합니다. 나에게 가장 큰 문제는 맛이다. 무향이기 때문에 생 제조법의 맛이 정말 느껴지고, 불행히도 매우 불쾌합니다. 미묘한 뒷맛이 아닙니다. 오래 지속되며 하루 종일 착용한 후에도 익숙해지지 않습니다. 그것은 다른 훌륭한 공식의 경험을 완전히 망쳤습니다.

질감이 딱 맞아서 너무 아쉽고 기대가 컸어요. 어쩌면 향이 나는 버전이나 착색된 버전은 깎을 때 맛을 더 잘 가릴 수도 있지만, 지금으로서는 이것은 나에게 적합하지 않습니다.

Author: Estellajmv
Title: Good But Could Be Great
ReviewText:
It really is an excellent lip balm. It reminds me of the old Fitglow lip balms that were the gold standard for longevity, moisture and how they feel on the lips. However - a few things need to be tweaked before the hype is warranted here. 

First, either produce enough product or don't put it on the market. The false scarcity sales tactic is so tired, and this shade "sold out" minutes into its release. Other shades keep going in and out of stock as well. Second, my local Sephora randomly had a tester for this shade a day after its release online, and it is NOT the "hazy pink" shade its described to be. It's more of a sheer warm red. The shade in person looks more like the swatch online for fig sauce, although fig sauce AND guava fresca are both much warmer in person. Again - not sure why brands do this thing of making every swatch look cooler in photos than the product is in person. Lastly - and this is just nitpicking, but the product can be a challenge to squeeze out if it's not warm. 

I'd highly recommend swatching in person before you buy, or just go with the clear version...IF you can find it in stock. I hope they produce more colors with accurate swatches in more realistic quantities. Then it could be just about perfect.
ReviewText_ko:
정말 훌륭한 립밤입니다. 지속력, 촉촉함, 입술에 닿는 느낌의 표준이었던 오래된 Fitglow 립밤을 생각나게 합니다. 그러나 여기서 과대 광고가 보장되기 전에 몇 가지 사항을 조정해야 합니다. 

첫째, 충분한 제품을 생산하거나 시장에 출시하지 마십시오. 잘못된 희소성 판매 전술은 너무 지쳐서 이 색상은 출시된 지 몇 분 만에 "매진"되었습니다. Other shades keep going in and out of stock as well. 둘째, 내 지역 Sephora는 온라인에 출시된 지 하루 만에 이 색상에 대한 테스터를 무작위로 보유했으며 설명된 "흐릿한 핑크색" 색상이 아닙니다. 좀 더 따뜻한 느낌의 레드에요. 무화과 소스와 구아바 프레스카는 모두 직접 보면 훨씬 더 따뜻하지만, 직접 보면 그늘이 온라인에서 무화과 소스 견본과 더 비슷해 보입니다. 다시 말하지만, 왜 브랜드가 모든 견본을 실제 제품보다 사진에서 더 멋있게 보이도록 만드는지 잘 모르겠습니다. 마지막으로, 이것은 단지 트집잡기일 뿐이지만, 제품이 따뜻하지 않으면 짜내는 것이 어려울 수 있습니다. 

구매하기 전에 직접 견본을 보거나 클리어 버전을 선택하는 것이 좋습니다. 재고가 있는 경우. 좀 더 현실적인 수량으로 정확한 견본으로 더 많은 색상을 생산해 주셨으면 좋겠습니다. 그렇다면 거의 완벽할 수 있습니다.

Author: galgid
Title: More cool-toned pink shades PLEASE!
ReviewText: This is such a rich, hydrating, luxurious lip balm. It's very thick and cushy feeling on the lips, and the metal applicator makes applying this feel very elegant. My only complaint is that the shades are mostly orange/warm-toned so Bissap Glaze is the only color that is flattering on my fair olive skin. Even so, sometimes it is a bit dark for what I want so I don't reach for it as much as I'd like to. The clear shade would be an obvious "fix" for that, but my natural lips are very pale so I just personally like to have color in any balm I use.
ReviewText_ko: 풍부하고 촉촉하며 고급스러운 립밤입니다. 입술에 닿는 느낌은 굉장히 도톰하고 푹신한 느낌인데, 메탈 어플리케이터 덕분에 굉장히 우아한 느낌을 줍니다. 나의 유일한 불만은 색조가 대부분 주황색/따뜻한 톤이므로 Bisap Glaze가 나의 흰 올리브 피부를 돋보이게 하는 유일한 색상이라는 것입니다. 그럼에도 불구하고 때로는 내가 원하는 것이 조금 어두워서 원하는 만큼 손이 닿지 않을 때도 있습니다. 투명한 색상이 이에 대한 확실한 "수정"이 될 수 있지만, 내 자연스러운 입술은 매우 창백하기 때문에 개인적으로 사용하는 밤에 색상이 있는 것을 좋아합니다.
text_for_model: This is such a rich, hydrating, luxurious lip balm. It's very thick and cushy feeling on the lips, and the metal applicator makes applying this feel very elegant. My only complaint is that the shades are mostly orange/warm-toned so Bissap Glaze is the only color that is flattering on my fair olive skin. Even so, sometimes it is a bit dark for what I want so I don't reach for it as much as I'd like to. The clear shade would be an obvious "fix" for that, but my natural lips are very pale so I just personally like to have color in any balm I use.

ReviewText: I am the country mouse and my sister is the city mouse lol. It’s crazy how she can spot a nice lip color or fragrance for me and have the hardest time for herself lol. Anyways, she told me about the Eadem brand months ago, and in particular, the Le Chouchou Exfoliating + Softening Peptitde Lip Balm. I finally made a purchase last month and I love it! I like the brands philosophy: Health is the only beauty standard, the application tip, it’s cooling and covers the lips smoothly. I like the simple packaging for it reminds me of vintage or days gone by. Yes, it is great for dryness, ashiness, and flakiness that sometimes accompany chapped lips. I really like the nice pop of color, it can compliment many skin tones, it’s nothing too glossy or sticky, but just right! I would and will be purchasing this item again and again!

I had to squeeze so hard it made the tube separate from the metal applicator and product would come out there. It might have just been a bad instance, so I hope to try a different shade eventually and see if I like it better.

Author: skinwithdee
ReviewText:
if you’re looking for a tinted lip balm that actually makes your lips softer and plumper the more you wear it, the eadem le chou chou lip softening balm is such a great option. it has a thick texture that feels very plush and cushiony on the lips, and it delivers pretty long-lasting moisture. the shade i have is boba bounce, which is a medium-deep brown. the metal packaging and applicator feel super luxurious and cooling when i apply it on my lips.

i don’t particularly love the scent of the lip balm–it’s a bit overly sweet for me. also, because of the level of pigment in the product and the heavy applicator, it can take a long time to get an even layer of color on your lips. and i find that the flat applicator gets messy easily too. despite these shortcomings, i think the formula, shade, and finish make it worth it!
ReviewText_ko:
실제로 바를수록 입술을 더욱 부드럽고 도톰하게 만들어주는 틴티드 립밤을 찾고 있다면 eadem le chou chou 립 소프트닝 밤이 정말 좋은 선택입니다. 도톰한 텍스처로 입술에 매우 푹신하고 쿠션감이 느껴지며, 꽤 오래 지속되는 촉촉함을 선사합니다. 내가 가진 그늘은 중간 정도의 갈색 인 보바 바운스입니다. 메탈 패키징과 어플리케이터로 입술에 바르면 고급스럽고 쿨링감이 느껴집니다.

나는 특히 립밤의 향기를 좋아하지 않습니다. 나에게는 약간 지나치게 달콤합니다. 또한, 제품에 함유된 피그먼트의 양과 무거운 어플리케이터로 인해 입술에 균일한 컬러를 발색하는 데 오랜 시간이 걸릴 수 있습니다. 플랫 어플리케이터도 쉽게 지저분해지는 것 같아요. 이러한 단점에도 불구하고 포뮬러, 색상, 마감이 그만한 가치가 있다고 생각합니다!

It adds the right amount of shine without looking wet, moisturized my lips, and even as it wears off during the day it still feels good. The cool touch/feel of the applicator is an added bonus - I found myself wanting to keep using it as it felt so good!

Title: WHERE HAS THIS BEEN MY WHOLE LIFE

not to mention how gorgeous the colour is!! I find that nearly every lip coloue reads super bright on my features, and the muted fig shade is the PERFECT healthy glow for my lips.

really impressed with this one, 10/10.

색깔이 얼마나 아름다운지는 말할 것도 없고!! 나는 거의 모든 립 컬러가 내 특징을 매우 밝게 읽고, 음소거 된 무화과 그늘이 내 입술에 완벽하고 건강한 빛을 발한다는 것을 알았습니다.

정말 감동받았어요, 10/10.

Author: melonkhali
Title: My new favorite lip balm 10/10
ReviewText: This is hands down, the best lip balm on the market. I used to think that of Glossier's Balm Dot Com (prior to reformulation), and I don't take this new discovery lightly. Fig Sauce is a gorgeous color for my two-toned dark lips. I especially love the packaging. The metal tip is always so cooling and relaxing. This lip balm applies and glides like BUTTTEEERRR. There is nothing smoother. It is never sticky, never too oily, never gritty. I've kept this is my warm pockets on a summer day and the formula didn't separate. It stays the exact same and smells sooo good. This is my new staple lip balm. If I leave the house without it, my day is ruined. This product is 100% worth all the hype.
ReviewText_ko: 이것은 시중에서 판매되는 최고의 립밤입니다. 나는 Glossier의 Balm Dot Com(재형성 이전)을 생각하곤 했으며 이 새로운 발견을 가볍게 여기지 않습니다. 무화과 소스는 어두운 투톤 입술에 잘 어울리는 컬러에요. 특히 포장이 마음에 듭니다. 금속 팁은 항상 매우 시원하고 편안합니다. 이 립밤은 BUTTTEEERRR처럼 바르고 미끄러지듯 움직입니다. 더 부드러운 것은 없습니다. 결코 끈적거리지 않고, 너무 기름지지도 않고, 거칠지도 않습니다. 나는 이것을 여름날 따뜻한 주머니에 보관했고 공식이 분리되지 않았습니다. 그대로 유지되고 향도 너무 좋아요. 이것은 나의 새로운 스테이플 립밤입니다. 그거 없이 집을 나가면 하루가 망가져요. 이 제품은 모든 과대 광고의 가치가 100% 있습니다.

Author: rachellemarie
Title: Burnt Malai isn’t too orange
ReviewText: I’ve been wanting to pick this up in Butter Mochi and Fig Sauce but those shades have been sold out for ages. I finally just decided to try Burnt Malai, but wasn’t sure how much I’d like it based on how orange it looked. I’m happy to report that Burnt Malai is not as intense as the photos make it out to be, which for me is a good thing because it’s a much more wearable shade for me. The formula is thick and grippy vs slippy which I like because it actually stays on your lips for more than 5 minutes. Some people have complained about the packaging saying it’s hard to squeeze out but I think that’s a bit dramatic and given the consistency I like that it doesn’t all just ooze out super quickly when you squeeze it because it allows more control so you don’t over apply. I’ve also seen some comments talking about lip irritation but I haven’t experienced that (and I’m on Accutane). Considering just buying the other two shades directly from the brand because Sephora is taking their sweet time to restock.
ReviewText_ko: 저는 이것을 버터 모찌와 무화과 소스로 사고 싶었지만 그 색상은 오랫동안 매진되었습니다. 마침내 번트 말라이(Burnt Malai)를 먹어보기로 결정했지만, 오렌지색으로 보이는 것을 기준으로 얼마나 좋아할지 확신할 수 없었습니다. 번트 말라이(Burnt Malai)가 사진에서 보이는 것만큼 강렬하지 않다는 사실을 알려드리게 되어 기쁩니다. 이는 저에게 훨씬 더 착용하기 좋은 색상이기 때문에 좋은 일입니다. 포뮬러는 두껍고 미끄러운 것에 비해 실제로 5분 이상 입술에 남아 있기 때문에 제가 좋아하는 제형입니다. 어떤 사람들은 짜내기가 어렵다고 포장에 대해 불평했지만 나는 그것이 약간 극적이라고 생각하며 일관성을 고려할 때 더 많은 제어를 허용하므로 너무 많이 바르지 않기 때문에 짜낼 때 모든 것이 매우 빨리 스며 나오지 않는다는 점이 마음에 듭니다. 입술 염증에 대한 댓글도 본 적이 있지만 그런 경험은 없었습니다(저는 Accutane을 사용하고 있습니다). Sephora가 재입고에 시간을 투자하고 있기 때문에 다른 두 가지 색상을 브랜드에서 직접 구매하는 것을 고려해보세요.

Title: Tore my lips up

However, I only used it twice and that was enough to compromise my lips to the point that a nourishing lip oil burned! The texture was thick although it had a tendency to pool to the outer edges of the lips which had me evening it out quite often. This unfortunately left my lips drier and wrinkly than before use.

Author: bevifaru
Title: There are way better similar products out there
ReviewText:
The formula is so thick that even during this hot summer I struggle to squeeze any product out of the tube. It also sits on my lips without ever being absorbed. I don't feel any softening or exfoliating, just a glob of product that sits there, on top of my lips. 

Even though the product is supposed to be clear, it leaves a white film or cast on my lips, dulling their natural color and making them look weird. Not even in a stylistic way.

The cooling metal applicator is nice, but I usually associate such applicators with under eye products; here it feels a bit gimmicky. 

To top it all off, literally, the way the cap is designed gets product stuck in it with no way to clean it or get it out. 

It's way too expensive to not deliver on its claims. You might honestly do better with a tub of vaseline. But I recommend looking at other similar offerings.
ReviewText_ko:

투명해야 할 제품인데도 입술에 하얀 막이 생기거나 묻어나면서 본연의 발색이 흐릿해지고 이상해 보이는 느낌이 들더군요. 문체적인 방식으로도 아닙니다.

냉각용 금속 어플리케이터도 좋지만 저는 보통 이러한 어플리케이터를 눈 밑 제품과 연관시킵니다. 여기서는 약간 변덕스러운 느낌이 듭니다. 

무엇보다도 말 그대로 캡 디자인 방식으로 인해 제품이 캡에 달라붙게 되어 청소하거나 꺼낼 방법이 없습니다.

Author: OpalPearl
Title: Nice subtle color and shine
ReviewText:
The tube is sleek and attractive, silver and shiny. The top screws off, revealing a wide and angled applicator tip. It does take more pressure than expected to squeeze out the balm, but not so much so that it’s an issue. The balm has a pleasant rich fruity scent and very dark pigment, but once applied and spread, it softens to almost a subtle berry stain that I really liked! The applicator also worked well and was comfortable to use. The metal tip also feels cooling and pleasant, and as someone with thicker lips, I liked the wider applicator tip! Not sure if it could be an issue for those with thinner lips though? Once on, the balm has a shiny and moisturized look without being overly shiny. It does also have a slightly sticky texture, but I didn’t think it was too bad.

(Note: In the picture of it applied on skin, once fully spread and applied, it creates the sheer tinted color towards the end (right) of the balm smear)
ReviewText_ko:
튜브는 매끄럽고 매력적이며 은색이며 반짝입니다. 상단 나사를 풀면 넓고 각진 어플리케이터 팁이 드러납니다. 밤을 짜내려면 예상보다 더 많은 압력이 필요하지만 문제가 될 만큼 많은 압력은 아닙니다. 밤은 기분 좋고 풍부한 과일 향과 매우 어두운 색소를 가지고 있지만 일단 바르고 퍼지면 제가 정말 좋아하는 거의 은은한 베리 스테인으로 부드러워집니다! 어플리케이터도 잘 작동하고 사용하기 편했어요. 메탈 팁도 시원하고 기분 좋은 느낌이고, 입술이 두꺼운 편이라 어플리케이터 팁이 넓어서 맘에 들었어요! 입술이 얇은 분들에게는 문제가 될 수 있을지 모르겠지만요. 바르고 나면 과하게 번들거리지 않고 윤기있고 촉촉한 느낌을 주는 밤입니다. 약간 끈적한 질감도 있지만 나쁘지는 않다고 생각했어요.

(참고: 피부에 바르는 사진은 완전히 펴서 바르면 밤스미어 끝부분(오른쪽)으로 갈수록 투명한 틴트 컬러가 표현됩니다.)

Author: MarinaLis
ReviewText:
First of all, I really liked the sleek packaging. The applicator is great too, making it easy to spread the product evenly on the lips. The lip butter itself is quite thick and requires a bit of effort to get out of the tube, but this is balanced by the fact that a little goes a long way.

I tried the translucent option (Butter Mochi) and didn’t notice any scent or taste, which I appreciate. I was pleasantly surprised by the plumping effect it gave my lips without any tingling sensation. The texture is more like a lip gloss, making it perfect for adding an extra oomph over different lipstick shades.

Author: letrainfalldown
Title: Interesting concept but not my favorite.
ReviewText:
I got the shade Burnt Malai because I wanted something fairly neutral. I like the shade - it's a bit darker than expected but I guess it's a good shade to have in my repertoire!
The applicator is a cool idea, but is better in theory than practice - it's metal with a sloping tip, but it ended up making a bit of a mess when I used it. I think you'll have to clean it off (or use way less product) every time in order to not make a mess inside the cap 😅
The product smells really good! Almost like sugar cookie batter or something. 
Even though it's called a balm, it's more of a thick lip gloss than a balm. It's like a paste and ends up making my lips fairly shiny, which I would've have expected (and honestly would prefer not to) from a balm. But my lips were a bit dry and it does its job and my lips look pretty hydrated now. I did notice a bit of a funny sensation on my lips - it's kind of cooling or something? 
Overall, interesting product although not my favorite - the applicator especially needs work (although the squeeze tube is an interesting idea too.)
(I received this product free in exchange for a review.)

Author: divz9
Title: Love the treatment
ReviewText: I have incorporated Le Chouchou Lip Softening Treatment into my daily routine and have been impressed with its ability to provide my lips with a sumptuous experience. The formula consists of nourishing ingredients like shea butter and essential oils, keeping my lips soft, protected, and voluminous. Each application feels velvety and effortless, depositing a gentle shimmer that enhances their natural appearance. Moreover, the appealing rose aroma elevates my self-care ritual, making the experience even more indulgent. Say goodbye to dryness and roughness on your lips; Le Chouchou promises to deliver comfort and relief. If you desire to indulge your lips in premium care, consider trying this excellent treatment.

Author: christina222
Title: A luxe product
ReviewText: This balm is a luxe experience from start to finish. The packaging is beautiful and the metal tip feels nice and cooling on the lips. I got the color Burnt Malai, which is sort of a warm terracotta color. It was more brown than I thought it would be but it’s beautiful on. The texture is not thin but not too thick either — it feels secure on the lips and doesn’t move. It fills in my lip lines and gives me a plump, glossy look. The smell is fantastic and it wears off evenly. This one is a winner.
ReviewText_ko: 이 밤은 처음부터 끝까지 호화로운 경험을 선사합니다. 패키지도 예쁘고 메탈 팁이 입술에 닿는 느낌도 좋고 시원해요. 저는 따뜻한 테라코타 색상인 번트 말라이(Burnt Malai) 색상을 구매했습니다. 생각보다 브라운빛이 돌았지만 예뻐요. 질감은 얇지도 않고 너무 두껍지도 않고 입술에 밀착되어 움직이지 않는 느낌이에요. 입술 라인을 채워주어 통통하고 글로시한 룩을 연출해줍니다. 냄새가 환상적이며 고르게 닳아집니다. 이것은 승자입니다.

Author: DanielleJhaye
Title: New obsession.
ReviewText: I literally just got this in the mail 2 hours ago and immediately put it on, but I'm already obsessed. I have naturally full lips, so when it comes to lip balm, I don't like any of that plumping stuff. It's super moisturizing but not sticky, and I love that. I usually use the glow recipe hyaluronic gloss balm, but mostly at night because it can get a bit sticky. I live in a state where it's super dry, so most products don't last very long on me before I have to reapply, but i can already tell this is going to be a winner. I've tried 2 other products from this brand so far, and I think I'm becoming a fan. I can't wait to buy every color. oh and the applicator feels phenomenal. I'm assuming it's supposed to have like a cooling effect which I do enjoy.

Title: Such a stunning balm
ReviewText: The Le Chouchou Lip Softening Treatment has significantly upgraded my regular skincare regimen. Applying this lip balm feels seamless as it glides over the lips softly, leaving behind a slight shimmer that highlights their natural hue. However, the most captivating aspect of this product is its enticing rose fragrance which adds a sensational element to my everyday life. No more dryness or cracking on my lips, not even in cold temperatures! I cannot stress enough how much I endorse the Le Chouchou Lip Softening Treatment for all those who long for soothing respite and pampering care for their precious pouts.

Title: Natural shade lip balm
ReviewText:
The Le Chouchou Lip Balm by EADEM combines exfoliation, intense hydration, and a glossy finish, making it a versatile product for daily use. My lips become dry at times and this lip balm instantly provides hydration and gently buffs away flaky skin. On application, my lips feel plumpy with a glossy finish. 
The formula includes hibiscus enzymes and lactic acid for gentle exfoliation, along with shea butter and moringa oil for deep moisturization. It's vegan, cruelty-free, and dermatologist-tested. I find the pigment giving a natural shade to lips. The applicator is very attractive  and gives a cool touch to lips.

이 포뮬러에는 부드러운 각질 제거를 위한 히비스커스 효소와 젖산, 깊은 보습을 위한 시어 버터와 모링가 오일이 포함되어 있습니다. 완전 채식이고 잔인하지 않으며 피부과 전문의 테스트를 거쳤습니다. 입술에 자연스러운 그늘을주는 색소를 발견했습니다. 어플리케이터가 매우 매력적이며 입술에 시원한 느낌을 줍니다.

밤에 자기 전에 사용하면 좋을 것 같아요. 낮에는 밥 먹고 세수를 많이 하면 그냥 없어져요. 어쨌든 나는 아침에 입술이 수분을 공급 받고 각질이 제거되는 것을 발견했습니다. 손가락으로 문질러야 해요. 입술을 문지르느라 물집이 생겨서 좋지는 않지만 입술이 예전처럼 건조하지 않고 매끈해졌어요.

나는이 제품을 투명하게 가지고 있지만 여전히 입술이 색상면에서 더 좋아 보입니다. 그것은 두꺼운 일관성을 가지고 있습니다. 입술에 바르면 무겁긴 한데 끈적이지 않아요. 시원한 느낌이나 타는듯한 느낌도 없고 맛도 없습니다.

마음에 듭니다. 유일한 문제는 튜브에서 짜내는 데 어려움을 겪는다는 것입니다. 그렇지 않으면 좋습니다.
text_for_model: I like this Le Chouchou Exfoliating + Softening Peptide Lip Balm. It truly exfoliates and hydrates. I like to use it at night before bed. I did end up blistering my lips from rubbing it off so that’s not good but my lips are smoother and not as dry as before. I have this product in the clear but it still makes my lip look better color wise. It has a thick consistency. It feels heavy on my lips but not sticky. There’s no cooling or burning feeling and no flavor either. I like it, my only issue is I have a hard time squeezing it out of the tube, otherwise good.

Title: Sticky formula, but other than that I love it!!
ReviewText:
The Le Chouchou Lip Softening Treatment is an excellent addition to my lip care routine. One of the standout features is its absolutely amazing metal applicator, which always feels refreshingly cold against my lips. This makes the application process both soothing and pleasant, adding a touch of luxury to my daily routine.

The treatment does a fantastic job of softening and hydrating my lips, and I’ve noticed a significant improvement in their texture. However, I did find the formula to be a bit sticky. It’s a minor inconvenience, but it can be a little uncomfortable, especially if you’re not a fan of sticky lip products.

Overall, despite the stickiness, the Le Chouchou Lip Softening Treatment delivers great results in terms of hydration and softness. If the formula were a bit less sticky, it would be perfect. Still, it’s a solid product that I would recommend to anyone looking for an effective lip softening treatment. This is a strong 4-star product!

Additionally, it’s available in five buildable shades, catering to a variety of skin tones and enhancing natural lip colors without masking them . Author: oscsmom
Title: The most reached for gloss in my collection!
ReviewText:
This lip balm stands out because it not only hydrates but also gently exfoliates, leaving my lips feeling incredibly soft and smooth. The texture is just right—creamy without being too thick or sticky, and it melts into my lips providing immediate comfort.

What I love about this product is its subtle exfoliation. It’s effective enough to remove dry flakes but gentle enough for daily use, thanks to the peptides that help rejuvenate and strengthen the lip barrier. The clear, translucent finish gives a natural look, enhancing my lips without the need for added color. It’s perfect for those no-makeup days or for layering under my favorite lipstick. The scent is mildly sweet, which is a nice touch.

이 립밤은 수분을 공급할 뿐만 아니라 부드럽게 각질을 제거해 입술이 놀라울 정도로 부드럽고 매끄러워지는 점이 돋보입니다. 질감은 딱 적당합니다. 너무 두껍거나 끈적이지 않고 크리미하며, 입술에 녹아 즉시 편안함을 선사합니다.

이 제품에 대해 제가 좋아하는 점은 은은한 각질 제거입니다. 입술 각질을 제거하는 데 효과적이지만 입술 장벽을 강화하고 활력을 주는 펩타이드 덕분에 매일 사용하기에 충분히 부드럽습니다. 맑고 반투명한 마무리감이 내추럴한 마무리감으로 별도의 덧칠 없이도 입술을 화사하게 연출해줍니다. 화장을 하지 않은 날이나 제가 가장 좋아하는 립스틱 아래에 덧바르기에 딱 맞습니다. 향은 은은하게 달콤한 향이 나서 기분 좋은 촉감이에요.

Author: evenstevens13
Title: Best lip balm on the market!
ReviewText: Wow genuinely impressed with this lip balm. Lip balms have been the recent beauty trend, so I had rather low expectations for this lip balm but it completely blew me away and now I need all shades. The packaging is very elegant and luxurious, which is a win for the relatively affordable price point. The metal applicator is also a nice touch that adds to the luxurious feel and also spreads the balm easily on the lips with a slight cooling sensation. The balm itself is a bit thick but spreads on easily and gives a very beautiful tint to the lips that can be built up to your liking. Not only that, but this balm actually lasts a really long time, even through eating and drinking. Your lips definitely feel noticeably hydrated after using this balm and the hydration lasts all day. I really love this lip balm it’s so good

The AHA and peptide blend smooths out any flakiness, while the buttery formula keeps my lips feeling soft and moisturized throughout the day. I also love the subtle, glossy finish it gives, perfect for both day and night use. Plus, the hint of color from Butter Mochi adds a lovely touch. Definitely my new favorite lip product!

Author: LisaOst
Title: Amazing lip softening balm
ReviewText:
I recently tried this new exfoliating-to-moisturizing lip balm from Sephora, and I'm really impressed. I'm 31 years old, and having a natural lip color that's both sexy and beneficial is very important to me.
This lip balm smooths out ashy, flaky skin and reduces lip wrinkles while locking in moisture with a glossy finish. It works for all skin types, and I love how it addresses my concerns about fine lines, dryness, and dullness.
The balm is formulated with hibiscus enzymes and lactic acid to immediately buff away dry skin, allowing my lips to absorb the rich moisture. Brazilian Açaí and African Mongongo butters provide intense nourishment and lock in moisture with protective antioxidants. The collagen-boosting peptide helps restore a supple feel and visibly reduces fine lines, making my lips look naturally plump.
I also appreciate that this product is gluten-free and cruelty-free. The 3-in-1 lip treatment exfoliates, moisturizes, and adds a flush of color, transforming my lips into a pillowy pout. The SpreadIt™ Polymer Technology makes the gloss bouncy, non-sticky, and ensures even color application that stays within my lip line. My lips feel so plump and look fantastic!
ReviewText_ko:
저는 최근 세포라(Sephora)의 새로운 각질 제거-보습 립밤을 사용해 보았는데 정말 감동받았습니다. 저는 31세이고 섹시하면서도 유익한 자연스러운 립 컬러를 갖는 것이 저에게 매우 중요합니다.
칙칙하고 각질이 일어나는 피부를 매끈하게 정돈하고, 입술 주름을 줄여주며 윤기 있는 마무리감으로 촉촉함을 잡아주는 립밤입니다. 모든 피부 타입에 효과가 있으며, 잔주름, 건조함, 칙칙함에 대한 고민을 해결해주는 방식이 마음에 듭니다.
히비스커스 효소와 젖산이 함유된 밤이 건조한 피부를 즉각적으로 닦아주고, 입술에 풍부한 수분을 흡수시켜줍니다. 브라질산 아사이 버터와 아프리카산 몽공고 버터는 강력한 영양분을 공급하고 보호 항산화제로 수분을 가두어 줍니다. 콜라겐 강화 펩타이드가 탄력 있는 느낌을 되찾아주고 잔주름을 눈에 띄게 줄여주어 자연스럽게 통통한 입술로 연출해줍니다.
또한 이 제품에는 글루텐이 없고 잔인함이 없다는 점도 감사하게 생각합니다. 3-in-1 립 트리트먼트는 각질을 제거하고, 수분을 공급하고, 화사한 컬러를 더해 입술을 푹신한 입술로 바꿔줍니다. SpreadIt™ 폴리머 기술은 광택을 탄력있고 끈적이지 않게 하며 입술 라인 안에 균일한 컬러 발색을 보장합니다. 입술이 너무 통통하고 환상적으로 보입니다!

Author: EvieOD
Title: Makes lips soft, but not much color
ReviewText: The Eadem Le Chouchou lip softening treatment lives up to its name. After applying it on my lips, it left my lips feeling soft and supple. And it lasted for hours. Even after eating lunch, I felt my lips and it was still soft.  I got it in the color Bissau Glaze, which is a berry color.  It doesn’t add much color, and is pretty sheer.  But it doesn’t keep the lips hydrated and plump. I feel a difference in it and other lip products. I wish the color was more prominent. That is my only problem.  Also I would love to wear it at night but don’t want anything on my pillow. That  is how soft it is. This is my first time using this brand and I am very impressed. I debated a 4 or 5 because I wish there was more color but decided on 5 cuz I like the softness it gives my lips.
ReviewText_ko: Eadem Le Chouchou 립 소프트닝 트리트먼트는 그 이름에 걸맞은 제품입니다. 입술에 바르고 나면 입술이 부드럽고 매끈해지는 느낌이 들었어요. 그리고 그것은 몇 시간 동안 지속되었습니다. 점심을 먹은 후에도 입술이 만져보니 여전히 부드러웠어요.  베리 컬러인 비사우 글레이즈 컬러로 구매했어요.  색이 많이 들어가지 않고, 꽤 투명해요.  하지만 입술을 촉촉하고 통통하게 유지하지는 못합니다. 다른 립 제품들과 차이가 느껴지네요. 색상이 더 눈에 띄었으면 좋겠어요. 그게 내 유일한 문제입니다.  또한 밤에도 착용하고 싶지만 베개에 아무것도 묻고 싶지 않습니다. 그만큼 부드럽습니다. 이 브랜드를 처음 사용해봤는데 매우 감동받았습니다. 색상이 더 있었으면 좋겠다고 해서 4~5호를 고민했는데, 입술에 닿는 부드러움이 마음에 들어서 5호로 결정했습니다.

Author: PrincessOnABudg
Title: More then just a lip balm !
ReviewText:
💋 Hey beauties! Today, I’m beyond excited to share my thoughts on a new holy grail product that has completely transformed my lip care routine – the EADEM Lip Softening Balm in the shade Milky Desert Rose. 

💋From the moment I first applied this balm, I noticed an immediate difference. The formula is incredibly smooth and glides on like a dream, thanks to EADEM’s innovative SpreadIt™ Polymer Technology. It’s not just a balm – it’s an experience. The texture is ultra-comfy and non-sticky, which is a huge plus for me. I love that it provides a glossy finish without that annoying tacky feeling.

💋Now, let’s talk about the magic ingredients. This balm is packed with Hibiscus Enzymes and Lactic Acid, which work together to gently exfoliate and buff away dry, flaky skin. This means my lips can better absorb all the rich moisture that the balm has to offer.

💋The Brazilian Açaí and African Mongongo Butters are absolute superstars in this formula. They intensely nourish and lock in moisture, ensuring my lips stay hydrated and protected throughout the day. Plus, these butters are loaded with protective antioxidants, which is always a bonus.

Title: Love the metal applicator!

Looks really pretty on. It has AHA + Peptides in it. Which helps dry flaky lips. Which I suffer with during allergy season. Author: SaraBunni
Title: Nourish & Shine with Le Chouchou Lip Balm
ReviewText: I recently tried EADEM Le Chouchou Exfoliating + Softening Peptide Lip Balm in the beautiful shade Bissap Glaze, a deep plum berry that adds a lovely pop of color. This lip balm is incredibly moisturizing and effectively fills in lip wrinkles, giving my lips a smooth, glossy finish. I love the cooling applicator, which makes it easy to apply precisely. The formula includes Hibiscus Enzymes and Lactic Acid for gentle exfoliation, while Brazilian Açaí and African Mongongo Butters provide deep nourishment. Additionally, the collagen-boosting peptide helps to soften and improve the overall texture of my lips. Overall, it's a stunning lip balm that leaves my lips looking and feeling amazing.

Author: MariaLuizaV
Title: My favorite gentle exfoliating toner
ReviewText:
This has become one of my favorite toners. I use it a few times a week at night, and it really helps keep my skin clearer and brighter. I noticed my texture started to smooth out and my dark spots faded gradually over a few weeks. It gives that “fresh skin” look without feeling harsh.

The formula is lightweight and absorbs quickly, but it can feel a little tingly—especially if your skin barrier is sensitive or if you’ve exfoliated recently. On those days, I either skip it or layer a hydrating toner first, which works perfectly.

I think the key is not to use it every single day right away. Once you build up tolerance, it’s honestly amazing. My skin looks more even and more “awake” since I added it to my routine.

Overall: Effective, not too strong, and actually delivers results. Just listen to your skin and adjust the frequency if needed.

Author: Justinemarienav
Title: Holy Grail Multi-Tasker!
ReviewText:
This is my unbiased review! No incentives or anything, purchased on my own and I'm OBSESSED!

I've been using The Ordinary's 7% Glycolic Acid Exfoliating and Brightening Daily Toner for a while now, and it's truly become a staple in my routine.

For my face, I incorporate this powerful toner into my P.M. routine just twice a week. Consistency is key, especially with active ingredients, so I always follow it up with a hydrating powerhouse. My routine looks like this: after cleansing, I apply the Glycolic Acid Toner, then layer with The Inkey List's Hyaluronic Acid Serum (my absolute favorite for a hydration boost), and lock it all in with an intensely rich moisturizer like La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Balm B5. The results? My skin has never been clearer, completely free of breakouts. It feels incredibly smooth to the touch, and I've noticed a significant improvement in my overall complexion – it's much more even and radiant.

But here's where this toner truly shines as a multi-tasker for me: its incredible effectiveness on my body. After I shower and shave my bikini line, I immediately apply this Glycolic Acid Toner to the area(bikini line ONLY****) I then follow up with either my Naturium Bio-Lipid Restoring Body Lotion or Neutrogena Hydro Boost Body Gel Cream (depending on what I have on hand!), and the difference is phenomenal. It has completely eliminated any razor bumps, irritation, and, most importantly, those pesky ingrown hairs that used to be a constant struggle.

This isn't just a toner; it's a versatile solution for both face and body. If you're looking for a product that delivers on its promises – from clearer, smoother facial skin to banishing post-shave issues – The Ordinary's 7% Glycolic Acid Toner is an absolute must-try. Highly recommend!

이것은 나의 편견없는 리뷰입니다! 인센티브도 없고 아무것도 없이 직접 구매했는데 집착했어요!

저는 한동안 The Ordinary의 7% 글리콜산 엑스폴리에이팅 앤 브라이트닝 데일리 토너를 사용해왔는데, 정말 제 일상의 필수품이 되었습니다.

내 얼굴에는 이 강력한 토너를 P.M.에 사용합니다. 일주일에 딱 두 번만 하는 일상. 특히 활성 성분의 경우 일관성이 중요하므로 저는 항상 수분을 공급하는 강력한 제품을 사용합니다. 내 루틴은 다음과 같습니다. 클렌징 후 글리콜산 토너를 바르고 The Inkey List의 히알루론산 세럼(수분 공급 강화에 제가 가장 좋아하는 제품)을 바르고 La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Balm B5와 같은 강렬하고 풍부한 모이스처라이저로 모든 것을 고정합니다. 결과는? 내 피부는 이보다 더 깨끗하고 트러블이 전혀 없었습니다. 촉감이 놀라울 정도로 매끄러웠고 전체적인 안색이 눈에 띄게 개선되었습니다. 훨씬 더 고르고 빛나더군요.

하지만 이 토너가 멀티태스커로서 진정으로 빛을 발하는 부분은 바로 이 토너가 내 몸에 미치는 놀라운 효과입니다. 샤워하고 비키니 라인을 면도한 후 즉시 이 글리콜산 토너를 해당 부위에 바르고(비키니 라인만 해당****) 그 다음 나투리움 바이오 리피드 복원 바디 로션이나 뉴트로지나 하이드로 부스트 바디 젤 크림(보유하고 있는 제품에 따라 다름!)을 사용했는데 그 차이는 놀라웠습니다. 면도칼로 인한 돌기, 자극, 그리고 가장 중요한 것은 끊임없이 어려움을 겪던 성가신 인그로운 헤어를 완전히 제거했습니다.

이것은 단순한 토너가 아닙니다. 얼굴과 몸 모두를 위한 다재다능한 솔루션입니다. 더 깨끗하고 부드러운 얼굴 피부부터 면도 후 문제를 해결하는 데 이르기까지 약속을 이행하는 제품을 찾고 있다면 The Ordinary의 7% 글리콜산 토너는 꼭 사용해 보아야 할 제품입니다. 적극 추천합니다!

Author: giesha
Title: NOTHING WORKED BUT THIS
ReviewText:
BUY IT NEOWW!!! I went to a general physician and a doctor and no one knew what exactly was causing this and they ruled out fungal. The derm said maybe glycolic acid will work and I bought this almost a year ago today. I’ve been using it once every three days and the second picture is the improvement I’ve seen in a full year. Every three months or so I could see some improvement but it made me so happy to notice the patch was all gone! 
I also used it under my arms and it really helps with bad odor and I have seen some betterment in discoloration. But I am also using an antiperspirant and that might still be causing the darkness to persist so I’ll be trying to switch my deodorant and keep applying glycolic acid.

I love that it's natural, simple, and works like nothing else.

Author: sainty333
Title: really strong, be cautious.
ReviewText:
for reference, I have balanced skin but when there are issues it tends to lean sensitive/dry. 

this is STRONG. I originally got this for my face but it gave me really bad chemical burns. i tried diluting it as well with distilled water and even then it was barely usable.  i think if your skin doesn’t lean sensitive and if you need what this does, this is great but otherwise, be really, really cautious when using it on your face. 

it does work well for KP / body exfoliation and brightening though. for some reason it’s only my face skin that reacts badly to this product. however, given how it isn’t particularly amazing, and how there are other products on the market that perform just as well for a cheaper price per oz/unit, it wouldn’t be my first choice.

하지만 KP/바디 각질 제거 및 브라이트닝에는 효과가 좋습니다. 어떤 이유로 이 제품에 나쁘게 반응하는 것은 내 얼굴 피부뿐입니다. 그러나 이것이 특별히 놀라운 것은 아니며, 단위당 온스당 더 저렴한 가격으로 성능이 비슷한 다른 제품이 시장에 있다는 점을 고려하면 이 제품이 나의 첫 번째 선택은 아닐 것입니다.
