Author: angiebeautybabe
Title: Holy Grail for Skin Texture & Hyperpigmentation
ReviewText:
I can’t recommend this glycolic acid toner from The Ordinary enough! It’s absolutely amazing for anyone struggling with rough, bumpy skin texture. I use it every night, gently patting it on my face with a cotton pad, and by the next morning, my skin feels incredibly smooth and soft. No more dullness—my skin looks brighter and refreshed!

It’s also helped with my hyperpigmentation. Over time, I’ve noticed a reduction in the dark spots, and it’s made my complexion look more even. It does wonders for exfoliating and removing dead skin cells, leaving my skin feeling rejuvenated.

I always follow up with a moisturizer to keep my skin hydrated, and it’s become a holy grail product I couldn’t live without. If you have skin texture issues or pigmentation concerns, this is definitely worth trying!

Highly recommend!

나는 피부에 수분을 유지하기 위해 항상 모이스처라이저를 사용하는데, 그것은 나에게 없이는 살 수 없는 성배 제품이 되었습니다. 피부 질감 문제나 색소 침착 문제가 있다면 시도해 볼 가치가 있습니다!

Author: Abbey321
Title: Many uses, very happy with results!
ReviewText:
Big fan of this! I use it on my face and body. I use it on areas of my body that I am prone to break out and it has full resolved my body acne and bumpy skin. 

When using this on my face I went through a small acne period upon initial use. I believe it was just pulling congestion out of my skin. I use this 3-4 times a week alternating with a different tone and giving my skin a break and I can tell a difference since introducing this.

When I can feel a pimple forming or a clogged pore I will soak a cotton round and hold it on for ~30 seconds and it also help pull out any oil and reduce swelling and overall feels like it stops for formation. 

There are a lot of ways to use this product, and I’ll keep it in my arsenal of skin care!

이것의 열렬한 팬입니다! 얼굴과 몸에 사용하고 있어요. 몸에서 트러블이 나기 쉬운 부위에 사용하고 있는데 몸의 여드름과 울퉁불퉁한 피부가 완전히 해결되었습니다. 

이것을 얼굴에 사용할 때 처음 사용 시 약간의 여드름 기간이 있었습니다. 나는 그것이 내 피부의 혼잡을 끌어내는 것이라고 믿습니다. 일주일에 3~4번씩 다른 톤으로 번갈아가며 사용하면서 피부에 휴식을 주고 있는데, 소개하고 나서부터 달라진 점을 알 수 있어요.

여드름이 생기거나 모공이 막힌 느낌이 들 때 면봉을 둥글게 적셔 30초 정도 유지하면 기름기를 빼내고 부기를 가라앉히는 데 도움이 되며 전체적으로 여드름이 멈춘 듯한 느낌이 듭니다. 

이 제품을 사용하는 방법은 다양하며 스킨 케어 무기고에 보관하겠습니다!

Author: Jan29N
Title: A Game-Changer for Lightening Underarms and Reduci
ReviewText:
The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution has been an absolute lifesaver for me, especially when it comes to lightening my underarms and reducing odor. I started using it as part of my skincare routine, and the results have been nothing short of amazing.

Within a few weeks of consistent use, I noticed that the dark pigmentation under my arms began to fade. My skin tone is now much more even, and I feel so much more confident. The glycolic acid gently exfoliates the skin, removing dead cells and allowing fresher, brighter skin to come through.

What surprised me even more was how effectively it reduced underarm odor. By eliminating the buildup of bacteria and dead skin cells, this toner has helped keep odor at bay far better than I expected. It’s a fantastic alternative to harsh deodorants, especially if you’re looking for a more natural solution.

The formula is powerful yet gentle enough for regular use. I apply it at night with a cotton pad, and it doesn’t cause any irritation. Plus, it’s affordable, making it an excellent addition to any skincare routine.

If you’re struggling with dark underarms or persistent odor, I highly recommend giving The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution a try. It has made such a positive difference for me!

Author: alexalynn110
Title: Great for scalp also!
ReviewText: The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toner is a highly effective product for smoother, brighter skin. It gently exfoliates to improve texture and tone, helping to reduce dullness and signs of aging. The formula includes soothing ingredients like aloe vera and ginseng to minimize irritation. Lightweight and easy to use, it can also be used on the scalp to help remove buildup and promote a healthier scalp environment. It's a great addition to any skincare routine for a radiant complexion and healthy scalp.

Author: yoenoiii
Title: surprisingly good!
ReviewText: I was not sure if I was going to get this because alot of people have said that they have broken out from this. I have sensitive skin and at the time I had mini breakouts on my face. When popped/applying this, they went away over night with swelling gone and for another day it was almost gone (red spot from when popped only left but will go away in a couple days or so) i really like this product because i also had dry skin/uneven texture. After a couple weeks of use it made my skin from what I feel more even, glowy, and most importantly it actually made my skin feel smoother. I love this product! I tried using with the other serums from the ordinary but I prefer to use this one alone because i think it’s best to use this after cleanser alone at night (I usually wash my face and apply the toner and sleep). It does enhance the blood smell when u apply it to popped pimples but other than that I have no complaints!

(터졌을 때 붉은 반점이 왼쪽으로만 남았지만 며칠 정도 지나면 사라질 것입니다.) 피부도 건조하고 질감이 고르지 않았기 때문에이 제품이 정말 마음에 듭니다. 몇 주 동안 사용한 후에는 피부가 더욱 균일해지고 윤기가 나며, 가장 중요한 것은 실제로 피부가 더욱 매끄러워졌다는 것입니다. 나는 이 제품을 좋아한다! 일반 세럼들과 함께 사용해봤는데 밤에는 클렌저 후 단독으로 사용하는 게 가장 좋은 것 같아서 단독으로 사용하는 걸 더 선호해요(보통 세수하고 토너만 바르고 자요). 터진 여드름에 바르면 피 냄새가 강화되지만 그 외에는 불만이 없습니다!

Title: Can’t imagine my routine without it!
ReviewText:
The Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution has become an absolute staple in my skincare routine, and for good reason. After finishing one bottle, I was so impressed with the results that I immediately started on my second bottle. This toner has truly transformed my skin, leaving it noticeably smoother, clearer, and more radiant.

Using it 3 times a week has been key to maximizing its benefits. The 7% glycolic acid gently exfoliates away dead skin cells, revealing a brighter complexion and improving skin texture over time. I've noticed a significant reduction in the appearance of fine lines and dark spots, which has boosted my confidence in my skin's overall appearance.

What's remarkable about this toner is its effectiveness yet gentle formulation. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, and I appreciate how it preps my skin for better absorption of serums and moisturizers.

If you're looking to enhance your skincare routine with a powerhouse product that delivers visible results, I highly recommend incorporating the Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution into your regimen. It's a game-changer, and I can't imagine my routine without it!

Author: Heyzah
Title: It’s Okay.
ReviewText:
I’ll be honest, I can never make hypochlorous acid work for me, which is weird because it’s supposed to be amazing for rosacea. Yet, every time I use it, whether it’s Tower 28 or the many brands on Amazon, it always makes my skin tight and my rosacea flare. So, if you can’t make it work, don’t force yourself to love it, even if everyone around you is saying you’re supposed to because it helped plenty of people with your concerns. 

For the price, it’s a pass. It’s more of a PR brand since you can get more for less with other brands and websites. 

Skin: Sensitive, Rosacea type 1, combination, and non-acne prone. Fair/cool/pink toned.
ReviewText_ko:
솔직히 말해서 차아염소산은 나에게 효과가 있을 수 없습니다. 주사비에 효과가 좋다고 생각되기 때문에 이상한 일입니다. 하지만 Tower 28이든 Amazon의 여러 브랜드이든 사용할 때마다 항상 피부가 팽팽해지고 장미증이 심해집니다. 그러므로, 당신이 그것을 작동시킬 수 없다면, 그것을 좋아하도록 강요하지 마십시오. 비록 당신 주변의 모든 사람들이 그것이 당신의 걱정을 가진 많은 사람들에게 도움이 되었기 때문에 당신이 그래야 한다고 말하더라도 말입니다. 

가격대비 패스입니다. 다른 브랜드와 웹사이트를 통해 더 적은 비용으로 더 많은 것을 얻을 수 있기 때문에 PR 브랜드에 가깝습니다. 

피부: 민감성, 주사비 1형, 복합성, 여드름이 발생하지 않는 피부. 페어/쿨/핑크 톤.

I tried many balms and creams that worked to some extent but they really only treated it at the surface level. It was a journey for many years trying to figure out what I could do. Within a week of trying the tester I went back and bought a large bottle to have on my shelf.  I noticed how much this was helping bring down the inflammation. There are obviously stills days where my skin has maybe a little redness or a small breakout due to life but I no longer have to cover my face with products. This product has become a staple and I no longer feel like I lost my skin.

I was diagnosed with papulopustular rosacea and NOTHING seemed to be helping. I’d read that this product could help with rosacea, so I decided to try it. I’ve only been using it for like 6 days (along with the serum at night), and it’s already making a HUGE difference without making my skin super dry or stripping the barrier. It’s brought the swelling and redness down, as well as decreasing the amount of pustules. I’m so glad I decided to try this product! I highly recommend it!

Title: Opposite of Calming

Used this product for a couple weeks, primarily after working out or the beach. I had not introduced any other new products into my routine. My skin got incredibly irritated and red to the point where even washing my face hurt. Took 4-5 days for my face to recover. I've read that overuse of hypochlorous acid can disrupt the skin's natural microbiome. Same with sodium chloride. Maybe it is best to only use occasionally for SOS emergencies as the name says...not every day.

Author: Elenberry
Title: Calming and Essential for Sensitive Skin
ReviewText: This spray has become a staple in my skincare routine because it’s one of the few products that instantly calms my skin when it feels irritated or reactive. The mist is super fine and evenly coats my face without drenching it, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any residue. I use it after cleansing and before serums, but it’s also amazing as a mid-day refresher when my skin feels stressed. It noticeably reduces redness within minutes and seems to help prevent small breakouts from getting worse. I also love that it’s fragrance-free and gentle enough to use multiple times a day. If you have sensitive, acne-prone, or easily irritated skin, this is one of those products that’s worth always having on hand.

Author: itsfi
Title: I get the hype now
ReviewText:
SKIN TYPE & CONCERNS: 
* Normal -to-dry / combo in summer
* Year-round - mild rosacea on cheeks, redness around nose, occasional clogged pores along jawline; slightly compromised skin barrier; dehydrated, sensitive skin 
* Summer - breakouts periodically on chin; enlarged pores on nose; excess sebum on lower T-zone

USAGE: 
* 5-6 days per week for almost 4+ weeks in a mild climate as part of evening skincare routine 
* Multiple times per day for almost a week in warm & humid setting & to hydrate skin in-flight to/from 

TL;DR: I never understood the hype with this product … until now. I purchased this when it first came out in 2019 & have received it as gratis on a few occasions since then, including a month ago. With first use, it just didn’t do anything, good or bad, to my skin. My skin has changed since I first tried this. To my surprise, it’s turned out to do a nice job keeping my skin clean, reducing redness, & helping to heal & soothe cuts & scrapes. 👍🏼

WHAT I LIKE: 
* Helps calm & soothe redness, in both milder & humid climates
* Good for sensitive skin 
* Lightly hydrating 
* Disinfecting / antibacterial properties with cuts & scrapes - I experienced some minor cuts & scrapes on my hands & legs while on vacay & spritzed this spray on those areas to keep them clean & speed up the healing process 
* Helped with managing / caring for a zit that surfaced while on vacay

AREA(S) FOR IMPROVEMENT: 
* Minor issue - wish it didn’t have the swimming pool scent

FYI:  
* I picked up a scent from this spray a few times (not every time), reminiscent of a swimming pool. It wasn’t too pronounced & did not linger but it was noticeable. 
* Seems like it’s better or best suited for those with oily, normal or combo skin. May not be great for those with very dry skin. 

BUY, BUY, BUY 🛍️ or BYE-BYE 👋🏼?:
* This is something I would use in the warmer months or if I’m traveling someplace with high humidity. BUY 🛍️
ReviewText_ko:
피부 타입 및 고민: 
* 여름에는 노멀-투-드라이/콤보
* 연중 - 뺨에 가벼운 장미증, 코 주위가 붉어짐, 가끔 턱선을 따라 모공이 막힘; 약간 손상된 피부 장벽; 탈수되고 민감한 피부 
* 여름 - 턱에 주기적으로 발진이 발생합니다. 코의 모공 확대; T존 하부의 과도한 피지

사용법: 
* 저녁 스킨케어 루틴의 일환으로 온화한 기후에서 거의 4주 동안 주당 5~6일 
* 따뜻하고 습한 환경에서 거의 일주일 동안 하루에 여러 번 & 기내에서 피부에 수분을 공급합니다. 

TL;DR: 저는 지금까지 이 제품의 과대광고를 이해하지 못했습니다. 저는 이 제품이 2019년에 처음 출시되었을 때 구매했고 그 이후로 한 달 전을 포함해 여러 차례 무료로 받았습니다. 처음 사용했을 때는 피부에 좋든 나쁘든 아무런 영향을 미치지 않았습니다. 처음 시도한 이후로 피부가 달라졌습니다. 놀랍게도 피부를 깨끗하게 유지하고 발적을 줄이며 상처와 긁힌 상처를 치유하고 진정시키는 데 도움이 되는 것으로 나타났습니다. 👍🏼

내가 좋아하는 것: 
* 온화하고 습한 기후 모두에서 붉은기를 진정시키고 진정시키는 데 도움이 됩니다.
*민감한 피부에 좋습니다 
* 가볍게 수분 공급 
* 베인 상처와 긁힌 자국에 대한 소독/항균 특성 - 휴가 중 손과 다리에 약간의 베인 상처와 긁힌 자국이 있었습니다. 청결을 유지하고 치유 과정을 가속화하기 위해 해당 부위에 이 스프레이를 뿌렸습니다. 
* 휴가 중 나타난 여드름 관리/관리에 도움을 주었습니다.

개선 분야: 
* 사소한 문제 - 수영장 냄새가 없었으면 좋았을 텐데요.

참고:  
* 나는 이 스프레이에서 수영장을 연상시키는 향기를 몇 번(매번은 아님) 맡았습니다. 너무 뚜렷하지도 않고 오래 머물지도 않았지만 눈에 띄었습니다. 
* 지성, 중성, 복합성 피부이신 분들에게 더 잘 맞을 것 같습니다. 피부가 많이 건조한 분들에게는 별로일 수도 있어요.

Author: v2mendez
Title: Skeptical, and PLEASANTLY SURPRISED!
ReviewText: Skeptical at first because I thought it would be one of those trendy skincare items that wouldn’t work for my skin type, but I’m so glad I purchased! I had been going through some congestion acne on my cheeks and chin (probably due to dirty pillowcases, phone, touching my face, makeup products, what have you) and I really thought it would never clear up. When one pimple was gone, another grew in its place. I consulted tiktok and my esthetician, and decided to buy the mini version as a trial. I added this to my routine am and pm; and carried the mini for a spritz on the go (especially for use after public bathrooms where you can’t close the toilet lid, because there isn’t any, before flushing 🤢). Within a week, I saw a decrease in redness, irritation, and the pimples started disappearing. It’s been about a month now, and it’s now a part of my every day routine. Especially useful for those lazy evening where my skincare routine is micellar water and a cotton round, using this spray afterwards has kept the breakouts at bay.

So lesson learned... if it ain't broke... etc.

Be forewarned that this clearly is not for everyone.

Title: Never discontinue this product
ReviewText:
I have been using this product for about four months now and it has done wonders for my skin.
Before bed and after waking up I spritz three sprays onto a cotton pad and dab it onto my face after cleansing. 

I have oily skin prone to breakouts and redness and I've seen a major difference in my complexion. I don't have redness anymore and aside from a monthly hormonal chin pimple, no more acne. I've used pretty much every product under the sun for acne and this has finally (almost completely) tamed it. 

I might be the only person in the world who actually likes the smell of chlorine so the smell doesn't bother me, but it might be a dealbreaker for others. 

This is a must-try for anyone with stubborn acne. Once my current bottle runs out I'll have to pick up one of the jumbo bottles.

저는 이 제품을 약 4개월 동안 사용해 왔으며 제 피부에 놀라운 효과를 주었습니다.
잠들기 전과 기상 후 화장솜에 3회 스프레이를 뿌리고 세안 후 얼굴에 두드려 발라줍니다. 

나는 지성 피부가 뾰루지나 붉어지기 쉬운 피부를 가지고 있는데 안색이 크게 달라진 것을 보았습니다. 나는 더 이상 붉어짐이 없으며 매월 발생하는 호르몬 턱 여드름을 제외하고는 더 이상 여드름이 없습니다. 나는 여드름 치료를 위해 햇빛 아래에서 거의 모든 제품을 사용해 왔고 이것이 마침내 (거의 완전히) 길들여졌습니다. 

나는 실제로 염소 냄새를 좋아해서 그 냄새가 나를 괴롭히지 않는 유일한 사람일 수도 있지만, 다른 사람들에게는 거래를 방해하는 것일 수도 있습니다.

Author: jaeeebaee
Title: Put down the pimple patches…
ReviewText:
Before purchasing this product, I was experiencing some minor breakouts throughout my face and wanted to try something new in my routine that would specifically target my acne. After making some research, I came across hypochlorous acid spray and read the benefits it provides for acne prone skin. After trying the mini size, I would say overall that I am not a fan of the smell but love the fast acting results. I see the reduction in redness in my face after one day of use and love the way it dried up my pimples over night, leaving them ready to heal and go away on its own.

If the results I keep experiencing continue to help with my acne, I will most definitely be buying a bigger bottle once I run out.

Author: TeriU
Title: Imagine charging 4x the amount for a basic formula
ReviewText:
I'm a big fan of hypochlorous acid sprays but this version by Tower 28 is ridiculously priced. I almost feel like this product is just a social experiment to see how many people are stupid enough to buy a basic no-frills HA spray marked up 4x.

Save yourself so much money and avoid. There are far too many other reasonably priced options on the market with a (literally) identical formulation.

저는 차아염소산 스프레이의 열렬한 팬이지만 Tower 28의 이 버전은 가격이 터무니없이 높습니다. 나는 이 제품이 얼마나 많은 사람들이 기본적이고 단순한 HA 스프레이를 4x로 표시할 만큼 어리석은지 알아보기 위한 사회적 실험인 것처럼 거의 느낍니다.

너무 많은 돈을 절약하고 피하십시오. 시장에는 (문자 그대로) 동일한 제제를 사용하는 합리적인 가격의 다른 옵션이 너무 많습니다.

Author: AriD67
Title: Eczema Miracle!
ReviewText:
This saved me and my eczema! Every single winter I get a patch of eczema right on the middle of my neck. It’s irritating, painful, and impossible to get rid of. On top of that, it’s very noticeable and makes me self conscious sometimes. It lasts from November through about April, almost half the year! I’ve tried almost every eczema product out there, and while some helped, none of them got rid of it, just made it look and feel slightly better. I heard about this and some people online saying that it helps with eczema. I decided to give it a try. I bought a bottle on Sunday. It’s now Wednesday. I’ve used it once every day since buying it and my eczema patch is almost completely gone! It’s just a faint spot now and I expect it to clear up completely in another day or so. I saw noticeable improvements the very next day and it’s gotten better every single day. This has seriously saved me! If you have eczema definitely give this a try. 

I’ll round out my review by saying that some people comment on the smell. The person who rang me up at Sephora also mentioned that some people don’t like the smell, just to prepare me. I honestly don’t think it’s that bad. It smells a little like bleach (not nearly as strong, just a faint hint of it), but it goes away after drying and doesn’t bother me. Granted, I’m using it on my neck and not on my face so that might have an impact on how intense it is for me. Either way, don’t let the smell scare you away if you feel like this product could really help you!

Author: Zaex
Title: Met My Expectations
ReviewText: First of all I want to say the size is perfect for on the go and minimal sized make-up bags. This was my first hypochlorous acid spray and it did exactly as described for me. Since then I’ve found lower priced versions from other companies with more product and I prefer to use those now. Hypochlorous acid is antimicrobial, antibacterial, and reduces inflammation so that’s what I used it for. Times when my skin felt irritated, itchy, and/or hot. Times when my face was super oily to the point where my eyes would burn after a long day. I’ve used it as a cleaner when I didn’t have hand sanitizer with me. I’ve used it if I had a cut. In all those instances it helped. What I’ve learned from dermatologists who make videos on YouTube is that this is great for irritation due to sweating (sometimes I’ve sprayed it on an irritated area, left it on for a little and wiped it off after). I also learned that if used too soon before or after other skincare products it can cause irritation. So to whoever decides to buy this, think of it as more of a gentle cleaner/refresher for your skin, face and body.

Author: alyssabub
Title: Awful and ruined my skin
ReviewText: I bought this the first time because it was a cheaper type of skin care product on Sephora. A lot of people rave about this product so I wanted to give it a try. For context I have dry normal sensitivity, and acne prone skin. I decided maybe a hypochlorous acid would be a good shot at curing my acne and random spots. That was a no because I used it the first time the first bottle and it broke me out at the time that I bought it. I also used new products so I figured maybe it could’ve been the other products I used and scrap them for my routine however I never tried them by themselves and just kept breaking my skin out more and more, I eventually got to the end of skincare products and probably should have figured out by now what broke me out, but I didn’t this time about a week ago with my mom and used it. The entire weekend made me feel clean because the scent behind it was good however, the more I realized that I was getting spots in places I’ve never had before Have acne prone, but I assumed maybe it was something more than just my hormones. I started reading into this product and why I could be breaking out because of it due to the fact that I wanted answers on why this product which was a saver for most wasn’t for me, then I have hormonal acne, and that sometimes skincare products that don’t go towards my type of acne won’t actually help it. This was a learning lesson for me and please know your type of sensitivity before hand. I think that tower 28 should help and advertise the packaging into a more suitable skin type and do put some warnings on the back or something, or maybe do a post online because people just have face breakouts and I would hate to see more people break out from a product that has been raved on online.￼

Author: aLeigh202
Title: New favorite in my routine!
ReviewText: As other reviews have noted, this does smell a bit like pool water. This scent quickly goes away, however, and I don't find it bothersome. This product has been a game changer in preventing and tackling breakouts in the humid summer heat and while masking (which always makes me break out near my mouth and nose). Make sure that you use this product BY ITSELF! Let it soak in (ideally for 30min) before applying other skincare, particularly actives, or you will neutralize the hypochlorous acid. Such a simple step that has really helped improve my skin without drying it out. This will be part of my routine moving forward!

ReviewText: I bought this to use for my underarms, as it's summer and I get very sweaty at work. This was recommended to me because it can be used for body odor, as it's antimicrobial. I thought maybe it was reacting with my antiperspirant (Dove), so I tried it on freshly clean underarms without any product, and I still smelled of body odor after using it. Author: krisclaire
Title: Unfortunately, a miss for me
ReviewText: I have sensitive, combination skin that is acne-prone, and this spray unfortunately does not work for me. Instead of calming my skin, this actually causes irritation and breakouts on my face. I know so many people LOVE this product, so I think this is still worth trying if you’re interested (because I suspect I’m in the minority for whom this does not work). I love the SOS cleanser for helping calm down dermatitis-like / eczema-like symptoms on my face, and I also consistently use the SOS moisturizer as my night cream—definitely recommend those Tower 28 products.

Author: chrgrsgrl
Title: Must Buy Always
ReviewText:
Honestly, I heard someone say, in passing, that it was good for breakouts. How? I don’t know. Is it really? Scientifically, I don’t know, but yes my hormonal chin/jaw breakouts have diminished since use. Bonus, it is also very refreshing. I spray before the actives in my skincare and let it dry down completely before applying. I also spray before moisturizer without letting it fully dry. I spray all day, mostly on my chin, but because it’s summer I will use it to refresh my face. 
I’m not sure if it will dry me out eventually because it seems to “dry” my acne…maybe? 
I can’t say. I just know I love it and I hope it works for everyone the same!
ReviewText_ko:
솔직히 지나가다가 트러블에 좋다는 말을 들었습니다. 어떻게? 모르겠습니다. 정말인가요? 과학적으로는 모르겠지만, 그렇습니다. 사용 후 호르몬에 의한 턱/턱 돌출이 줄어들었습니다. 보너스, 그것은 또한 매우 상쾌합니다. 스킨케어 제품을 바르기 전에 뿌리고 완전히 건조시킨 후 바르세요. 저는 보습제를 바르기 전에 완전히 건조시키지 않고 뿌립니다. 저는 하루종일 주로 턱에 뿌리는데, 여름이니까 얼굴을 상쾌하게 하는 용도로 사용하겠습니다. 
내 여드름을 "건조"시키는 것처럼 보이기 때문에 그것이 결국 나를 건조하게 만들 것인지 잘 모르겠습니다… 어쩌면? 
말할 수 없습니다. 나는 그것을 좋아한다는 것을 알고 있으며 그것이 모든 사람에게 동일하게 작용하기를 바랍니다!

Author: znbwgl
Title: Refreshing, and Unnecessary
ReviewText: While this product is refreshing, like you initially feel moisture misting directly into your pores, I think it's ultimately an inconsequential product with negligible "results" and an aroma reminiscent of your grandma's freshly bleached bathroom floor. Just extra plastic out in the world and an extra step that I don't think is necessary for anyone. However, maybe that's just me! My only skin challenges are redness and dryness, which this did nothing to alleviate. You could chock that up to diet, general health, et cetera - there's a variety of factors that contribute to your skins appearance/health that many don't consider when evaluating a dermatological product's success. It's all about the combo! But I can confidently say that this isn't critical to your regime. The *only* thing I can see this maybe being nice for is before/during/after a flight, but you can drink water for less money.

Title: Worth every penny
ReviewText: I used this product for 3 days so far and it’s been a life saver. To put into perspective, I’m currently pregnant and get hot and sweaty very quickly. Chest and body acne were not a big concern for me before, but now I’m breaking out all the time with small cystic like acne in clusters that dries up and leaves hyperpigmentation. Since using this spray on my chest and back, it has started to relieve some of the active acne. The moisturizer hopefully will lighten some of the acne scars over the next couple weeks but I can attest the spray really works to reduce redness and has kept the flare ups away as well as new pimples on the chest and back. Even if it’s meant for your face, it gets the job done.

When I let the spray dry then apply a barrier repair cream near my eye, I found the combo cleared up my light eye eczema within a week. There is a light chlorine smell but it fades. I did not have a reaction but if you're extra sensitive consider a wrist patch test for a day before trying. I tried the travel size first, then bought the value size to keep refilling it. When I'm traveling or sweaty I use it multiple times per day. When I'm just maintaining my skin I only use it every other day to reduce the risk of over drying. -- This wasn't an issue but one day I noticed my skin felt drier so I added this. Also make sure if you're using topical and hopefully sunscreen you read up on how to use them with this. Order matters from what I've seen derms post. Apologies for no before/after photos but my partner complimented my skin this week and I realized this was the difference.

Author: Amilaonaire
Title: Magic in a bottle
ReviewText:
I've attached photos but I have/had this really stubborn acne on my jaw/neck area for a while now that just WOULD NOT BUDGE. I used salicylic acid, glycolic acid, ALL of my tried and trues -- thing's I've done in the past and just KNOW work and nothing was working! I even use tretinoin on my face for acne, but when I'd put it on this region it made it super sensitive so I had to step back from that. 

I finally gave this spray a try and I'm genuinely blown away. In 24 hours my skin calmed down so much. The redness dissipated and I could finally see what exactly I was dealing with. It was really hard tiny pimples. I kept using this spray for a few more days and the actual acne is gone 99% at least and I'm only left with some hyperpigmentation which will go away with time and I will continue to use gentle exfoliating treatments for that (I'm not tripping about it). 

I just cannot express how grateful I am for hypochlorous acid lol THAT BEING SAID, yes you can definitely get this cheaper at the drugstore. I'm actually considering using what is left of this and getting a refill elsewhere.

Additionally, yes T28 may be overpricing this but I am grateful that they kind of put hypochlorous acid spray in the beauty market frfr. Like yes it existed but how many of us REALLY knew to reach for it for acne or redness? I know for a fact I didn't know and watching/reading things about it, it seems many didn't know either. 

I think the bottle for this spray is really nice. It mists very well and evenly. I'm keeping the bottle LOL 

It's also so gentle and not drying at all. I also DO use it with my other treatments. I use it with tretinoin. No issues.. I think you just have to let it dry before moving forward with your routine so requires some patience. 

Also, smells like pool water lol interesting scent but not "bad" by any means. 

For me: very effective, gentle acne and redness treatment. 10/10 would recommend and WILL repurchase.
ReviewText_ko:
사진을 첨부했지만 한동안 턱/목 부위에 정말 완고한 여드름이 생겨서 꿈쩍도 하지 않을 정도였습니다. 저는 살리실산, 글리콜산 등 제가 시도한 모든 것을 사용했습니다. 과거에 해본 일이고 단지 작동만 알고 있었지만 아무것도 작동하지 않았습니다! 나는 심지어 여드름 때문에 얼굴에 트레티노인을 사용하기도 하는데, 이 부위에 바르면 너무 민감해져서 그 부분에서 물러나야 했습니다. 

나는 마침내 이 스프레이를 시험해 보았고 진심으로 놀랐습니다. 24시간만에 피부가 너무 진정됐어요. 붉은기가 사라지고 마침내 내가 정확히 무엇을 다루고 있는지 알 수 있었습니다. 정말 작은 여드름이 났습니다. 나는 이 스프레이를 며칠 더 계속 사용했고 실제 여드름은 최소한 99% 사라졌으며 시간이 지나면 사라질 약간의 색소침착만 남았고 계속해서 부드러운 각질 제거 트리트먼트를 사용할 것입니다(나는 그것에 대해 넘어지지 않습니다). 

차아염소산에 대해 얼마나 감사한지 말로 표현할 수 없습니다. ㅋㅋㅋ 그렇게 말하면 네, 약국에서 확실히 더 저렴하게 구입할 수 있습니다. 실제로 남은 것을 사용하고 다른 곳에서 리필을 받는 것을 고려하고 있습니다.

또한, 예, T28이 이 제품의 가격을 너무 높게 책정했을 수도 있지만 미용 시장에 차아염소산 스프레이를 넣은 점에 감사드립니다. 예, 존재했지만 여드름이나 발적을 위해 그것을 사용하는 방법을 실제로 아는 사람은 몇 명입니까? 나는 내가 몰랐던 사실을 알고 있고 그것에 대해 보고/읽고 있는데 많은 사람들도 몰랐던 것 같다. 

이 스프레이 병은 정말 좋은 것 같아요. 아주 고르게 분사됩니다. 병은 내가 보관하고 있어 ㅋㅋㅋ 

게다가 너무 부드럽고 건조함도 전혀 없어요. 나는 또한 다른 치료법과 함께 그것을 사용합니다. 나는 트레티노인과 함께 사용합니다. 문제 없습니다.. 루틴을 진행하기 전에 건조시키기만 하면 된다고 생각하므로 인내심이 필요합니다. 

그리고 수영장 물 냄새도 나고 ㅋㅋ 흥미로운 향이지만 결코 "나쁜" 향은 아닙니다. 

나에게 있어서는 매우 효과적이고 부드러운 여드름 및 발적 치료입니다. 10/10은 추천하고 재구매할 것입니다.

Author: vannieee
Title: The only thing that has worked
ReviewText:
I’ve been struggling with mild-moderate hormonal acne my entire life. As I was about to give up hope on at-home treatments, I picked up a mini size of this product to try out. I’ll admit, I was nervous about the hypochlorous acid, but this product has COMPLETELY CLEARED my skin (yes, not even a period pimple in sight). 

With only 3 ingredients, this product is extremely gentle on my acne prone, barrier damaged, sensitive skin. It not only manages inflammation once a pimple has already popped up (like most “acne treatment” products do), but it PREVENTS the pimple from forming in the first place. 

Yes, it has a faint chlorine smell, but please do not let that deter you from trying this product out. Real products with real ingredients don’t smell like artificial flowers. It’s completely safe, highly effective, and the scent disappears instantly. 

P.S. I attached some before and after pics. Before was from December 2023/January 2024, at the peak of my latest flare. After was from yesterday, May 1st. I’ve been using the spray since April 7th.
ReviewText_ko:
저는 평생 동안 경미한 호르몬성 여드름으로 고생해 왔습니다. 재택치료에 대한 희망을 버리려던 중, 이 제품을 미니 사이즈로 구매하여 사용해보았습니다. 인정합니다. 차아염소산 때문에 긴장했지만 이 제품을 사용하면 피부가 완전히 깨끗해졌습니다(예, 생리 여드름도 보이지 않았습니다). 

단 3가지 성분으로 구성된 이 제품은 여드름이 나기 쉽고, 장벽이 손상되고, 민감한 피부에 매우 순합니다. 여드름이 이미 발생한 후에 염증을 관리할 뿐만 아니라(대부분의 "여드름 치료" 제품이 그러하듯이) 애초에 여드름이 형성되는 것을 예방합니다. 

예, 희미한 염소 냄새가 나지만 이 제품을 사용하는 것을 방해하지 마십시오. 진짜 성분을 사용한 진짜 제품은 인공 꽃 냄새가 나지 않습니다. 완전히 안전하고 효과가 뛰어나며 향이 즉시 사라집니다. 

추신 전후 사진 몇 장을 첨부했습니다. 이전에는 2023년 12월/2024년 1월이 가장 최근의 정점이었습니다. 이후는 5월 1일 어제였습니다. 저는 4월 7일부터 스프레이를 사용하고 있어요.

Author: MattiaFritse
Title: Damaged my barrier
ReviewText: Not to be dramatic, but this stuff is the devil. I purchased the travel size to treat a couple jaw pimples. Nothing major, mostly annoying and I thought I would try something low-rsk and new out. I have a paired down routine where I use tret at night a couple times a week, and Dieux Instant and Air Angel as well as Korean sunscreen (Purito). I used the spray twice; once after a shower and then before bed before my nightly routine. Yes, I let it dry down and didn't go crazy with it. My bottom lip swelled out with a pimple on my lip line, and I developed medium cysts on my lower face and jawline where the spray was concentrated. I then developed texture, redness and burning irritation that accompanies a damaged skin barrier over the next two days, although of course I didn't use the spray again. Moral of the story, as you can imagine, is PATCH TEST before using. Everything I read online indicated this would be safe for my skin. Jokes on me!

Author: haleyvvvv
Title: Nice for a special occasion
ReviewText:
Overall: good adherence, easy to use and provided brightening and some plumping and hydration

This is an intriguing product to use; I really enjoyed the idea that it's a gel sheet mask that can be (and is encouraged to be) worn overnight, which is great that I don't have to find 30 minutes for a sheet mask elsewhere in my schedule. Overall, it wore well, I woke up midway through the night and the mask had cleared, so I took it off then but the effects held until morning (last picture). I found the fit to be good and I used the little extra bits to try and cover what the mask didn't. 

I do think this provides more of a brightening than 'anti-aging' effect, which although it purports to also be brightening and hydrating, was geared to be more anti-aging, do I removed 1 star for that. It did provide a bit of plumping and hydration. I was worried that leaving it on overnight would potentially drag moisture back out of my skin but that didn't happen.

Good for a nice occasion the next day. A bit pricey for an everyday mask. I received discounted for review from Style Korean.
ReviewText_ko:

이것은 사용하기에 흥미로운 제품입니다. 밤새 착용할 수 있는(그리고 권장되는) 젤 시트 마스크라는 아이디어가 정말 마음에 들었습니다. 이는 일정 중 다른 곳에서 시트 마스크를 구입하기 위해 30분을 찾을 필요가 없다는 점이 좋습니다. 전체적으로 잘 붙고, 밤중에 자고 일어났더니 마스크가 지워져서 그때 벗었는데 아침까지 효과가 지속됐어요(마지막 사진). 나는 핏이 좋다고 생각했고 약간의 추가 비트를 사용하여 마스크가 덮지 못한 부분을 가려 보았습니다.

Author: erica209
Title: I bought this mask and it didn’t work for me
ReviewText: Honestly, in my experience this mask is horrible. Getting it on my face wasn’t easy or hard just annoying. After I got the mask on my face I felt tingling cool sensation. They after a while the tingling sensation turned into itchy and then burning sensation, that I had to remove the mask and rinse my face off. My face was left red and irritated. For the past days since using the mask I have horrible random white heads appear in places that I never get acne before. I just know in my experience the mask irritated my skin very badly. It also didn’t feel hydrating it just felt wet. After my experience I checked the ingredients of this mask in a skin care ingredient checker. I found 2 ingredients in the mask which is iris floritina root is an irritant and Rosa Damascena Flower Water can also cause irritation. So now I decide I should check ingredients now before purchasing products. I believe these ingredients caused irritation to my skin. Again this is my experience you may have a different one.

Author: lunar86
Title: Hydrated and Beautiful Skin!
ReviewText: I'm turning 40 shortly and as I get older, I'm looking for ways to help my skin stay looking as youthful as possible. I recently tried the Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask by Biodance. It is said to hydrate, perfect pores, and improve elasticity. I received this product as part of an educational promotion and couldn't wait to put it on! The mask is made of a highly concentrated ampoule solidified into a hydrogen mask. Just opening up the mask, you can immediately feel how amazing it's going to make your skin feel. Now Biodance suggests using the mask on clean skin after serum, so I did just that. Additionally, they suggest keeping on from 3-4 hours or overnight. I ended up taking it off after 3.5 hours. The mask felt very cooling and it did not ever irritate or bother my skin. My skin looked very hydrated and slightly more youthful after this one use. I even noticed my makeup application was much smoother afterwards. Although, I've only used once I will be re-purchasing this product as I loved how my skin looked and felt.

Author: jmt002
Title: Stays put!
ReviewText:
This is one mask that I can say has definitely made a swift and visible improvement in the appearance of my skin.  I have tried many face masks and typically don’t like hydrogel face masks as I find it difficult to keep them from sliding off my face.  Enter Biodance - I’m not sure what they do that’s different but this is the only hydrogel mask that didn’t slide once me. It’s a two piece mask that contains probiotics,  hyaluronic acid and collagen that claims to hydrate, reduce the appearance of pores and firm the skin.  The mask is meant to be worn overnight or for a minimum of 3 hours.  I wore the mask for 6 hours and after removing I can say that it definitely left my skin feeling hydrated and bouncy.  As far as reducing pores, I cannot say I saw any improvement, but overall I am still impressed with this mask.  Application was easy and once it’s not likely to slide off.  I will definitely plan on using this mask again.
This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

Author: daoma
Title: A real treat of a mask!
ReviewText:
My first time trying the Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask was quite an experience! The packaging made it a bit tricky to get out, and I quickly learned the mask itself is delicate – handle with care or it can rip. It comes in two pieces: one for the forehead/under eyes/nose and another for the chin/cheeks. The nose flap doesn't stay stuck to the nose, except to the bridge, but the rest of the mask doesn't move once applied.

When I applied it, it felt very cold for the first couple of hours, which was surprisingly refreshing. As it started to dry, it gradually turned clear, and I noticed a tighter sensation on my skin. I wore mine for 3.5 hours until it was completely transparent. You simply peel the mask off and throw it away when you're done! The technology behind this mask is incredibly cool and innovative; I love the idea of all those beneficial ingredients being absorbed directly into my skin as it dries. My skin felt super hydrated and looked plump and healthier afterward. While it's a bit pricey, the unique experience and noticeable results make it a good occasional treat for your skin! I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion.

Author: Kbeth88
Title: Get your glass skin on!
ReviewText:
I’ve tried my fair share of sheet masks over the years, but the Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask honestly stands out in a way that surprised me. I initially picked it up because of all the buzz around its “bio-collagen” technology and how it claims to deliver a spa-like treatment at home. After a few uses, I can confidently say it lives up to the hype — and then some. First, let’s talk fit and feel. This mask adheres to the face like a second skin — no slipping or air bubbles — which is rare. It’s made with this unique jelly-like material that feels ultra-soothing and cool the second you apply it. Unlike typical sheet masks that start drying out halfway through, this one stays moist and delivers a continuous surge of hydration. Now for the results: instant glow. Every time I’ve used it, my skin looks visibly plumper and smoother right after. Fine lines seem softer, and there’s this firm, bouncy feeling to my face that wasn’t there before. It’s like my skin got a tall glass of water and a collagen boost all at once. 
The only thing I’ll say is that it’s more of a treat than an everyday product, especially price-wise. But if your skin is feeling dull, dry, or tired — or if you just want to pamper yourself — this is 100% worth it. I now keep a few on hand for when my skin needs a serious boost.

내가 말할 유일한 것은 그것이 특히 가격면에서 일상적인 제품보다 더 큰 즐거움을 준다는 것입니다. 그러나 피부가 칙칙하고, 건조하고, 피곤하다고 느끼거나 단지 자신을 가꾸고 싶다면 이 제품을 사용하는 것이 100% 가치가 있습니다. 이제 피부에 심각한 활력이 필요할 때를 위해 몇 가지를 준비하고 있습니다.

Author: NoodleZ120
Title: Great hydration mask
ReviewText:
I had the chance to try the Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, and it was definitely an experience. The instructions say to leave it on your face for at least 3 to 4 hours, or even overnight. I didn’t want to risk messing it up or missing out on the full benefits while sleeping, so thankfully, since I work from home, I had no issue trying it out during the day.

I did my usual skin prep beforehand. At first glance, it seems like a typical sheet mask — all slimy and gooey — but the texture of this one reminded me of a super thin slice of Jell-O. It’s not as fragile as Jell-O, but I did accidentally tear it slightly with a nail. Fortunately, it didn’t affect the mask’s performance.

I liked that it comes in two parts, making it easier to fit different face shapes. There were leftover pieces for the eyes and mouth, which I placed under my boyfriend’s eyes and on the center of his forehead — surprisingly, it worked for all face sizes! I definitely felt like Dwight from The Office during the CPR training scene… IFYKYK.

Around the 2-hour mark, I noticed the mask slowly started changing color. By the 3-hour mark, about 95% of the essence had absorbed. Once fully absorbed, the mask felt like stretched-out plastic. The areas with overlap — and around one of my eyes — didn’t absorb quite as well, so I repositioned those sections for a bit longer.

After removing it, my skin felt super hydrated and glowing. I actually enjoyed the whole experience. I’d recommend saving this mask for a self-care day or an at-home spa session while binge-watching your favorite shows. I’d definitely repurchase and try their other masks.

This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

평소 피부관리를 미리 해두었어요. 언뜻 보면 끈적끈적하고 끈적끈적한 전형적인 시트 마스크처럼 보이지만, 이 마스크의 질감은 아주 얇은 젤로 조각을 연상시켰습니다. 젤로만큼 깨지지는 않지만 실수로 손톱으로 살짝 찢어졌네요. 다행히 마스크 성능에는 영향을 미치지 않았습니다.

두 부분으로 나누어져 있어 다양한 얼굴형에 맞춰 사용하기 편한 점이 마음에 들었습니다. 눈과 입 부분이 남아서 남자친구의 눈 아래와 이마 중앙에 배치했습니다. 놀랍게도 모든 얼굴 크기에 효과가 있었습니다! 심폐소생술 훈련 현장에서 나는 확실히 The Office의 Dwight가 된 듯한 느낌을 받았습니다… IFYKYK.

2시간쯤 지났을 때 마스크 색이 천천히 변하기 시작하는 것을 발견했습니다. 3시간이 지나면 에센스의 약 95%가 흡수됩니다. 완전히 흡수되면 마스크가 플라스틱이 늘어난 것처럼 느껴졌습니다. 겹치는 부분과 눈 주위 부분은 잘 흡수되지 않았기 때문에 해당 부분의 위치를 ​​조금 더 길게 조정했습니다.

제거하고 나면 피부가 매우 촉촉하고 윤기나는 느낌을 받았어요. 나는 실제로 전체 경험을 즐겼습니다. 자기 관리의 날이나 좋아하는 프로그램을 몰아서 시청하는 동안 집에서 스파 세션을 위해 이 마스크를 보관하는 것이 좋습니다. 나는 확실히 재구매하고 다른 마스크를 시험해 볼 것입니다.

본 상품은 프로모션 목적으로 제공받아 솔직하게 작성한 후기입니다.

Author: mash6
Title: Kept my skin hydrated after a long haul flight!
ReviewText: I have oily skin, and the Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask was a total game changer—especially while traveling, when my skin tends to get dehydrated and dull. The oligo-hyaluronic acid deeply hydrated without clogging my pores, and I noticed an immediate glow after just one use. I used it overnight, and by morning, my skin looked plump, dewy, and visibly smoother. The ultra-low molecular collagen really helped refine my pores and gave my face a firmer, more lifted appearance. I also love that it contains probiotics to strengthen the skin barrier—my skin felt more balanced and calm afterward. Best of all, it's gentle, fragrance-free, and didn’t cause any irritation. This is a new must-have in my skincare routine, especially after long flights or dry climates. Product was received as part of an educational promotion.

Author: Nightenbelle
Title: Great mask with great results
ReviewText: I love a relaxing mask to pamper myself after a hard day, who doesn't? I'm not always sure they do. . . anything other than relax me- but that's enough sometimes. And I rarely wear them longer than 15-30 minutes because I don't sit still well. However, I wanted to give this one its best possible chance to do more than just relax me. So I wore it the full time. And marveled as the color seeped out of the mask and into my skin. Once I removed the mask, my skin was dewey and glowy for a couple hours- even after the residual stuff dried. I checked the 5x mirror- and my pores were noticeably smaller. Even the next day- my skin was glowing and my pores were smaller- which made my make up look all the better for the job interview I had. Did this mask earn me my new job? Well I won't find out for a few more days- but I definitely felt more confident and relaxed because of it- so it gets 5 stars from me!!

Author: JennaKCr
Title: This a Must in your Skincare!!!
ReviewText:
Let me start by saying, I’ve never used a mask like this before, and I’m officially hooked.
The Biodance Collagen Real Deep Mask goes on like a second skin. It has a silicone-like texture that hugs your face in the best way. You can feel the serum, but it’s not dripping or sliding around. It stays put, which is a huge plus.
I wore it overnight (yep, all night), but honestly, after about an hour I could already feel it bonding to my skin. Not in a scary way,more like a snug glove. It just fit perfectly. By morning, it was completely clear and so satisfying to peel off. My skin? Plump, bouncy, glowing. Pores? Tight. Texture? Smooth. I couldn’t stop touching my face.
Living in Arizona, my skin is usually in a constant battle against dryness. But even after a full day at a waterpark in the sun, chlorine, heat. My face still felt hydrated and healthy. I normally get super dry, irritated patches from sun exposure, sometimes even flare-ups from eczema. This time? Just a little dryness around my nose. That’s it.
I’m not claiming this mask is a miracle cure, but it did what most products don’t: it actually made my skin feel protected, soothed, and nourished. And it made skincare fun. It’s rare I enjoy the process this much, but this mask? Total win.
Already adding more to my cart. This one’s a staple.

먼저 말씀드리자면, 저는 이런 마스크를 사용해 본 적이 없고, 공식적으로 푹 빠졌습니다.
바이오댄스 콜라겐 리얼 딥 마스크는 마치 제2의 피부처럼 지속됩니다. 실리콘 같은 질감이 얼굴에 가장 잘 밀착됩니다. 세럼이 느껴지긴 하지만 뚝뚝 떨어지거나 미끄러지지는 않습니다. 그대로 유지된다는 점이 큰 장점입니다.
밤새도록 착용했는데(네, 밤새도록) 솔직히 한 시간 정도 지나니 이미 피부에 밀착되는 느낌이 들었습니다. 무서운 방식이 아니라 꼭 맞는 장갑에 가깝습니다. 딱 딱 맞았네요. 아침에는 완전히 맑아져서 떼어내기에 너무 만족스러웠습니다. 내 피부? 통통하고 탄력 있고 빛납니다. 모공? 단단한. 조직? 매끄러운. 나는 얼굴을 만지는 것을 멈출 수 없었다.
애리조나에 살고 있는 제 피부는 대개 건조함과 끊임없이 싸우고 있습니다. 그러나 태양, 염소, 열기 속에서 워터파크에서 하루 종일 보낸 후에도 마찬가지입니다. 내 얼굴은 여전히 ​​​​수분과 건강한 느낌을 받았습니다. 나는 일반적으로 햇빛 노출로 인해 매우 건조하고 자극받은 반점이 생기고 때로는 습진으로 인해 갑자기 발진이 생기기도 합니다. 이번에는? 코 주변이 살짝 건조하네요. 그게 다야.
나는 이 마스크가 기적의 치료법이라고 주장하는 것이 아니지만 대부분의 제품이 하지 않는 일을 했습니다. 실제로 피부가 보호되고, 진정되고, 영양이 공급되는 느낌을 받았습니다. 그리고 그것은 스킨케어를 재미있게 만들었습니다. 이렇게 과정을 즐기는 경우는 흔치 않은데, 이 마스크는요? 총 승리.
이미 내 장바구니에 더 많은 것을 추가했습니다. 이것은 필수품입니다.

Author: SpiffyTiffys
Title: Powerful moisturizing mask
ReviewText:
As I get older, dryness is becoming one of the major issues when it comes to my skin. So I’m constantly on the lookout for products that pack a powerful moisturizing punch while addressing any fine lines and wrinkles. The Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask checks all of those boxes. The oligo-hyaluronic acid penetrates deep into the layers of the skin to provide superior moisturizing effects along with ultra low molecular collagen to maximize absorption, minimize the appearance of pores, and boost skins elasticity. 
I’m a huge fan of sheet masks and use them regularly. But this one is different. After my regular evening skin care routine, I applied the mask to my face. Unlike other sheet masks, I didn’t have to make cuts to mask to get it to form to my face around my nose and eyes. I left it on overnight while I slept and woke up to glowing, glassy skin that felt deeply moisturized for several days after using it. I will definitely be adding these to my regular skincare stash.

Title: Great hydration and glow boost
ReviewText: I tried the Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask from Biodance for the first time and was honestly impressed with how it made my skin feel. The sheet was soft, gentle, and fit my face without slipping at all. I left it on for three full hours until the mask became transparent. My skin felt instantly more hydrated, smoother, and calm. The hyaluronic acid added deep moisture, niacinamide helped brighten my overall tone, and the collagen made my skin feel slightly firmer and more plump. There was plenty of essence in the mask, and it absorbed nicely without any sticky residue. Even though I’ve only used it once, I noticed a healthy glow afterward. I’m looking forward to using it more often and seeing how my skin improves over time. So far, I’m very happy.

Author: ABmagic
Title: Good but not great
ReviewText:
This mask provides deep hydration and leaves your skin feeling soft and supple while delivering an even, glowy complexion. However, the product is difficult to apply, falls apart during use, and doesn’t fully deliver on pore minimization.

What I loved:
	•	The product offers some comfort and relaxation during use.
	•	The hydration effects were noticeable even after one use.
	•	My face felt plumper, glowy, and soft afterward.

What could be improved:
	•	Applying the product is cumbersome, and my mask ripped in multiple places during application.
	•	The mask doesn’t sit well on the face, even during minimal movement. It peeled at the edges and never felt secure.
	•	While the instructions suggest overnight wear is possible, I’m highly skeptical it would stay on for more than twenty minutes or through normal sleep movements.
	•	The effects didn’t fully live up to the hype, especially regarding pore minimization.
	•	The mask barely lasts three hours before falling apart, although the instructions recommend 3–4 hours for full benefits.

Ultimately, the mask does deliver deep hydration and can be a nice way to feel pampered if you’re lounging for a few hours, but it earns 3.5 stars at most. The delicacy and effort required to apply and maintain the mask on your face aren’t justified by the results.

However, I would still recommend it to anyone looking for a megadose of hydration during a lengthy movie or TV marathon, provided you’re prepared to handle it carefully and manage your expectations.

Author: BellaNaka
Title: Deep Hydration Mask for Glass-Like skin 👌🏼
ReviewText:
If you’re looking for a deeply hydrating mask that actually feels like it’s doing something, this is it. The Biodance Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask surprised me in the best way.

Right out of the pouch, the mask feels jelly-like and very saturated. It’s not your average sheet mask, it’s made from a solidified ampoule that forms a hydrogel, which means it adheres closely to the skin and stays in place. It comes in two pieces (top and bottom), so it fits the face better than most masks I’ve tried.

After cleansing and toning my skin, I applied the mask and left it on for nearly 4 hours while doing things around the house. Over time, the mask turned transparent, indicating that the ingredients were being absorbed into my skin. Once I removed it, my skin felt incredibly soft, plump, and hydrated. The glow was immediate, and my face looked noticeably smoother.

There was no sticky residue, no irritation, and I didn’t even feel like I needed to apply moisturizer afterward. My pores looked more refined, and my skin tone appeared more even and refreshed.

What makes this mask stand out is its use of ultra-low molecular weight collagen (243Da) and hyaluronic acid (500Da), which allow the ingredients to penetrate deeply for maximum hydration and elasticity. It also includes Galactomyces Ferment Filtrate, Niacinamide, Adenosine, and a blend of soothing botanical extracts like aloe, melon, green tea, and fig.

Additional pros:
	•	Fragrance-free
	•	Paraben-free
	•	Non-comedogenic
	•	No animal testing

Pro tip: Use it at night and leave it on for at least 3 to 4 hours, or overnight for even better results.

Overall, this mask delivered exactly what it promised hydration, pore refinement, and improved elasticity. I’ll definitely repurchase and recommend it to anyone needing a serious skin reset. It feels like an at-home spa treatment in one packet.
ReviewText_ko:
실제로 뭔가 효과가 있는 듯한 촉촉한 수분 마스크를 찾고 있다면 바로 이 마스크입니다. 바이오댄스 바이오 콜라겐 리얼 딥 마스크는 가장 좋은 방법으로 저를 놀라게 했습니다.

파우치에서 꺼내자마자 마스크는 젤리 같은 느낌이 들고 매우 촉촉합니다. 일반적인 시트 마스크가 아닌, 하이드로겔 형태의 고체 앰플로 만들어져 피부에 밀착되어 자리를 유지해줍니다. 두 조각(상단과 하단)으로 구성되어 있어 제가 사용해 본 대부분의 마스크보다 얼굴에 더 잘 맞습니다.

클렌징과 토너로 피부결을 정돈한 후 마스크를 바르고 4시간 정도 방치하면서 집안일을 했습니다. 시간이 지나면서 마스크가 투명해지면서 성분이 피부에 잘 흡수되는 것 같았어요. 일단 제거하고 나면 피부가 믿을 수 없을 정도로 부드럽고 통통하며 수분을 공급받는 느낌을 받았습니다. 빛이 즉각적으로 나타났고, 내 얼굴이 눈에 띄게 매끄러워 보였습니다.

끈적임도 없었고, 자극도 없었으며, 사용 후 보습제를 바르고 싶은 느낌도 없었습니다. 모공이 더욱 정돈되어 보였고, 피부톤도 더욱 균일하고 산뜻해 보였습니다.

이 마스크의 특징은 초저분자 콜라겐(243Da)과 히알루론산(500Da)을 사용해 성분이 깊숙이 침투해 수분과 탄력을 극대화했다는 점이다. 또한 갈락토미세스 발효 여과물, 나이아신아마이드, 아데노신 및 알로에, 멜론, 녹차, 무화과와 같은 진정 식물 추출물의 혼합물이 포함되어 있습니다.

추가 장점:
	• 무향료
	• 파라벤 무첨가
	• 논코메도제닉
	• 동물 실험 금지

전문가 팁: 밤에 사용하고 최소 3~4시간 동안 그대로 두거나 더 나은 결과를 얻으려면 하룻밤 동안 그대로 두세요.

전반적으로 이 마스크는 수분 공급, 모공 개선, 탄력 개선을 약속한 그대로 전달했습니다. 나는 확실히 재구매하고 심각한 피부 재설정이 필요한 사람에게 추천할 것입니다. 한 봉지로 집에서 스파 트리트먼트를 받는 듯한 느낌을 받을 수 있습니다.

Author: ModelPatience
Title: A Must-Have Mask For Anyone Serious About Skincare
ReviewText:
As someone who’s constantly testing new skincare products, I’m always skeptical of anything that promises instant results. But after trying the Bio-Collagen Deep Mask for Pore Minimizing and Firming, I can confidently say-this one lives up to the hype. From the moment I applied the mask, I noticed how generously soaked it was in serum. The texture felt soothing and luxurious, and it stayed perfectly in place throughout my 20-minute masking session (no slipping = major bonus!). It gave me that “spa at home” feeling, which I love after a long day.

What truly impressed me were the results—visible even after one use. My pores looked noticeably smaller, especially around my T-zone, and my skin felt firmer and deeply hydrated. There was a soft, healthy glow I usually only get after a facial.

The formula is rich in bio-collagen, niacinamide, and skin-loving botanical extracts—all ingredients my skin reacts well to. I’ve now incorporated it into my weekly skincare ritual, and my skin texture has never been smoother.

Whether you’re prepping for a big event or just want to treat your skin, this mask delivers on every front. It’s gentle, effective, and gives that plump, pore-less look we’re all after.
ReviewText_ko:
끊임없이 새로운 스킨케어 제품을 테스트하는 사람으로서 저는 즉각적인 결과를 약속하는 제품에 대해 항상 회의적입니다. 하지만 모공 축소 및 탄력 강화를 위한 바이오 콜라겐 딥 마스크를 사용해 본 후에는 이 제품이 과대 광고에 부응한다고 자신있게 말할 수 있습니다. 마스크를 바르는 순간부터 세럼에 듬뿍 스며드는 느낌이 들었어요. 질감은 차분하고 고급스러운 느낌을 주었으며 20분 동안의 마스킹 세션 동안 완벽하게 제자리에 유지되었습니다(미끄러짐 없음 = 큰 보너스!). 그것은 나에게 긴 하루를 보낸 후 좋아하는 "집에서의 스파" 느낌을 주었습니다.

정말 인상 깊었던 점은 한 번 사용한 후에도 눈에 띄는 결과였습니다. 특히 T존 주변의 모공이 눈에 띄게 작아졌고, 피부가 더욱 탄탄해지고 깊은 수분을 공급받는 느낌을 받았습니다. 부드럽고 건강한 빛이 나는데, 보통 페이셜 후에만 얻을 수 있습니다.

Author: Ancily
Title: Refresh and reboot your skin
ReviewText:
This mask exceeded my expectations. It is my first time using a deep mask that had to be kept on for 3 to 4 hours. But it was worth it. I put it on after cleansing my skin. I kept it on for 4 hours. It feels nice, soft, and cool on the face. Unlike other masks I have used before, this mask stays in place. After 2 hours, I could see it starting to turn transparent. This mask is really a great way to pamper yourself. 

I personally felt that adding this step to my skincare routine felt relaxing. Once it was 4 hours, the mask was completely translucent. I was so excited to see the result when it was time to take it off. And I was not disappointed. It left my skin feeling refreshed and moisturized. It gives a nice glow and tone. I feel that this mask is great for prepping the skin if you look tired and have an event to attend or if you just want to look your best after a busy and tiring day, of course given you have a few hours in between. The change it not drastic right upon taking the mask off but is visible. 

And I feel that once you finish your skincare routine by adding a serum and moisturizer, it is even more obvious. It feels like the mask's effect is long lasting and works way beyond after having removed it. I loved how this mask deeply hydrated my face and made it look fresh and dewy. It is a product I want to add to my skincare routine a few times a week.

I received this product for promotional purposes, in exchange for my honest feedback.

이 마스크는 내 기대를 뛰어 넘었습니다. 3~4시간 동안 붙이고 있어야 하는 딥마스크를 처음 써보는데요. 그러나 그것은 그만한 가치가 있었습니다. 피부결 정돈 후 바르고 있어요. 4시간 동안 계속 켜두었어요. 얼굴에 닿는 느낌이 좋고 부드럽고 시원합니다. 이전에 사용했던 다른 마스크와 달리 이 마스크는 제자리에 고정됩니다. 2시간쯤 지나니 투명해지기 시작하는 걸 볼 수 있었어요. 이 마스크는 정말 자신을 가꾸는 좋은 방법입니다. 

저는 개인적으로 스킨케어 루틴에 이 단계를 추가하면 마음이 편안해지는 느낌을 받았습니다. 4시간이 지나면 마스크가 완전히 반투명해졌습니다. 떼어낼 시간이 되었을 때 결과를 보고 너무 기뻤습니다. 그리고 나는 실망하지 않았습니다. 피부가 상쾌하고 촉촉해지는 느낌을 받았어요. 좋은 빛과 톤을 제공합니다. 피곤해 보이고 참석할 행사가 있거나 바쁘고 피곤한 하루를 보낸 후, 물론 그 사이에 몇 시간의 시간이 있다는 점을 감안할 때 가장 멋진 모습을 보이고 싶을 때 이 마스크가 피부를 준비하는 데 아주 좋다고 생각합니다. 마스크를 벗은 순간에는 급격한 변화는 아니지만 눈에 띄게 나타납니다. 

그리고 세럼과 모이스처라이저를 추가하여 스킨케어 루틴을 마무리하고 나면 그 느낌이 더욱 확연해지는 것 같아요. 마스크 효과가 오래 지속되고 마스크를 제거한 후에도 효과가 훨씬 더 좋은 것 같습니다. 나는 이 마스크가 내 얼굴에 깊은 수분을 공급하여 신선하고 이슬처럼 보이게 만드는 방식을 좋아했습니다. 일주일에 몇 번씩 스킨케어 루틴에 추가하고 싶은 제품이에요.

나는 솔직한 피드백을 대가로 프로모션 목적으로 이 제품을 받았습니다.
text_for_model: This mask exceeded my expectations. It is my first time using a deep mask that had to be kept on for 3 to 4 hours. But it was worth it. I put it on after cleansing my skin. I kept it on for 4 hours. It feels nice, soft, and cool on the face. Unlike other masks I have used before, this mask stays in place. After 2 hours, I could see it starting to turn transparent. This mask is really a great way to pamper yourself. I personally felt that adding this step to my skincare routine felt relaxing. Once it was 4 hours, the mask was completely translucent. I was so excited to see the result when it was time to take it off. And I was not disappointed. It left my skin feeling refreshed and moisturized. It gives a nice glow and tone. I feel that this mask is great for prepping the skin if you look tired and have an event to attend or if you just want to look your best after a busy and tiring day, of course given you have a few hours in between. The change it not drastic right upon taking the mask off but is visible. And I feel that once you finish your skincare routine by adding a serum and moisturizer, it is even more obvious. It feels like the mask's effect is long lasting and works way beyond after having removed it. I loved how this mask deeply hydrated my face and made it look fresh and dewy. It is a product I want to add to my skincare routine a few times a week. I received this product for promotional purposes, in exchange for my honest feedback.

Author: MariMiles
Title: Nothing spectacular
ReviewText: I received this mask in exchange for my honest review. I am a big fan of facial masks bur this one really disappointed me. It is very flimsy and it breaks easily when I was trying it to apply it. The instructions said I should keep it for at least three , four hours, but after about twenty minutes it was already getting dry. The results are neutral, my skin wasn’t dry nor hydrated. Waste of time. The nice thing is that it did feel good on my skin, soothing and cooling.

Author: DreamBright49
Title: A neat experience & a nice treat
ReviewText:
Biodance Collagen Real Deep Mask is a nice treat with a neat application. The mask is made of a soft jelly that goes from white to clear after three hours as it absorbs. The adherence and placement is a bit tricky at first as the softer material does rip with too much manipulation. However, it’s also easy to stretch to fit a larger area. I have a large face and it did nearly completely fit mine. The nose bridge area fit the least and might be cut to fit. After the mask set, which did not take that long (five minutes?), I watched a two hour movie without issue of it falling off. However, I did not easily eat or drink (the mask slid around then). 

During the three hours I had the mask on, I experienced a slight tingle. Maybe due to the niacinamide? It went away. The mask became more taut. And when I peeled the mask off, my skin looked radiant and had a plump firmness similar to how my skin feels after using a peptide serum (although there are no peptides in this mask). Good results, though not miracle working as I do still see wrinkle lines (brow furrowed) and such. 

I missed the step to apply toner or serum before the mask, which might make a difference. 

I’m glad I tried this product. I don’t think it’s an essential, but I had a good experience. However, my skin did start to redden after first use. So please test run before using on an important date. 

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review.]
ReviewText_ko:
바이오댄스 콜라겐 리얼 딥 마스크는 깔끔하게 바르기 좋은 제품입니다. 마스크는 부드러운 젤리로 구성되어 있으며, 흡수되면서 3시간이 지나면 흰색에서 투명하게 변합니다. 부드러운 소재는 너무 많이 조작하면 찢어지기 때문에 접착과 배치가 처음에는 약간 까다롭습니다. 그러나 더 넓은 영역에 맞게 늘리는 것도 쉽습니다. 제가 얼굴이 큰 편인데 거의 딱 맞더라구요. 콧대 부분이 가장 적게 맞으며 딱 맞게 잘라질 수도 있습니다. 그리 오랜 시간(5분?)도 걸리지 않은 마스크셋팅 후 2시간 동안 영화를 흐트러짐 문제 없이 봤습니다. 그러나 나는 쉽게 먹거나 마시지 않았다(그때 마스크가 미끄러졌다). 

마스크를 착용하고 있는 3시간 동안 약간의 따끔거림을 느꼈습니다. 나이아신아마이드 때문일까요? 그것은 사라졌습니다. 마스크가 더욱 팽팽해졌습니다. 그리고 마스크를 떼어냈을 때, 피부가 광채가 나고 펩타이드 세럼을 사용한 피부와 비슷하게 탱탱한 탄력이 느껴졌습니다. (이 마스크에는 펩타이드가 없지만) 좋은 결과는 있지만 기적은 아니지만 여전히 주름살(눈썹 주름) 등이 보입니다. 

마스크 전 토너나 세럼을 바르는 단계를 놓쳤는데, 조금 차이가 날 수도 있겠네요. 

이 제품을 사용해 보니 기쁘네요. 필수는 아닌 것 같지만 좋은 경험을 했습니다. 그런데 처음 사용 후 피부가 붉어지기 시작했어요. 따라서 중요한 날짜에 사용하기 전에 테스트 실행을 하시기 바랍니다. 

[본 상품은 제공받아 솔직하게 작성한 후기입니다.]

Highly recommend to leave on as long as possible to absorb all the serum. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

Author: Glorybsan
Title: Glow Up Goodness
ReviewText:
The Biodance Bio Collagen -Real Deep Mask is an awesome sheet mask that delivers on its promise of intense hydration, firmer feel, and radiant complexion—thanks to its smart formulation combining collagen peptides, oligo‑hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and galactomyces. Ideal for a once- to thrice-weekly overnight treatment to nourish the skin and give it a boost.

If you’re looking for a no-fuss, powerful hydrator that tightens and brightens overnight, this mask is a standout.  I used my mask overnight and woke up to feeling my skin soft and with a glow. As a tired mama, I LOVE how my skin felt juicy, bouncy, and refreshed by morning.
It’s like sleep + skincare therapy in one.
This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review

수면 + 스킨케어 테라피를 하나로 합친 것과 같습니다.

Title: Not the Same Anymore
ReviewText: I used to really love the Biodance Collagen Mask, but unfortunately, it’s just not the same anymore. The formula and experience feel downgraded compared to what I remember. One of the most frustrating things is how fragile the sheet has become — it’s so thin that it’s incredibly easy to tear, and I accidentally made holes just trying to adjust it with my nails. For a product marketed as premium, that’s honestly ridiculous. I still enjoy the ritual of leaving it on until it turns transparent — that’s a unique touch that feels luxurious and calming. And yes, it does give a temporary glow and hydration boost. But overall, it lacks the substance and results it once had. My skin didn’t feel as plump or firm afterward, and I was left underwhelmed. It’s no longer a staple for me, and there are other collagen masks that perform better and feel higher quality.

Title: A nice mask
ReviewText: This mask is nice the packaging is a nice color and it’s simple. I like that it feels like it has texture. Taking the mask out tha package was not that easy because I had to take off multiple layers or wrapping and then it was split into two parts so you had to make sure that you are lining it up properly on your face. I was surprised that you had to leave it on so long but I wanted to get the full effect.  I did notice that the mask rips easily but there was a cooling affect to it as well. The mask coming off your face was pretty easy. The results are a more moisturizing and tight feeling but you do get a shine on your face. I think that I might try it again but I wouldn’t mind using the one that has a multipack so that I can use it another time.

Author: MrsNeida03
Title: Very delicate mask, but amazingly hydrating.
ReviewText:
I did like this Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask because it is incredibly hydrating and soothing, too. It’s really saturated, so it felt cool and refreshing as soon as I placed it on my skin. I used it during the day and left it on until it turned clear, as recommended. After removing it, my skin did look more radiant, felt smoother, and definitely more hydrated. There was a noticeable "glow".
The only downside for me was how delicate the mask was, it actually tore in a few spots while I was applying it, which was a little frustrating. I was able to fix it and still enjoyed the results, but I do wish the material was a bit firmer. Despite that problem, the glow and hydration it delivered do make it a great choice for a face refreshing session.

text_for_model: I did like this Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask because it is incredibly hydrating and soothing, too. It’s really saturated, so it felt cool and refreshing as soon as I placed it on my skin. I used it during the day and left it on until it turned clear, as recommended. After removing it, my skin did look more radiant, felt smoother, and definitely more hydrated. There was a noticeable "glow". The only downside for me was how delicate the mask was, it actually tore in a few spots while I was applying it, which was a little frustrating. I was able to fix it and still enjoyed the results, but I do wish the material was a bit firmer. Despite that problem, the glow and hydration it delivered do make it a great choice for a face refreshing session.

Author: HannahEZ
Title: Amazed!
ReviewText:

Author: danicerulli
Title: Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask
ReviewText:
I was genuinely impressed with the Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask. From the moment I applied it, my skin felt instantly soothed and deeply hydrated. After removing it, my face looked visibly plumper, smoother, and had that fresh post-facial glow. The mask is drenched in essence and fits snugly to the skin without sliding, which makes it perfect for relaxing while it works its magic. I also noticed my skin looked calmer and less irritated afterward. My only complaint is that the material is a bit delicate—it can tear easily if you’re not careful unfolding it. But honestly, the results are worth the extra care. This mask has earned a spot in my self-care routine and is great for travel or event prep when my skin needs to look its best.
This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

Author: cathyminhtam
Title: Highly recommend
ReviewText:
My skin type is oily plus large pore and dehydrated, so I try to apply mask twice a week to soothe my skin as routine.
First I like the pink packet of the single mask. It was easy to tear off and got the whole mask out. There are two different as half for top face and the rest for full coverage the wide cheek area. 
The mask was like milky jelly. The scent was really relaxing. All my masks are put inside the refrigerator so the skin felt really cool when the jelly mask touched on my face. I left it on for 10 minutes and then I rinsed off with water. I could feel the skin was tightened and smoother and it was easy to rinse without greasy. My skin was not irritated. 
This mask contains 234 Dalton ultra-low molecular collagen, which deeply absorbs to tighten pores and boost elasticity. It’s 20,000-times smaller than a strand of hair, ensuring better skin absorptio. That’s why I could see the result immediately for first trial. The price is reasonable so highly recommend.

** This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

Author: JmeJinxx
Title: Fragile but enjoy the results!
ReviewText: I have been so curious about the Biodance sheet masks since they went super viral a little bit ago. I'm already a long-time sheet mask lover and use them on a weekly basis. This Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask is a two-piece hydrogel mask that fits and clings to the skin very well. Firstly, these masks should be handled with the gentlest touch because the hydrogel is very fragile. I accidentally nicked a spot with a fingernail as I was unfolding it from the packaging and it started ripping apart. For the cost per use, I'm a bit annoyed about it. That flaw aside, the mask does a great job adding hydration to my skin and my face was left super radiant, plump, and smooth afterwards. I wouldn't necessarily reach for them all the time, but these would be particularly great before a special event as an extra nourishing skin treatment.

Title: Glowy Skin
ReviewText: I've been using this Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask by Biodance for a few weeks  now . It's my go to mask when I need extra hydration and glowy skin. It's super hydrating ,moisturizing to the skin and firming . This is also great for anyone who is looking for an anti aging mask , with the bio collagen , it helps reduce the appearance of wrinkles and fine lines. I personally use this mask at night and keeping it on til the next morning . Your skin will feel visibly radiant the next day , less visible pores and a smoother complexion . Author: ugcvalerie
ReviewText:
The hype is real! I was thrilled to finally get my hands on this face mask. I am huge into Asian beauty products due to their hydrating and soothing nature. I’ve tried probably hundreds of face masks at this point! This Biodance mask absolutely exceeds my high expectations! 

The mask itself has pieces for your upper and lower face which is very helpful and will help fit varying face shapes easier. It fit my face very well. It’s slippery when first applying, but once it starts to soak in a little you can move around with it more and not be so careful about trying to keep it on. This is important because you should keep it on for at least three hours for maximum results! The texture is refreshing. 

I used this for three hours until it turned clear. My skin was left so dewy and glass like. After using, it looks like I just got out of a facial! I absolutely will be using this before special events, or when my skin is in desperate need of rejuvenation. This is one of those holy grail products that you just cannot find elsewhere.

Title: My must have
ReviewText: As a makeup artist, I’m constantly searching for skincare that not only nourishes but also preps the skin perfectly for makeup — and the BIODANCE mask has exceeded my expectations. The hydrogel texture adheres beautifully to the skin, delivering an immediate cooling and calming sensation. After just one use, the skin feels deeply hydrated, soothed, and noticeably firmer. Redness is reduced, pores look minimized, and the surface becomes smoother — making foundation glide on effortlessly and look more natural. It’s the kind of product I reach for before important shoots, clients, or events when I need skin to look healthy, radiant, and well-rested. I also appreciate how gentle it is — even on sensitive or post-procedure skin. BIODANCE has officially become a staple in my professional kit.

Author: HairByLeanaK
Title: This is an absolute must have!
ReviewText: This is an absolute must have! I was a bit leery when I first read the package saying that is best if this is worn overnight. But the awkwardness was well worth it. I put the mask on about an hour before bed and  that was plenty of time for is to adhere to my face well and not slip around then I laid down. I will say it is a little slippery when taking it out of the package and it did tear in a small spot  but other than that the application was simple. I like that it was in two separate pieces. It made it much easier to smooth it down around my eyes, nose and mouth. It seems like it is very think and slippery and will not stay put if you sleep with it on, but as time passes is begins to tighten and adheres nicely to your face. It is an opaque white when you first out it on and by morning it is clear. If you opt not to sleep with it on, it  is ready to be removed once it is clear. The next morning, my skin felt amazing. It was soft and supple and gave me an amazing glow. I used this before taking a 6 hour road trip and my skin looked just as good when I arrive at my destination as it did when I first removed the mask. I am going to be stocking up on these and they will make a nice treat to share with friends for a little pick me up.

I will say it is a little slippery when taking it out of the package and it did tear in a small spot but other than that the application was simple. I like that it was in two separate pieces. It made it much easier to smooth it down around my eyes, nose and mouth. It seems like it is very think and slippery and will not stay put if you sleep with it on, but as time passes is begins to tighten and adheres nicely to your face. It is an opaque white when you first out it on and by morning it is clear. If you opt not to sleep with it on, it is ready to be removed once it is clear. The next morning, my skin felt amazing. It was soft and supple and gave me an amazing glow. I used this before taking a 6 hour road trip and my skin looked just as good when I arrive at my destination as it did when I first removed the mask. I am going to be stocking up on these and they will make a nice treat to share with friends for a little pick me up.

Author: eeranehh
ReviewText:
My initial impression of the mask was how hydrating it felt. The material of the mask immediately felt cooling and hydrating. The application of the mask was pretty straight forward and easy. The instructions states to leave the mask on until it is completely translucent or about 3-4 hours. It stays on the face nicely and doesn't slide around which makes it easy to leave it on and forget about it. Surprisingly, the mask for me actually dried a lot faster than the time mentioned which was about 2 hours. After the taking off the mask my skin felt hydrated and plump. I, also, noticed an improvement to my texture and the size of my pores. Although, I didn't feel that the effect lasted very long. I'd love to incorporate this mask into my weekly routine and see what the long term benefits could be. 
I received this mask as part of a promotion for my honest review.

Author: Zombiecats32
Title: Wow
ReviewText:
This mask SUCH a great sheet mask for anyone wanting to feel luxurious and make their skin look and feel supple. Super inexpensive and such a nice add on to your skin care routine for an extra bit of hydration. Sheet masks are the best for this purpose because they hold the concentrated serum in so your skin can have optimal absorption.  After cleansing my skin at night, I apply my regular toner and let that absorb. Then I use the Biodance sheet mask to really seal in the hydration and give me a firmer look and feel to my skin. I do prefer to wear them overnight (or as long as possible into sleeping!) so I can make sure to get all the benefits of this mask! Its lightweight, fast-absorbing texture instantly melts into the skin, providing deep hydration without feeling greasy or heavy. From the very first applications, I noticed my skin looked smoother, more supple, and refreshed. And my pores are minimized
 
This product was received as part of an educational promotion.

Author: marylinchicago
Title: A must-have for glowy and makeup-free skin
ReviewText: I can confidently say the Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask left a lasting impression. I applied it for four full hours, during which I simply lay down, relaxed, and watched my favorite TV series. Once I removed the mask, my skin felt intensely hydrated, plump, and incredibly soft - almost as if I had just left a professional facial appointment. The transformation was so significant that I didn’t feel the need to apply any makeup or foundation for the next two days. My skin felt pampered and rejuvenated. I’ve now committed to using this mask at least once a month as a special self-care ritual. The texture is cool, gel-like, and refreshing to the touch. It begins opaque and slowly turns translucent as it delivers hydration to the skin. The scent is neutral and fragrance-free. I loved this mask as it delivers a spa-like treatment in the comfort of your home. It not only hydrates and softens but leaves the skin looking and feeling refreshed and naturally radiant. I genuinely love it and would recommend it to anyone looking to enhance their skincare regimen with a powerful yet relaxing treatment. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

Title: A must have
ReviewText:
Skincare is personal, and finding a face mask that truly delivers noticeable results can feel like finding gold. After weeks of using the Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, I’m ready to say it’s one of the most effective sheet masks I’ve tried, especially for hydration, firmness, and glow.

As someone who deals with occasional dryness and dullness (especially after long workdays or late nights), I’m always on the lookout for skincare products that work fast and don’t irritate my sensitive skin. The Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask immediately caught my attention because of its rich ingredient profile: marine collagen, botanical extracts, and hydrating compounds that claim to replenish skin at a deep level. So I gave it a try and honestly, I’m impressed.

Author: Kattbrooke56
Title: Meh
ReviewText: There is some things I like about this mask, but just several reasons why I do not think this will be part of my normal routine. First, I wish they would have warned that this mask is extremely easy to rip/tear. You have to be super careful not to destroy it as you opened it and put it on. I do absolutely love that there are separate sections for top and bottom. It makes it fit so much better. The fact that you have to leave it on for so long makes it really hard to use very often. I do not sleep on my back so wearing it at night isn't on the table. Its also next to impossible to try to eat while wearing it. The chin of mine broke so it was just dangling. This might be a nice addition to a spa night but for regular use I just don't think I would chose this type of mask.

Author: shrky001
Title: Collagen
ReviewText: The mask is a thick, gel like substance that adheres well to the skin. Application is easy and mess free, which is always a plus. After cleansing, I applied the mask and left it on over night . I experienced a pleasant cooling sensation during this time, and the mask stayed in place without slipping also dried up in place very well Once the time was up, I gently peeled off the mask and was immediately impressed. My skin looked noticeably more hydrated, plumper, and had a healthy glow. Fine lines appeared softened, and my complexion looked more even. The effects weren't just visual my skin felt incredibly soft and supple to the touch. What sets this mask apart is its long-lasting hydration. Title: disappointed
ReviewText:

BIODANCE 바이오 콜라겐 리얼 딥 마스크는 꿈의 제품입니다. 그것은 실제로 제품이 광고한 것과 같은 효과를 내는 내 스킨케어 루틴에 저렴한 가격으로 추가된 것입니다. 밤새 마스크를 사용한 후 피부가 촉촉하고 탱탱하며 고급스러운 느낌을 받았습니다. 내가 일반적으로 스포츠하는 평소의 피곤한 엄마 모습이 아니라 가르치고 이슬 맺힌 것입니다. 마스크를 적용하는 것은 나에게 약간 어색했습니다. 이는 절대적으로 사용자 오류일 수 있습니다. 나는 단단한 마스크를 적용하는 데 익숙하지 않습니다. 두 부분으로 구성되어 있으며 섬세합니다. 찢어진 부분이 있었지만 쉽게 제자리에 고정하고 마스크를 착용한 채 밤새 편안하게 쉬었습니다. 그러다가 오늘 아침에 그것은 바로 벗겨져 아름다운 이슬 맺힌 모습을 드러냈습니다. 솔직히, 이렇게 빨리 장바구니에 제품을 추가한 적은 없었습니다!

BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask is a dream product; it’s an affordable addition to my skincare routine that actually did what the product advertised.
