Author: Chassie0315
Title: This will be a staple in my daily skincare routine
ReviewText:
Upon receiving this mask, I was very excited to give it a try. I followed directions before applying the mask. I will say, I was not happy with how it felt and how it was a little bit a nuisance removing the clear plastic from the mask. The mask is VERY delicate, so you have to be care removing it from the packaging.

After removing the mask from the package, I applied it on my face. I left it on for four hours. The instructions recommend you either sleep with it (and there was no way I could have done that) or leave on for three to four hours. I was very impressed on how the mask dried to a skin like product. It felt smooth and no longer sticky after the four hours.

When I took the mask off, I was impressed with how supple my skin looked. It gave me an instant plumping effect. That makes this product a 5 star product in my opinion. 

There was barely no scent, which I was happy about.

I will be ordering more of these masks. That is how much I loved it.

Author: ahenson24
Title: Smooth  and Glowing Skin!
ReviewText:
This was the first time using the Biodance product.  I really enjoyed the experience.  At first I wasn't sure how I would like the feel of the mask on my skin. But the hydrogel formula of the weighted collagen and hyaluronic acid provides a very soothing, refreshing and cooling sensation.  I have sensitive skin and it was not irritating to my skin.  I was able to sleep soundly with the mask on and I left it on for about 3 hours until the mask turned transparent and absorbed into the skin.  The mask came in two halves, the top half that covered the fore head, high cheek bones and nose and then a lower half covering the chin and cheeks.  It was very easy to appy and the instructions were easy to follow. After taking off the mask my skin felt smooth in certain areas and also it was a little clammy on my cheeks. My skin was glowing and even toned and texture and no redness, but appeared bright and hydrated.

I loved the placement of this sheet mask on my face. There were two cutouts: one covering the forehead, eyes, and nose, and the second covering the lower cheek, lips, and chin area. It also came with two under-eye patches and a lip mask.

I definitely recommend all my girlies to give this mask a try.

Author: ccindie
ReviewText: I wore the mask for about 4 hours during the day, as recommended, and my skin definitely felt softer and looked more radiant afterward. I really liked how it gradually turned transparent, which was a cool way to tell it was done working. That said, the results didn’t last beyond the next morning. I was hoping to see more of a difference in elasticity or fine lines because of the collagen, but after just one use, the main benefit was a boost in hydration and I didn’t notice a big difference beyond temporary moisture. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

Author: Candacerae09
Title: Biodance Collagen Sheet Mask
ReviewText:
The Biodance Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask for Pore  Minimizing and Firming Care is SUCH a great sheet mask for anyone wanting to feel luxurious and make their skin look and feel supple. Super inexpensive and such a nice add on to your skin care routine for an extra bit of hydration. Sheet masks are the best for this purpose because they hold the concentrated serum in so your skin can have optimal absorption. 

After cleansing my skin at night, I apply my regular serum and let that absorb. Then I use the Biodance sheet mask to really seal in the hydration and give me a firmer look and feel to my skin. It's so fun to see it turn from white to clear, but I do prefer to wear them overnight (or as long as possible into sleeping!) so I can make sure to get all the benefits of this mask!

This product was received as part of an educational promotion.

Author: awalcutt
Title: Lovvvvve this
ReviewText: As a woman obsessed with skin care, I absolutely love finding a good face mask. I recently tried the Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask. I’ve heard it’s the latest craze so I was absolutely thrilled to try it. Now, I’ve never tried an overnight mask before and I absolutely can’t stay still while sleeping so I went the daytime route of wearing for a few hours. Application was super easy although the mask feels a bit fragile. I used the eye and mouth pieces for my neck. It did finally tear slightly about 2 hours in when I went to itch my nose. It’s very comfortable to wear while preforming basic household chores. I laid back and binge watched some tv while it worked its magic. For the end result, my skin felt absolutely amazing. This was probably the best face mask I’ve ever used. My skin felt firmed and hydrated. It’s quite pricey and not a miracle fix-all, but I definitely recommend using as a treat for your skin.

Author: chiamseyy
Title: A must-have for deep hydration and glow!
ReviewText:
The Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask delivers a spa-like experience in just one use. The bio-cellulose sheet clings perfectly to the skin and doesn’t slip or dry out. I wore it for 30 minutes, and it stayed moist and soothing the entire time.

By the end of the session, my skin felt noticeably plumper, firmer, and deeply moisturized. There was no stickiness left behind, just a bouncy, refreshed finish. I love how the collagen-rich essence absorbed quickly and gave my skin a glowy boost that lasted well into the next day. I love that it comes individually packed and is perfect for travel, just toss one in your carry-on for a hydration boost mid-flight or post-jetlag recovery. I do this a few times during my long haul flights and they are amazing! Cooling and hydrating.

There’s also plenty of leftover essence to apply to the neck and chest. It’s a self-care favorite I’ll definitely be repurchasing!

Author: laurenhoman
Title: Love this mask!
ReviewText: This face mask was absolutely wonderful to use. It went on easily and stayed on, which is rare for me when it comes to a sheet mask. The longer the better I suppose. 10/10 definitely recommend this sheet mask!!!

Author: jingleshark
Title: Great for a night in!
ReviewText: If you’re planning a cozy night in, the Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask is the perfect skincare companion. This ultra hydrating, two-piece mask offers a luxurious selfcare experience..just make sure you have 3 to 4 hours to spare, because that’s how long it takes to fully dry. The mask comes soaked in essence and feels incredibly soothing when applied. It’s made of a delicate gel material that tears easily, so handle with care. I found that the nose flap was a little too long, but a simple fix - folding it up and layering the cut out pieces for the eyes to keep it secure. As it dries, the mask becomes transparent and tightens slightly, giving a second-skin effect. Despite the long wear time, it remains comfortable throughout. I didn’t experience any irritation. The results are instantly visible. After peeling it off, my skin looked plumper, smoother, and noticeably more hydrated. I would definitely recommend and I will be buying another one for my next selfcare night.

Author: KatieDawn1988
Title: Great product, but lacking in practicality.
ReviewText: I'm currently much closer to forty than I'd like to be and with that in mind, I love trying things to help my skin look and feel great. I love that this mask is full of so many wonderful, high-quality ingredients like niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, collagen peptides, and centella asiatica. My skin felt quite wonderfully soft and looked very happy and glowy after using the mask. I feel that it really did help to reduce inflammation and hydrate. I also liked that it didn't leave any sticky residue while also not slipping around once it was on. The only downsides are that the mask can be torn fairly easily and I do have long nails so that was something of a small concern, the other, more prominent issue for me though is the length of time that it needs to be left on, four hours was quite a commitment and not one that I could do very often. I would recommend this mask to anyone looking for some serious self-care.

Author: valesimosa
Title: My Skin Loved This
ReviewText: I honestly didn’t expect to love this mask as much as I did, but it feels amazing on the skin. I used it after coming back from a beach vacation, three days straight under the sun, and my skin was feeling dry and tired. The mask had this cooling, soothing effect that felt incredible, like exactly what my skin needed. I left it on for a little over four hours and when I took it off, my face looked noticeably plumper and more hydrated. The serum is rich, super hydrating and not sticky at all. It absorbs beautifully. I’ve tried a lot of masks and this one definitely stands out. Just be gentle when applying it, since the sheet is delicate and can tear with your nails. But once it’s on, you feel that refreshing effect right away. I’m a big fan of sheet masks, and this is officially in my top 3. I totally recommend it.

Author: melbprado
Title: Glowy skin
ReviewText:
As someone with combination skin, I’m always looking for skincare that hydrates without clogging pores — and this mask really impressed me! The Biodance Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask is a highly concentrated gel-type mask, and I used it overnight for a serious hydration boost.

The texture is super soothing and cooling, and by morning, the mask had turned almost transparent — a sign my skin had absorbed all the nutrients. I woke up with hydrated, plump, glowy skin, and I noticed a slight improvement in my pores as well. I especially love that it contains niacinamide (a must-have for me), low-molecular collagen for firmness, and Oligo Hyaluronic Acid for deep hydration. 

My only downside was the gel texture — while it feels great on the skin, it made the mask a little tricky to handle. I accidentally tore it slightly while unfolding, so I’d recommend being extra gentle when applying.

Still, the results were worth it, and I’m definitely planning to keep using it to see more long-term benefits. If you’re looking for a hydrating overnight treatment with pore-refining benefits, this one is a great pick!

Author: Heidisheartmade
Title: First step to glass skin
ReviewText: As a medical aesthetician I’m honestly not a fan at all of sheet masks. Most are to be quite honest total crap. It’s like toilet paper soaked in random liquid that has holes that don’t line up correctly on your face. I did really enjoy this one though. It was better fitting than most I’ve tried in the past including medical grade ones. Obviously your skin is only capable of absorbing so much topically so leaving it on for an extended period of time really does nothing extra. I didn’t feel like I needed to adjust it much or feel like it was falling off all the time. I did have to trim the piece at the end of the nose because it was too short and it kept flapping when I breathed and it was driving me crazy. Otherwise it was overall a good experience.

Author: Makeuploverlex
Title: Overall uncomfortable
ReviewText: I was so excited to try this mask as I have heard alot about it. When I first applied it, I immediately had a very cooling sensation. After that subsided, it was more of a burning feeling all over my skin. It was very uncomfortable. I’m not typically sensitive to skincare products. I considered taking it off shortly after but wanted to see the after results. I left it on for a few hours, and took it off in the middle of sleep. It was a little weird putting it on at first and making sure it stayed in place, but it did stick to my face better after awhile. When I looked at my skin in the morning, it was more glowy and hydrated. If that’s what you are looking for and you aren’t sensitive to products, you might really love this. I personally wouldn’t try this again.

Title: Ended up working

Author: pinkyy32790
ReviewText: This was my first time ever using a face mask like this before. I've never used Biodance nor have i ever used korean skin care so this was a great opportunity for me to do so. Before I opened the face mask I decided I was going to wear it while I slept since it said to do so for more optimal results. The application was fairly easy but if your not careful you will rip the mask. The mask had no smell, it was very jelly feeling but it did remind me of the same smell that slime had that we use to play with as kids. It smells exactly like slime lol. After applying my mask my face felt nicely cool and avigorated. The product/mask didn't burn, but i felt it "doing its magic" if that makes sense. However, i found it somewhat difficult to get comfortable going to bed with it on my face but I still managed and was able to fall asleep lying on my back. Early in the morning I took it off and I immediately noticed a difference in my skin. The product definitely absorbed extremely well into my pores and my face felt wonderfully hydrated. I also saw a small difference on the size of my pores. I then took a shower and washed my face. Now hours later my face still feels wonderfully soft and hydrated. I've even noticed again a second time in the difference of my pores, their appearance are smaller and definitely look minimized. The mask was definitely a nice pick me up for my face to boost hydration and brighten up my skin and make it look less dull. I'd definitely buy from this brand again. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

Author: iqraa1
Title: amazing mask!
ReviewText: The Biodance Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask for Pore Minimizing & Firming Care truly delivers on its promises for a spa-like experience at home. From the moment you apply it, the mask adheres beautifully to the skin with a jelly-like texture that feels cooling and deeply hydrating. It’s soaked in essence—without being drippy—and hugs the contours of the face, making it ideal for staying in place while multitasking or relaxing. After just one use, my skin looked noticeably smoother, pores appeared tighter, and there was a subtle lift in my cheek and jaw area. What stands out most is how plump and firm my skin felt afterward, without any stickiness. Packed with collagen and skin-loving ingredients, this mask is a go-to for anyone looking for immediate radiance and long-term firming care. It’s perfect before events or as a weekly treat in a skincare routine.

Title: Soft hydrated skin
ReviewText: I really enjoyed using this Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask. It was easy to apply. Although I did need to adjust the bottom half a few times to get it just right. Otherwise it was very easy to use. I liked the thick gel like texture ofvthe mask. The white color fades to a clear one once the product is absorbed into the skin. I left the mask on overnight. Title: Love this one !
ReviewText: This was such a nice experience!  I definitely prefer for sheet masks to be in a hydrogel or gel like form. I enjoy them more for some reason, maybe because they are less messy and more form fitting and stay put . This one is even better than the average hydrogel mask .  I really like that it’s a two piece mask as well. I first applied the lower half from my upper lip to my jawline and then I added the top half . The way it just hugged my skin and stayed put is so nice !  No dripping serum anywhere . It just feels smooth, cool, and hydrating . This one is also different because you leave it on way longer than your average mask and hours after wearing it , it starts to dry and disappears as the gel turns clear . I felt like it helped to add some plumpness and overall hydration but I can’t really say much for the pores after one use. I think the nice experience was the most appealing part . I already have a 4 pack in my cart . I loved this but I didn’t wear mine to bed.  I want to try again and wear it overnight. I definitely recommend this one . Pop it in the fridge and then throw it on after a day in the sun .

Title: Super moisturizing but tears easily.
ReviewText: The good first- Biodance Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask for Pore Minimizing & Firming Care is super moisturizing.  The mask is very cooling and has a nice light scent.  I wore it for 4 hours during a heat wave and it felt very nice on.  Once I took it off my skin felt moisturized and refreshed. It had a nice smooth look.  The not so good- The mask is very hard to handle and tears easily.  I have used many sheet masks previously. My nails are manicured short. I peeled the mask pieces off the film and poked two holes in them. When I was applying the top part and adjusting it the middle V area tore a little as well.  As I said, I wore it for 4 hours as recommended. During that time I yawned and the side of the mouth tore a little. t is also recommended to sleep in. I believe it would be very hard unless you sleep on your back, as the mask is fragile and can tear at the slightest movement. All in all I would purchase this mask because I like the feel and results. I know I would have to extremely careful handling it. Author: jenihoover
Title: Glow for the day
ReviewText:
I used this mask one time and liked it. What I noticed was plump, hydrated, glowing skin. It lasted a few hours. I didn’t notice any difference in how my skin would normally be the next day. I think these masks are great for special event/photo prep. 
The sheets are really thick, and stay in place fairly well. They are not drippy like thin sheet masks. The 2 piece feature is nice, but the nose doesn’t get a good fit. They got some tears when I tried to reposition it. Not any sort of miracle product, but among the top three I’ve tried.
Note: I received this product in exchange for an honest review.

Title: Poreless Dreams Wrapped in Collagen
ReviewText:
This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review. 

Absolutely OBSESSED is an understatement! The BIODANCE Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask has completely transformed my self-care nights into a spa-level experience. 💆‍♀️💖

From the moment I opened the pack, I was met with the most subtle, calming scent—fresh, clean, and luxuriously delicate, like a soft floral breeze. The texture of the mask is incredibly unique—gel-like, bouncy, and drenched in essence without being drippy. It hugs every contour of my face like a second skin, not slipping or drying out too fast. ✨

The application is seamless—cooling and soothing from the first touch, instantly calming redness and tired skin. After 20 minutes, my skin felt plump, firm, and visibly smoother—especially around my cheeks and nose, where pores tend to show the most. The pore-minimizing effect is real—my skin looked filtered, but IRL!

What really sets this apart is how my skin stays hydrated and glowy even hours later—no stickiness, just that "I drink water and mind my business" radiance. ☁️💧

This is more than a mask—it’s a moment of joy, a deep breath for your skin, and a gentle reminder to love on yourself. 💕

Author: Radhs13patel16
Title: Hydrating mask
ReviewText:
I was genuinely impressed by this mask! Unlike typical sheet masks, it’s made of a hydrogel material that adheres beautifully to the skin. As it dries, it slowly becomes clear — which is surprisingly satisfying to watch. I left it on for about three hours (yes, really!) and afterward, my skin felt incredibly plump, smooth, and intensely hydrated. My pores looked more refined, and there was a visible glow to my complexion.

This isn’t your everyday mask — it feels more like a skin rescue treatment or something you’d reach for before a big event. Packed with collagen, niacinamide, and fermented ingredients, it delivers a nourishing and soothing experience that feels truly luxurious.

A couple of things to note: the mask is on the delicate side and can tear if you're not careful when applying it. And if you have oily or acne-prone skin, I’d recommend patch testing first, just to be safe.

All in all, this is a gorgeous self-care treat that gives fast, noticeable results. I’ll definitely be keeping a few in my skincare stash for those times when my skin needs an extra boost!

Author: amber8622
Title: A must have
ReviewText: The first thing I noticed with this mask is that it comes in 3 separate pieces making it very easy to apply. It feels very thick and luxurious to the touch. The directions say to use over night or a minimum of 3 to 4 hours and since I'm not a very light sleeper I opted for the 4 hours on my day off. The mask adhered perfectly to my skin and didn't feel slippery or move around like other masks can tend to do. It felt cooling and refreshing to my skin which I really enjoyed, especially since right now there's a heat wave occurring. It didn't ever dry out and felt moisturizing. The mask transforms from pale pink to translucent when it's done which I felt like was a very neat and unique feature. After raking off I couldn't believe how hydrated, plump, and dewy my skin felt. I also noticed the fine lines which I'm starting to see appeared alot less noticeable. It gave me a "glassy" and also baby fave like look to my complexion. I really enjoyed this mask and recommend to others.  I definitely plan on tryimg others out from this brand and this one again as well. I'm happy I recieved it as a product for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

Author: mehraj
Title: Worth it
ReviewText:
As someone with naturally dry skin, I’m super picky when it comes to sheet masks — most just sit on top of my skin without actually doing much. But the Biodance Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask honestly surprised me in the best way.

The mask was drenched in essence (like, fully soaked), and the material felt soft and high quality — not flimsy like some cheaper ones. It hugged my face really well and didn’t slide off even when I was sitting upright, which is always a plus.

Right when I applied it, I felt this calming, cooling sensation that instantly relieved the tight, dry feeling I’d had all day. I left it on for 20 minutes, and when I took it off, my skin drank up the leftover essence like water. No stickiness, no residue — just smooth, bouncy hydration. I genuinely felt like my skin had been reset.

The combo of low molecular hyaluronic acid, collagen, and probiotics makes it feel like more than just a quick-fix — my skin looked noticeably plumper, more radiant, and way more comfortable. Even the next morning, it still felt hydrated, which is rare for me.

If you have dry, flaky, or tight-feeling skin — especially from weather or over-exfoliating — this mask is a gem.

마스크는 에센스가 흠뻑 젖어 있었고(완전히 흠뻑 적셔진 것처럼), 재질은 저가 제품처럼 허술하지 않고 부드럽고 고급스러운 느낌을 주었습니다. 얼굴을 정말 잘 안아주고 똑바로 앉아 있어도 미끄러지지 않는 게 항상 장점이에요.

바르는 순간 하루 종일 답답하고 건조한 느낌이 즉각적으로 해소되는 차분하고 시원한 느낌이 들었습니다. 20분 정도 방치하고 떼어내니 피부가 남은 에센스를 물처럼 흡수해버렸어요. 끈적임도 없고 잔여물도 없습니다. 부드럽고 탄력 있는 수분 공급이 가능합니다. 정말 피부가 리셋된 기분이었어요.

저분자 히알루론산, 콜라겐, 프로바이오틱스의 조합은 단순한 빠른 수정 이상의 느낌을 줍니다. 피부가 눈에 띄게 더 통통해지고, 더 빛나고, 훨씬 더 편안해 보였습니다. Even the next morning, it still felt hydrated, which is rare for me.

특히 날씨나 과도한 각질 제거로 인해 피부가 건조하고 벗겨지거나 당기는 느낌이 있는 경우 이 마스크는 보석입니다.

Author: esbritom
Title: A new staple in my routine!
ReviewText:
This mask surprised me in the best way. From the first use, my skin felt super soft and looked more plump the next morning. The texture is creamy but not too heavy,it spreads nicely and absorbs well without leaving a sticky feeling.

What I really loved is how refreshing it feels on the skin. The cooling sensation is subtle but so soothing, especially after cleansing at night. It makes the whole experience feel like a mini spa moment.

I have combo skin that leans dry, and this really gave me that deep hydration I’ve been looking for. The scent is very light, almost unnoticeable, which I appreciate because I’m sensitive to strong fragrances.

My skin looks glowy and feels calm, especially after long days or when I’ve been out in the sun. Definitely a new staple in my routine!

Author: SammyRaeh89
Title: A must try!
ReviewText: I’ve tried a lot of sheet masks, but the Biodance Bio Collagen Face Mask truly stands out. The mask fits comfortably, although it was a little tricky to get on. After using it, my skin instantly feels more hydrated, plump, and smooth. The collagen really seems to give my skin a firmer, more youthful look, and there’s no sticky residue left behind—just soft, glowing skin. I also love that it's fragrance-free and gentle on sensitive skin. I only used it once and I've noticed a visible improvement in my skin's elasticity and overall radiance. I had it on for about 4 hours and when I woke up the next day my fiance said my face was glowing. It's a little more expensive than other masks, but the results are worth it. Author: jocelyn711
Title: not worth it
ReviewText: I was really looking forward to trying this Bio Dance mask, especially after hearing so much hype about it. Unfortunately, my experience was quite underwhelming. Right from the first use, I noticed that the material felt very thin and delicate, which immediately had me questioning its durability. That concern was proven right when the mask tore easily, which definitely not what you’d expect at this price point. In terms of results, I kept hoping my skin would feel more hydrated or look smoother after one use, but honestly, I didn’t see or feel much of a difference. My skin looked the same before and after. Given that it’s marketed as a premium product, I expected noticeable improvements or at least a more luxurious feel. Overall, I wouldn’t recommend this mask if you want something that’s going to hold up well or produce visible results. There are far better options out there for the money.

Author: Jaydeegee13
Title: Firming and Soothing
ReviewText:
Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask
 
*I was gifted only one sample so my review was based on that experience*

*My mask was damaged on during the mailing process but it still worked.

It has a sticky texture and as it dries it starts to firm up. I didn't feel any noticeable differences in my skin other than being a bit more moisturized.

I would recommend refrigerating your mask prior to using as the mask itself is very delicate and has a rice paper texture that almost melts to the touch.

Would I use this mask again ?

I think I would like to try it more than the one time to give it a more fair chance/ review. It does feel very soothing and deeply moisturizing.

Before using the mask my skin was a little dry due to the summer weather we have been experiencing lately with the mask I did notice a mild difference but I would not rely solely on the mask for hydration.

After using the mask my skin did have a glow to it and did feel a bit firmer. I followed up with my usual skin care routine and it took a while to absorb it. 

In terms of fine lines and wrinkles I think it's still to early to tell and would have to use the mask more times to give a more in depth review but  it's not bad for the one use.


Overall the mask is good , I would to try it out more to give it a more in depth review . Based on this experience I would recommend it to those who are avid skin care enthusiasts.

ReviewText_ko:
바이오 콜라겐 리얼 딥 마스크
 
*샘플을 1개만 선물받았기 때문에 그 경험을 바탕으로 리뷰를 작성했습니다*

*우편 과정에서 마스크가 손상되었지만 여전히 작동했습니다.

끈적한 질감이 있고, 건조되면서 단단해지기 시작합니다. 피부가 좀 더 촉촉해진 것 외에는 눈에 띄게 달라진 점을 못 느꼈어요.

마스크 자체가 매우 섬세하고 라이스 페이퍼 질감을 갖고 있어 손에 닿으면 거의 녹는 느낌이 들기 때문에 사용 전 마스크를 냉장 보관하는 것이 좋습니다.

이 마스크를 다시 사용할 수 있을까요?

좀 더 공정한 기회/리뷰를 제공하기 위해 한 번 이상 시도해보고 싶다고 생각합니다. 정말 진정되고 깊은 보습이 느껴집니다.

마스크를 사용하기 전에는 최근 마스크 사용으로 겪고 있는 여름 날씨로 인해 피부가 약간 건조했습니다. 약간의 차이를 느꼈지만 수분 공급을 마스크에만 의존하지는 않을 것입니다.

마스크 사용 후 피부에 윤기가 나고 좀 더 탄탄해진 느낌이 들었습니다. 나는 평소의 스킨 케어 루틴을 따랐고 그것을 흡수하는 데 시간이 걸렸습니다. 

잔주름이나 주름에 관해서는 아직 말씀드리기는 이르고, 마스크를 여러 번 사용해 보아야 더 심도 있게 리뷰할 수 있을 것 같지만, 한 번 사용하기에는 나쁘지 않습니다.


전반적으로 마스크는 괜찮습니다. 좀 더 사용해보고 좀 더 심층적인 리뷰를 드리고 싶습니다. 이 경험을 바탕으로 나는 열렬한 스킨 케어 매니아들에게 그것을 추천하고 싶습니다.

ReviewText: It’s giving glass skin. I was a little skeptical when I was reading the instruction and it said to sleep in the sheet mask for best results. I peeled it off after waking up to it being transparent, just the description says. It starts off very moist and white and I’m assuming the white is the product that is going to absorbed into the skin. Once it adheres into place it’s pretty on. I as surprised. The first thing I noticed was the glow to my skin after peeling it off. Elasticity feels nice as well. As a licensed esthetician, I’ve tried many sheet masks and this one may be the new favorite just because it acts as an overnight mask as well. Minimum leave on time is 3-4 hours.

ReviewText:

It’s especially effective after a long day or before a special occasion when my skin needs a boost.

Definitely a new step in my beauty routine

Author: BettyGray01
Title: Boost of moisture
ReviewText:
I recently tried the Biodance BioCollagen Real Deep Mask, and it stands out against all of the other mask I’ve tried. The mask is easy to apply, well soaked with serum, fits the face comfortably without sliding around.  I was really impressed at how well it stayed in place considering it’s a much longer wear.  This isn’t the typical 15-20 minute mask.  This mask requires a long wear of 3-4 hours for the serum to soak into the skin.  This makes the mask feel more like a skin treatment session than a skin refresh.  The mask once fully absorbed turns clear.  This is great to know when it’s fully completed absorption. 
After I removed the mask, my skin looked more plump and hydrated with an overall smoother appearance.  The only downside I experienced after using was my skin felt more oily than usual afterward, especially in the T zone.  If you do t mind a little extra shine and want a boost of moisture then this is the mask for you!

Author: tammeyg
Title: Easily applied & Felt great.
ReviewText:
This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

Upon opening the package, I was pleasantly surprised to find there was absolutely no smell or scent to the product. It was well-packaged, and the mask peeled easily from a thick plastic liner. The design features two separate pieces—one for the upper face and one for the lower—making application more convenient and customizable.

The mask itself is thick, gel-like, and saturated (but not dripping wet), which made it easy to apply. While adjusting the mask around my eyes, it did tear slightly in a couple of areas, but overall it remained intact and comfortable. It’s recommended to wear for at least three hours or even overnight. Personally, I found it unrealistic to wear it while sleeping, as it would likely fall off, but I did make it to the three-hour mark.

After use, the mask dried to a nearly transparent film and peeled off easily with no residue left behind. I didn’t feel the need to rinse my face afterward. My skin felt noticeably hydrated and refreshed. As for fine lines or wrinkle reduction, I didn’t observe much change after just one use—but that’s to be expected. I believe consistent, weekly use would provide more visible results over time.

All in all, I would recommend the BioDance Real Deep Collagen Face Mask for anyone looking to boost hydration and treat themselves to a self-care skincare moment. I’d likely purchase it myself to incorporate into my skin routine.
ReviewText_ko:
본 상품은 프로모션 목적으로 제공받은 솔직한 후기입니다.

패키지를 열어보니 제품에 냄새나 향이 전혀 없어서 깜짝 놀랐습니다. 잘 포장되어 있었고 두꺼운 플라스틱 라이너에서 마스크가 쉽게 벗겨졌습니다. 이 디자인은 윗면과 아랫면을 위한 두 개의 개별 부품으로 구성되어 있어 적용이 더욱 편리하고 사용자 정의가 가능합니다.

마스크 자체는 두껍고, 젤 같은 느낌이며, 포화 상태(물이 떨어지지 않음)로 되어 있어 바르기가 쉽습니다. 눈 주위 마스크를 조정하는 동안 몇 군데가 약간 찢어졌지만 전체적으로는 손상되지 않고 편안했습니다. 최소 3시간 또는 밤새 착용하는 것이 좋습니다. 개인적으로는 자고 있을 때 착용하면 떨어질 가능성이 높아 비현실적이라고 생각했지만, 3시간 정도 착용할 수 있었습니다.

사용 후 마스크는 투명에 가까운 필름으로 건조되었으며 잔여물 없이 쉽게 벗겨졌습니다. 나중에 세수할 필요를 못 느꼈어요. 피부가 눈에 띄게 수분을 공급받고 상쾌해지는 느낌을 받았습니다. 잔주름이나 주름 개선에 관해서는 1회 사용만으로는 큰 변화가 느껴지지 않았습니다. 하지만 이는 예상할 수 있는 일입니다. 나는 일관되게 매주 사용하면 시간이 지남에 따라 더 눈에 띄는 결과를 얻을 수 있다고 믿습니다.

전체적으로 수분 공급을 강화하고 셀프 케어 스킨케어 순간을 즐기고 싶은 모든 분들에게 BioDance Real Deep Collagen 페이스 마스크를 추천하고 싶습니다. 내 피부 루틴에 포함시키기 위해 직접 구매할 것 같습니다.

Author: weezyw
Title: Easy to apply
ReviewText:
I am in my late 40’s so have skin that is starting to show its age. I have a few fine lines around my eyes and forehead. 

This Biodance Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask comes in two pieces, one for around your mouth and one for the upper half of your face. You are advised to set aside 3-4 hours to get all the benefits of this mask, or use it overnight. 

This is a gel mask that is fairly simple to apply. I don’t find that it tore when applying. It did stick to my skin easily and it didn’t slide off like I thought it might. It felt quite slimy at first, but I got used to it and settled in to relax while wearing it. I love that after a couple of hours it changes color. 

Once I removed the mask my face felt refreshed, hydrated and clean. I didn’t feel like I needed to wash my face after removing the mask. My skin looked a little smoother and brighter. The effects lasted around 24 hours. I can see me applying this type of mask once a week to boost my complexion. 

I really like that this is fragrance free and paraben free as well as being cruelty free.

Author: Brownsugar4
Title: BIODANCE Face Mask Review
ReviewText:
I recently tried the BIODANCE Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask, and wow—my skin did not come to play. I was genuinely surprised by how refined and snatched my skin looked after just one use.

From the second I opened the pack, the mask felt luxe—super saturated, cooling, and fit like a second skin (no slipping around while multitasking). As someone with visible pores and a goal of firmer, smoother skin, I’m always skeptical of “firming” claims. But this mask? It delivered.

After 20 minutes, I peeled it off and instantly noticed tighter pores, a lifted feel, and that juicy, plump look. Like I just walked out of a facial. My makeup even went on smoother the next day—less texture, more glow.

Bonus points for being gentle, fragrance-free, and perfect for sensitive skin days. I’ll definitely be keeping this in my weekly skincare rotation.

If you’re looking for something that feels spa-level at home and gives real results, I highly recommend giving this mask a try. Your skin will thank you.

Author: Prettyparo
Title: A luxurious skin treat that delivers results
ReviewText:
As someone with combination skin that's prone to enlarged pores and occasional dullness, I am always on the lookout for a sheet mask that does more than just hydrate. The Biodance Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask has genuinely impressed me; it feels like an at-home facial in a single use.
First off, the mask itself is made from a unique bio-cellulose material that adheres beautifully to the skin. It hugs every contour of my face like a second skin, allowing the essence to absorb more effectively. No slipping or sliding, just a spa-like fit.
The essence is rich but not greasy, with a soothing, almost serum-like texture. After 20–30 minutes of wear, my skin looked visibly plumper and more refined. What really surprised me was how much smoother my pores appeared, especially around my nose and cheeks. My skin felt firmer yet deeply hydrated, like it had taken a long drink of water but also received a lifting boost.
I’ve used this mask before events and photoshoots, and each time it gives me that glow-from-within finish. It layers well under makeup, too, with no pilling or stickiness. I also appreciate that it’s formulated without harsh ingredients, making it suitable for my sensitive skin.
Final Verdict: This mask has become my go-to for instant firming and pore care. If you’re dealing with skin fatigue, enlarged pores, or just want to give your complexion a refined, hydrated boost, this one’s worth the splurge. I have already repurchased, and I rarely say that about masks!

Author: Rubyrosee0227
Title: Hydrating and plumping!
ReviewText:
I was really impressed by this mask. The texture is different from typical sheet masks. It’s a hydrogel that clings nicely to the skin and gradually turns clear as it dries, which is actually really satisfying to see. I kept it on for about three hours and afterward my skin felt plump, smooth, and deeply hydrated. My pores looked more refined and my complexion had a noticeable glow.

This feels more like a special occasion or skin rescue mask rather than something I would use regularly. I love that it contains collagen, niacinamide, and fermented ingredients. It feels soothing, nourishing, and luxurious. My only small complaint is that the mask is a bit fragile and can tear if you are not gentle. Also, if you have oily or acne-prone skin, it might be smart to patch test first.

Overall, it is a lovely self-care treat that delivers fast results. I will definitely keep a few in my skincare stash for when my skin needs a boost.

Author: heathernickole
Title: Worth the Wait—My Skin Looked So Good After This!
ReviewText:
I’ve tried a lot of sheet masks, but the Biodance Collagen Sheet Mask is in a league of its own. Unlike typical masks you leave on for 15–20 minutes, this one is designed to stay on for three to four hours—and trust me, it’s worth every minute. The material is super thin and breathable, so it doesn’t feel heavy or irritating at all. I wore it while working from home, and it stayed in place beautifully the entire time.

I’ll be honest—I did notice a small hole in mine when I opened it, but it didn’t affect the performance at all. The mask still delivered insane hydration and left my skin looking smooth, firm, and glowing. Fine lines looked softer, and my face felt plump and refreshed. No sticky residue, just results. It honestly felt like I had just gotten a facial. I’ve already repurchased. If you’re serious about skincare, this one’s a keeper.

Author: andreaspiek
Title: A Nice Face Mask
ReviewText:
I had this recommended to me by my friends and I heard good things about it but didn’t know what to expect. It’s my first sheet mask remotely like this. First it comes in two pieces which can be tricky, but ultimately is better because then it can flatter in the face. Then it is a hydrogel mask, so it has this slippery silicone feel - but it doesn’t slide off the skin while applying it. I didn’t have any problem with it tearing like some other people have. Last, I put it on before bed thinking it was a 15-20 min face mask. Well shame on me, because it’s a 4 hour mask. So I went to sleep in it. I sleep pretty hard so I didn’t notice it. But I did wake up 5 hours later, saw the time and peeked it off and tossed it on the floor and went back to sleep. When I got up a few hours later, my skin was so well hydrated and dewy. Even my husband commented how noticeable the results are, and he thought it was going to be gimmicky. And I put the mask on fresh clean skin, no other product applied first.  The results last only through the day of course, maybe a little the next day too. I like the mask and would get it again, but I’d probably just use it before events.

text_for_model: I had this recommended to me by my friends and I heard good things about it but didn’t know what to expect. It’s my first sheet mask remotely like this. First it comes in two pieces which can be tricky, but ultimately is better because then it can flatter in the face. Then it is a hydrogel mask, so it has this slippery silicone feel - but it doesn’t slide off the skin while applying it. I didn’t have any problem with it tearing like some other people have. Last, I put it on before bed thinking it was a 15-20 min face mask. Well shame on me, because it’s a 4 hour mask. So I went to sleep in it. I sleep pretty hard so I didn’t notice it. But I did wake up 5 hours later, saw the time and peeked it off and tossed it on the floor and went back to sleep. When I got up a few hours later, my skin was so well hydrated and dewy. Even my husband commented how noticeable the results are, and he thought it was going to be gimmicky. And I put the mask on fresh clean skin, no other product applied first. The results last only through the day of course, maybe a little the next day too. I like the mask and would get it again, but I’d probably just use it before events. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review,

Author: Janenna
Title: Radiant skin
ReviewText: This mask has become my bestie after first use. It delivers amazing results after one use and I have to admit I’m impressed with the results and quality of this product. It’s a simple process, if you use regular face masks, you shouldn’t have problems using this one, it takes time but it’s absolutely worth it. The product/ essence on the mask absorb well into the skin leaving it soft, radiant and smooth. The mask changes color from white to transparent and which indicates time to take it off. What you’ll get might shock you, plumber, glass skin, just like in TikTok videos which stays for days, not just one day. I was beyond amazed by the results, how my skin was clear and refined, and toned after one use. This is one product that makes a huge improvement and difference in your overall skin appearance without any issues or irritation. I find the ingredients very effective and gentle and suitable for even sensitive skin conditions. Overall, a great product that delivers outstanding results that it promises and a must have product for anyone looking for better, clearer and radiant results.

Author: mellyosaurus
Title: delivers on firmness, tricky to sleep in
ReviewText:
I used the mask overnight. It felt very soothing to apply. I had it in the fridge because it's been very hot outside lately. I did find it hard to sleep in, and it's not practical for 3-4 hours of wear. I am a side sleeper, so that added to the difficulty. This morning, I removed the mask before I woke up as it felt sticky. I checked the mirror and my skin felt and looked tighter and smoother. My skin felt too tight for my personal preference, so I applied moisturizer. 
The ingredients seem solid, but it ripped easily with my gel nails. I'd love it if it were a washable or absorbent one without the sheet!

Author: Pinkdiscoball77
Title: Biodance Gives The Glass Skin I’ve Always Wanted
ReviewText: Hello my name is Michele and I’m a Beauty Expert in my 30’s with fair, sensitive, combination skin. The Biodance Bio Collagen-Real Deep Facial Sheet Mask is a unique hydrogel luxury mask. I’ve never used a mask that required me to wear it for three to four hours or that I could even wear overnight. I ended up wearing it for three hours because that’s when the mask turned transparent and I knew that the ampoule was fully absorbed into my skin.  I love how this sheet mask is unscented and does not irritate my sensitive skin. The texture of this sheet mask is a hydrogel mask texture. This mask is formulated by solidifying a 1.19 ounce bottle of highly concentrated ampoule into a sheet mask. The ampoule is infused with Ultra-Low Molecular Weight Collagen and Hyaluronic Acid to help make your skin more firm, to hydrate the skin and to help form a moisture barrier for the skin. Adenosine and Galactomyces Ferment Filtrate help firm the skin and it boosts skin elasticity.  This beautiful formulation helps to improve resiliency and to replenish skin’s moisture. After using this mask my skin is so beautiful, moisturized, plump and shiny like glass. This is the dream glass skin I’ve been waiting for! Use this mask at the end of your skincare routine after you have cleansed, toned and put serum on your skin. Pro tip use the eye and mouth cutouts on areas that need extra care like your eyelids, or lower chin. The beauty of this mask is there is no need to clean your skin after using it and it’s mess free. Excuse me while I stock up on some more. I would recommend this to anyone 25 and older with all types of skin from normal, dry, combination, oily and even sensitive skin who are looking for a long-lasting sheet mask that will give you beautiful glass skin while also hydrating your skin, leaving your skin plump and soft, minimizing the appearance of pores and leaving skin more bouncy and elastic. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review

Author: bterrible
Title: Not Practical but Effective
ReviewText:
This mask made my skin feel great. It is loaded with great, high quality ingredients, like loww-molecular-weight collagen peptides, hyaluronic acid, niacinamide and centella asiatica. It helps to hydrate, plump and reduce inflammation in the skin, and it did deliver. My skin visibly looked and felt amazing.

The cons are that the mask is not very durable, and did tear upon application. The other con, is that it is advised to wear for 4-5 hours. There are so many fast acting and result delivering masks out there, that this feels like a big ask. While I did follow the instructions, and wear it as recommended for results, I don’t think I can budget this kind of commitment on a regular basis.

Title: My skin looked renewed and fresh!
ReviewText: I tried Biodance’s Bio Collagen- Real Deep Mask and the results are pretty amazing! Author: Rosanniera
Title: Game-Changer for Pores and Elasticity
ReviewText:
I’ve tried so many masks for hydration and firming, but the Biodance Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask is truly on another level. The texture is a luxurious gel that feels super soothing the moment you apply it. After just one use, my skin looked noticeably smoother, pores appeared smaller, and I had this healthy, radiant glow.

What really impressed me is the ultra-low molecular collagen — it actually absorbs deeply instead of just sitting on top of my skin. Plus, the Oligo Hyaluronic Acid gives a serious moisture boost, making my skin feel plump and refreshed. The Galactomyces added that extra touch of brightness and refinement to my overall complexion.

I especially love that it targets fine lines, pores, and dullness all at once — it’s like an instant facial in a mask.

If you’re struggling with visible pores or your skin is feeling dull or saggy, this is definitely worth adding to your routine. Highly recommend!

Author: estefaniamo
Title: Nice and relaxing
ReviewText: As a beauty enthusiast, fashion blogger, and someone passionate about mental health, I love using skincare products as a special treat to relax. This face mask has everything I need. On this special occasion, I used the Bio Collagen Real Deep Mask, which contains probiotics, galactomyces ferment filtrate, and low-molecular hyaluronic acid and collagen solutions that help hydrate my skin. It reduces pores and improves elasticity. I love that you apply this mask and leave it on for at least three hours to allow your skin to absorb all the nutrients. During this time, you can read a book, meditate, or even sleep with the mask on. You know it's working because it turns transparent, making it really easy to take care of yourself. After using it, your skin will look and feel more glowing and soft. The results are almost immediate.

Title: Very nice mask
ReviewText: This collagen face mask from Biodance is something I was so looking forward to trying out especially since I love a lot of K-beauty products and have initially tried their collagen gel toner pads on my own. This mask has a specific set of instructions which I carefully followed by using a toner and serum and then placing the top half, middle and, bottom half on my face. Author: OpalPearl
ReviewText: This Biodance Bio Collagen - Real Deep Mask is an overnight mask which does mean it either needs to be used overnight, or you should set aside three hours to use it. Since I cannot sleep on my back, I wasn’t sure about the logistics of sleeping with it on, so I instead used it for three hours in the evening. It’s a gel mask which feels cooling and comfortable, and it comes in two separate halves which allows it to fit smoothly on your face with minimal wrinkles and folds. It’s also cool that it turns fully transparent when it’s done, which is a clear indicator that you can remove it. By the time its finished, it turns into a thin clear almost plasticky consistency, but it still felt comfortable on my face the whole time. I like that you can use it daily if you want, but since I don’t wear it overnight, I would only use it once a week. After using it, I did feel that my skin felt smoother and more hydrated. I didn’t notice a huge difference with my pores after one use, but I would imagine greater results with more consistent and long-term usage.

Author: ahahahhahahah
ReviewText: I had high hopes for the Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, especially after seeing so many positive reviews about its deep hydration and firming effects. After using it a few times, I have mixed feelings. Pros: ✅ Super hydrating – My skin definitely felt plumper and more moisturized after using it. It’s a great option for long flights or when my skin feels extra dry. ✅ Good fit – The hydrogel texture sticks well to my face and doesn’t slide around like some sheet masks do. ✅ Packed with skincare benefits – It contains niacinamide (great for brightening) and collagen (for skin elasticity), which are always a plus in my book. Cons: ❌ Feels a bit suffocating – Since it’s a hydrogel mask, it has a slightly occlusive feel, and after an hour or so, my skin started feeling a bit oily instead of refreshed. ❌ Fragile material – The mask is very soft and jelly-like, but also quite delicate. I accidentally tore a piece when adjusting it with my nails. ❌ Long wear time – It’s designed to be worn for 3–4 hours, which is way longer than most masks. While this might be great for people who like extended skincare routines, I don’t always have that much time to spare. Would I repurchase? Maybe for travel. I can see this being useful for long-haul flights when I want something hydrating that lasts. However, for everyday use, I prefer a mask that feels lighter and doesn’t require such a long wear time. If you love hydrogel masks and don’t mind a long treatment session, you might really enjoy this one. But if you prefer quick and breathable hydration, this might not be the best choice.
ReviewText_ko: 저는 바이오댄스 바이오 콜라겐 리얼 딥 마스크에 대한 기대가 컸습니다. 특히 깊은 수분 공급과 퍼밍 효과에 대한 많은 긍정적인 리뷰를 보고 나서 더욱 그랬습니다. 몇 번 사용하고 나면 여러 가지 감정이 듭니다. 장점: ✅ 뛰어난 수분 공급 - 사용 후 피부가 확실히 더 통통해지고 촉촉해지는 느낌이 들었습니다. 장거리 비행을 할 때나 피부가 더욱 건조하다고 느낄 때 아주 좋은 옵션입니다. ✅ 밀착력 좋음 – 하이드로겔 텍스처가 얼굴에 잘 달라붙고 일부 시트 마스크처럼 미끄러지지 않습니다. ✅ 스킨 케어 혜택이 가득 – 내 책에서 항상 플러스로 여겨지는 나이아신아미드(미백에 좋음)와 콜라겐(피부 탄력에 좋음)이 함유되어 있습니다. 단점: ❌ 약간 답답한 느낌 - 하이드로겔 마스크라서 약간의 밀착감이 있고, 1시간 정도 지나면 피부가 산뜻한 느낌보다는 약간 오일리한 느낌이 들기 시작했어요. ❌ 깨지기 쉬운 소재 – 마스크는 매우 부드럽고 젤리 같지만 매우 섬세합니다. 손톱으로 조정하다가 실수로 조각이 찢어졌습니다. ❌ 긴 착용 시간 – 대부분의 마스크보다 훨씬 긴 3~4시간 동안 착용하도록 설계되었습니다. 확장된 스킨케어 루틴을 좋아하는 사람들에게는 이것이 좋을 수도 있지만, 항상 여유 시간이 그렇게 많지는 않습니다. 재구매할까요? 아마도 여행용일 겁니다. 지속되는 수분 공급을 원할 때 장거리 비행에 유용하다는 것을 알 수 있습니다. 하지만 일상생활에서는 사용감이 가벼우면서 착용시간도 그리 오래 걸리지 않는 마스크를 선호합니다. 하이드로겔 마스크를 좋아하고 긴 치료 세션에 신경 쓰지 않는다면 이 마스크를 정말 좋아할 것입니다. 그러나 빠르고 통기성이 좋은 수분 공급을 선호한다면 이것이 최선의 선택이 아닐 수도 있습니다.

Author: carissacarissa
Title: Left my skin feeling super soft and hydrated!
ReviewText: I’ve always heard a lot of hype about Biodance’s face masks and how great they are for your skin. I was super excited to try them out for myself after a stressful week that left my skin feeling more dry than normal. The sheer mask consists of two different parts one which is for the top part of your face and nose and the other which covers the jaw area. I like this design as it really makes sure you cover the full area of your face unlike other sheet masks. With this mask you’re supposed to leave it on until the sheet dries completely, so I left it on for over an hour and a half and let it really seep into my skin. My skin felt sooooo soft afterwards and I definitely noticed a big difference in the days after using it! Highly recommend!

Author: liquorwithlove
Title: Wonderful for a facial mask
ReviewText: I used this Biodance mask overnight as suggested, and I was pleasantly surprised by how well it performed. The texture is a thick, bouncy gel that initially feels cool and hydrating on the skin. It spreads easily without tugging, and despite being quite concentrated, it absorbs beautifully. By morning, the mask had completely soaked into my skin, leaving behind no stickiness or residue—which is rare for gel-type sleeping masks. My skin felt noticeably plumper and softer when I woke up. It also looked more even-toned and radiant. The biggest change I noticed was in how smooth my skin felt, particularly around areas where pores tend to look more noticeable (like the sides of my nose). The mask gave me that subtle, “well-rested glow” effect without causing any irritation or congestion. There’s a light, clean scent to it—barely noticeable, and it didn’t linger or bother me during the night. I really appreciated how breathable it felt too; even though it’s a hydrating mask, it didn’t suffocate my skin or feel heavy. This is a great overnight mask if you’re looking to boost hydration, improve skin texture, and get that “glass skin” effect by morning. It feels luxe, but without being too rich or greasy—perfect for dry to normal skin types. I’ll definitely be keeping this in rotation, especially on nights when my skin needs a little extra care.

Title: Fun and effective
ReviewText: I tried this as an overnight mask, and while it works beautifully, I did find it a little uncomfortable to sleep in. That way, it has time to really melt into your skin while you’re still awake, and by the time it’s fully working its magic, you’re already drifting off. My husband tried it too, and it was fun to watch! It starts as a sheet mask that looks a little creepy at first, but within about three hours, it turns practically clear, leaving your skin looking smooth and shiny—just like glass. Definitely a cool product if you’re looking for that glass skin effect!

ReviewText:

It does exactly what it’s supposed to do and leaves a nice healthy glow on my skin. Worms really well with makeup too. I also never experienced any breakouts. 

Just be careful with the bottle, I dropped it and now it doesn’t mist anymore but only squirts.
ReviewText_ko:
피부가 너무 건조한 경우 스킨케어 단계 사이에 사용하고 메이크업 위와 아래에 수분을 공급하기 위해 이 스프레이를 받았습니다. 캐나다 겨울에 살고 있는 건조한 여드름 피부를 가진 사람으로서 이 스프레이가 바로 그 소녀라고 말할 수 있습니다. 

그것은 해야 할 일을 정확히 수행하고 내 피부에 건강하고 건강한 빛을 남깁니다. 벌레는 메이크업에도 정말 잘 어울립니다. 나는 또한 어떤 탈주도 경험하지 못했습니다. 

병을 조심하세요. 떨어뜨렸는데 이제는 더 이상 안개가 튀지 않고 분출만 됩니다.

Author: itsfi
Title: Hydrates & refreshes while providing a soft glow
ReviewText:
I purchased the mist directly from the brand and have been reaching for it at least a few days each week for the past 9 weeks.

TL:DR: A fine, light mist that hydrates & refreshes skin while providing a soft glow. 

WHAT I LIKE:
* Very fine, light mist
* Pump is easy to use - no jamming, clogging
* Feels hydrating, refreshing, great especially as a midday pick-me-up
* Perks up skin - adds hydration, doesn't make skin look oily or greasy
* Surprisingly more compact than it looks (but see below)
* The white packaging & shape help it stand out from my other products & from the other Rhode skincare products
* Adds a soft glow
* Can be used to help give a little more slip to thicker makeup products (concealer, etc.), which helps them blend easier
* Good year round
* Great hydrating ingredients

AREA(S) FOR IMPROVEMENT:
* Would love to be able to see how much product remains/has been used
* Being nit picky here, the cap, while cute, could be less bulky

FYI:
* Remember to shake before use
* Gives a soft glow (I don’t personally get a “next level glow” as claimed; it’s a more of a brightened, illuminated complexion)
* Fragrance free (and unscented)
* Can be used on the body as well (but I have not yet tried that)
* Price-wise, there are more budget-friendly mists available (and more expensive ones, for that matter). I've not tried ones comparable to Rhode and cannot make a direct comparison. 

BUY, BUY, BUY 🛍️ or BYE-BYE 👋🏼?
* I have a handful of mists in my rotation and am not in need of another one, but based solely on performance, I would (and have) repurchased another one of these from Rhode. BUY 🛍️
ReviewText_ko:
저는 해당 브랜드에서 미스트를 직접 구입했으며 지난 9주 동안 매주 최소 며칠씩 미스트를 구입해 왔습니다.

TL:DR: 피부에 수분을 공급하고 상쾌한 느낌을 주는 동시에 부드러운 광채를 선사하는 미세하고 가벼운 미스트입니다. 

내가 좋아하는 것:
* 아주 미세하고 가벼운 미스트
* 펌프는 사용하기 쉽습니다. 막힘이나 막힘이 없습니다.
* 수분을 공급하고 상쾌한 느낌을 주며 특히 한낮의 기분 전환에 좋습니다.
* 피부에 활력을 줍니다 - 수분을 공급하고 피부를 기름지거나 번들거리게 만들지 않습니다.
* 보기보다 놀라울 정도로 컴팩트합니다(단, 아래 참조).
* 흰색 포장과 모양은 내 다른 제품 및 다른 로드 스킨케어 제품과 구별되는 데 도움이 됩니다.
* 은은한 빛을 더해줍니다
* 두꺼운 메이크업 제품(컨실러 등)에 좀 더 미끄러움을 주어 더 쉽게 블렌딩하는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다.
* 일년 내내 좋은
* 뛰어난 보습성분

개선 분야:
* 제품이 얼마나 남았는지/사용했는지 확인하고 싶습니다.
* 여기서는 까다롭기 때문에 모자는 귀엽지만 부피가 덜할 수 있습니다.

참고:
* 사용 전 꼭 흔들어주세요
* 부드러운 빛을 발합니다. (저는 개인적으로 주장하는 "다음 단계 빛"을 얻지 못합니다. 더 밝고 빛나는 안색입니다)
* 무향료(무향)
*바디에도 사용 가능합니다(아직 사용해본 적은 없습니다)
* 가격면에서 더 예산 친화적인 미스트가 있습니다(그리고 더 비싼 미스트도 있습니다). 나는 Rhode와 비슷한 것을 시도한 적이 없으며 직접적인 비교를 할 수 없습니다. 

구매, 구매, 구매 🛍️ 또는 작별 인사 👋🏼?
* 내 로테이션에 미스트가 몇 개 있고 다른 미스트가 필요하지 않습니다. 하지만 성능만 보고 Rhode에서 미스트를 하나 더 구매하고 싶습니다. 구매하세요 🛍️

Author: valenciiaa
Title: A Must Try
ReviewText:
I absolutely love the Rhode Glazing Milk! As someone with oily skin, I’m always cautious about hydrating products, but this mist is a game-changer. It’s super lightweight yet incredibly hydrating, leaving my skin feeling refreshed and balanced—never greasy. The fine mist is so soothing, and it gives my complexion a healthy, dewy glow without clogging my pores.  

I use it throughout the day for a quick pick-me-up or as part of my skincare routine, and it layers beautifully under makeup. Highly recommend to anyone, especially my fellow oily-skinned friends looking for the perfect hydration boost! 10/10 would repurchase!

Title: Great product
ReviewText: I’ve been using Rhode products since they launched and have tried everything except for the lip contours. Even though it’s a celebrity brand, I think the quality is good.  This mist is no exception. It’s nice and fine (similar to the glow recipe watermelon mist in this regard). I like to use it partway through the day to refresh my makeup and skin.  However, it’s really nice anytime you want to be refreshed and get a little hydration. I didn’t find it to cause any skin issues. I do have perioral dermatitis and occasional hormonal breakouts and this mist didn’t make either of those conditions worse.

Author: krissy0909
Title: A must have
ReviewText:
Where has this mist been all my life? As someone with gorgeous deep brown skin (shoutout to the melanin queens!), finding a hydrating mist that actually *works* without leaving a weird white cast or sticky residue is like finding gold. Rhode You struck GOLD with  
1.  **INSTANT RADIANCE BOOST:** Spritz this on, and within SECONDS, my skin looks awake, plump, and has this *healthy*, juicy sheen. No more dullness or ashy patches! It literally melts them away. Dehydration lines? Gone. It gives that 'lit-from-within' glow that darker skin tones wear SO beautifully.  
2.  **ZERO WHITE CAST, ZERO STICKINESS:** Seriously, it disappears like magic. Pure, weightless hydration. No chalky film, no greasy feel – just dewy, supple perfection. Perfect under makeup or over it for a refresh!  
3.  **CALMING & EVENING:** My skin can be sensitive and prone to hyperpigmentation. This mist feels incredibly soothing – like a cool, tropical breeze on a hot day. I swear it helps calm any redness.

**How I Use It:**  
*   **Morning Wake-Up:** First thing after cleansing for an instant hydration hit.  
*   **Pre-Makeup Prep:** Creates the perfect dewy canvas.  
*   **Makeup Setting/Refresh:** Spritz lightly over makeup (let it fall onto skin) for a fresh, non-cakey finish midday.  
*   **After Sun/Post-Workout:** Instant cool-down
ReviewText_ko:
내 평생 동안 이 안개는 어디에 있었나요? 화려한 짙은 갈색 피부를 가진 사람으로서(멜라닌 여왕에게 고함!), 이상한 흰색 캐스트나 끈적한 잔여물을 남기지 않고 실제로 *효과가* 있는 수분 공급 미스트를 찾는 것은 금을 찾는 것과 같습니다. 로드 당신은 금을 달성했습니다  
1. **인스턴트 래디언스 부스트:** 이것을 뿌리면 몇 초 만에 피부가 깨어나고 통통해지며 *건강하고* 촉촉한 광채가 납니다. 더 이상 칙칙함이나 칙칙함은 없습니다! 그것은 말 그대로 그들을 녹입니다. 탈수 라인? 다 쓴. 어두운 피부 톤이 아름답게 빛나는 '내부에서 빛나는' 광채를 선사합니다.  
2. **화이트 캐스트 0, 끈적임 0:** 정말 마법처럼 사라집니다. 순수하고 무게감 없는 수분 공급. 백악질의 필름도 없고 기름진 느낌도 없습니다. 촉촉하고 부드러운 완벽함만 느껴집니다. 메이크업 아래에도, 위에도 상쾌하게!  
3. **진정 및 저녁:** 제 피부는 민감하고 색소침착이 잘 발생하는 경향이 있습니다. 이 안개는 마치 더운 날의 시원한 열대 바람처럼 믿을 수 없을 정도로 마음을 진정시켜줍니다. 나는 그것이 발적을 진정시키는 데 도움이된다고 맹세합니다.

**사용 방법:**  
* **아침 기상:** 즉각적인 수분 공급을 위해 클렌징 후 가장 먼저 해야 할 일입니다.  
* **메이크업 전 준비:** 완벽하게 촉촉한 캔버스를 만듭니다.  
* **메이크업 세팅/새로고침:** 메이크업 위에 가볍게 뿌리면(피부에 떨어지도록) 정오에 산뜻하고 끈적임 없이 마무리됩니다.  
* **일요일 후/운동 후:** 즉시 쿨다운

Author: KylaGanote
Title: Glass skin finish
ReviewText:
I’ve tried a lot of facial mists, but this one is in its own league. The Rhode Glazing Mist gives my skin that fresh, lit-from-within glow without feeling sticky or greasy. The mist itself is super fine with no harsh droplets, and it layers beautifully under or over makeup. I’ve been using it both as a prep step before skincare and as a mid-day refresh, and it instantly revives my complexion.

The hydration lasts for hours, and I love that it makes my skin look plump and smooth rather than just “wet.” Bonus: it has a subtle, clean scent that feels spa-like but disappears quickly.

If you want a healthy, glass-skin finish without heavy oils or residue, this is worth the hype.
ReviewText_ko:
저는 많은 페이셜 미스트를 사용해 보았지만 이것은 그 자체의 리그에 속합니다. 로드 글레이징 미스트(Rhode Glazing Mist)는 끈적임이나 기름기 없이 피부에 신선하고 빛나는 광채를 선사합니다. 미스트 자체는 미세한 물방울 하나 없이 매우 미세하며, 메이크업 위나 위에도 아름답게 레이어링됩니다. 스킨케어 전 준비 단계와 한낮의 리프레시 용도로 사용했는데, 피부가 즉각적으로 생기를 되찾아줍니다.

수분 공급은 몇 시간 동안 지속되며, 피부가 단순히 "젖은" 것이 아니라 통통하고 부드러워 보이는 것이 마음에 듭니다. 보너스: 스파 같은 느낌이 들지만 빨리 사라지는 미묘하고 깨끗한 향이 있습니다.

중유나 잔여물 없이 건강한 유리 피부 마감을 원한다면, 이 제품은 과대 광고할만한 가치가 있습니다.

Author: itsfi
Title: Performance 5 ⭐️; scent strength/longevity 3.5 ⭐️
ReviewText:
I’ve used this hand sanitizer at least once a day (usually more) for the past week and a half. 

WHAT I LIKE:
* Touchland hand sanitizers generally leave my hands clean and hydrated without feeling  sticky or greasy. That remained the case with this Gingerbread scented hand sanitizer.
* Soft, not overwhelming gourmand scent with a holiday feel to it - subtle mix of sweet & spicy with its gingerbread, cinnamon & vanilla notes (but see below) 
* Good & practical design - sleek, lightweight & portable, fits easily in purse or pocket, travel friendly, doesn't leak
* The mist that is dispensed with each spritz is nice - not too overpowering.
* Absorbs/dries quickly
* No sticky, tacky or filmy residue

AREA(S) FOR IMPROVEMENT:
* With some of the newer, limited edition scents, I've noticed more of an alcohol smell with the first half dozen or so sprays. Not sure why this is the case as I've never had this issue with the permanent scents. 
* Would be great if these were refillable (without compromising how well the design keeps product from leaking).
* To my nose, this is a very soft, fleeting scent; I wouldn't mind if all the notes were stronger.
* The scent on this doesn't last as long as the permanent scents or the other limited edition ones. Would like to have the scent linger longer. 

FYI:
* Limited edition seasonal scent. New scent for 2025. Once it's sold out, that'll be it, until next year if they bring it back.
* This scent can be purchased individually or as part of a trio of limited edition seasonal scents that includes spiced pumpkin-tini & peppermint mocha - the set does not include the salted caramel scent. 
* Makes a nice gift.

BUY, BUY, BUY 🛍️ or BYE-BYE 👋🏼?:
* While this Gingerbread isn't my favorite scent among the limited edition seasonal collection, I like it enough to pick up another of these if I finish it before the end of the year (and if it's still around). It’s also one I would purchase as a gift for others. BUY 🛍️
ReviewText_ko:
저는 지난 일주일 반 동안 이 손 소독제를 하루에 한 번 이상(보통 그 이상) 사용했습니다. 

내가 좋아하는 것:
* 터치랜드 손 소독제는 일반적으로 끈적임이나 기름기 없이 손을 깨끗하고 촉촉하게 해줍니다. 진저브레드 향이 나는 손 소독제의 경우에도 마찬가지였습니다.
* 부드럽고 과하지 않은 향으로 휴일 느낌을 줍니다 - 진저브레드, 시나몬, 바닐라 향과 달콤함과 매콤함이 은은하게 혼합되어 있습니다(아래 참조). 
* 훌륭하고 실용적인 디자인 - 세련되고 가볍고 휴대성이 뛰어나며 지갑이나 주머니에 쉽게 들어가고 여행에 적합하며 누출되지 않습니다.
* 분출할 때마다 나오는 미스트는 너무 강하지 않고 좋습니다.
* 빠르게 흡수/건조됩니다.
* 끈적거리거나 끈적거리거나 필름 같은 잔여물이 남지 않습니다.

개선 분야:
* 일부 최신 한정판 향기의 경우 처음 6개 정도의 스프레이에서 알코올 냄새가 더 많이 나는 것을 발견했습니다. 영구 향수에 대해 이런 문제가 발생한 적이 없기 때문에 이것이 왜 그런지 잘 모르겠습니다. 
* 리필이 가능하다면 좋을 것입니다(제품 누출을 방지하는 디자인이 얼마나 잘 유지되는지를 손상시키지 않고).
* 내 코에는 매우 부드럽고 덧없는 향기입니다. 모든 음표가 더 강해도 괜찮습니다.
* 이 제품의 향은 퍼머넌트 향이나 다른 한정판 향에 비해 오래 지속되지 않습니다. 향이 오래도록 남아있기를 바라요. 

참고:
* 한정판 계절 향기입니다. 2025년을 위한 새로운 향기입니다. 일단 매진되면 내년까지 다시 가져오면 그대로 유지됩니다.
* 이 향은 개별적으로 구매하거나 매콤한 호박티니와 페퍼민트 모카가 포함된 한정판 계절 향 3종으로 구매할 수 있습니다. 세트에는 솔티드 카라멜 향이 포함되어 있지 않습니다. 
* 좋은 선물이 됩니다.

구매, 구매, 구매 🛍️ 또는 작별 👋🏼?:
* 이 진저브레드는 시즌 한정 컬렉션 중 제가 가장 좋아하는 향은 아니지만, 연말 전에 다 끝내면(그리고 아직 남아 있다면) 또 하나 고를 만큼 마음에 듭니다. 다른 사람들에게 선물로 구매하고 싶은 제품이기도 합니다. 구매하세요 🛍️

Would like to have the scent linger longer. FYI: * Limited edition seasonal scent. New scent for 2025. Once it's sold out, that'll be it, until next year if they bring it back. * This scent can be purchased individually or as part of a trio of limited edition seasonal scents that includes spiced pumpkin-tini & peppermint mocha - the set does not include the salted caramel scent. * Makes a nice gift. BUY, BUY, BUY 🛍️ or BYE-BYE 👋🏼?: * While this Gingerbread isn't my favorite scent among the limited edition seasonal collection, I like it enough to pick up another of these if I finish it before the end of the year (and if it's still around). It’s also one I would purchase as a gift for others. BUY 🛍️

Title: Overly scented, overpriced for what it is

Title: Best EVER

These are just the perfect on the go hand sanitizers! They come out as a fine mist and smell AMAZING. My favorite scents are beach coco (smells like a pina colada) and mango passion (smells like real fresh fruit). Some of them have a slight alcohol scent but those two don’t at all. If you’re on the fence about these, seriously just get it! Or don’t, because then nothing else will compare and you’ll forever have to pay to replenish these lol.

Author: JoswysMama
Title: My 9 year olds Christmas and birthday wish.
ReviewText: I 9 year old daughter is in love with all things Sephora, which I am too but I’m 37. lol She is obsessed with these rich kids that have parents give the $500 to spend in Sephora then they do a Haul video on YouTube. Therefore she knows all the product names and what each is for. Even though she had never even stepped in a Sephora before. For Christmas her list was specific items from Sephora. One item was this Touchland hand sanitizer that was only $10. So I said alright I can do that, and she is the most grateful child and Money conscious fourth grader you could imagine. To watch her open that hand sanitizer on Christmas Day was one of the high of her day and made me so happy seeing her get her touch land.

Title: Don’t waste your money! I found a dupe
ReviewText: I think we can all agree that $10 is just outrageous for a hand sanitizer. I did get this for Christmas so I wanted to give it a fair chance. But it’s not worth it. It’s such a light mist that you have to spray quite a bit to get your hands wet enough to kill germs. I don’t think people realize, you really need to cover your hands with this product and rub them together really well in order to kill germs. I’ve seen so many people do a couple sprays and rub their hands once. That’s not doing anything. This is pretty much a glorified hand fragrance. Don’t waste your money because the clock app aesthetic influencers have you thinking you need this. In fact, if you are in the US, five below the discount store, has a dupe. I actually bought some of those to compare. The packaging is the same, the container is the same shape, and there are some fun scents. My favorite is the pineapple. It smells like a pineapple lifesaver candy! And the five below product sprays more of a wet mist so you can actually get your hands clean.

Author: kmb7800
Title: Touchland Rainwater Scent
ReviewText:
This sanitizer is good value, even though it looks bit fancier and is more expensive than the typical drugstore hand sanitizer.  One spray bottle lasts a while, although a spritz or two isn’t enough to cover a pair of hands.  Personally, I need at least 4 spritzes per application.  Even so, it still lasts a good number of weeks, depending on usage.

The Rainwater scent is fresh but can be overpowering.  Coming from using alcohol sprays with the smell dissipating after a while, the Touchland sanitizer smell seems to last hours.  It may or not may not be a good thing, depending on how one handles scents.  As far as effectivity is concerned, the back of the case indicates that its active ingredient is “Alcohol 70% v/v”, which is usual for commercial hand sanitizers.

The best thing about the sanitizer though is its packaging.  It’s easy to stash, not just because of its size, but because of its shape.  Because it’s angular and not circular like most spray bottles, it’s easier to find space for it and tuck it in corners, or even pockets.  

Would definitely purchase again but perhaps will try the unscented version next time.
ReviewText_ko:
이 소독제는 일반적인 약국 손 소독제보다 좀 더 고급스러워 보이고 가격도 비싸지만 가치가 좋습니다.  한 개의 스프레이 병은 꽤 오래 지속되지만 한두 개의 스프레이만으로는 두 손을 덮을 수 없습니다.  개인적으로 저는 응용 프로그램당 최소 4개의 스프릿츠가 필요합니다.  그럼에도 불구하고 사용량에 따라 여전히 몇 주 동안 지속됩니다.

빗물 향은 신선하지만 압도적일 수 있습니다.  알코올 스프레이를 사용하고 시간이 지나면 냄새가 사라지면서 터치랜드 소독제 냄새는 몇 시간 동안 지속되는 것 같습니다.  향기를 어떻게 다루느냐에 따라 좋을 수도 있고 아닐 수도 있습니다.  유효성에 관해서는 케이스 뒷면에 활성 성분이 상업용 손 소독제에 일반적으로 사용되는 "알코올 70% v/v"임을 나타냅니다.

살균제의 가장 좋은 점은 포장입니다.  크기 때문만이 아니라 모양 때문에 보관하기 쉽습니다.  대부분의 스프레이 병처럼 원형이 아니고 각진 형태이기 때문에 공간을 찾기가 더 쉽고 모서리나 주머니에도 넣을 수 있습니다.  

꼭 다시 구매할 의향이 있지만 다음번에는 무향 버전을 시험해 볼 것 같습니다.

Author: BriTucson
Title: Unimpressed
ReviewText:
Hi. I only write reviews if something is exceptionally good or exceptionally bad. This product, by and large, is the latter, unfortunately. 

I don't know how this has so many good reviews (I guess if you filter by non-incentivized and verified purchase, there aren't, but that's my mistake).

The one good thing about this product seems to be that it isn't drying. I wouldn't call it "hydrating"; any product with alcohol likely won't be. 

I've tried four (4) scents and the only one I like is the salted caramel. It's very strong, but I think it is warm and caramelly-smelling. That being said, my husband hates it and says it smells like cotton candy.

The vanilla blossom literally smells like OFF! (the insect repellent). I used dish soap to get the scent off because it was offensively bad. 

The beach coco smells like chemical coconut. It smells like coconut, if coconut were made in a laboratory, alongside sugar alcohols.

Had high hopes for the spiced pumpkin-tini, which when dry only smells like mild cinnamon. It's not bad, but it'd be more accurate to just call it "cinnamon". 

Quite bold of this brand to charge $10 a bottle for this quality. I don't know if I'll bother to return it and may just give it away. Won't be repurchasing.
ReviewText_ko:
안녕하세요. 저는 뭔가가 아주 좋거나 아주 나쁜 경우에만 리뷰를 씁니다. 이 제품은 아쉽게도 후자입니다. 

좋은 리뷰가 얼마나 많은지 모르겠습니다(인센티브가 없고 검증된 구매로 필터링하면 없는 것 같지만 그건 제 실수입니다).

이 제품의 좋은 점은 건조함이 없다는 점인 것 같아요. 나는 그것을 "수분 공급"이라고 부르지 않을 것입니다. 알코올이 함유된 제품은 그렇지 않을 것입니다. 

나는 네 가지 향을 시험해 보았지만 내가 좋아하는 유일한 것은 솔티드 카라멜이었습니다. 굉장히 강하지만 따뜻하고 캐러멜 향이 나는 것 같아요. 그런데 남편은 그것을 싫어하며 솜사탕 냄새가 난다고 합니다.

바닐라 꽃은 말 그대로 OFF 냄새가 나요! (벌레 퇴치제). I used dish soap to get the scent off because it was offensively bad. 

해변 코코는 화학적 코코넛 냄새가 납니다. 코코넛이 실험실에서 당알코올과 함께 만들어지면 코코넛 냄새가 납니다.

건조하면 순한 계피 냄새만 나는 매운 호박티니에 대한 기대가 컸습니다. 나쁘지는 않지만 그냥 '계피'라고 부르는 것이 더 정확할 것 같습니다. 

이 품질에 대해 한 병에 10달러를 청구하는 이 브랜드는 매우 대담합니다. 귀찮게 반품하고 그냥 버릴 수도 있을지 모르겠습니다. 재구매는 하지 않을 예정입니다.
text_for_model: Hi. I only write reviews if something is exceptionally good or exceptionally bad. This product, by and large, is the latter, unfortunately. I don't know how this has so many good reviews (I guess if you filter by non-incentivized and verified purchase, there aren't, but that's my mistake). The one good thing about this product seems to be that it isn't drying. I wouldn't call it "hydrating"; any product with alcohol likely won't be. I've tried four (4) scents and the only one I like is the salted caramel. It's very strong, but I think it is warm and caramelly-smelling. That being said, my husband hates it and says it smells like cotton candy. The vanilla blossom literally smells like OFF! (the insect repellent). I used dish soap to get the scent off because it was offensively bad. The beach coco smells like chemical coconut. It smells like coconut, if coconut were made in a laboratory, alongside sugar alcohols. Had high hopes for the spiced pumpkin-tini, which when dry only smells like mild cinnamon. It's not bad, but it'd be more accurate to just call it "cinnamon". Quite bold of this brand to charge $10 a bottle for this quality. I don't know if I'll bother to return it and may just give it away. Won't be repurchasing.

Title: Touchland Power Mist: Luxe Apple Scented Clean
ReviewText: Touchland Power Mist in Appleicious is the hand sanitizer you’ll actually look forward to using! The hydrating formula leaves hands soft, not dry, and the sleek, pocket-sized bottle is perfect for on-the-go spritzing. At 67% alcohol, it’s got all the germ-fighting power you need. Author: pattcr22
Title: Not Sanitizing
ReviewText: I don't think people understand- this product smells good but if you actually want it for hand sanitizing purposes, it's most likely not doing the job. You need at least 1.1ml of Purell to kill 99.9% of germs. I contacted TouchLand about how much product is needed for the same germ kill and they just said - it depends on your hand size. So you will need to use many sprays for this to actually do anything.
ReviewText_ko: 사람들이 이해하지 못하는 것 같습니다. 이 제품은 냄새가 좋지만 실제로 손 소독 목적으로 원한다면 효과가 없을 가능성이 높습니다. 99.9%의 세균을 죽이려면 최소한 1.1ml의 퓨렐이 필요합니다. 동일한 세균 박멸에 얼마나 많은 제품이 필요한지 TouchLand에 문의했는데 그들은 단지 손 크기에 따라 다르다고 말했습니다. 따라서 실제로 무엇이든 하려면 많은 스프레이를 사용해야 합니다.

Author: RustyShacklford
Title: Decent, Just be careful
ReviewText: I am an avid user of hand sanitizers and have probably tried them all. I have them stashed everywhere. I was looking for a replacement to the Sol De Janeiro hand sanitizer they no longer make (the best)! I really like this one and it’s unique flatter packaging. However this “unique design” has a flaw when left in any sort of heat. I left this in my car, where I have 5 other bottles of other brands of spray sanitizer. This one bulged out like it was going to explode! And all the liquid leaked out of it. And I live up north, so it wasn’t even like the heat of the desert or anything. I’ve never seen anything like it! When I went to Florida for a week in the summer none of my regular sanitizers had this problem, so seems a flaw in the package design. Otherwise I like the smell and feel of this product, I am really picky with how sanitizers feel. I will just have to limit to keeping it in my purse.

Author: MJeigh
Title: No more dry hands.
ReviewText:
After the pandemic, I became a little bit of a germophobe, and I could not be without any sort of sanitizing product, particularly when going out. Due to constant sanitizing, my hands became really dry until I found Touchland Power Mist.
This product is ultra hydrating, and my hands never had any bad reactions to it. 
The compact, slim design makes it so convenient and easy to slide in any bags, purse, even pockets. 
Also, get the Berry Bliss scent it is the best!
ReviewText_ko:
팬데믹 이후 나는 약간의 세균혐오자가 되었고, 특히 외출할 때 어떤 종류의 살균 제품도 없이는 지낼 수가 없었습니다. 계속되는 소독으로 인해 손이 너무 건조해져서 터치랜드 파워 미스트를 발견하게 되었습니다.
이 제품은 수분 공급이 매우 뛰어나서 손에 나쁜 반응이 발생한 적이 없습니다. 
컴팩트하고 슬림한 디자인으로 가방, 지갑, 심지어 주머니에도 매우 편리하고 쉽게 넣을 수 있습니다. 
그리고 베리블리스 향도 최고예요!
